skills.name: Frigid Light
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Sanhua performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Sanhua consumes STA to launch attacks, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Sanhua consumes STA to perform a Mid-Air Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].

skills.name: Eternal Frost
skills.description: Sanhua sends an air blade to create 1 Ice Prism on the ground, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].

skills.name: Glacial Gaze
skills.description: Sanhua deals [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] and creates 1 Glacier.

skills.name: Freezing Thorns
skills.description: Sanhua swings her blade downward and creates 1 Ice Thorn, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].

skills.name: Silversnow
skills.description: The incoming Resonator has their Basic Attack DMG Amplified by 38% for 14s or until they are switched out.

skills.name: Tune Break: Sword
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Clarity of Mind
skills.description:
[c=Title]Heavy Attack: Detonate[/c]
When holding [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c], a cursor moves back and forth on the Forte Gauge. Release [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] while cursor falls in the "Frostbite" area, to perform Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Detonate[/c], dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
 
[c=Title]Ice Burst[/c]
Sanhua's Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Detonate[/c] detonates all "Ice Thorns", "Ice Prisms" and "Glaciers" within her attack range, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c]. [c=Highlight]Ice Burst[/c] deals Resonance Skill DMG.
 
[c=Title]Frostbite Area[/c]
The "Frostbite" area expands with every 1 stack of "Clarity". "Clarity" stacks up to 2 times.
Sanhua obtains 1 stack of "Clarity" upon performing [c=Highlight]Basic Attack 5[/c].
Sanhua obtains 1 stack of "Clarity" upon casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Freezing Thorns[/c].
Sanhua obtains 1 stack of "Clarity" upon casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Eternal Frost[/c].
Sanhua obtains 2 stack(s) of "Clarity" upon casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Glacial Gaze[/c].
Upon casting Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Detonate[/c], all "Clarity" is removed.

skills.name: Condensation
skills.description: Damage dealt by Sanhua's Resonance Skill is increased by 20% for 8s after casting her Intro Skill.

skills.name: Avalanche
skills.description: Damage dealt by Sanhua's Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Ice Burst[/c] is increased by 20% for 8s after casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack 5[/c].

sequences.name: Solitude's Embrace
sequences.description: [c=Highlight]Basic Attack V[/c] increases Sanhua's Crit. Rate by 15% for 10s.

sequences.name: Snowy Clarity
sequences.description: Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Detonate[/c] STA cost is reduced by 10. When Sanhua casts Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Eternal Frost[/c], her resistance to interruption is enhanced for 10s.

sequences.name: Anomalous Vision
sequences.description: Sanhua's damage dealt is increased by 35% against targets with HP below 70%.

sequences.name: Blade Mastery
sequences.description:
Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Glacial Gaze[/c] restores 10 Resonance Energy. 
DMG of the next Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Detonate[/c] within 5s is increased by 120%.

sequences.name: Unraveling Fate
sequences.description: Crit. DMG of Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Ice Burst[/c] is increased by 100%. Ice Creations (Ice Thorn, Ice Prism, and Glacier) will explode even if they are not detonated.

sequences.name: Daybreak Radiance
sequences.description: After an Ice Prism or a Glacier is detonated, all team members' ATK is increased by 10% for 20s, stacking up to 2 times.

skills.name: Destined Promise
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Baizhi instructs You'tan to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Baizhi continuously consumes STA to command You'tan to attack enemies, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c]. During Heavy Attack, Baizhi can command You'tan to move.
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Baizhi consumes STA and summons You'tan in mid-air to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].

skills.name: Emergency Plan
skills.description: Baizhi calls You'tan to attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] while immediately healing all characters on nearby teams.

skills.name: Momentary Union
skills.description:
Baizhi summons You'tan to heal all characters on nearby teams, generating 4 stacks of [c=Highlight]Remnant Entities[/c].
 
[c=Title]Remnant Entities[/c]
Remnant Entities follow the active team members. 1 stack(s) of [c=Highlight]Remnant Entities[/c] are automatically consumed to perform Coordinated Attacks every 2.5s, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] on hit while healing all characters of the team when the active character is within the range.

skills.name: Harmonic Range
skills.description:
When Baizhi casts Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Emergency Plan[/c], You'tan generates a field of [c=Highlight]Euphonia[/c] that lasts for 15s.
 
[c=Title]Euphonia[/c]
ATK of the Resonators who pick up Euphonia is increased by 15% for 20s.

skills.name: Tune Break: Rectifier
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Stimulus Feedback
skills.description: Baizhi's [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] on hit heals the character with the lowest HP on a nearby team by 0.25% of her Max HP.

skills.name: Overflowing Frost
skills.description: Baizhi calls You'tan to perform 1 plunging attack, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] while healing all characters on a nearby team.

skills.name: Rejuvinating Flow
skills.description: Heal the incoming Resonator by 1.54% of Baizhi's max HP every 3s for 30s. The healed Resonator has their DMG Amplified by 15% for 6s.

skills.name: Cycle of Life
skills.description:
[c=Title]You'tan[/c]
A Remnant Creature that answers to Baizhi's mind and desires while sharing all her stats. You'tan goes back to Baizhi when Baizhi dodges.
 
[c=Title]Concentration[/c]
Baizhi consumes all "Concentration" when casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] or Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Emergency Plan[/c] to continuously heal all Resonators on nearby teams. Each 1 "Concentration" consumed provides 1 healing. The healing happens every 2s.
When Baizhi consumes "Concentration" to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c], Baizhi additionally restores Concerto Energy and Resonance Energy.
When Baizhi consumes "Concentration" to cast Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Emergency Plan[/c], Baizhi additionally restores Concerto Energy.
 
[c=Title]Forte Gauge: Concentration[/c]
Baizhi can hold up to 4 "Concentration".
Baizhi obtains 1 "Concentration" for every [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] on hit.

sequences.name: Complex Simplicity
sequences.description: Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Emergency Plan[/c] additionally restores 2.5 Resonance Energy for every 1 Concentration consumed.

sequences.name: Silent Tundra
sequences.description: Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Emergency Plan[/c] increases Baizhi's Glacio DMG Bonus by 15% and her Healing by 15% if she has 4 Concentration. These effects last for 12s.

sequences.name: Veritas Lux Mea
sequences.description: Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Overflowing Frost[/c] increases Baizhi's Max HP by 12% for 10s.

sequences.name: Eternal Verity
A Wish Answered
sequences.description: If a team member is knocked out when Baizhi is alive on the team, immediately revive them and restore 100% of their Max HP. This effect can be triggered once every 10 minute(s).

sequences.name: Seeker's Devotion
sequences.description: When [c=Highlight]Euphonia[/c] is picked up, increase the Glacio DMG Bonus of all characters nearby by 12% for 20s.

skills.name: Majestic Fists
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Lingyang performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Basic Attack: Feral Roars[/c]
After Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Furious Punches[/c] is cast, [c=Highlight]Basic Attack 5[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Feral Roars[/c], dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Lingyang consumes STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Lingyang consumes STA to perform a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].

skills.name: Ancient Arts
skills.description:
[c=Title]Ancient Arts[/c]
Attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Furious Punches[/c]
When [c=Highlight]Basic Attacks 3, 4, or 5[/c] or Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Feral Roars[/c] hits the target, Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Ancient Arts[/c] is replaced with Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Furious Punches[/c].
Lingyang's [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] cycle starts from [c=Highlight]Basic Attack 3[/c] after casting Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Feral Roars[/c] and Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Furious Punches[/c] in turn.
 
Lingyang's Resonance Skill does not reset his Basic Attack cycle.

skills.name: Strive: Lion's Vigor
skills.description:
Attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], and receive the blessing of [c=Highlight]Lion's Vigor[/c].
 
[c=Title]Lion's Vigor[/c]
Lingyang gains 50% [c=Ice]Glacio DMG Bonus[/c].

skills.name: Lion's Pride
skills.description: DMG of the Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Lion Awakens[/c] is increased by 50%.

skills.name: Tune Break: Gauntlets
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Diligent Practice
skills.description: Under the Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Striding Lion[/c] state, within 3s after each [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c], the next Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Mountain Roamer[/c] will deal an additional [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], equal to 150% of [c=Highlight]Mountain Roamer[/c] DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.

skills.name: Lion Awakens
skills.description: Lingyang enters the battlefield, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].

skills.name: Frosty Marks
skills.description: Lingyang releases a shock wave centered on the skill target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] equal to 587.94% of Lingyang's ATK to targets within the range.

skills.name: Unification of Spirits
skills.description:
[c=Title]Heavy Attack: Glorious Plunge[/c]
When "Lion's Spirit" is full, use [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] to perform [c=Highlight]Glorious Plunge[/c], dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack: Tail Strike[/c]
When "Lion's Spirit" is not full, use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] to perform [c=Highlight]Tail Strike[/c], dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Striding Lion[/c]
After casting Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Glorious Plunge[/c], enter [c=Highlight]Striding Lion[/c] state;
After casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Lion Awakens[/c] or Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Strive: Lion's Vigor[/c], if "Lion's Spirit" is full, use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] to enter [c=Highlight]Striding Lion[/c] state.
In the [c=Highlight]Striding Lion[/c] state:
-Attacks can be launched in mid-air. If Lingyang is on the ground, use Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Glorious Plunge[/c] to get back in the air.
-"Lion's Spirit" is continuously consumed before running out in 5s, and when it runs out, [c=Highlight]Striding Lion[/c] ends;
-If Lingyang is in the Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Lion's Vigor[/c] state, the consumption speed of "Lion's Spirit" is reduced by 50%, extending [c=Highlight]Striding Lion[/c] state by up to 10s.
-Lingyang's [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] is replaced with Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Feral Gyrate[/c], which performs up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c];
-Lingyang's [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Mountain Roamer[/c], dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c];
-When "Lion's Spirit" is less than 10, use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] to perform [c=Highlight]Stormy Kicks[/c], dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c]; after performing Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Stormy Kicks[/c], the Mid-air Attack [c=Highlight]Tail Strike[/c] becomes available.
-Concerto Energy is restored when "Lion's Spirit" is consumed.
 
[c=Title]Lion's Spirit[/c]
Lingyang can hold up to 100 "Lion's Spirit".
When casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Furious Punches[/c], "Lion's Spirit" is restored.
When casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Lion Awakens[/c], "Lion's Spirit" is restored.
When casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Strive: Lion's Vigor[/c], "Lion's Spirit" is restored.

sequences.name: Lion of Light, Blessings Abound
sequences.description: During Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Lion's Vigor[/c], Lingyang's Anti-Interruption is enhanced.

sequences.name:
Dominant and Fierce, 
Power Unbound
sequences.description: Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Lion Awakens[/c] additionally recovers 10 Resonance Energy for Lingyang, triggered once every 20s.

sequences.name:
Jaw-Dropping Feats, 
Loud and Wide
sequences.description: During Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Lion's Vigor[/c], Lingyang's Basic Attack DMG Bonus is increased by 20%, and Resonance Skill DMG Bonus increased by 10%.

sequences.name:
Immortals Bow, 
in Reverence Flawed
sequences.description: Outro Skill [c=Highlight]Frosty Marks[/c] increases the Glacio DMG Bonus of all team members by 20% for 30s.

sequences.name:
Seven Stars Shine, 
Stepped upon High
sequences.description: Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Strive: Lion's Vigor[/c] additionally deals [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] equal to 200% of Lingyang's ATK.

sequences.name:
Demons Tremble, 
Divine Power Nigh
sequences.description: In the Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Striding Lion[/c] state, during the first 3s after every Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Mountain Roamer[/c], the Basic Attack DMG Bonus for Lingyang's next Basic Attack is increased by 100%.

skills.name: Dimming Brush
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform an attack, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
Heavy Attack does not reset the Basic Attack cycle.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform up to 2 consecutive attacks while in mid-air, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].

skills.name: Manifestation
skills.description:
Deal [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c]. If Afflatus is no less than 60, consume 60 Afflatus to summon [c=Highlight]Phatasmic Imprint - Left[/c] and [c=Highlight]Phantasmic Imprint - Right[/c].
-Press the button on the ground to summon the Phantasmic Imprints on the ground.
-Hold the button on the ground or press the button in mid-air to summon the Phantasmic Imprints in mid-air.

skills.name: Living Canvas
skills.description:
Summon [c=Highlight]Inklit Spirits[/c] for assistance.
Can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Inklit Spirit[/c]
When the active Resonator deals DMG, an [c=Highlight]Inklit Spirit[/c] will be summoned to perform a Coordinated Attack, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered as Basic Attack DMG.
-For 3s after dealing DMG, 1 [c=Highlight]Inklit Spirit[/c] is summoned per second. This effect can trigger once per second. Damage dealt by an Inklit Spirit does not trigger this effect.
-Up to 1 [c=Highlight]Inklit Spirit[/c] can be summoned every second, and up to 21 in total.
-This effect lasts for 30s, or until max [c=Highlight]Inklit Spirits[/c] are summoned.

skills.name: Calligrapher's Touch
skills.description: When casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Stroke of Genius[/c] or Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Creation's Zenith[/c], ATK is increased by 6% for 27s. This can be stacked up to 3 time(s).

skills.name: Tune Break: Rectifier
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Flourish
skills.description: After Outro Skill is cast, restore 15 Resonance Energy for the incoming Resonator.

skills.name: Radiant Ruin
skills.description: Attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].

skills.name: Carve and Draw
skills.description: The incoming Resonator has their Glacio DMG Amplified by 20% and Resonance Skill DMG Amplified by 25% for 14s or until they are switched out.

skills.name: Ink and Wash
skills.description:
[c=Title]Phantasmic Imprint[/c]
Zhezhi may summon [c=Highlight]Phantasmic Imprints[/c] at the cost of Afflatus when casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Manifestation[/c] or Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Conjuration[/c].
Up to 1 of each of [c=Highlight]Phantasmic Imprint - Left[/c], [c=Highlight]Phantasmic Imprint - Middle[/c], and [c=Highlight]Phantasmic Imprint - Right[/c] can exist at the same time, each lasting for 15s.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Conjuration[/c]
The 5 moves below consume STA to perform [c=Highlight]Conjuration[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
-Hold the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack button[/c] shortly after [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c].
-Press the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack button[/c] shortly after casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Manifestation[/c].
-Hold the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack button[/c] shortly after casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Stroke of Genius[/c] or Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Creation's Zenith[/c].
-Hold the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack button[/c] while in mid-air.
-Hold the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack button[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c].
If Zhezhi has at least 30 Afflatus when performing any of these, consume 30 Afflatus to summon a [c=Highlight]Phantasmic Imprint - Middle[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Stroke of Genius[/c]
When a [c=Highlight]Phatasmic Imprint[/c] is nearby, the Resonance Skill is replaced with [c=Highlight]Stroke of Genius[/c], which can be cast while in mid-air. When it is cast, Zhezhi will:
-Move to the location of the [c=Highlight]Phatasmic Imprint[/c], remove it, and then summon an Ivory Herald to attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered as Basic Attack DMG. Refresh the mid-air Dodge attempts if the target [c=Highlight]Phatasmic Imprint[/c] is in mid-air.
-Gain 1 stack of Painter's Delight, lasting for 8s and stacking up to 2 times.

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Creation's Zenith[/c]
When a [c=Highlight]Phantasmic Imprint[/c] is nearby and there are 2 stacks of Painter's Delight, [c=Highlight]Stroke of Genius[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Creation's Zenith[/c], which can be cast while in mid-air. When it is cast, Zhezhi will:
-Lose all stacks of Painter's Delight
-Move to the location of the [c=Highlight]Phantasmic Imprint[/c], remove it, and then summon an Ivory Herald to attack the target, dealing greater [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered as Basic Attack DMG, additionally increasing the Basic Attack DMG Bonus by 18% for 27s. Refresh the mid-air Dodge attempts if the target [c=Highlight]Phatasmic Imprint[/c] is in mid-air.

[c=Title]Afflatus[/c]
Zhezhi can hold up to 90 Afflatus.
Normal Attacks grant Afflatus on hit.
Casting Intro Skill grants Afflatus.

sequences.name: Brushwork's Finish
sequences.description: Casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Creation's Zenith[/c] restores 15 Resonance Energy and increases Crit. Rate by 10% for 27s.

sequences.name: Vivid Strokes
sequences.description: Max [c=Highlight]Inklit Spirits[/c] summoned by Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Living Canvas[/c] increases by 6.

sequences.name: Reflection's Grace
sequences.description: Casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Manifestation[/c], Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Stroke of Genius[/c], or Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Creation's Zenith[/c] increases ATK by 15% for 27s, stacking up to 3 time(s).

sequences.name: Hue's Spectrum
sequences.description: Casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Living Canvas[/c] increases ATK of Resonators on the team 20% for 30s.

sequences.name: Composition's Clue
sequences.description: For every 3 [c=Highlight]Inklit Spirits[/c] summoned by Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Living Canvas[/c], 1 extra [c=Highlight]Inklit Spirit[/c] is summoned to perform a Coordinated Attack, dealing DMG equal to 140% of Inklit Spirit's DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG. This damage dealt will not further summon Inklit Spirit.

sequences.name: Infinite Legacy
sequences.description: Casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Stroke of Genius[/c] or Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Creation's Zenith[/c] summons an extra [c=Highlight]Ivory Herald[/c] to deal DMG equal to 120% of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Stroke of Genius[/c]'s DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG.

skills.name: Frosty Punches
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
- When Frost is full, hold the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack Button[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Frostfall[/c].
- When Frost is full during the [c=Highlight]Fortune Rolling[/c] state, release the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack Button[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Frostfall[/c]. If Youhu cannot cast [c=Highlight]Frostfall[/c] at the moment, perform [c=Highlight]Lucky Draw[/c] once instead.
[c=Highlight]Youhu can obtain Frost in the following ways:[/c]
- When Frost is not full, hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack Button[/c] to enter the [c=Highlight]Fortune Rolling[/c] state and restore Frost over time.
- When [c=Highlight]Basic Attacks[/c] hit a target.
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack: Frostfall[/c]
Youhu dashes forward, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], and performs [c=Highlight]Lucky Draw[/c] once.
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
When Youhu possesses no [c=Highlight]Antique[/c], quickly press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack Button[/c] right after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to thrust forward, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], and perform [c=Highlight]Lucky Draw[/c] once.

skills.name: Scroll Divination
skills.description:
Youhu smashes her scroll down at the enemy, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], restoring HP for all party members nearby, and performs [c=Highlight]Lucky Draw[/c] once.
 
[c=Title]Lucky Draw[/c]
Youhu obtains a random [c=Highlight]Antique[/c] after the [c=Highlight]Lucky Draw[/c]. With an [c=Highlight]Antique[/c], her next [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] will activate the corresponding [c=Highlight]Antique Appraisal[/c].
Only one [c=Highlight]Antique[/c] can exist at a time, and the newly drawn [c=Highlight]Antique[/c] will replace the existing one.
 
[c=Title]Antique Appraisal[/c]
- [c=Highlight]Chime[/c]: Attack the enemy with a Chime, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c]. Chime can effectively reduce the enemy's Vibration Strength.
- [c=Highlight]Ruyi[/c]: Batter the enemy with a Ruyi, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c]. Ruyi has a higher DMG Multiplier.
- [c=Highlight]Ding[/c]: Ram into the enemy on a Ding, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c]. Ding can effectively break the enemy's stance.
- [c=Highlight]Mask[/c]: Throw a Mask at enemies in front, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c]. Mask can pull in enemies along its path.

skills.name: Fortune's Favor
skills.description:
Youhu hurls her scroll at the enemy, causing a [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] blast in the area.
On the blast, four buttons will appear. Choose a button within the specified time to obtain the corresponding [c=Highlight]Antique[/c]. Otherwise, obtain one random [c=Highlight]Antique[/c].

skills.name: Treasured Piece
skills.description: Restore HP for all nearby party members based on 30% of the healing provided by Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Scroll Divination[/c] when Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Antique Appraisal[/c] is cast.

skills.name: Tune Break: Gauntlets
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Rare Find
skills.description: Gain 15% Glacio DMG Bonus for 14s upon casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Scroll of Wonders[/c].

skills.name: Scroll of Wonders
skills.description: Toss out the scroll and perform [c=Highlight]Lucky Draw[/c] once.

skills.name: Timeless Classics
skills.description: The incoming Resonator has their Coordinated Attack DMG Amplified by 100% for 28s.

skills.name: Poetic Essence
skills.description:
At four Auspices, hold the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] button to release [c=Highlight]Poetic Essence[/c], dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered as Resonance Skill DMG, while restoring HP for all nearby party members.
Youhu can hold up to four Auspices.
 
[c=Title]Poetic Essence[/c]
Deal [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] to enemies within the range and additionally obtain one of the following effects based on the Auspice combination:
- [c=Highlight]Free Verse[/c]: Four different types Auspices. Additionally reduce the Vibration Strength of hit enemies.
- [c=Highlight]Antithesis[/c]: A pair of Auspices. Increase [c=Highlight]Poetic Essence[/c]'s DMG by 70%.
- [c=Highlight]Double Pun[/c]: Two pairs of Auspices. Additionally restore HP for all nearby party members.
- [c=Highlight]Triplet[/c]: Three identical Auspices. Increase [c=Highlight]Poetic Essence[/c]'s DMG by 175%.
- [c=Highlight]Perfect Rhyme[/c]: Four identical Auspices. Simultaneously activate the effects of [c=Highlight]Free Verse[/c], [c=Highlight]Double Pun[/c], and [c=Highlight]Triplet[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Poetic Essence[/c] removes all Auspices.
 
[c=Title]Auspice[/c]
- Youhu gains an Auspice through [c=Highlight]Antique Appraisal[/c]. Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] while holding an [c=Highlight]Antique[/c] to receive the corresponding Auspice.
- Youhu unlocks [c=Highlight]Antiques[/c] by casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Scroll Divination[/c], Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Scroll of Wonders[/c], Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Frostfall[/c], Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Fortune's Favor[/c], and [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c].

sequences.name: Waterside Respite
sequences.description: Youhu has a 10% chance to gain immunity to damage and interruption after casting [c=Highlight]Lucky Draw[/c]. This effect lasts for 5s or until she is switched out.

sequences.name: Sunroom Siesta
sequences.description: The DMG bonus of [c=Highlight]Antithesis[/c], [c=Highlight]Triplet[/c] and [c=Highlight]Perfect Rhyme[/c] on [c=Highlight]Poetic Essence[/c] is doubled.

sequences.name: Restless Sleep
sequences.description: Youhu's ATK is increased by 20%.

sequences.name: Frosted Lullaby
sequences.description: Every time Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Scroll Divination[/c] is cast, there is a 20% chance that the skill will not enter Cooldown.

sequences.name: Dreamland Meander
sequences.description: When Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Scroll of Wonders[/c] is cast, Youhu's Crit. Rate is increased by 15% for 14s.

sequences.name: Slumber Evermore
sequences.description: When casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Antique Appraisal[/c], gain 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Sky Blue[/c], stackable up to 4 times, lasting for 7s. Each stack increases Youhu's Crit. DMG by 15%.

skills.name: Silent Execution
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 2 consecutive strikes, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Basic Attack - Necessary Measures[/c]
With Moldable Crystals, Carlotta's [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Necessary Measures[/c].
Chain up to 3 strikes, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c]. Each strike of [c=Highlight]Necessary Measures[/c] consumes 1 Moldable Crystals.
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Deliver a charged attack at the target at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Containment Tactics[/c]
When Carlotta's Substance is full, her [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] will be replaced with [c=Highlight]Containment Tactics[/c]: consume all Substance to deal [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] and reduce the cooldown of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Art of Violence[/c] by 6s.
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c]. Using [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] shortly after the landing will cast [c=Highlight]Customary Greetings[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Customary Greetings[/c]
Flip over the target and deliver a surprise shot, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to deliver a riposte shot, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c]. This consumes 1 Moldable Crystals.

skills.name: Art of Violence
skills.description:
Deal [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] and inflict [c=Highlight]Dispersion[/c] on the target. Press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] again shortly after to cast [c=Highlight]Chromatic Splendor[/c]. 
 
[c=Title]Dispersion[/c]
Targets with Dispersion are immobilized for 1.5s. 
 
[c=Title]Chromatic Splendor[/c]
Consume all Moldable Crystals and deal [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
The Resonance Skill enters cooldown after a while if [c=Highlight]Chromatic Splendor[/c] is not cast or Carlotta is switched off the field.

skills.name: Era of New Wave
skills.description:
Deal [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] to all targets in an area (considered Resonance Skill DMG) and inflict [c=Highlight]Deconstruction[/c] on targets hit, then activate [c=Highlight]Twilight Tango[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
 
[c=Title]Deconstruction[/c]
Dealing DMG to targets inflicted with [c=Highlight]Deconstruction[/c] ignores 18% of their DEF.
 
[c=Title]Twilight Tango[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Twilight Tango[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] or [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Death Knell[/c].
Each [c=Highlight]Death Knell[/c] grants 1 Meta Vectors.
With 4 Meta Vectors, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] or [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Fatal Finale[/c]. 
- All Substance is removed when activating and ending [c=Highlight]Twilight Tango[/c]. Cannot perform Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Necessary Measures[/c], Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Containment Tactics[/c], and Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Imminent Oblivion[/c] while in [c=Highlight]Twilight Tango[/c].
 
[c=Title]Death Knell[/c]
Carlotta fires powerful shots with her musket and summons 4 crystal shards to attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered Resonance Skill DMG.
- Carlotta moves in the direction of the movement input with each shot of [c=Highlight]Death Knell[/c].
 
[c=Title]Fatal Finale[/c]
Deal [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] to an area, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
- [c=Highlight]Twilight Tango[/c] ends after casting [c=Highlight]Fatal Finale[/c].

skills.name: Wintertime Aria
skills.description: Attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].

skills.name: Closing Remark
skills.description: Attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] equal to 794.2% of Carlotta's ATK.

skills.name: Tune Break: Pistols
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Lethal Repertoire
skills.description:
[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Imminent Oblivion[/c]
Carlotta activates [c=Highlight]Tinted Crystal[/c] every 22s.
When Substance is full and [c=Highlight]Tinted Crystal[/c] is activated, hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to consume all Substance and cast Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Imminent Oblivion[/c], after which [c=Highlight]Tinted Crystal[/c] enters cooldown. 
Deal [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] (considered Resonance Skill DMG), and reduce the cooldown of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Art of Violence[/c] by 6s.
 
[c=Title]Final Bow[/c]
When Substance is full, enter the [c=Highlight]Final Bow[/c] state.
Increase the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Era of New Wave[/c], Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Death Knell[/c], and Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Fatal Finale[/c] by 80%. This effect ends when Carlotta is switched off the field during [c=Highlight]Twilight Tango[/c] or when [c=Highlight]Twilight Tango[/c] ends.
 
[c=Title]Substance[/c]
Carlotta can hold up to 120 points of Substance.
Cannot gain Substance while in [c=Highlight]Twilight Tango[/c] triggered by Resonance Liberation.
Restore 30 points of Substance upon casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Wintertime Aria[/c].
Restore 10 points of Substance for every 1 Moldable Crystal consumed upon casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Chromatic Splendor[/c].
Restore 10 points of Substance for every 1 Moldable Crystal consumed upon casting Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Necessary Measures[/c].
Consume 1 Moldable Crystal and restore 10 points of Substance upon casting [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c].
 
[c=Title]Moldable Crystal[/c]
Carlotta can hold up to 6 Moldable Crystals.
Cannot gain Moldable Crystal while in [c=Highlight]Twilight Tango[/c] triggered by Resonance Liberation.
Restore 3 Moldable Crystals upon casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].
Restore 3 Moldable Crystals upon casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c].
Restore 3 Moldable Crystals upon casting Mid-air Attack [c=Highlight]Customary Greetings[/c].
Restore 3 Moldable Crystals upon casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Wintertime Aria[/c].
Restore 3 Moldable Crystals upon casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Art of Violence[/c].
Restore 3 Moldable Crystals upon a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c].

skills.name: Flawless Purity
skills.description:
After casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Chromatic Splendor[/c], Carlotta can perform [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attacks[/c] while being immune to any DMG or interruptions before the Mid-air Attack deals DMG.
When Carlotta is on the team, the active Resonator's Flight STA cost is reduced by 20%.

skills.name: Ars Gratia Artis
skills.description: Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Wintertime Aria[/c], Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Chromatic Splendor[/c], Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Death Knell[/c], and Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Imminent Oblivion[/c] can inflict [c=Highlight]Deconstruction[/c].

sequences.name: Beauty Blazes Brightest Before It Fades
sequences.description: When Carlotta deals DMG to a target inflicted with [c=Highlight]Deconstruction[/c], the Crit. Rate of this instance of DMG is increased by 12.5%. When Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Chromatic Splendor[/c] hits a target inflicted with [c=Highlight]Dispersion[/c], Carlotta additionally restores 30 points of Substance.

sequences.name: Fallen Petals Give Life to New Blooms
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Fatal Finale[/c] is increased by 126%.

sequences.name: Adelante, Cortado, Spinning in Grace
sequences.description: Enable Outro Skill [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscope Sparks[/c]: Deal 1 additional strike at the end of Outro Skill [c=Highlight]Closing Remark[/c], dealing Glacio DMG equal to 1032.18% of Carlotta's ATK. The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Art of Violence[/c] and Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Chromatic Splendor[/c] is increased by 93%.

sequences.name: Yesterday's Raindrops Make Finest Wine
sequences.description: Casting Heavy Attack, Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Containment Tactics[/c], and Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Imminent Oblivion[/c] grants all Resonators in the team 25% Resonance Skill DMG Bonus for 30s.

sequences.name: Toast to Past, Today, and Every Day to Come
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Imminent Oblivion[/c] is increased by 47%.

sequences.name: As the Curtain Falls, I Remain What I Am
sequences.description:
Shots of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Death Knell[/c] deal higher DMG and shoot out double the number of crystal shards, representing a total increase of 186.6% in the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Death Knell[/c].
Shots of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Death Knell[/c] inflict [c=Highlight]Scattering[/c] on targets when hit, during which the target is immobilized. This effect is removed after 1.5s or when the target receives DMG.

skills.name: Flaming Sakura Blade Art
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack - Present Self[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] consecutively or hold it down to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3[/c] applies [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] 1 time on hit.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self[/c]
When [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c] reaches 300 points, [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self[/c] becomes available.
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to shoot out 3 arrows one by one at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Hiyuki is immune to interruptions and incoming DMG in the duration.
When the last arrow is shot, 300 points of [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c] is consumed and [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Inward Vision[/c] becomes available. The arrow applies [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] 1 time on hit.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Present Self[/c]
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack from Mid-air, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Present Self[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period after casting this skill to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Present Self[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self[/c].
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3, 4, and 5[/c] each applies [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] 1 time on hit.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self[/c]
In [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c], hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to enter [c=Highlight]Hold Breath[/c], continuously consuming STA. When [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] is released or STA is depleted, Hiyuki leaves the [c=Highlight]Hold Breath[/c] state and thrusts forward, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period after casting this skill to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2[/c].
If Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during the thrust, neutralize that instance of damage, Stagnate nearby targets, and become immune to interruptions for a certain period afterward while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%. Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period after triggering this effect to chain into [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 4[/c] instead.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self[/c]
When [c=Highlight]Whiteout Bitterfrost[/c] is full, [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self[/c]. 
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] and consume STA and 3 stacks of [c=Highlight]Whiteout Bitterfrost[/c] to gain 1 point of [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c], dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
[c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self[/c] applies [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] 1 time on hit.
If Hiyuki is airborne while casting this skill, she'll land on the ground first.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Present Self[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self[/c].
Consume STA to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks in Mid-air, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Stage 3 is a Plunging Attack.
[c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2 & 3[/c] apply [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] 1 time on hit.
The [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self[/c] cycle will not be reset by casting skills other than [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iai[/c] within a short period.
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] while airborne to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Present Self[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period after casting this skill to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3[/c].
