skills.name: Frostblight
skills.description:
[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Present Self[/c]
Deal [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
Casting this skill enhances the next [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3[/c], which now restores 100 points of [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c] when cast. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect.
Press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period after casting this skill to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3[/c].

While in [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Present Self[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c] and [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Petalfall[/c]:

[c=Title]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c]
While on the ground, press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to pull in nearby targets and deal [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], removing the targets' [c=Highlight]Frostbind[/c].
This skill shares a Cooldown with [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Petalfall[/c].

[c=Title]Frostblight: Petalfall[/c]
While in mid-air, press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to pull in nearby targets and deal [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], removing the targets' [c=Highlight]Frostbind[/c].
This skill shares a Cooldown with [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c].

skills.name: Foreclaiming
skills.description:
[c=Title]Foreclaiming: Inward Vision[/c]
[c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Inward Vision[/c] becomes available after casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self[/c].
While in [c=Highlight]Present Self[/c], press [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] to cast this skill, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c]. Upon casting this skill, gain 3 points of [c=Highlight]Frostharden Iai[/c], remove 300 points of [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c] and [c=Highlight]Frostheart[/c]. Then, enter [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c] and restore 50 points of [c=Highlight]Frostheart[/c].
[c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Inward Vision[/c] applies 4 stacks of [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] on hit.
Casting [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Inward Vision[/c] does not consume Resonance Energy.

[c=Title]Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation[/c] can be cast via the following ways:
- Press [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] and release to cast [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation[/c]. If Hiyuki has 3 points of [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c], consume all [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c]. Otherwise, this cast does not consume [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c].
- Hold [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] to enter a charging state. During this state, consume 1 point of [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c] periodically. Release [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation[/c]. If no [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c] is consumed when [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] is released, Hiyuki will continue to charge the attack and cast the skill automatically after certain time. [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation[/c] will also be cast automatically when [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c] depletes. 
Hiyuki deals [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c]. Each point of [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c] consumed increases the DMG Multiplier of this attack.
Casting the skill consumes 300 points of [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c] and [c=Highlight]Frostheart[/c], and ends [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c].

rows.label: Total Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation DMG Increase per Snowforged Blade

skills.name: Frostedge
skills.description:
Deal [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered Resonance Liberation DMG, and apply [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] 1 time on hit.
In [c=Highlight]Present Self[/c], casting this skill restores 200 points of [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c]. Press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3[/c].
In [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2[/c].

skills.name: Snowlight Blessing
skills.description: Glacio DMG dealt by nearby Resonators other than Hiyuki in the team is Amplified by 20% against targets affected by [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] for 20s.

skills.name: Tune Break: Sword
skills.description:
When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, Hiyuki can cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

While in [c=Highlight]Present Self[/c], press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3[/c].
While in [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3[/c].

skills.name: Everfrost Dominion
skills.description:
[c=Title]Glacio Bite[/c]
- While Hiyuki is in the team, [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] inflicted by nearby Resonators in the team is converted to [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite[/c]. Every time a new stack of [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite[/c] is inflicted on a target, an instance of [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite DMG[/c] is triggered based on that enemy's current [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite[/c] stack limit. [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite[/c] can be inflicted on [c=Highlight]frozen[/c] targets. [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite[/c] is also considered [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] and [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite DMG[/c] is also considered [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe DMG[/c].
- When [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Inward Vision[/c] or [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iai[/c] hits a target, if the target has no fewer than 10 stacks of [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite[/c], consume 10 stacks and trigger [c=Highlight]Frostbind[/c] once. 
- When Hiyuki joins the team, remove all stacks of [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] from the targets. When Hiyuki leaves the team, if there is no other Resonator in the team who can convert [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] into [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite[/c], all enemies' [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite[/c] stacks are cleared.

[c=Title]Present Self[/c]
Hiyuki starts in [c=Highlight]Present Self[/c]. While in [c=Highlight]Present Self[/c], casting certain skills restores [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c].

[c=Title]Foreclaimed Self[/c]
Hiyuki enters [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c] after casting [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Inward Vision[/c]. While in [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c], Hiyuki unlocks new moves and restores [c=Highlight]Frostheart[/c] through certain attacks.

[c=Title]Iai Stance[/c]
If Hiyuki has at least 100 points of [c=Highlight]Frostheart[/c], performing any of the following actions causes her to flash backward at the cost of STA and enter [c=Highlight]Iai Stance[/c]:
- Press [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] after casting any [c=Highlight]Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self[/c] other than [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c], [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Petalfall[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iai[/c], or [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Frostedge[/c].
- Hold [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] within a certain period after casting [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c] or [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Petalfall[/c].
While performing the actions above, if there is a valid target within the range and the forward input is held down, Hiyuki instead flashes behind the enemy at the cost of STA and enters [c=Highlight]Iai Stance[/c].
Hiyuki may enter [c=Highlight]Iai Stance[/c] while airborne. Upon entering the [c=Highlight]Iai Stance[/c], Hiyuki's mid-air Dodge charges are reset. [c=Highlight]Iai Stance[/c] ends if Hiyuki is switched out.

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Iai[/c]
Within a certain period after entering [c=Highlight]Iai Stance[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] and consume 100 points of [c=Highlight]Frostheart[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iai[/c], dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
If [c=Highlight]Frostheart[/c] remains at 100 points or above after casting this skill, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iai[/c] again.
If Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iai[/c], neutralize this instance of damage and become immune to interruptions for a certain duration afterwards while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%.
Each time [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iai[/c] is cast, if Hiyuki has [c=Highlight]Frostharden Iai[/c], consume 1 point of [c=Highlight]Frostharden Iai[/c] to inflict 3 stacks of [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] on hit, and gain 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Whiteout Bitterfrost[/c].

[c=Title]Dedication[/c]
Hiyuki holds up to  300 points of [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c].
While in [c=Highlight]Present Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c] may be restored via the following ways:
- Casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3[/c] restores 100 points of [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c].
- Casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Frostedge[/c] restores 200 points of [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Present Self[/c] enhances the next [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3[/c], which now additionally restores 100 points of [c=Highlight]Dedication[/c]. This effect ends when Hiyuki is switched out.

[c=Title]Frostheart[/c]
Hiyuki holds up to 300 points of [c=Highlight]Frostheart[/c].
[c=Highlight]Frostheart[/c] is restored while casting [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c] and [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Petalfall[/c], or when [c=Highlight]Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self[/c] other than [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self[/c] hits the target.

[c=Title]Frostharden Iai[/c]
[c=Highlight]Frostharden Iai[/c] has a maximum of 3 points.
Casting [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Inward Vision[/c] grants 3 points of [c=Highlight]Frostharden Iai[/c].

[c=Title]Whiteout Bitterfrost[/c]
[c=Highlight]Whiteout Bitterfrost[/c] stacks up to 3 times.
Each time [c=Highlight]Frostharden Iai[/c] is consumed through [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iai[/c], gain 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Whiteout Bitterfrost[/c].

[c=Title]Snowforged Blade[/c]
[c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c] stacks up to 3 times.
Each time [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self[/c] is cast, gain 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c].

skills.name: Fine Snow
skills.description:
When a Resonator in the team applies [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] or [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c], Hiyuki gains 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c]. [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c] stacks up to 3 times. Each Resonator can trigger this effect only once in this way.
Based on Hiyuki's current stacks of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c], the following bonuses are unlocked:
1 stack of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c]: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite DMG[/c] is Amplified by 30% against targets within a certain range. Hiyuki's Crit. DMG is increased by 40%.
2 stacks of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c]: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time she applies [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c], she additionally deals an instance of [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite DMG[/c] with a fixed DMG Multiplier of 102%.
3 stacks of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c]: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite DMG[/c] is additionally Amplified by 30% against targets within a certain range.
This effect resets when new Resonators are added to the team.

skills.name: Ephemeral Realm
skills.description: Once Hiyuki leaves the combat state or recovers after being knocked out, when she stays out of combat for 4s with fewer than 1 point of [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c], restore 1 point.

sequences.name: Springless
sequences.description:
The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self[/c], and [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self[/c] are increased by 120%.

[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3[/c] now has an increased range and pulls enemies within range toward the center. Hiyuki is immune to interruptions while casting  [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 4 & 5[/c].

Casting [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Inward Vision[/c] enhances the next [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 1 & 2[/c], which now inflict [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] 1 time on hit.

sequences.name: To Burn Cold in Silence
sequences.description:
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iai[/c]'s DMG Multiplier is increased by 125%.

Inherent Skill [c=Highlight]Ephemeral Realm[/c]'s effect becomes the following one:
Once Hiyuki leaves the combat state or recovers from being knocked out, after staying out of combat for 4s, restore 3 points of [c=Highlight]Snowforged Blade[/c].

Once Hiyuki leaves the combat state or recovers from being knocked out, after staying out of combat for 4s, the following effects are triggered once:
- While in [c=Highlight]Foreclaimed Self[/c], restore 3 points points of [c=Highlight]Frostharden Iai[/c].
- Reset the Cooldown of 2 charges of [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c].
- Restore an additional 50 points of [c=Highlight]Frostheart[/c] for the next 2 casts of [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c] or [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Petalfall[/c].

sequences.name: No Self, No Bound
sequences.description:
Inherent Skill [c=Highlight]Fine Snow[/c] gains the following effect:
2s after a Resonator joins the team or Hiyuki is revived, Hiyuki gains 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c]. Hiyuki can obtain up to 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c] in this way.

The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self[/c] and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self[/c] are increased by 160%.

At 2 stacks of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c], while Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, the DMG Multiplier of the additionally applied Glacio Bite DMG each time she inflicts [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] is increased by 488%.

sequences.name: Like Reeds on Tides
sequences.description:
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Present Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c], or [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Petalfall[/c] increases the DMG dealt by all nearby Resonators in the team by 20% for 30s.

Restore 18% of Max HP while casting [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c] or [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Petalfall[/c].

sequences.name: Vessel of Thousand Wishes
sequences.description: The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Present Self[/c], [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Jade Cleave[/c], and [c=Highlight]Frostblight: Petalfall[/c] are increased by 80%.

sequences.name: Into a Night Without End
sequences.description:
The Crit. DMG of [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Inward Vision[/c] and [c=Highlight]Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation[/c] is increased by 500%.

At 2 stacks of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c], the effect "While Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time she applies [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c], she additionally deals an instance of Glacio Bite DMG with a fixed DMG Multiplier" changes to "While Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time a Resonator in the team applies [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c], she additionally deals an instance of Glacio Bite DMG with a fixed DMG Multiplier."
At 2 stacks of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c], Hiyuki's Crit. DMG is increased by 40%.
At 3 stacks of [c=Highlight]Snow Rust[/c], the total [c=Highlight]Glacio Bite DMG[/c] taken by targets within a certain range of the active Resonator in the team is increased by 25%.

skills.name: Snapshot
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
While casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c], hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to deploy [c=Highlight]Focus Ring[/c]. A cursor will move around the [c=Highlight]Focus Ring[/c]. 
- Releasing the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] button when the cursor falls outside of [c=Highlight]Perfect Focus[/c] will trigger [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable[/c], dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] and restoring [c=Highlight]Trace[/c].
- Releasing the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] button when the cursor falls within [c=Highlight]Perfect Focus[/c] will trigger [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable[/c], dealing increased [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] and restoring additional [c=Highlight]Trace[/c].
Pressing [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c] will trigger [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable[/c] instead of deploying [c=Highlight]Focus Ring[/c].
When [c=Highlight]Focus Ring[/c] is deployed, the [c=Highlight]Perfect Focus[/c] zone continues to fill the ring. Once [c=Highlight]Focus Ring[/c] is completely filled, it automatically collapses and triggers [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable[/c].
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 1, 2, and 3[/c] in sequence, and deploy [c=Highlight]Focus Ring[/c] during [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c]. Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c]. Shortly after performing this attack, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c].

skills.name: Phantom Frame
skills.description:
Pull in nearby targets, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
While casting this skill, hold [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to deploy [c=Highlight]Focus Ring[/c]. A cursor will move around the [c=Highlight]Focus Ring[/c].
- Releasing the [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] button when the cursor falls outside of [c=Highlight]Perfect Focus[/c] will trigger [c=Highlight]Compensate[/c], dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] and restoring [c=Highlight]Trace[/c].
- Releasing the [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] button when the cursor falls within [c=Highlight]Perfect Focus[/c] will trigger [c=Highlight]Spotlight[/c], dealing increased [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] and restoring additional [c=Highlight]Trace[/c].
If Lucilla casts the skill on-field without holding [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c], she directly casts [c=Highlight]Compensate[/c] instead of deploying [c=Highlight]Focus Ring[/c].

[c=Title]Compensate[/c]
Attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] and reducing the Cooldown of Lucilla's [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] by 8s.
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Spotlight[/c]
Attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].
While casting [c=Highlight]Spotlight[/c], Lucilla additionally restores 20 points of Concerto Energy, and inflicts 1 extra stacks of [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] onto the target if she is in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe[/c].
[c=Highlight]Spotlight[/c] is immune to interruptions. Switching to another Resonator while casting [c=Highlight]Spotlight[/c] ends the skill early.
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].

skills.name: Clear As Day
skills.description:
Lucilla holds up to 0 Resonance Energy. [c=Highlight]Clear As Day[/c] consumes no Resonance Energy.
[c=Highlight]Clear As Day[/c] unlocks when Lucilla holds all 3 [c=Highlight]Photos[/c].

[c=Title]Clear As Day[/c]
Deal [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] and enter [c=Highlight]Reminiscence[/c]:
- When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe[/c], the DMG dealt is considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c]. Casting this skill grants Lucilla 30% Basic Attack DMG Bonus for 10s.
- When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Echo[/c], the DMG dealt is considered [c=Highlight]Echo Skill DMG[/c]. Casting this skill grants Lucilla 30% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for 10s.
When in [c=Highlight]Reminiscence[/c], Lucilla's resistance to interruption is increased, and she cannot cast [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] and [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c]. Her [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack[/c], and [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Clip It[/c] are replaced with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Tracing Forms[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Reminiscence[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Reminiscence[/c], and [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Clip It: Hard Cut[/c] respectively.
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Tracing Forms[/c]
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c].
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 1, 2, & 3[/c] consecutively.
While casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3[/c], consecutively press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to continuously attack the target.
While casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3[/c], release the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] button or finish the whole [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3[/c] to automatically perform [c=Highlight]Letting It Go[/c].

[c=Title]Letting It Go[/c]
Deal [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] to targets within the range. When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe[/c]/[c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Echo[/c], DMG dealt is considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c]/[c=Highlight]Echo Skill DMG[/c].
Lucilla is immune to interruption and damage during [c=Highlight]Letting It Go[/c], and Resonator switching is disabled while casting.
While casting [c=Highlight]Letting It Go[/c], Lucilla additionally restores 20 points of Concerto Energy.
Casting [c=Highlight]Letting It Go[/c] ends [c=Highlight]Reminiscence[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Reminiscence[/c]
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c]. 
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Reminiscence[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c]. 
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3[/c].

rows.label: Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 1 DMG
Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 2 DMG
Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3 DMG

skills.name: Clip It
skills.description:
[c=Title]Clip It[/c]
Attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] and inflicting 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c].

[c=Title]Clip It: Hard Cut[/c]
When in [c=Highlight]Reminiscence[/c], [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Clip It: Hard Cut[/c].
Attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] and inflicting 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3[/c].

rows.label: Clip It: Hard Cut Concerto Regen

skills.name: Montage
skills.description:
When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe[/c], [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] DMG against targets within a certain range around the active Resonator is Amplified by 60% for 30s.
This effect ends when Lucilla switches Resonance Modes.

When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Echo[/c], grant 50% Echo Skill DMG Amplification to the incoming Resonator for 14s.
This effect ends when the incoming Resonator is switched off the field or when Lucilla switches Resonance Modes.

skills.name: Tune Break: Rectifier
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Memory Palace
skills.description:
[c=Title]Déjà Vu[/c]
While casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Clear As Day[/c], Lucilla grants the following enhancements based on her [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode[/c]:
- When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe[/c], gain 4 stacks of [c=Highlight]Film Roll[/c] for 30s, stacking up to 4 times. All stacks are removed when the duration ends.
- When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Echo[/c], gain 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Zoom[/c] for 30s. Max 1 stack, which is removed when the duration ends.
The above effects end early when Lucilla switches Resonance Mode.

[c=Title]Film Roll[/c]
When an active Resonator in the team other than Lucilla inflicts [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] onto the target, Lucilla consumes 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Film Roll[/c] to inflict [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] 2 times on nearby targets. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

[c=Title]Zoom[/c]
Each stack of [c=Highlight]Zoom[/c] increases the Crit. DMG of the active Resonator's Echo Skill by 10%.

[c=Title]Oblivion[/c]
During [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3[/c], Lucilla consumes 1 [c=Highlight]Photo[/c] intermittently to perform [c=Highlight]Oblivion[/c], dealing 1 instance of [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c]:
- When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe[/c], this instance of DMG is considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c]. The skill inflicts 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] on the target.
- When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Echo[/c], this instance of DMG is considered [c=Highlight]Echo Skill DMG[/c]. Each cast of [c=Highlight]Oblivion[/c] is considered as casting a different Echo Skill.

[c=Title]Quick Glance[/c]
Press Aim to enter the camera mode. During this mode, Reverberations, environmental collectibles, and special collectibles within a certain range of Lucilla's shot will be marked. Press the shutter button to capture the moment, and the marked items will be gathered.

[c=Title]Trace[/c]
Lucilla can hold up to 150 points of [c=Highlight]Trace[/c].
Restore 100 points of [c=Highlight]Trace[/c] while casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Clip It[/c].
Restore 50 points of [c=Highlight]Trace[/c] while casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Spotlight[/c].
Restore 50 points of [c=Highlight]Trace[/c] while casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable[/c].
Restore 25 points of [c=Highlight]Trace[/c] while casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Compensate[/c] or [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable[/c].

[c=Title]Photos[/c]
Lucilla can hold up to 3 [c=Highlight]Photos[/c].
Every 50 points of [c=Highlight]Trace[/c] restored generates 1 [c=Highlight]Photo[/c].

skills.name: Slow Motion
skills.description:
When [c=Highlight]Focus Ring[/c] is deployed, Lucilla slows targets within her shot.
While casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Spotlight[/c], Lucilla grants the following enhancements based on her [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode[/c]:
- When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe[/c], Glacio RES of targets within a certain range around the active Resonator is reduced by 8% for 30s. If an enemy falls to [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] DMG during this time, it counts as caused by the nearest active Resonator.
- When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Echo[/c], Resonators in the team gain 25% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for 30s.
These enhancements end when Lucilla switches the Resonance Mode.

skills.name: Remembrance
skills.description:
[c=Highlight]Film Roll[/c] can now be stacked up to 10 stacks, and [c=Highlight]Zoom[/c] up to 4 stacks.
Each time Lucilla consumes [c=Highlight]Photo[/c] when in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe[/c]/[c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Echo[/c], she gains 2 stacks of [c=Highlight]Film Roll[/c]/1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Zoom[/c].

sequences.name: Distant Noon
sequences.description:
While casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Phantom Frame[/c] to deploy [c=Highlight]Focus Ring[/c], the first time landing the cursor within [c=Highlight]Perfect Focus[/c] will immediately expand [c=Highlight]Perfect Focus[/c] to fill up [c=Highlight]Focus Ring[/c]. 
Lucilla's Crit. Rate increases by 20% for 10s when [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Spotlight[/c] is cast.
Lucilla is immune to interruptions while casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Phantom Frame[/c] and [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3[/c].

sequences.name: Slumbering Moonlight
sequences.description:
While casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Clear As Day[/c], Lucilla grants the following enhancements based on her [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode[/c]:
- When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe[/c], [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] DMG against targets within a certain range around the active Resonator is Amplified by 80%.
- When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Echo[/c], grant 40% Echo Skill DMG Bonus to Resonators in the team.
These enhancements last as long as [c=Highlight]Reminiscence[/c] is active and remain effective for 30s after [c=Highlight]Reminiscence[/c] ends.
These effects end when Lucilla switches Resonance Modes.

sequences.name: Days Fade Unheard
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Letting It Go[/c] is increased by 100%.

sequences.name: The Past Fades Into Silence
sequences.description:
[c=Highlight]Oblivion[/c] pulls in nearby targets on hit. While casting [c=Highlight]Oblivion[/c], Lucilla's ATK is increased by 10% for 6s, stacking up 3 times. All stacks are removed when the duration ends.
While casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3[/c], Lucilla takes 30% less DMG.

sequences.name: Time is Like a Stream
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Oblivion[/c] is increased by 50%.

sequences.name: Gazing In the Mist of Time
sequences.description:
When in [c=Highlight]Reminiscence[/c], each time Lucilla consumes [c=Highlight]Photo[/c], she gains 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Remembrance[/c], stacking up to 3 times. Each stack of [c=Highlight]Remembrance[/c] increases [c=Highlight]Letting It Go[/c]'s DMG dealt to the target by 200%, up to 600%. Casting [c=Highlight]Letting It Go[/c] removes all stacks of [c=Highlight]Remembrance[/c].
Lucilla gains [c=Highlight]Longing[/c] if she has defeated a target while in [c=Highlight]Reminiscence[/c]: Upon ending [c=Highlight]Reminiscence[/c] while not in combat, consume [c=Highlight]Longing[/c] to restore 150 points of [c=Highlight]Trace[/c].

skills.name: Unraveled Spring
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance[/c]
Press repeatedly or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] and restoring [c=Highlight]Cloud Breath[/c] on hit.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Zephyr Stance[/c]
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] and restoring [c=Highlight]Cloud Breath[/c] on hit.
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance Stage 4[/c].

rows.label: Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance Stage 1 DMG
Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance Stage 3 DMG
Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance Stage 4 DMG
Mid-air Attack - Zephyr Stance STA Cost

skills.name: Vernal Screen
skills.description:
[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Zephyr Stance[/c] and [c=Highlight]Cloud Breath[/c] is not full, press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to have Suisui thrust forward, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c]. If Suisui is the active Resonator while casting the skill, restore [c=Highlight]Cloud Breath[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
This skill shares a Cooldown with [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance[/c].

[c=Title]Awakening Spring[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Zephyr Stance[/c] and at full [c=Highlight]Cloud Breath[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Awakening Spring[/c]. Casting this skill consumes all [c=Highlight]Cloud Breath[/c], pulls in nearby targets, and sends Suisui into [c=Highlight]Drizzle Stance[/c], dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] and inflicting [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] on the target 1 time on hit.

[c=Title]Enrichment[/c]
Casting [c=Highlight]Awakening Spring[/c] or [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Tinkling Jade[/c] grants all nearby Resonators in the team 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Enrichment[/c]. This effect can be triggered once every 25s. Incoming Resonators receive healing from Suisui at the cost of [c=Highlight]Enrichment[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Drizzle Stance[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to have Suisui thrust forward, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c]. If Suisui is the active Resonator while casting the skill, restore [c=Highlight]Floral Epistle[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
This skill shares a Cooldown with [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance[/c].

rows.label: Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance/Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance Cooldown

skills.name: Song of Thoroughfare
skills.description:
Casting the skill deploys [c=Highlight]Ceaseless Landscape[/c] that lasts for 30s. When [c=Highlight]Ceaseless Landscape[/c] is active, Suisui enters the [c=Highlight]Roaming Transcendent[/c] state when casting [c=Highlight]Outro Skill - Rippling Waters[/c].
[c=Highlight]Ceaseless Landscape[/c] grants all nearby Resonators in the team the following enhancements:
- Inflicting a target with [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle[/c], [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c], [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c], and [c=Highlight]Aero Erosion[/c], or dealing the corresponding Negative Status DMG increases the max stack limit of the corresponding [c=Highlight]Negative Status[/c] the target can receive by 3 for 15s. This effect does not stack.
- Inflicting a target with [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] or dealing the corresponding Negative Status DMG increases the max stack limits of [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] and [c=Highlight]Electro Rage[/c] the target can receive by 3 for 15s. This effect does not stack.
- Consuming [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c] stacks on the target after landing a skill allows the Resonator's Havoc DMG to ignore the target's DEF by 6% and Havoc RES by 12% for 30s. This effect does not stack.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

skills.name: Tinkling Jade
skills.description:
Attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c], and inflict [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] 1 time on the target.
While casting this skill, consume all [c=Highlight]Cloud Breath[/c] to pull in nearby targets and enter [c=Highlight]Drizzle Stance[/c].

skills.name: Rippling Waters
skills.description:
Resonators in the team gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 30s.

Suisui enters [c=Highlight]Roaming Transcendent[/c] when [c=Highlight]Ceaseless Landscape[/c] is active.
Suisui exits [c=Highlight]Drizzle Stance[/c] and consumes all [c=Highlight]Floral Epistle[/c] and unlocks the following effects based on the amount of [c=Highlight]Floral Epistle[/c] consumed:

0 [c=Highlight]Floral Epistle[/c] consumed:
- All nearby Resonators in the team gain [c=Highlight]Reflecting Shadows[/c] for 6s. Resonators with [c=Highlight]Reflecting Shadows[/c] have increased resistance to interruption.

At least 200 [c=Highlight]Floral Epistle[/c] consumed:
- If [c=Highlight]Ceaseless Landscape[/c] is active, Suisui may perform [c=Highlight]Plume Step[/c] for the first time within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in [c=Highlight]Roaming Transcendent[/c].

At least 400 [c=Highlight]Floral Epistle[/c] consumed:
- During this [c=Highlight]Roaming Transcendent[/c] state, the active Resonator within the [c=Highlight]Ceaseless Landscape[/c] deals more DMG if they have [c=Highlight]Reflecting Shadows[/c]. For every 1% of Suisui's Energy Regen over 200%, the Resonator deals 0.2% more DMG, up to 12%.
- If [c=Highlight]Ceaseless Landscape[/c] is active, Suisui may perform the second [c=Highlight]Plume Step[/c] within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in [c=Highlight]Roaming Transcendent[/c].

At least 600 [c=Highlight]Floral Epistle[/c] consumed:
- When Suisui performs the first [c=Highlight]Plume Step[/c], all nearby active Resonators in the team within the [c=Highlight]Ceaseless Landscape[/c] gain the following effects for the duration of this [c=Highlight]Roaming Transcendent[/c]:
- When they cast Outro Skill, Suisui grants the incoming Resonator [c=Highlight]Undulating Mist[/c]. When Resonators with [c=Highlight]Undulating Mist[/c] consume [c=Highlight]Negative Status[/c] or [c=Highlight]Electro Rage[/c] stacks on the target, they gain an ATK increase: For every 0.12% of Suisui's Energy Regen over 200%, the Resonator's ATK is increased by 0.1% for 6s, up to 50%. [c=Highlight]Undulating Mist[/c] lasts for 14s or until the Resonator is switched off the field. When [c=Highlight]Undulating Mist[/c] is removed, the ATK increase effect is also removed.
- If [c=Highlight]Ceaseless Landscape[/c] is active, Suisui may perform the third [c=Highlight]Plume Step[/c] within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in [c=Highlight]Roaming Transcendent[/c].

[c=Title]Roaming Transcendent[/c]
Lasts for 30s.
During [c=Highlight]Roaming Transcendent[/c], Suisui will merge with [c=Highlight]Ceaseless Landscape[/c] and start a Transcendent Dance, during which she will perform [c=Highlight]Plume Steps[/c] at intervals based on the amount of [c=Highlight]Floral Epistle[/c] consumed when [c=Highlight]Outro Skill - Rippling Waters[/c] is cast.
When Suisui is the active Resonator in the team, she stops the Transcendent Dance.
When [c=Highlight]Ceaseless Landscape[/c] isn't active, she will exit the [c=Highlight]Roaming Transcendent[/c] state.

[c=Title]Plume Step[/c]
Performing [c=Highlight]Plume Step[/c] grants [c=Highlight]Reflecting Shadows[/c] to all nearby Resonators in the team for 6s, inflicts 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] on all enemies within the [c=Highlight]Ceaseless Landscape[/c], and heals the nearby active Resonators in the team within the [c=Highlight]Ceaseless Landscape[/c].

skills.name: Tune Break: Rectifier
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Lambent Gold
skills.description:
[c=Title]Zephyr Stance[/c]
Suisui is in [c=Highlight]Zephyr Stance[/c] by default. When in [c=Highlight]Zephyr Stance[/c], Suisui can obtain [c=Highlight]Cloud Breath[/c] through certain skills.

[c=Title]Drizzle Stance[/c]
Entering [c=Highlight]Drizzle Stance[/c] clears all [c=Highlight]Floral Epistle[/c].
During [c=Highlight]Drizzle Stance[/c]:
- Suisui unlocks new combat moves and restores [c=Highlight]Floral Epistle[/c] through certain skills.
-Suisui gains increased resistance to interruption.
- Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time after triggering a successful Dodge via [c=Highlight]Dodge skills[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 1[/c].
After entering [c=Highlight]Drizzle Stance[/c] for 15s, Suisui ends [c=Highlight]Drizzle Stance[/c] and clears all [c=Highlight]Floral Epistle[/c] upon exiting the state.

[c=Title]Dodge - Parting Mist[/c]
While performing attacks on the ground, press [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Dodge - Parting Mist[/c] at the cost of STA.
When in [c=Highlight]Zephyr Stance[/c], triggering a successful Dodge while casting [c=Highlight]Dodge - Parting Mist[/c] restores [c=Highlight]Cloud Breath[/c]. Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after triggering the Dodge to cast [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance[/c].
- When in [c=Highlight]Drizzle Stance[/c], triggering a successful Dodge while casting [c=Highlight]Dodge - Parting Mist[/c] restores [c=Highlight]Floral Epistle[/c], and does not reset the cycle of [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance[/c] within a certain period.

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance[/c]
When in [c=Highlight]Drizzle Stance[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] repeatedly to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] and restoring [c=Highlight]Floral Epistle[/c] on hit.
When casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 3[/c],  continuously pull in nearby targets.
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 4[/c] inflicts [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c] 1 time on the target on hit.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance[/c]
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c] and restoring [c=Highlight]Floral Epistle[/c] on hit.

[c=Title]Illuminating Dew[/c]
When in [c=Highlight]Drizzle Stance[/c], keep holding [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] after casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance[/c] to cast this skill.
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Swallow's Cut[/c]
When in [c=Highlight]Drizzle Stance[/c], cast this skill in one of the following ways:
- Release the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] button while casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance[/c].
- Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] while Suisui is mid-air.
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Ice]Glacio DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Cloud Breath[/c]
Max 120 points.
When in [c=Highlight]Zephyr Stance[/c]: 
- [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance[/c] and [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance[/c] restore [c=Highlight]Cloud Breath[/c] on hit.
- Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance[/c] restores 40 points of [c=Highlight]Cloud Breath[/c] when Suisui is the active Resonator in the team.
- Triggering a successful Dodge while casting [c=Highlight]Dodge - Parting Mist[/c] restores 35 points of [c=Highlight]Cloud Breath[/c].

[c=Title]Floral Epistle[/c]
Max 600 points.
When in [c=Highlight]Drizzle Stance[/c]:
- [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance[/c] and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance[/c] restore [c=Highlight]Floral Epistle[/c] on hit.
- Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance[/c] restores 100 points of [c=Highlight]Floral Epistle[/c] when Suisui is the active Resonator in the team.
- Triggering a successful Dodge while casting [c=Highlight]Dodge - Parting Mist[/c] restores 102 points of [c=Highlight]Floral Epistle[/c].

skills.name: Sky Over Water
skills.description:
Consuming [c=Highlight]Enrichment[/c] grants the Resonator 10 stacks of [c=Highlight]Spring's Birth[/c], up to 10 stacks. When the Resonator with [c=Highlight]Spring's Birth[/c] is not at full HP, restore their HP by 62 + 0.34% of Suisui's Max HP at the cost of 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Spring's Birth[/c] every 2s.

When [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Awakening Spring[/c] and [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Tinkling Jade[/c] hit a target, they additionally restore 18 points of Concerto Energy and 13 points of Resonance Energy, and increase the attack's Crit. Rate by 80% and Glacio DMG by 240%. This effect can be triggered up to once every 25s.

skills.name: Glimmering Gold
skills.description: When a Resonator other than Suisui takes a fatal blow, they will not be knocked out but will instead regain 50% of Suisui's current HP, while Suisui herself loses the same amount of HP. Suisui's HP will not go below 1 from this effect. This effect can be triggered once every 10 minutes.

sequences.name: Mountains Washed Into Paintings
sequences.description:
Resonators with [c=Highlight]Undulating Mist[/c] also gain ATK increase after inflicting [c=Highlight]Negative Status[/c] or dealing [c=Highlight]Negative Status DMG[/c].
The duration of [c=Highlight]Reflecting Shadows[/c] obtained through the third [c=Highlight]Plume Step[/c] is extended by 100%.
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance[/c], [c=Highlight]Plunging Attack - Illuminating Dew[/c] and [c=Highlight]Plunging Attack - Swallow's Cut[/c] are immune to interruption.

sequences.name: Clouds Pour Like Molten Gold
sequences.description:
All nearby Resonators in the team within the [c=Highlight]Ceaseless Landscape[/c] have their Crit. DMG increased by 50% for 30s after performing the following actions:
- Inflicting [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle[/c], [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c], [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c], [c=Highlight]Aero Erosion[/c], and [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c], or dealing the corresponding Negative Status DMG.
- Consuming [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c] stacks on the target.
When the active Resonator is not in the [c=Highlight]Ceaseless Landscape[/c], this Crit. DMG bonus effect is disabled.

sequences.name: Sparse Curtains Invite Evening Glow
sequences.description:
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 4[/c].

Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance[/c] grants [c=Highlight]Kingfisher[/c]. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect. Casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 4[/c] consumes [c=Highlight]Kingfisher[/c] to restore 20 points of Concerto Energy and 350 points of [c=Highlight]Floral Epistle[/c]. [c=Highlight]Kingfisher[/c] can be consumed up to once every 25s.

sequences.name: Autumn Mountains in Choir Sing
sequences.description: Healing provided by [c=Highlight]Enrichment[/c] and  [c=Highlight]Spring's Birth[/c] are increased by 50%.

sequences.name: I Long To Ride The Eastern Wind
sequences.description: The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance[/c] and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance[/c] are increased by 100%.

sequences.name: Staying True To This Splendid Realm
sequences.description: The Crit. DMG of [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Tinkling Jade[/c] and [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Awakening Spring[/c] is increased by 500%.

skills.name: POW POW
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Chixia fires up to 4 consecutive shots, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Chixia enters the aiming state for a more powerful shot.
The aimed shot fired after charging finishes deals [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Chixia consumes STA to perform consecutive shots at the target in mid-air, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

skills.name: Whizzing Fight Spirit
skills.description:
Chixia unleashes a flurry of shots, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
 
[c=Highlight]Whizzing Fight Spirit[/c] has 2 initial charges.

skills.name: Blazing Flames
skills.description: Chixia fires up fast shots at nearby enemies, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

skills.name: Scorching Magazine
skills.description: Max Thermobaric Bullets is increased by 10 rounds. The damage of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Boom Boom[/c] is increased by 50%.

skills.name: Tune Break: Pistols
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Numbingly Spicy!
skills.description: Each Thermobaric Bullet that hits a target during Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]DAKA DAKA![/c] increases ATK by 1% for 10s, stacking up to 30 times.

skills.name: Grand Entrance
skills.description: Chixia makes a heroic entrance and fires rapidly with her dual pistols at the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

skills.name: Heroic Bullets
skills.description:
[c=Title]Resonance Skill: DAKA DAKA![/c]
Hold Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Whizzing Fight Spirit[/c] to enter [c=Highlight]DAKA DAKA![/c]. In this state:
- Chixia continuously consumes "Thermobaric Bullets" to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered as Resonance Skill DMG.
- Tap [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack 4[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered as Basic Attack DMG. Then she exits the "DAKA DAKA!" state.
- If 30 "Thermobaric Bullets" have been fired when [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] is activated, Chixia will cast Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Boom Boom[/c] and exit "DAKA DAKA!" state.
- Chixia exits the "DAKA DAKA!" state when all "Thermobaric Bullets" are consumed.
 
[c=Title]Resonance Skill: Boom Boom[/c]
Deal [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered as Resonance Skill DMG.
 
[c=Title]Thermobaric Bullets[/c]
Chixia can hold up to 60 "Thermobaric Bullets".
Inherent Skill [c=Highlight]Scorching Magazine[/c] increases Max "Thermobaric Bullets" by 10.
Chixia obtains "Thermobaric Bullets" for every Normal Attack [c=Highlight]POW POW[/c] on hit.
Chixia obtains "Thermobaric Bullets" upon casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Grand Entrance[/c] and Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Whizzing Fight Spirit[/c].

skills.name: Leaping Flames
skills.description: Chixia releases a shock wave surrounding the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c] equal to 530.00% of Chixia's ATK to enemies within the range.

sequences.name: No.1 Hero Play Fan
sequences.description: Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Boom Boom[/c] hits will always be Critical Hits.

sequences.name: Leaping Sparkles
sequences.description: During Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Blazing Flames[/c], for every 1 target defeated, Chixia recovers 5 Resonance Energy, up to 20 each time.

sequences.name: Eternal Flames
sequences.description: Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Blazing Flames[/c] deals 40% more DMG to targets whose HP is below 50%.

sequences.name: Hero’s Ultimate Move
sequences.description: Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Blazing Flames[/c] grants 60 "Thermobaric Bullets" and immediately resets the Cooldown of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Whizzing Fight Spirit[/c].

sequences.name: Triumphant Explosions
sequences.description: When the Inherent Skill [c=Highlight]Numbingly Spicy![/c] reaches max stacks, ATK is additionally increased by 30%.

sequences.name: Easter Egg Performance
sequences.description: Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Boom Boom[/c] increases the Basic Attack DMG Bonus of all team members by 25% for 15s.

skills.name: Wooly Attack
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Encore performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Basic Attack: Wooly Strike[/c]
After [c=Highlight]Basic Attack 4[/c], press the Normal Attack button to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Encore consumes STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Encore consumes STA to perform a Mid-Air Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

skills.name: Flaming Woolies
skills.description:
[c=Title]Flaming Woolies[/c]
Encore summons Cloudy and Cosmos to attack with burning rays, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Energetic Welcome[/c]
After casting [c=Highlight]Flaming Woolies[/c], use [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to perform [c=Highlight]Energetic Welcome[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

skills.name: Cosmos Rave
skills.description:
As Encore loses control, Cosmos breaks free and wreaks havoc on its surroundings.
 
[c=Title]Basic Attack: Cosmos - Frolicking[/c]
During Cosmos Rave, the [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Cosmos - Frolicking[/c], which performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered as Basic Attack DMG.
 
[c=Title]Cosmos: Heavy Attack[/c]
During Cosmos Rave, the [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Cosmos - Heavy Attack[/c], consuming STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
 
[c=Title]Resonance Skill: Cosmos - Rampage[/c]
During Cosmos Rave, [c=Highlight]Flaming Woolies[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Cosmos - Rampage[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered as Resonance Skill DMG.
 
[c=Title]Cosmos: Dodge Counter[/c]
During Cosmos Rave, use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered as Basic Attack DMG.

skills.name: Woolies Helpers
skills.description: Encore pounces at the enemies with Cosmos, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

skills.name: Thermal Field
skills.description: Encore generates a Thermal Field centered around skill target, with a radius of 3m. Targets inside the Thermal Field are continuously burned, suffering [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c] equal to 176.76% of Encore's ATK every 1.5s for 6s.

skills.name: Tune Break: Rectifier
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Black & White Woolies
skills.description:
[c=Title]Heavy Attack: Cloudy Frenzy[/c]
When Encore's "Mayhem" is full, after casting a [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c], Encore will consume all "Mayhem" to enter the Mayhem state, reducing damage taken by 70%. Switching Characters does not interrupt the Mayhem state.
After the Mayhem state ends, Encore will cast [c=Highlight]Cloudy Frenzy[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered as Resonance Liberation damage.
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack: Cosmos Rupture[/c]
During Cosmos Rave, when casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c], if "Mayhem" is full, Encore will consume all "Mayhem" to enter Cosmos' Mayhem state, reducing damage taken by 70%. Switching Characters does not interrupt the Cosmos' Mayhem state.
After Cosmos' Mayhem state ends, Encore will cast [c=Highlight]Cosmos Rupture[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered as Resonance Liberation DMG. 
[c=Title]Mayhem[/c]
Encore can hold up to 100 "Mayhem".
When Normal Attack [c=Highlight]Wooly Attack[/c] hits a target, Encore restores "Mayhem".
When Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Flaming Woolies[/c] hits a target, Encore restores "Mayhem".
When Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Energetic Welcome[/c] hits a target, Encore restores "Mayhem".
When Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Woolies Helpers[/c] hits a target, Encore restores "Mayhem".
During the duration of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Cosmos Rave[/c], Encore restores "Mayhem" when hitting a target.

skills.name: Angry Cosmos
skills.description: During the Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Cosmos Rave[/c], when Encore's HP is above 70%, DMG dealt is increased by 10%.

skills.name: Woolies Cheer Dance
skills.description: When Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Flaming Woolies[/c] or Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Cosmos - Rampage[/c] is cast, Encore's Fusion DMG Bonus is increased by 10% for 10s.

sequences.name: Wooly's Fairy Tale
sequences.description: When [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] hits a target, Encore's Fusion DMG Bonus is increased by 3%, stacking up to 4 time(s) for 6s.

sequences.name: Sheep-counting Lullaby
sequences.description: Encore additionally restores 10 Resonance Energy when casting Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Wooly Strike[/c] or Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Energetic Welcome[/c]. This can be triggered once every 10s.

sequences.name: Fog? The Black Shores!
sequences.description: The DMG multiplier of Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Cloudy Frenzy[/c] and Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Cosmos Rupture[/c] is increased by 40%.

sequences.name: Adventure? Let's go!
sequences.description: Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Cosmos Rupture[/c] increases the Fusion DMG Bonus of all team members by 20% for 30s.

sequences.name: Hero Takes the Stage!
sequences.description: Resonance Skill DMG Bonus is increased by 35%.

sequences.name: Woolies Save the World!
sequences.description: During Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Cosmos Rave[/c], Encore gains 1 stack(s) of "Lost Lamb" every time she deals damage, each stack increasing her ATK by 5% for 10s, stacking up to 5 time(s).

skills.name: Impromptu Show
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Mortefi uses his dual pistols and flames to perform up to 4 consecutive shots, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Mortefi enters the aiming state for a more powerful shot.
The aimed shot fired after charging finishes deals [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Mortefi consumes STA to perform consecutive shots at the target in mid-air, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

skills.name: Passionate Variation
skills.description: Launch a flashing lightning of flames forward, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

skills.name: Violent Finale
skills.description:
Deal [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], and apply [c=Highlight]Burning Rhapsody[/c] to all characters on the team.
 
[c=Title]Burning Rhapsody[/c]
When the active character's [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] hits the target, Mortefi launches a Coordinated Attack, firing 1 [c=Highlight]Marcato[/c].
When the active character's [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] hits the target, Mortefi launches a Coordinated Attack, firing 2 [c=Highlight]Marcato[/c].
Mortefi can launch one Coordinated Attack every 0.35s.
 
[c=Title]Marcato[/c]
Deals [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

skills.name: Harmonic Control
skills.description: After casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Passionate Variation[/c], the damage of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Fury Fugue[/c] is increased by 25% for 8s.

skills.name: Tune Break: Pistols
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Rhythmic Vibrato
skills.description:
During Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Burning Rhapsody[/c], each hit of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Marcato[/c] will increase the DMG of the next Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Marcato[/c] by 1.5%, which can be triggered once every 0.35s, stacking up to 50 times.
The effect will be reset after Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Burning Rhapsody[/c] ends.

skills.name: Dissonance
skills.description: Attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

skills.name: Rage Transposition
skills.description: The incoming Resonator gains 38% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification for 14s or until they are switched out.

skills.name: Fury Fugue
skills.description:
[c=Title]Resonance Skill: Fury Fugue[/c]
When Mortefi's Annoyance reaches 100, his [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Fury Fugue[/c].
When casting Fury Fugue, Mortefi consumes all Annoyance to unleash high-speed flame lightning, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered as Resonance Skill DMG.
 
[c=Title]Annoyance[/c]
Mortefi can hold up to 100 Annoyance and can restore Annoyance in the following ways:
- When Normal Attack [c=Highlight]Impromptu Show[/c] hits the target
- When Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Dissonance[/c] hits the target
- When Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Passionate Variation[/c] hits the target
- Within 5s after casting [c=Highlight]Passionate Variation[/c], Normal Attack [c=Highlight]Impromptu Show[/c] that hits the target restores Annoyance additionally.

sequences.name: Solitary Etude
sequences.description: During Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Burning Rhapsody[/c], Mortefi launches Coordinated Attacks when the on-field character performs their Resonance Skills, firing 2 Resonance Liberation's [c=Highlight]Marcato[/c] hits, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

sequences.name: Hypocritical Hymn
sequences.description: After using the Echo Skill, Mortefi restores an additional 10 Resonance Energy. This can be triggered once every 20 second.

sequences.name: Flaming Recitativo
sequences.description: During Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Burning Rhapsody[/c], the Crit. DMG of Resonance Liberation's [c=Highlight]Marcato[/c] is increased by 30%.

sequences.name: Cathartic Waltz
sequences.description: The duration of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Burning Rhapsody[/c] is extended by 7s.

sequences.name: Funerary Quartet
sequences.description: When Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Passionate Variation[/c] or Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Fury Fugue[/c] hits a target, Coordinated Attacks will be triggered to fire 4 Resonance Liberation's [c=Highlight]Marcato[/c] hit(s), dealing [c=Fire]Fusion Damage[/c]. DMG of Resonance Liberation's [c=Highlight]Marcato[/c] fired in this way is reduced by 50%.

sequences.name: Apoplectic Instrumental
sequences.description: When Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Violent Finale[/c] is cast, ATK of all team members is increased by 20% for 20s.

skills.name: Blazing Enlightment
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
After releasing [c=Highlight]Basic Attack 4[/c], enter [c=Highlight]True Sight[/c], lasting for 12s.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume Stamina to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks in mid-air, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
After releasing [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack 4[/c], enter [c=Highlight]True Sight[/c], lasting for 12s.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Hold [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] on the ground to perform an upward strike at the cost of Stamina, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c]. Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] within a certain time to release [c=Highlight]Mid-Air Attack 3[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Heavy Attack[/c]
Shortly after holding [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] in mid-air or using Basic Attack [c=Highlight]True Sight: Charge[/c], use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] to perform a plunging attack at the cost of Stamina, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c]. Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] within a certain time to release [c=Highlight]Basic Attack 3[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

skills.name: Tripartite Flames
skills.description:
[c=Title]True Sight: Capture[/c]
After releasing [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c], Changli dashes towards the enemy and enters [c=Highlight]True Sight[/c], lasting for 12s. In the end, she releases a plunging attack, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
[c=Highlight]True Sight: Capture[/c] has 2 initial charges and holds up to 2 charges at maximum. The number of charges is replenished by 1 every 12s.
Can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Basic Attack: True Sight - Conquest[/c]
When in [c=Highlight]True Sight[/c], if Changli uses [c=Highlight]Ground Basic Attack[/c], she releases [c=Highlight]True Sight: Conquest[/c], dashing towards the enemy and dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered as Resonance Skill DMG. After releasing [c=Highlight]True Sight: Conquest[/c], [c=Highlight]True Sight[/c] ends.

[c=Title]Basic Attack: True Sight - Charge[/c]
When in [c=Highlight]True Sight[/c], if Changli [c=Highlight]jumps[/c] or uses [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] in mid-air, she releases [c=Highlight]True Sight: Charge[/c], dashing towards the enemy and dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered as Resonance Skill DMG. After releasing [c=Highlight]True Sight: Charge[/c], [c=Highlight]True Sight[/c] ends.

skills.name: Radiance of Fealty
skills.description:
Deal [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c] to nearby targets, obtaining 4 stacks of Enflamement, and entering [c=Highlight]Fiery Feather[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Fiery Feather[/c]
When Changli releases Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Flaming Sacrifice[/c] within 10s, her ATK is increased by 25%, after which [c=Highlight]Fiery Feather[/c] ends.

skills.name: Secret Strategist
skills.description: When casting Basic Attack: [c=Highlight]True Sight - Conquest[/c] or Basic Attack: [c=Highlight]True Sight - Charge[/c], each stack of Enflamement will increase Fusion DMG Bonus by 5%.

skills.name: Tune Break: Sword
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Sweeping Force
skills.description: Casting Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Flaming Sacrifice[/c] or Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Radiance of Fealty[/c] gives 20% Fusion DMG Bonus and ignores 15% of the target's DEF when dealing damage.

skills.name: Obedience of Rules
skills.description: Changli appears in mid-air, attacks the target, and enters [c=Highlight]True Sight[/c], lasting for 12s.

skills.name: Strategy of Duality
skills.description: The incoming Resonator has their Fusion DMG Amplified by 20% and Resonance Liberation DMG Amplified by 25% for 10s or until the Resonator is switched out.

skills.name: Flaming Sacrifice
skills.description:
[c=Title]Heavy Attack: Flaming Sacrifice[/c]
When releasing [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c], if Changli carries 4 stacks of Enflamement, she consumes all stacks of Enflamement to cast [c=Highlight]Flaming Sacrifice[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered as Resonance Skill DMG.
While casting [c=Highlight]Flaming Sacrifice[/c], Changli takes 40% less DMG.

[c=Title]Enflamement[/c]
Changli can hold up to 4 stacks of Enflamement.
Changli obtains 1 stack of Enflamement for every Basic Attack: [c=Highlight]True Sight - Conquest[/c] on hit.
Changli obtains 1 stack of Enflamement for every Basic Attack: [c=Highlight]True Sight - Charge[/c] on hit.
Changli obtains 4 stacks of Enflamement for every Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Radiance of Fealty[/c].

sequences.name: Hidden Thoughts
sequences.description: Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Tripartite Flames[/c] and Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Flaming Sacrifice[/c] increase Changli's DMG dealt by 10% and resistance to interruption.

sequences.name: Pursuit of Desires
sequences.description: Enflamement increases Changli's Crit. Rate by 25% for 8s.

sequences.name: Learned Secrets
sequences.description: Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Radiance of Fealty[/c] DMG is increased by 80%.

sequences.name: Polished Words
sequences.description: After Intro Skill is cast, all team members' ATK is increased by 20% for 30s.

sequences.name: Sacrificed Gains
sequences.description: Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Flaming Sacrifice[/c]'s Multiplier is increased by 50% and its DMG dealt is increased by 50%.

sequences.name: Realized Plans
sequences.description: Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Tripartite Flames[/c], Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Flaming Sacrifice[/c], and Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Radiance of Fealty[/c] ignore an additional 40% of the target's DEF when dealing damage.

skills.name: Captain's Rhapsody
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Rhapsodic Riff[/c]
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
- After performing Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Stage 2[/c] or [c=Highlight]Stage 4[/c], hold Normal Attack to perform [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Rhapsodic Riff[/c].
-  After performing [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack Stage 4[/c], press Normal Attack to perform [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Rhapsodic Riff[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
Press Normal Attack following Mid-air Attack [c=Highlight]Stage 1[/c] or [c=Highlight]Stage 2[/c] to swing to the target with Grapple. Brant will attack the target if he reaches them with the swing. Release while in action to [c=Highlight]flip backward[/c] after the attack hits; or hold Normal Attack to attack the target continuously and [c=Highlight]flip backward[/c] after the finishing move. Brant [c=Highlight]flips backward[/c] automatically after [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack Stage 3[/c]. Press Normal Attack after each [c=Highlight]flip[/c] to perform the next stage of [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack[/c]. [c=Highlight]Flip[/c] resets Mid-air Dodge attempts.
- If Brant fails to reach the target with the Grapple swing of [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack Stage 1[/c], he instead performs a slash forward, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
- If Brant reaches the target with the Grapple swing of [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack Stage 1[/c] or [c=Highlight]Stage 2[/c] but the attack fails to hit the target, he will drop down after a temporary suspension in mid-air.
  
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] right after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

rows.label: Mid-air Attack Stage 1: Charged Attack DMG
Mid-air Attack Stage 2: Charged Attack DMG
Heavy Attack - Rhapsodic Riff STA Cost

skills.name: Anchors Aweigh!
skills.description:
Brant launches himself into the air and blasts all targets in an area, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c]. While in mid-air, if Bravo is not full, Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Anchors Aweigh![/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Plunging Attack[/c].
 
[c=Title]Plunging Attack[/c]
Plunge at the target at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], which is considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c].
- If Brant fails to reach the target with the Grapple swing of [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack Stage 1[/c], he instead performs a slash forward. Afterward, press Normal Attack to perform [c=Highlight]Plunging Attack[/c].
- If Brant reaches the target with the Grapple swing of Mid-air Attack [c=Highlight]Stage 1[/c] or [c=Highlight]Stage 2[/c] but the attack fails to hit the target, press Normal Attack to perform [c=Highlight]Plunging Attack[/c] during the suspension.

skills.name: To the Horizon
skills.description:
Deal [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c] to targets within the range and heal all nearby Resonators in the team before entering the [c=Highlight]Aflame[/c] state.
Can be cast in mid-air.
 
[c=Title]Aflame[/c]
The efficiency of gaining Bravo is increased by 100% when [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] or Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Anchors Aweigh![/c] hits the target. Meanwhile, Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Theatrical Moment[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]"My" Moment[/c].
 
[c=Title]"My" Moment[/c]
Brant gains additional ATK based on his Energy Regen: For every 1% of his Energy Regen over 150%, Brant gains additional 20 points of ATK, up to 2600.

skills.name: Applaud for Me!
skills.description:
Attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], and gain [c=Highlight]Interlude Applause[/c] effect.
 
[c=Title]Interlude Applause[/c]
The next Mid-air Attack begins at [c=Highlight]Stage 2[/c]. This effect ends when Brant lands early or is switched out.

skills.name: The Course is Set!
skills.description: Amplify the incoming Resonator's Fusion DMG by 20% and Resonance Skill DMG by 25% for 14s or until the Resonator is switched out.

skills.name: Tune Break: Sword
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Ocean Odyssey
skills.description:
[c=Title]Theatrical Moment[/c]
Brant gains additional ATK based on his Energy Regen: For every 1% of his Energy Regen over 150%, Brant gains additional 12 points of ATK, up to 1560.
 
[c=Title]Waves of Acclaims[/c]
Heal all nearby Resonators in the team when Bravo reaches 25, 50, 75, and 100.
 
[c=Title]Returned from Ashes[/c]
When Bravo is full, replace Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Anchor Aweigh![/c] with [c=Highlight]Returned from Ashes[/c].
Consume all Bravo to perform [c=Highlight]Returned from Ashes[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c], and generate a shield for all nearby Resonators in the team. Casting this skill when in [c=Highlight]Aflame[/c] ends this state after [c=Highlight]Returned from Ashes[/c] ends.
- The shield cannot be transferred when the Resonator on the field is switched off.
 
[c=Title]Bravo[/c]
Brant can hold up to 100 Bravo.
- Obtain Bravo when Normal Attacks hit the target.
- Obtain Bravo when Intro Skill hits the target.
- Obtain Bravo when Resonance Skill hits the target.

skills.name: Voyager's Blaze
skills.description: Healing provided by [c=Highlight]Waves of Acclaims[/c] is increased by 20%.

skills.name: Trial by Fire and Tide
skills.description: Brant's resistance to interruption is increased during [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attacks[/c] and gains 15% [c=Fire]Fusion DMG Bonus[/c].

sequences.name: By Currents and Winds
sequences.description:
[c=Highlight]Returned from Ashes[/c] temporarily causes nearby targets to stagnate while casting. The stagnation effect is removed when Brant is switched off the field.
After casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Applaud for Me![/c] or each [c=Highlight]flip[/c] following Mid-air Attack, Brant's DMG dealt is increased by 20% for 5s, stacking up to 3 times.

sequences.name: For Smiles and Cheers
sequences.description:
Casting [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack[/c] and [c=Highlight]Returned from Ashes[/c] increases Brant's Crit. Rate by 30%. 
Brant's Outro Skill [c=Highlight]The Course is Set![/c] gains a new enhancement:
When [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] cast by the incoming Resonator (or nearby Resonators who activate Brant's Outro Skill) hits a target within 20s after Brant's Outro Skill, Brant blasts the hit target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c] equal to 440% of Brant's ATK (considered Basic Attack DMG). This explosion can be triggered 1 times per second, up to 2 explosions in total.
- This effect remains active when Brant is switched off the field.

sequences.name: Through Storms I Sail
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Returned from Ashes[/c] is increased by 42%.

sequences.name: To Freedom I Sing
sequences.description: The Shield obtained from [c=Highlight]Returned from Ashes[/c] is increased by 20%. Casting [c=Highlight]Returned from Ashes[/c] restores HP for all nearby Resonators in the team (6.60 HP for every 1% Energy Regen).

sequences.name: All the World's an Actor's Stage
sequences.description: Dealing Basic Attack DMG gives Brant 15% [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG Bonus[/c] for 10s.

sequences.name: All the World's a Captain's Carnevale
sequences.description: [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack's[/c] DMG Multiplier is increased by 30%. Casting [c=Highlight]Returned from Ashes[/c] causes a secondary blast, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c] equal to 30% of the DMG dealt by [c=Highlight]Returned from Ashes[/c], considered Basic Attack DMG.

skills.name: Flaming Star
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
- After Basic Attack Stage 3, press Normal Attack in the right time to cast [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack Stage 1[/c].
- After [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c], Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Starfall[/c], Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Shewolf's Hunt[/c], or Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Feral Fang[/c], press Normal Attack in time to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing[/c]
When Wolflame reaches 50 points, [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] will be replaced by [c=Highlight]Wolf's Gnawing[/c], consuming STA to attack the target and dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
- This attack does not restore Wolflame. Consume 50 points of Wolflame to perform this attack and gain 1 points of Wolfaith.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw[/c]
When Wolflame reaches 50 points and Wolfaith reaches 1 point, [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] will be replaced by [c=Highlight]Wolf's Claw[/c], consuming STA to attack the target and dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
- If Wolflame reaches 50 points and Wolfaith reaches 1 point after performing [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Firestrike[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] in time to perform [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw[/c].
- This attack does not restore Wolflame. Consume 50 points of Wolflame to perform this attack and gain 1 points of Wolfaith.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c] 
Consume STA to perform up to 3 attacks in mid-air, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c]. The [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack[/c] cycle will not be reset.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Firestrike[/c]
When Wolflame reaches 50 points, [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack Stage 3[/c] will be replaced by [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Firestrike[/c], consuming STA to attack the target and dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c] (considered Heavy Attack DMG).
- This attack does not restore Wolflame. Consume 50 points of Wolflame to perform this attack and gain 1 points of Wolfaith.

[c=Title]Plunging Attack[/c]
Hold Normal Attack while airborne to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c]. After performing this attack, press Normal Attack in time to perform Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Starfall[/c].
- If a [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] is performed while casting [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack Stage 3[/c] or [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Firestrike[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to perform [c=Highlight]Plunging Attack[/c] in time at the cost of STA.

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Starfall[/c]
Attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Press Normal Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
