Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw STA Cost

skills.name: Shewolf's Hunt
skills.description:
Lupa hurls her Wildfire Banner at the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c] and restoring 15 points of Wolflame. [c=Highlight]Mark[/c] the target for 8s. After performing Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Shewolf's Hunt[/c], Lupa can perform [c=Highlight]Feral Fang[/c] within a certain period of time.
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.
- Hold Resonance Skill to leap into the air, then press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] in time to cast [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack Stage 1[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Feral Fang[/c]
Lupa locks onto a target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c] and restoring 15 points of Wolflame. The DMG Multiplier to [c=Highlight]marked[/c] targets is increased by 50%. Resonance Skill - Feral Fang enters cooldown if not cast in time or when Lupa is switched out.
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.

skills.name: Fire-Kissed Glory
skills.description:
Attack the target and deal [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c]. Performing this attack consumes all Wolfaith and restores 100 points of Wolflame. Use Basic Attack or Resonance Skill in time to cast Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Foebreaker[/c].
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.
Performing this skill strengthens all Resonators in the team. Within 35s:
- All Resonators in the team gain [c=Highlight]Pack Hunt[/c] effect.
- If the active Resonator is hit or launched into the air, they immediately recover and are considered to have successfully dodged the attack when they are on the ground. Can be triggered up to 3 times.

[c=Title]Pack Hunt[/c]
Resonators with [c=Highlight]Pack Hunt[/c] gain a 6% ATK increase, and 10% Fusion DMG Bonus when they attack Overlord Class or Calamity Class targets (Both are non-stackable). If there are 3 Fusion Resonators in the team, the Fusion DMG Bonus against Overlord Class or Calamity Class targets additionally increases by 10%. When the active Resonator casts [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c], [c=Highlight]Pack Hunt[/c] is enhanced, granting an additional 6% ATK increase to all Resonators in the team, up to a maximum of 18%.
If Lupa's [c=Highlight]Pack Hunt[/c] reaches its cap within its duration, she enters [c=Highlight]Wild Hunt[/c] and Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Nowhere to Run![/c] becomes available. [c=Highlight]Wild Hunt[/c] can be triggered once per [c=Highlight]Pack Hunt[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Foebreaker[/c]
Consume all Wolflame to perform [c=Highlight]Foebreaker[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c] and entering [c=Highlight]Burning Matchpoint[/c] state. 

[c=Title]Burning Matchpoint[/c]
Normal Attacks restore 500% more Wolflame on hit. Cannot perform Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Shewolf's Hunt[/c] and Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Feral Fang[/c] in this state.

skills.name: Try Focusing, Eh?
skills.description:
Attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c]. Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] following Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Try Focusing, Eh?[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Nowhere to Run![/c]
When Lupa enters the [c=Highlight]Wild Hunt[/c] state, her next Intro Skill is replaced with [c=Highlight]Nowhere to Run![/c]. Casting [c=Highlight]Nowhere to Run![/c] removes the [c=Highlight]Pack Hunt[/c] and [c=Highlight]Glory[/c] effects on all Resonators in the team, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c] (considered Resonance Liberation DMG).

skills.name: Stand by Me, Warrior
skills.description: The incoming Resonator will have their Fusion DMG Amplified by 20% and Basic Attack DMG Amplified by 25% for 14s or until the Resonator is switched out.

skills.name: Tune Break: Broadblade
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Ignis Lupa
skills.description:
[c=Title]Wildfire Banner[/c]
Lupa's ATK is increased by 12% for 8s when performing the following actions:
- Casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Feral Fang[/c].
- Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw[/c], or [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Firestrike[/c].
- Casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Fire-Kissed Glory[/c].
- Casting [c=Highlight]Dance With the Wolf[/c] and [c=Highlight]Dance With the Wolf: Climax[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Dance With the Wolf[/c]
When Wolfaith reaches 2 points, Resonance Skill is replaced with [c=Highlight]Dance With the Wolf[/c]. Performing [c=Highlight]Dance With the Wolf[/c] consumes all Wolfaith, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c] (considered Resonance Liberation DMG).
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Dance With the Wolf: Climax[/c]
When Wolfaith reaches 2 points in the [c=Highlight]Burning Matchpoint[/c] state, Resonance Skill is replaced with [c=Highlight]Dance With the Wolf: Climax[/c]. Performing [c=Highlight]Dance With the Wolf: Climax[/c] consumes all Wolfaith, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c] (considered Resonance Liberation DMG). [c=Highlight]Burning Matchpoint[/c] is removed when the skill ends.
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Set the Arena Ablaze[/c]
Within 8s after performing [c=Highlight]Dance With the Wolf[/c] or [c=Highlight]Dance With the Wolf: Climax[/c], Lupa will remain on the field after switching to another Resonator and back up the active Resonator when they perform [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c] (considered Resonance Skill DMG). This effect can only be triggered once in its duration.

[c=Title]Wolflame[/c]
Lupa can hold up to 100 points of Wolflame.
- Restore Wolflame when Normal Attacks hit the target.
- Restore Wolflame while casting Resonance Skill.
- Restore Wolflame while casting Resonance Liberation.

[c=Title]Wolfaith[/c]
Lupa can hold up to 2 points of Wolfaith.
Wolfaith lasts for 10s. The duration is reset when Wolfaith is restored. At the end of its duration, each remaining point of Wolfaith becomes 50 points of Wolflame.
- Restore 1 point of Wolfaith when casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw[/c], or [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Firestrike[/c].

rows.label: Dance With the Wolf: Climax DMG

skills.name: Remember My Name
skills.description:
After dashing for 2.5s, Lupa enters Sprint state. The next [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Starfall[/c].
Gain increased resistance to interruptions while casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw[/c], and [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Firestrike[/c].

skills.name: Applause of Victory
skills.description:
Defeating a [c=Highlight]marked[/c] target resets the cooldown of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Shewolf's Hunt[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Liberation - Glory[/c]
Casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Fire-Kissed Glory[/c] grants [c=Highlight]Glory[/c]. Within 35s:
Attacks of all Resonators in the team ignore 3% of the target's Fusion RES. For each Fusion Resonator in the team other than Lupa, this effect increases by 3%, up to the maximum of 9%. When there are 3 Fusion Resonators in the team, Resonators' attacks further ignore 6% Fusion RES.

sequences.name: Behold the Nameless One
sequences.description:
Performing Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Fire-Kissed Glory[/c] recovers 10 Concerto Energy for Lupa and increases Lupa's Crit. Rate by 20% for 10s.
Gain immunity to interruption when casting [c=Highlight]Dance With the Wolf: Climax[/c].

sequences.name: Every Ground, Her Hunting Field
sequences.description: Performing [c=Highlight]Fire-Kissed Glory[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing[/c],  [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw[/c], or [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Firestrike[/c] gives 20% Fusion DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30s, stacking up to 2 times.

sequences.name: Wolflame Howls in Her Wake
sequences.description:
The DMG Multiplier of Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Nowhere to Run![/c] increases by 100%.
- The [c=Highlight]Pack Hunt[/c] effect of Resonance Liberation now no longer requires 3 Fusion Resonators.
- The [c=Highlight]Glory[/c] effect of Resonance Liberation is now modified as:
Casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Fire-Kissed Glory[/c] additionally grants [c=Highlight]Glory[/c]: Resonators in the team ignore 15% Fusion RES of targets for 35s.

sequences.name: Embrace the Thunderous Triumph

sequences.name: To the Brightest Flaming Star
sequences.description:
- The damage dealt by Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Dance With the Wolf: Climax[/c], Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Fire-Kissed Glory[/c], and Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Nowhere to Run![/c] ignores 30% of the target's DEF.
- Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Feral Fang[/c] restores 100 points of Wolflame on hit, triggered once per 20s.
- Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Dance With the Wolf[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Dance With the Wolf: Climax[/c]. [c=Highlight]Dance With the Wolf: Climax[/c] can be performed when Lupa is not in [c=Highlight]Burning Matchpoint[/c] state.
- Casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Nowhere to Run![/c] no longer ends [c=Highlight]Pack Hunt[/c] and [c=Highlight]Glory[/c].

skills.name: Slayer's Trigger
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c]. Basic Attack Stage 1 to 3 DMG are considered as [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack DMG[/c], and Basic Attack Stage 4 DMG as [c=Highlight]Echo Skill DMG[/c].
Press Normal Attack right after performing [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 4[/c] to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Volley of Death[/c]
Consume STA to attack the target and perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c]. Stage 3 DMG is considered as [c=Highlight]Echo Skill DMG[/c].
Press Normal Attack right after performing [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Volley of Death Stage 1[/c] to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c]. Press Normal Attack right after performing [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Volley of Death Stage 2 or 3[/c] to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Ashfall Barrage[/c]
While in mid-air, press Normal Attack to consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered as [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack DMG[/c].
While in mid-air, hold Normal Attack to continuously consume STA to launch a barrage of shots at targets below, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered as [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack DMG[/c]. If Galbrena does not land when interrupted during the barrage, she cannot immediately cast this skill again. Release Normal Attack during the barrage to cast Plunging Attack.
Press Normal Attack right after casting Plunging Attack to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Blood for Blood[/c]
Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered as [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack DMG[/c].
Press Normal Attack right after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 4[/c].

skills.name: Beyond Threshold
skills.description:
[c=Title]Threshold State[/c]
By default, Galbrena is in [c=Highlight]Threshold State[/c], and in this state, she accumulates [c=Highlight]Afterflame[/c] and [c=Highlight]Sinflame[/c].

[c=Title]Demon Hypostasis[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Demon Hypostasis[/c], Basic Attack, Heavy Attack - Volley of Death, Mid-air Attack - Ashfall Barrage, Dodge Counter - Blood for Blood, and Resonance Skill - Encroach are replaced with Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution, Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict, Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage, Dodge Counter - Purgatory Scourge, and Resonance Skill - Ravage, which consume [c=Highlight]Purging Flame[/c] on hit.
While in [c=Highlight]Demon Hypostasis[/c], every point of [c=Highlight]Afterflame[/c] increases the DMG of [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Ravage[/c], and [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Purgatory Scourge[/c] by 1.5%, up to 60%, which is removed upon exiting [c=Highlight]Demon Hypostasis[/c].
When [c=Highlight]Purging Flame[/c] depletes or after staying in [c=Highlight]Demon Hypostasis[/c] for over 50s, [c=Highlight]Demon Hypostasis[/c] ends automatically.

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution[/c]
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c]. Consume [c=Highlight]Purging Flame[/c] on hit. Stage 1 to 3 DMG are considered [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack DMG[/c], and Stage 4 & 5 DMG [c=Highlight]Echo Skill DMG[/c].
Press Normal Attack after casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 5[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict[/c]
Consume STA to attack the target and perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c]. Consume [c=Highlight]Purging Flame[/c] on hit. Stage 3 DMG is considered [c=Highlight]Echo Skill DMG[/c].
Press Normal Attack after casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict Stage 1[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 2[/c]. 
Press Normal Attack after casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict Stage 2 & 3[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 3[/c]. 

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage[/c]
While in mid-air, press Normal Attack to consume STA to perform aerial attacks, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack DMG[/c]. Consume [c=Highlight]Purging Flame[/c] on hit.
While in mid-air, hold Normal Attack to continuously consume STA to launch a barrage of shots at targets, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack DMG[/c]. Consume [c=Highlight]Purging Flame[/c] on hit. If Galbrena does not land when interrupted during the barrage, she cannot immediately cast this skill again. Release Normal Attack during the barrage to cast Plunging Attack. 
Press Normal Attack after the Plunging Attack to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 3[/c]. 

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Purgatory Scourge[/c]
Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack DMG[/c].
Press Normal Attack right after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 4[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Ravage[/c]
Dash forward and leap into the air. Flip backward upon hitting the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack DMG[/c]. Consume [c=Highlight]Purging Flame[/c] on hit. [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Ravage[/c] and [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Encroach[/c] share a cooldown.

[c=Title]Hellstride[/c]
Press Dodge on the ground while casting [c=Highlight]Galbrena's own skills[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Hellstride[/c] to deal a fixed amount of [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered Basic Attack DMG that does not bear any effect from DMG buffs. [c=Highlight]Hellstride[/c] can trigger successful Dodges. [c=Highlight]Hellstride[/c] cannot be cast consecutively.
Casting this skill does not reset the attack cycles within a short period of time.

[c=Title]Burning Drive[/c]
Casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c], [c=Highlight]Hellstride[/c], [c=Highlight]Normal Attack - Seraphic Execution Basic Attack Stage 4[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Encroach[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Ascent of Malice[/c], and [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Ravage[/c] increases Galbrena's resistance to interruptions and ATK by 20% for 4s.

[c=Title]Afterflame[/c]
Galbrena can hold up to 40 points of [c=Highlight]Afterflame[/c].
While in [c=Highlight]Threshold State[/c], Galbrena recovers 8 points of [c=Highlight]Afterflame[/c] when Resonators in the nearby team cast Echo Skill. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once. This effect resets when Galbrena exits [c=Highlight]Demon Hypostasis[/c].
All [c=Highlight]Afterflame[/c] is removed upon exiting [c=Highlight]Demon Hypostasis[/c].

[c=Title]Sinflame[/c]
Galbrena can hold up to 100 points of [c=Highlight]Sinflame[/c].
While in [c=Highlight]Threshold State[/c], hitting an enemy with Basic Attack, Heavy Attack - Volley of Death, Mid-air Attack - Ashfall Barrage, Resonance Skill - Encroach, and Intro Skill - Hellflare Overload recovers [c=Highlight]Sinflame[/c].

skills.name: Oathbound Hunt
skills.description:
1 stack of [c=Highlight]Fated End[/c] is inflicted on the target when the following skills hit: [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Volley of Death[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Hellstride[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Encroach[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Ascent of Malice[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Ravage[/c] and [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c], up to 4 stacks. Each stack Amplifies the DMG directly dealt by Galbrena's [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c], [c=Highlight]Forte Circuit[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c], [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c], and [c=Highlight]Outro Skill[/c] by 5% for 5.5s. The same type of skill can trigger this effect on the same target once every 5s.
[c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Encroach[/c] and [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Ravage[/c] are considered the same type of skill.

While in [c=Highlight]Demon Hypostasis[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 5[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict Stage 3[/c], and [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage[/c] are immune to interruption.

sequences.name: Hunter’s Blood Oath Rekindled

sequences.description: When Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, all Resonators in the team gain 20% all-Attribute DMG Bonus for 20s.

sequences.name: Though Light Fades, Torment Consumes
sequences.description: The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Encroach[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Ascent of Malice[/c], and [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Ravage[/c] are increased by 150%.

sequences.name: I Remain Who I am, Eternal My Flame
sequences.description:
[c=Highlight]Demon Hypostasis[/c] becomes [c=Highlight]Eternal Hypostasis[/c]. [c=Highlight]Eternal Hypostasis[/c] retains all effects of [c=Highlight]Demon Hypostasis[/c].
Additionally, [c=Highlight]Eternal Hypostasis[/c] lasts, the DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict[/c],  [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage[/c], and [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter -Purgatory Scourge[/c] are additionally increased by 60%.

When casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Ascent of Malice[/c], for every 1 point of [c=Highlight]Afterflame[/c] consumed, Galbrena's [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Ravage[/c], and [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter -Purgatory Scourge[/c] gain 0.875% Fusion DMG Amplification, up to 35%, which is removed upon exiting [c=Highlight]Eternal Hypostasis[/c].

skills.name: Ground State Calibration
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

skills.name: Resolution
skills.description:
[c=Title]Expectation Error[/c]
Heal all nearby Resonators in the team and enter the Parry state, during which DMG taken is reduced by 100% for a time. Switching to another Resonator ends this state immediately.
If attacked while in the Parry state, exit the state and cast [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Optimal Solution[/c].
If not attacked while in the Parry state, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to exit the state and cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Optimal Solution[/c]
Stagnate nearby targets and deal [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], reducing the cooldown of [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Expectation Error[/c] by 2s.
Switching to another Resonator ends the Stagnation effect early.

[c=Title]Distributed Array[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Wide Field Observation Mode[/c], Resonance Skill is replaced with [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Distributed Array[/c].
Heal all nearby Resonators in the team and summon Hover Cannons to strike the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

skills.name: Critical Protocol
skills.description:
Attack the targets within the effective range, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
For every 1% of Mornye's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, this skill gains an additional 0.5% Crit. Rate (up to 80%) and 1% Crit. DMG (up to 160%).
When casting this skill, if a [c=Highlight]Syntony Field[/c] is present, remove it and generate a [c=Highlight]High Syntony Field[/c].
Can be performed in mid-air.

[c=Title]High Syntony Field[/c]
- [c=Highlight]High Syntony Field[/c] lasts for 25s. 
- Increases the DEF of all nearby Resonators in the team within the [c=Highlight]High Syntony Field[/c] by 20%.
- Inherits the [c=Highlight]Syntony Field[/c]'s boost to resistance to interruption and [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Buildup Rate[/c].
- Inherits the [c=Highlight]Syntony Field[/c]'s healing effect and increases the Healing Multiplier by 40%.

skills.name: Convergence
skills.description: Attack the target to deal [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], then jump into mid-air, clearing all [c=Highlight]Rest Mass Energy[/c] and entering [c=Highlight]Wide Field Observation Mode[/c].

skills.name: Recursion
skills.description: Resonators in the team gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 30s.

skills.name: Decoupling
skills.description:
Mornye can respond to [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture - Interfered[/c] and [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c].
- Responding to [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture - Interfered[/c]: When any Resonator in the team deals [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] DMG and inflicts [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture - Interfered[/c], Mornye casts [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture Response - Particle Jet[/c]. Each target can be damaged by this skill up to once every 8s.
- Responding to [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c]: Each stack of [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] on the target increases Mornye's total DMG against them. Each point of Mornye's [c=Highlight]Tune Break Boost[/c] increases the total DMG by 0.12%. While Mornye is in the team, the max stack limit of [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] on a target is increased by 1.
Mornye can perform [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] against the targets with full [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c].

skills.name: Mass-Energy Equivalence
skills.description:
[c=Title]Baseline Mode[/c]
While in her default [c=Highlight]Baseline Mode[/c], Mornye gains [c=Highlight]Rest Mass Energy[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift[/c]
When [c=Highlight]Rest Mass Energy[/c] reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack is replaced with [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift[/c].
Cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift[/c] to deal [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered Heavy Attack DMG. Afterward, Mornye jumps into mid-air, consumes all [c=Highlight]Rest Mass Energy[/c] and enters [c=Highlight]Wide Field Observation Mode[/c].

[c=Title]Wide Field Observation Mode[/c]
[c=Highlight]Wide Field Observation Mode[/c] lasts for 30s.
- Upon entering [c=Highlight]Wide Field Observation Mode[/c], Mornye generates a [c=Highlight]Syntony Field[/c].
- While in [c=Highlight]Wide Field Observation Mode[/c], Mornye gains [c=Highlight]Relative Momentum[/c].
- If [c=Highlight]Relative Momentum[/c] is below 100 when holding [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c], perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Stage 1 to 3[/c] in sequence. If [c=Highlight]Relative Momentum[/c] reaches 100 during this time, cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Inversion[/c] instead.
- While moving, Mornye continuously consumes STA. STA cannot be recovered while in [c=Highlight]Wide Field Observation Mode[/c].
- When [c=Highlight]Dodging[/c] with directional input, Mornye starts to fly at speed, which lasts for up to 10s or until STA is depleted or until the [c=Highlight]Wide Field Observation Mode[/c] ends.
- When Mornye is hit or launched into mid-air, press [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to immediately recover from the attack, which is considered a successful Dodge. This effect can be triggered up to 3 times, which resets when [c=Highlight]Wide Field Observation Mode[/c] ends.
- Press Jump and Mornye will slowly descend. Before she lands, [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Distributed Array[/c], and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Inversion[/c] are unavailable. If Jump is pressed when Mornye runs out of STA, she will exit the [c=Highlight]Wide Field Observation Mode[/c]. She will leave the [c=Highlight]Wide Field Observation Mode[/c] also when she [c=Highlight]Dodges[/c], Jumps, or performs Mid-air Attacks.
Additionally, performing environmental interactions, using Utilities, or switching to another Resonator ends [c=Highlight]Wide Field Observation Mode[/c]. The state also ends when Mornye is no longer airborne.

[c=Title]Syntony Field[/c]
- [c=Highlight]Syntony Field[/c] lasts for 25s.
- When the [c=Highlight]Syntony Field[/c] is generated, deal [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
- Continuously restores HP for nearby active Resonators in the team within the [c=Highlight]Syntony Field[/c], triggered once every 3s.
- Increases the [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Buildup Rate[/c] of all nearby Resonators in the team within the [c=Highlight]Syntony Field[/c] by 50%.
- Enhances the resistance to interruption of nearby active Resonators in the team within the [c=Highlight]Syntony Field[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Inversion[/c]
- When [c=Highlight]Relative Momentum[/c] reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack is replaced with [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Inversion[/c].
- Consume all [c=Highlight]Relative Momentum[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Inversion[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered Heavy Attack DMG.
- [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Inversion[/c] inflicts [c=Highlight]Observation Marker[/c] upon the target on hit for 30s.

[c=Title]Observation Marker[/c]
When a Resonator in the team deals [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] DMG to a target inflicted with [c=Highlight]Observation Marker[/c], Mornye inflicts an [c=Highlight]Interfered Marker[/c] on the target for 8s.

[c=Title]Interfered Marker[/c]
Targets affected by [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture - Interfered[/c] or [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] take increased DMG from all nearby Resonators in the team. For every 1% of Mornye's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, their DMG is increased by 0.25%, up to 40%.

[c=Title]Visual Field[/c]
When a Resonator in the team defeats a target inflicted with [c=Highlight]Observation Marker[/c] or [c=Highlight]Interfered Marker[/c], Mornye gains [c=Highlight]Visual Field[/c] for 3s. While in this state, Mornye inflicts [c=Highlight]Observation Marker[/c] on the target hit whenever any Resonator in the team deals damage.

[c=Title]Tune Rupture Response - Particle Jet[/c]
Mornye deals one instance of [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c] to targets in the [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture - Interfered[/c] state within range, considered [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Rest Mass Energy[/c]
Mornye can hold up to 100 points of [c=Highlight]Rest Mass Energy[/c].
While in [c=Highlight]Baseline Mode[/c], she gains [c=Highlight]Rest Mass Energy[/c] when performing [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c], or when [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Optimal Solution[/c] hits a target.

[c=Title]Relative Momentum[/c]
Mornye can hold up to 100 points of [c=Highlight]Relative Momentum[/c].
While in [c=Highlight]Wide Field Observation Mode[/c], she gains [c=Highlight]Relative Momentum[/c] when [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Wide Field Observation Mode[/c] or [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Distributed Array[/c] hits the target.
Mornye cannot gain [c=Highlight]Relative Momentum[/c] during [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Inversion[/c].

skills.name: Blueprint
skills.description:
Mornye's Energy Regen is increased by 10%.
Casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Convergence[/c] restores 20 points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every 20s.
Casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Stage 3[/c] restores 20 points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every 20s.

skills.name: Boundedness
skills.description:
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Expectation Error[/c] or [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Distributed Array[/c] grants [c=Highlight]Proof of Boundedness[/c] to all Resonators in the team:
- [c=Highlight]Proof of Boundedness[/c] lasts for 60s and can be gained once every 5 min.
- When the active Resonator takes DMG greater than 30% of their Max HP, they instead take DMG equal to 30% of their Max HP. This effect can trigger up to 3 times. [c=Highlight]Proof of Boundedness[/c] is removed after triggering it 3 times.
- When the active Resonator takes a fatal blow, they are not downed by this instance of damage. This effect can trigger up to 1 times. [c=Highlight]Proof of Boundedness[/c] is removed after triggering it 1 times.
- When [c=Highlight]Proof of Boundedness[/c] is removed, the active Resonator restores HP equal to 150% of Mornye's DEF.

sequences.name: The Silent Observer
sequences.description:
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack – Wide Field Observation Mode[/c] becomes immune to interruption.
The duration of [c=Highlight]Interfered Marker[/c] is extended by 150%. [c=Highlight]Interfered Marker[/c] now grants DMG increase even when the target is not affected by [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture - Interfered[/c] or [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c]. When Mornye applies [c=Highlight]Observation Marker[/c] on a target, she also inflicts [c=Highlight]Interfered Marker[/c].

sequences.name: Morning Star of Entropy
sequences.description:
All nearby Resonators in the team gain Crit. DMG increase against targets with [c=Highlight]Interfered Marker[/c]: Every 1% of Mornye's Energy Regen over 100% grants 0.2% Crit. DMG increase, up to 32%.
[c=Highlight]Syntony Field[/c] and [c=Highlight]High Syntony Field[/c] further increase the [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Buildup Rate[/c] of all nearby Resonators in the team by 20%.

sequences.name: Blueprint of Recursion
sequences.description: Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Distributed Array[/c] additionally restores 25 points of Concerto Energy and 100 [c=Highlight]Relative Momentum[/c], triggered once every 25s.

sequences.name: Latent Variables of the Cosmos
sequences.description: The healing of [c=Highlight]High Syntony Field[/c] is increased by 30%.

sequences.name: Time Dilation Effect
sequences.description:
The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Critical Protocol[/c] is increased by 40%.
The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture Response - Particle Jet[/c] is increased by 160%.

sequences.name: To the Far Shores of the Stars
sequences.description: [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Critical Protocol[/c] deals 400% more DMG. If Mornye has not engaged in combat for over 4s, she restores Resonance Energy equal to 10% of her Max Resonance Energy every 0.2s.

skills.name: Infinity Calibration
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack - Aemeath[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Aemeath[/c]
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to charge the attack by consuming STA, release to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged I[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] longer to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged II[/c], dealing higher [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
When in [c=Highlight]Instant Response[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged II[/c] charges more quickly. Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged II[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged II[/c], or Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict: Finale[/c] ends [c=Highlight]Instant Response[/c].
This Skill DMG is considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged I[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged II[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Aemeath[/c]
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Aemeath[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 4[/c].

Heavy Attack - Aemeath Charged II DMG

skills.name: Shared Voyage
skills.description:
[c=Title]Form Switch[/c]
Aemeath can switch forms between herself and her Mech. The Mech inherits Aemeath's Stats and unlocks new moves.
Aemeath automatically casts [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stage 1[/c] upon casting [c=Highlight]Form Switch[/c].
While in the Mech form, Aemeath casts [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack[/c] automatically upon casting [c=Highlight]Form Switch[/c] in mid-air.

[c=Title]Sync Strike: Armament Merge[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2, 3 & 4[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Aemeath[/c], or [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Aemeath[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Sync Strike: Armament Merge[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
Switch into the Mech form after casting this skill. Press the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] button shortly after to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Sync Strike: Call of Dawn[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2, 3 & 4[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Mech[/c], or [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Mech[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Sync Strike: Call of Dawn[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air.
Switch into Aemeath after casting this skill. Press the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] button shortly after to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Mech[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Mech[/c]
Hold the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] button to charge by consuming STA, release to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged I[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
Hold the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] button longer to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged II[/c], dealing higher [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
When in [c=Highlight]Instant Response[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged II[/c] charges more quickly. Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged II[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged II[/c], or Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict: Finale[/c] ends [c=Highlight]Instant Response[/c].
This Skill DMG is considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation DMG[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged I[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged II[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Mech Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Mech[/c]
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
Press the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] button shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Mech[/c]
Press the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] button shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
Press the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] button shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Mech Stage 4[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground

skills.name: Towards the Daybreak
skills.description:
[c=Title]Heavenfall Edict - Overdrive[/c]
Deal [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c]. Switch into Mech form after casting this skill.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Casting this skill grants the following effects:
- Enter [c=Highlight]Stardust Resonance[/c] for 30s.
- Enter [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict: Unbound[/c] for 60s.
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to perform Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Form Switch[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2[/c].
The next [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duet[/c] cast within 30s after casting this skill doesn't consume [c=Highlight]Rupturous Trail[/c]/[c=Highlight]Fusion Trail[/c].

[c=Title]Stardust Resonance[/c]
Enhance the effect of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duet[/c].
This effect ends after [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duet[/c] is cast 2 times.

[c=Title]Heavenfall Edict - Unbound[/c]
[c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict - Overdrive[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict - Finale[/c].
When in [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict - Unbound[/c] and [c=Highlight]Resonance Rate[/c] reaches the limit, enter [c=Highlight]Instant Response[/c]. [c=Highlight]Instant Response[/c] is removed when the [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict - Unbound[/c] state ends.

[c=Title]Heavenfall Edict - Finale[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] or [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict: Finale[/c] when the following conditions are met:
- Be in the [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict: Unbound[/c] state.
- [c=Highlight]Synchronization Rate[/c] reaches the limit.
- [c=Highlight]Resonance Rate[/c] reaches the limit.
Casting this skill depletes all [c=Highlight]Synchronization Rate[/c] and [c=Highlight]Resonance Rate[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], and ends the [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict: Unbound[/c] state and [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duo[/c] state.
Switch back to Aemeath after casting this skill.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

skills.name: Overture of Departure
skills.description:
[c=Title]Songs Across the Universe[/c]
Deal [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
Cast this skill to enter [c=Highlight]Starlume Acceleration[/c] for 15s.
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 3[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] and cast Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Form Switch[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast  [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Mech Stage 3[/c] automatically.

[c=Title]Debut of Meteoric Radiance[/c]
In the Mech form, [c=Highlight]Songs Across the Universe[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Debut of Meteoric Radiance[/c].
Deal [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
Casting this skill grants [c=Highlight]Starlume Acceleration[/c] for 15s.
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Mech Stage 3[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] and cast Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Form Switch[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 3[/c] automatically.

[c=Title]Starlume Acceleration[/c]
In [c=Highlight]Starlume Acceleration[/c], casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive[/c] addtionally restores [c=Highlight]Resonance Rate[/c].
Casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive[/c] ends [c=Highlight]Starlume Acceleration[/c].

rows.label: Songs Across the Universe Concerto Regen
Debut of Meteoric Radiance Concerto Regen

skills.name: Silent Protection
skills.description:
When casting this skill, the following effects are triggered based on the [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode[/c] Aemeath is in:
- In [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture[/c]: all Resonators in the team except Aemeath gain 10% All-DMG Amplification for 20s. The All-DMG Amplification effect is increased to 20% for Resonators who inflict [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture - Shifting[/c].
- In [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst[/c]: all Resonators in the team except Aemeath gain 10% All-DMG Amplification for 20s. The All-DMG Amplification effect is increased to 20% for Resonators who inflict [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c].
Casting this skill resets the effects above.

skills.name: Unlanded Melody
skills.description:
When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, Aemeath can cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c].

Responding to [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture - Interfered[/c]: when Resonators in the team trigger [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target and cause them to be affected by [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture - Interfered[/c], Aemeath triggers [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture Response - Starburst[/c]. The same target can only be damaged by this skill once every 8s.

skills.name: To Sculpt the Silence
skills.description:
[c=Title]Seraphic Duo[/c]
When casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 4[/c] or [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Mech Stage 4[/c], enter [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duo[/c] for 5s. 

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Seraphic Duet: Overture[/c]
When Aemeath is in [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duo[/c] and the [c=Highlight]Synchronization Rate[/c] is no less than 100 points, press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to cast Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duet: Overture[/c] at the cost of 100 points of [c=Highlight]Synchronization Rate[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation DMG[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Switch into the Mech form after casting this skill and exit [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duo[/c]. Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period of time to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Seraphic Duet: Encore[/c]
In the Mech form, when in [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duo[/c] and the [c=Highlight]Synchronization Rate[/c] is no less than 100 points, press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to cast Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duet: Encore[/c] at the cost of 100 points of [c=Highlight]Synchronization Rate[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation DMG[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Switch back to Aemeath and exit the [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duo[/c] state. Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly afterward to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Mode[/c]
- In [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture[/c], when Resonators in the team respond to [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture - Interfered[/c], inflict 10 stacks of [c=Highlight]Rupturous Trail[/c] on the target for 30s, stacking up to 30 times.

- In [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst[/c], when Resonators in the team inflict [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c], inflict 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Fusion Trail[/c] for 30s, stacking up to 30 times.
While in combat, when the [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c] on targets near the active Resonator reaches 0 stacks, inflict 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c]. If the targets have more than 5 stacks of [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c], trigger [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c] based on their max stack limit and remove all of their stacks.

In [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture[/c]/[c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst[/c], inflict [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture - Shifting[/c]/[c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c] when the following skills deal damage. The same skill can only trigger this effect on the same target once every 3s:
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 3 & 4[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Mech Stage 3 & 4[/c], Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Sync Strike: Armament Merge[/c], Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Sync Strike: Call of Dawn[/c], Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Songs Across the Universe[/c], and Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Debut of Meteoric Radiance[/c].

Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duet[/c] gains the following enhancements based on Aemeath's [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode[/c]:
- When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture[/c], Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duet[/c] removes [c=Highlight]Rupturous Trail[/c] stacks on nearby targets and additionally deals 5 instances of [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture DMG[/c], each time to a random target within range. For each stack of [c=Highlight]Rupturous Trail[/c] removed from a target, the DMG Multiplier of the additional instances of Tune Rupture DMG triggered by [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duet[/c] against the target is increased by 4%. This effect lasts for 1s. The target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] does not affect the triggering of these instances of Tune Rupture DMG.
- When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst[/c], Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duet[/c] removes the [c=Highlight]Fusion Trail[/c] stacks on targets if they are inflicted with [c=Highlight]Fusion Trail[/c], and trigger the [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c] on the target based on its max stack limit without removing its stacks. Each stack of [c=Highlight]Fusion Trail[/c] removed from the target increases the DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c] on the main target by 10%.

When in [c=Highlight]Stardust Resonance[/c], Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duet[/c] gains the following enhancements based on Aemeath's [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode[/c]:
- In [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture[/c], casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duet[/c] additionally deal 10 instances of [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture DMG[/c].
- In [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst[/c], the DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c] triggered by Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duet[/c] on the main target is additionally increased by 200%. The DMG Multiplier increase effect is stackable with that provided by [c=Highlight]Fusion Trail[/c].

[c=Title]Tune Rupture Response - Starburst[/c]
Active in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture[/c]. Deal [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c] to targets within range that are affected by [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture - Interfered[/c], considered Tune Rupture DMG.

[c=Title]Starflux Thrust[/c]
When in the Mech form and [c=Highlight]Starflux[/c] is more than 200, use the Utility button to cast [c=Highlight]Starflux Thrust[/c] and soar in the air by continuously consuming [c=Highlight]Starflux[/c].

[c=Title]Synchronization Rate[/c]
[c=Highlight]Synchronization Rate[/c] is capped at 200 points.
- Dealing damage with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Aemeath[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Aemeath[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Aemeath[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Mech[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Mech[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Mech[/c], Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Sync Strike: Armament Merge[/c], and Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Sync Strike: Call of Dawn[/c] recovers [c=Highlight]Synchronization Rate[/c].
- Casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Songs Across the Universe[/c] and [c=Highlight]Debut of Meteoric Radiance[/c] recovers 40 points of [c=Highlight]Synchronization Rate[/c].
- Casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive[/c] recovers 30 points of [c=Highlight]Synchronization Rate[/c].
- When in [c=Highlight]Instant Response[/c] and [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict: Unbound[/c] at the same time, casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Aemeath Charged II[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Mech Charged II[/c] recovers 200 points of [c=Highlight]Synchronization Rate[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Rate[/c]
[c=Highlight]Resonance Rate[/c] is capped at 4 points.
- Casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duet[/c] recovers 1 point of [c=Highlight]Resonance Rate[/c].
- Casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive[/c] recovers 1 point of [c=Highlight]Resonance Rate[/c].
- When in [c=Highlight]Starlume Acceleration[/c], casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive[/c] additionally recovers 1 point of [c=Highlight]Resonance Rate[/c].

[c=Title]Starflux[/c]
[c=Highlight]Starflux[/c] is capped at 600 points.
[c=Highlight]Starflux[/c] recovers naturally over time.

skills.name: Before All Sounds
skills.description: In [c=Highlight]Instant Response[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Aemeath[/c] and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Mech[/c] gain 200% DMG Amplification.

skills.name: Between the Stars
skills.description:
In [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture[/c], when Resonators in the team inflict [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture - Shifting[/c] or deal [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture DMG[/c], Aemeath's Crit. DMG increases by 20%, up to 3 times. Each Resonator can only trigger this effect once.
With 3 stacks, Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict: Finale[/c] DMG is Amplified by 25%.
Resonators joining the team or switching Resonance Mode resets this effect.

In [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst[/c], when Resonators in the team inflict [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c], Aemeath's Crit. DMG increases by 30%, up to 2 times. Each Resonator can only trigger this effect once.
With 2 stacks, Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict: Finale[/c] DMG is Amplified by 25%.
Resonators joining the team or switching Resonance Mode resets this effect.

sequences.name: Gilded Glimmer of the First Dawn
sequences.description:
In [c=Highlight]Instant Response[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Aemeath[/c] and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Mech[/c] gain 300% Crit. DMG increase and continuously pull in nearby target while charging.

When Aemeath remains in a state that meets all of the following conditions for over 4s, she enters [c=Highlight]Instant Response - Brilliance[/c]:
- Out of combat;
- Not performing [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Aemeath[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Mech[/c], or Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict: Finale[/c].
[c=Highlight]Instant Response: Brilliance[/c] inherits all effects of [c=Highlight]Instant Response[/c] and remains active even when out of the duration of [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict: Unbound[/c]. 
When in [c=Highlight]Instant Response - Brilliance[/c] and not in [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict: Unbound[/c], casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Aemeath Charged II[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Mech Charged II[/c] grants 100 points of [c=Highlight]Synchronization Rate[/c].

In [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture[/c] or [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst[/c], when Aemeath defeats a target affected by [c=Highlight]Rupturous Trail[/c]/[c=Highlight]Fusion Trail[/c], she enters [c=Highlight]Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture[/c]/[c=Highlight]Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst[/c] for 10s.
While in [c=Highlight]Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture[/c] or [c=Highlight]Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst[/c], Aemeath records the highest stack count of [c=Highlight]Rupturous Trail[/c]/[c=Highlight]Fusion Trail[/c] among the targets defeated.
Her next skill that directly damages the target immediately inflicts the targets with the recorded stacks of [c=Highlight]Rupturous Trail[/c]/[c=Highlight]Fusion Trail[/c], up to the current max limit of [c=Highlight]Rupturous Trail[/c]/[c=Highlight]Fusion Trail[/c]. This ends [c=Highlight]Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture[/c]/[c=Highlight]Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst[/c] and Aemeath cannot enter [c=Highlight]Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture[/c] or [c=Highlight]Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst[/c] for 1s.

sequences.name: Downy Notes of Snowfluff
sequences.description:
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duet: Overture[/c] is increased by 100%.
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duet: Encore[/c] is increased by 100%.

While in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture[/c], when the additional instances [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture DMG[/c] triggered by Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duet[/c] hit the same target, the DMG Multiplier of the [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture DMG[/c] triggered by Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duet[/c] against this target is increased by 20% for 1s, stacking up to 5 times.

While in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst[/c], gain the following effects:
- In the [c=Highlight]Stardust Resonance[/c] state, the DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c] triggered by Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duet[/c] is further increased to 400% against the main target of the [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c].
- [c=Highlight]Fusion Trail[/c] now additionally increases the DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Fusion Trail[/c] triggered by Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duet[/c]. Each stack of [c=Highlight]Fusion Trail[/c] removed now provides a 15% DMG Multiplier increase to [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c] on the main target.
- In combat state, when a target near the active Resonator in the team is defeated, immediately trigger [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c] based on the target's current stack limit of [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c].

sequences.name: Fervor Sightly Burns Bright as New
sequences.description:
Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict: Finale[/c]'s DMG Multiplier is increased by 100%.
Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive[/c]'s DMG Multiplier is increased by 40%.

In [c=Highlight]Instant Response[/c], Aemeath now inflicts [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture - Shifting[/c] or [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c] on nearby targets while casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Aemeath[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Mech[/c], based on her current Resonance Mode.

Inherent Skill [c=Highlight]Between the Stars[/c] is replaced with the following effects:

- In [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture[/c], when Resonators in the team inflict [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture - Shifting[/c] or deal [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture DMG[/c], Aemeath's Crit. DMG is increased by 60%, and Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict: Finale[/c] DMG is now Amplified by 25%.
Resonators joining the team or switching Resonance Mode resets this effect.

- In [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst[/c], when Resonators in the team inflict [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c], Aemeath's Crit. DMG is increased by 60%, and Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Heavenfall Edict: Finale[/c] DMG is now Amplified by 25%.
Resonators joining the team or switching Resonance Mode resets this effect.

sequences.name: Ethereal Waltz on Binary Tides
sequences.description: When casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Songs Across the Universe[/c], Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Debut of Meteoric Radiance[/c], Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Sync Strike[/c] and Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duet[/c], Resonators in the team gain 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for 30s.

sequences.name: Voyage to the Astral Shore
sequences.description:
When Aemeath defeats a target directly with her skills, [c=Highlight]Starflux[/c] is reset to 100%.

When taking fatal damage, Aemeath is knocked out and turns into [c=Highlight]2D Digital Ghost[/c] for 5s.
In the [c=Highlight]2D Digital Ghost[/c] state, Aemeath grants Resonators in the team a Shield equal to 360% of her ATK for 5s. As she exits from the [c=Highlight]2D Digital Ghost[/c] state, she revives and recovers 100% of her Max HP and 30 points of Resonance Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 10 min.
When Aemeath revives, she exits the [c=Highlight]2D Digital Ghost[/c] state and removes the Shield provided.

sequences.name: A Zephyr-Kissed Journey to You
sequences.description:
Targets take 40% more Resonance Liberation DMG from Aemeath.

When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture[/c], Aemeath's Tune Rupture DMG can critically hit, with a fixed Crit. Rate of 80%, and fixed Crit. DMG of 275%.

When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst[/c] and in combat state, Fusion Burst DMG triggered on targets near the active Resonator in the team can critically hit, with a fixed Crit. Rate of 80%, and fixed Crit. DMG of 275%.

The stacks of [c=Highlight]Rupturous Trail[/c] and [c=Highlight]Fusion Trail[/c] inflicted on the target through Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]To Sculpt the Silence[/c] is doubled.

In [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture[/c]/[c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst[/c] and in combat, the max stack limit of [c=Highlight]Rupturous Trail[/c]/[c=Highlight]Fusion Trail[/c] on the targets near the active Resonator in the team is increased to 60. While casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Seraphic Duet[/c], inflict 10 stacks of [c=Highlight]Rupturous Trail[/c]/[c=Highlight]Fusion Trail[/c] on targets within range for 30s.

skills.name: Dreamweaver's Banquet
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Breakdown Form[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Stagecraft Form[/c]
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Breakdown Form[/c]
Consume STA to pull in nearby targets, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Stagecraft Form[/c]
Consume STA to perform Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c]. 

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form[/c]
Consume STA to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks in mid-air, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c]. 

[c=Title]Mid-air Heavy Attack - Breakdown Form[/c]
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] in the air to perform Mid-air Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Stagecraft Form[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 4[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Breakdown Form[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air.
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4[/c] or [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4[/c].

skills.name: Bubbles and Baits
skills.description:
[c=Title]Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form[/c]
Pull in nearby targets, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Beckon - Breakdown Form[/c]
Pull in nearby targets, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
This skill shares a Cooldown with [c=Highlight]Banish - Breakdown Form[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Banish - Breakdown Form[/c]
While holding a [c=Highlight]Dark Core[/c], replace [c=Highlight]Beckon - Breakdown Form[/c] with [c=Highlight]Banish - Breakdown Form[/c].
Cast [c=Highlight]Banish - Breakdown Form Stage 1[/c] to pull in nearby targets, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c]. Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] or [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] shortly after to cast [c=Highlight]Banish - Breakdown Form Stage 2[/c].
[c=Highlight]Banish - Breakdown Form Stage 2[/c] consumes all [c=Highlight]Dark Cores[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c]. For each [c=Highlight]Dark Core[/c] consumed, the DMG Multiplier of the attack is increased by 150%.
The skill deals Resonance Liberation DMG.
This skill shares a Cooldown with [c=Highlight]Beckon - Breakdown Form[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air.

skills.name: Final Act
skills.description:
[c=Title]Final Act - Stagecraft Form[/c]
Deal [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
After performing this skill, obtain [c=Highlight]Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form[/c] for 12s, then switch to [c=Highlight]Breakdown Form[/c].

[c=Title]Final Act - Breakdown Form[/c]
When [c=Highlight]Conformal Charge[/c] is full, consume all [c=Highlight]Conformal Charge[/c] and [c=Highlight]Void Particle[/c] to perform this skill.
Deal [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c]. 
After casting this skill, obtain [c=Highlight]Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form[/c], which lasts for 30s, and then switch to [c=Highlight]Stagecraft Form[/c].
Can be performed in mid-air.

[c=Title]Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form[/c]
Increases ATK by 30%.
Obtaining this effect removes the [c=Highlight]Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form[/c] effect.

[c=Title]Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form[/c]
Grants 1 point of [c=Highlight]Void Particle[/c] per second.
Obtaining this effect removes the [c=Highlight]Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form[/c] effect.

skills.name: Formal Greetings
skills.description:
[c=Title]It's Been A While![/c]
Available in [c=Highlight]Stagecraft Form[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 4[/c].

[c=Title]Knock Knock[/c]
Available in [c=Highlight]Breakdown Form[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
Casting this skill grants [c=Highlight]Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form[/c] for 12s.

rows.label: It's Been A While! Concerto Regen

skills.name: Unfinished Lies
skills.description:
When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst[/c], Fusion Burst DMG against targets near the active Resonator in the team is Amplified by 60% for 30s.
This effect ends early when Denia switches modes.

When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Strain[/c], the incoming Resonator has their All DMG Amplified by 15% for 16s.
After this Resonator under this effect inflicts [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Shifting[/c], they gain 40% DMG Amplification instead.
This effect ends early when this Resonator is switched out or when Denia switches modes.

skills.name: Shattered Hours
skills.description:
When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, Denia can cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Strain[/c], Denia gains the following effects:
- Denia can inflict [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Shifting[/c] on the target.
- Denia can respond to [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c].
When responding to [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c]: For each stack of [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] on the target, each point of Denia's Tune Break Boost increases her total DMG against the target by 0.12%. While Denia is in the team, the max stack limit of [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] on a target is increased by 1.

skills.name: "Flawless"
skills.description:
[c=Title]Erosion Field[/c]
After casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Final Act - Breakdown Form[/c], generate an [c=Highlight]Erosion Field[/c], lasting for 30s. Only one [c=Highlight]Erosion Field[/c] generated by your own Resonator can exist at a time.
[c=Highlight]Erosion Field[/c] pulls in nearby targets once every 4s, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Void Particle[/c]
When in the [c=Highlight]Breakdown Form[/c] while holding [c=Highlight]Void Particle[/c], [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] consumes [c=Highlight]Void Particle[/c] on hit and grants the following effects:
- The skill DMG is considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation DMG[/c] and the DMG Multiplier is increased by 50%.
- [c=Highlight]Conformal Charge[/c] regenerates 100% faster.

[c=Title]Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst[/c], Denia gains the following effects:
- Each time when the following skills deal damage, inflict 2 stacks of [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c] on the target. The same skill can only trigger this effect once every 2s against the same target.
Intro Skill [c=Highlight]It's Been A While![/c], Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Knock Knock[/c], Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Final Act - Stagecraft Form[/c], Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Final Act - Breakdown Form[/c], and [c=Highlight]Erosion Field[/c].
- Each time when the following skills deal damage, inflict [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c] on the target. The same skill can only trigger this effect once every 2s against the same target.
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 3[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 4[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3[/c], and [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4[/c].
- When Denia is in the team, if an enemy falls to [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst DMG[/c], it counts as caused by the nearest active Resonator. 

[c=Title]Resonance Mode - Tune Strain[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Strain[/c], Denia gains the following effects:
- Each time when the following skills deal damage, inflict [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Shifting[/c] on the target and reset the duration of [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] on the target. The same skill can only trigger this effect once every 2s against the same target.
Intro Skill [c=Highlight]It's Been A While![/c], Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Knock Knock[/c], Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Final Act - Stagecraft Form[/c], Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Final Act - Breakdown Form[/c], [c=Highlight]Erosion Field[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 3[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 4[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3[/c] and [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4[/c].
- When Resonators in the team inflict [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Shifting[/c] on the target, this target's Off-Tune Level is increased by 50% of the max. This effect can only be triggered on the same target once every 300s. 

[c=Title]Dark Core[/c]
- Denia can hold up to 3 [c=Highlight]Dark Cores[/c].
- While in the [c=Highlight]Entropy Shift[/c] states,  Denia obtains 1 [c=Highlight]{Cus:Sap,S=Dark Core P=Dark Cores SapTag=A}[/c] every 12s.
Denia obtains 1 [c=Highlight]{Cus:Sap,S=Dark Core P=Dark Cores SapTag=B}[/c] upon casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]It's Been A While![/c] and Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Knock Knock[/c].

[c=Title]Void Particle[/c]
- Denia can hold up to 100 points of [c=Highlight]Void Particle[/c].
- While in [c=Highlight]Stagecraft Form[/c], dealing damage through [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] grants [c=Highlight]Void Particle[/c].
- Casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]It's Been A While![/c], Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Knock Knock[/c] or Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form[/c] grants 25 points of [c=Highlight]Void Particle[/c].

[c=Title]Conformal Charge[/c]
- Denia can hold up to 100 points of [c=Highlight]Conformal Charge[/c].
- While in [c=Highlight]Breakdown Form[/c], dealing damage through [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] or Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Beckon - Breakdown Form[/c] grants [c=Highlight]Conformal Charge[/c].
- Casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Banish - Breakdown Form Stage 2[/c] grants 40 points of [c=Highlight]Conformal Charge[/c].

skills.name: Vestiges of Falsehood
skills.description: When Denia engages in combat in [c=Highlight]Stagecraft Form[/c]: restore [c=Highlight]Dark Cores[/c] to 2 if she has fewer than 2; restore [c=Highlight]Void Particle[/c] to 20 points if she has fewer than 20. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.

skills.name: Etched Colors
skills.description:
While in the [c=Highlight]Entropy Shift[/c] states, Denia obtains the following effects based on her current [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode[/c]:
- [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst[/c]: All Resonators in the team gain 30% Fusion DMG Bonus.
- [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Strain[/c]: All Resonators in the team gain 10 Tune Break Boost. When a Resonator in the team has an Off-Tune Buildup Rate over 100%, every 10% that runs over increases the Resonator's Tune Break Boost by 8, up to 40.

sequences.name: Silent Glows in a Dimlit Dream
sequences.description:
Crit. DMG is increased by 30%.

When performing Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form[/c], or Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Banish - Breakdown Form[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3[/c], and [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4[/c],  Denia becomes immune to interruption.

When Denia enters combat in [c=Highlight]Stagecraft Form[/c], she obtains the [c=Highlight]Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form[/c] effect for 30s.
When Denia enters combat in [c=Highlight]Breakdown Form[/c], she obtains the [c=Highlight]Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form[/c] effect for 12s.

sequences.name: Tossed in the Tides of Reality
sequences.description:
When Denia is in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst[/c], after a Resonator in the team inflicts [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c] on the target, they gain 50% Fusion DMG Bonus for 15s. After [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c] is triggered on enemies near the active Resonator in the team, Denia gains 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Degenerate Voidmatter[/c] for 15s, up to 10 stacks. Each stack of [c=Highlight]Degenerate Voidmatter[/c] causes Denia to ignore 1% of the target's Fusion RES.
This effect ends when Denia switches modes.

When Denia is in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Strain[/c], her [c=Highlight]Forte Circuit[/c] effect is enhanced: After a Resonator in the team inflicts [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Shifting[/c] on the target, their Tune Break Boost is increased by 20 for 15s, and the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is increased by 100% of the max. This effect can only be triggered once per 300s on the same target.
This effect ends when Denia switches forms.

The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Banish - Breakdown Form[/c] is increased by 40%.

sequences.name: Through Dark and Wind, the Erlking Follows
sequences.description:
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Final Act - Breakdown Form[/c] is increased by 80%.

Denia now holds up to 5 [c=Highlight]Dark Cores[/c]. While in [c=Highlight]Entropy Shift[/c],  the shortest interval at which she can obtain [c=Highlight]Dark Core[/c] is reduced to 6s.
The [c=Highlight]Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form[/c] effect is enhanced and now grants 4 points of [c=Highlight]Void Particle[/c] per second.
The [c=Highlight]Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form[/c] effect is enhanced: Casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Final Act - Breakdown Form[/c] additionally restores 30 points of Concerto Energy.

Denia's Inherent Skill [c=Highlight]Vestiges of Falsehood[/c] is enhanced:
Upon entering combat, [c=Highlight]Dark Core[/c] and [c=Highlight]Void Particle[/c] are restored to the max. This effect can be triggered once every 12s. 

When the number of [c=Highlight]Dark Cores[/c] reaches the limit, casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 4[/c] or Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form[/c] consumes all [c=Highlight]Dark Cores[/c] and increases the DMG Multiplier of this skill by 1200%. The DMG dealt is considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation DMG[/c].

sequences.name: From the Far Beyond, to the Far Beyond
sequences.description: The attack interval of [c=Highlight]Erosion Field[/c] is reduced to 3s.

sequences.name: If Lies Patch Up a Heart
sequences.description: The DMG of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Final Act -  Stagecraft Form[/c] is increased by 100%.

sequences.name: May You Find Your Sun in the Silence
sequences.description:
While in [c=Highlight]Entropy Shift[/c] states, gain 60% ATK increase and 60% Fusion DMG Bonus.

While Denia is in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst[/c],  after [c=Highlight]Erosion Field[/c] deals damage, trigger [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c] on the target based on its max limit. The [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c] DMG triggered gains a 200% DMG Multiplier increase against the main target and does not remove the [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c] stacks on the targets hit. The effect can be triggered on the same target up to 1 times. When the target is damaged by Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Final Act: Breakdown Form[/c], the effect's trigger count is reset. The trigger count can be reset for the same target once every 2s.

While Denia is in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Strain[/c], when Resonators in the team deal [c=Highlight]Tune Break DMG[/c] to [c=Highlight]Mistuned[/c] enemies in [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Shifting[/c], they additionally inflict 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] on the target. This effect can only be triggered on the same target once every 3s.

skills.name: Edge of Life and Death
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack - Drink Soul[/c]
While in the [c=Highlight]Yin Vessel[/c] state, perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 3[/c] restores 50 points of [c=Highlight]Qi[/c], dealing Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 4[/c] restores 50 points of [c=Highlight]Qi[/c], dealing Heavy Attack DMG.

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Devil's Bane[/c]
While in the [c=Highlight]Yang Font[/c] state, perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 3[/c] restores 50 points of [c=Highlight]Qi[/c], dealing Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 4[/c] restores 50 points of [c=Highlight]Qi[/c], dealing Heavy Attack DMG.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack in the air, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
While in the [c=Highlight]Yin Vessel[/c] state, press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2[/c].
While in the [c=Highlight]Yang Font[/c] state, press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Nether Dive[/c]
While in the [c=Highlight]Yin Vessel[/c] state, press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Nether Dive[/c] restores 100 points of [c=Highlight]Qi[/c], dealing Heavy Attack DMG.
Press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 4[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Light Watch[/c]
While in the [c=Highlight]Yang Font[/c] state, press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Light Watch[/c] restores 100 points of [c=Highlight]Qi[/c], dealing Heavy Attack DMG.
Press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 4[/c].

[c=Title]Shadow Step[/c]
While in combat and on the ground, [c=Highlight]press Dodge[/c] with directional input to cast [c=Highlight]Shadow Step[/c], dealing a fixed amount of [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered Basic Attack DMG. This instance of damage is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects. A successful Dodge may be triggered within a certain time during the action of this skill.
While in the [c=Highlight]Yin Vessel[/c] state, press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2[/c].
While in the [c=Highlight]Yang Font[/c] state, press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2[/c].
