skills.name: Malevolent Encounter
skills.description:
[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin[/c]
While in the [c=Highlight]Yin Vessel[/c] state, [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin[/c] is available, which deals [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
[c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin[/c] can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang[/c]
While in the [c=Highlight]Yang Font[/c] state, [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang[/c] is available, which deals [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
[c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang[/c] can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Cleanse of Impurity[/c]
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin[/c] or [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang[/c] grants [c=Highlight]Cleanse of Impurity[/c] for 4s or until one of the following conditions is met:
- Switching to another Resonator.
- Switching to the [c=Highlight]Yin Vessel[/c] or [c=Highlight]Yang Font[/c] state.
- Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse[/c] or [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse[/c]
While in the [c=Highlight]Yin Vessel[/c] state with [c=Highlight]Cleanse of Impurity[/c], press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] in mid-air to cast [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse[/c] restores 100 points of [c=Highlight]Qi[/c].
Press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide[/c]
While in the [c=Highlight]Yang Font[/c] state with [c=Highlight]Cleanse of Impurity[/c], press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] in mid-air to cast [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide[/c] restores 100 points of [c=Highlight]Qi[/c].
Press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2[/c].

skills.name: Burial of Thousand Souls
skills.description:
[c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls[/c] can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered Heavy Attack DMG, and granting 100 points of [c=Highlight]Fire of Life[/c].
Gain the following effects after casting this skill:
- If Jingran's current HP is above 50% of the Max HP, reduce his current HP to 50% of the Max HP.
- Gain 200 points of [c=Highlight]Qi[/c].
- Gain 3 stacks of [c=Highlight]Wayfarer's Mark[/c].
- Enter the [c=Highlight]Yinghuo[/c] state for 15s.

[c=Title]Wayfarer's Mark[/c]
Max 3 stacks.
Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Soul Raid[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander[/c] restores 200 points of [c=Highlight]Qi[/c] and reduces 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Wayfarer's Mark[/c]. This effect lasts for 15s.

[c=Title]Yinghuo[/c]
- Dealing damage with [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Soul Raid[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander[/c] summons [c=Highlight]Chimei Wangliang[/c] to attack the targets, which deals [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered Heavy Attack DMG. This effect can be triggered once per [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Soul Raid[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander[/c].
- All [c=Highlight]Fire of Life[/c] will be removed as [c=Highlight]Yinghuo[/c] ends.

skills.name: Question the Tombs
skills.description:
Attack the target, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c]. Consume and convert all [c=Highlight]Ghost Shroud[/c] to equal stacks of [c=Highlight]Fortune in Disguise[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Question the Tombs[/c] restores 100 points of [c=Highlight]Qi[/c].
While in the [c=Highlight]Yin Vessel[/c] state, press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2[/c].
While in the [c=Highlight]Yang Font[/c] state, press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Fortune in Disguise[/c]
Max 50 stacks. Each stack of [c=Highlight]Fortune in Disguise[/c] grants additional Fusion DMG Bonus based on Jingran's Max HP: For every 1000 points of Max HP, Jingran gains 0.05% additional Fusion DMG Bonus for 15s, up to 2.5% for each stack of [c=Highlight]Fortune in Disguise[/c].
Switching to another Resonator ends the effect.

[c=Title]Ghost Shroud[/c]
- Max 50 points.
- When Jingran gains a Shield, he gains 1 points of [c=Highlight]Ghost Shroud[/c]. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

skills.name: Rising Fortune and Ebbing Evil
skills.description: Deal [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c] equal to 795% of Jingran's ATK.

skills.name: Tune Break: Broadblade
skills.description:
When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.
While in [c=Highlight]Yin Vessel[/c], press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2[/c].
While in [c=Highlight]Yang Font[/c], press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2[/c].

skills.name: Upstream Along Santu
skills.description:
[c=Title]Qi Modulation[/c]
Jingran switches between the [c=Highlight]Yin Vessel[/c] and [c=Highlight]Yang Font[/c] states by casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Soul Raid[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander[/c]. Jingran is in the [c=Highlight]Yang Font[/c] state by default.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Soul Raid[/c]
When Jingran holds 300 points of [c=Highlight]Qi[/c] while in the [c=Highlight]Yin Vessel[/c] state, [c=Highlight]hold Normal Attack[/c] to consume 300 points of [c=Highlight]Qi[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Soul Raid[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
After casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Soul Raid[/c], Jingran switches to the [c=Highlight]Yang Font[/c] state.
Press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander[/c]
When Jingran holds 300 points of [c=Highlight]Qi[/c] while in the [c=Highlight]Yang Font[/c] state, [c=Highlight]hold Normal Attack[/c] to consume 300 points of [c=Highlight]Qi[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander[/c], dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c].
After casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander[/c], Jingran switches to the [c=Highlight]Yin Vessel[/c] state.
Press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2[/c].
[c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander[/c] can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Qi[/c]
Max 300 points.
- Casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 3[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 4[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 3[/c], or [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 4[/c] restores 50 points of [c=Highlight]Qi[/c].
- Casting [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Nether Dive[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Light Watch[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide[/c], or [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Question the Tombs[/c] restores 100 points of [c=Highlight]Qi[/c].
- Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls[/c] or casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Soul Raid[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander[/c] with [c=Highlight]Wayfarer's Mark[/c] restores 200 points of [c=Highlight]Qi[/c].

[c=Title]Fire of Life[/c]
Max 100 points.
- Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls[/c] grants 100 points of [c=Highlight]Fire of Life[/c].
- All [c=Highlight]Fire of Life[/c] is cleared when [c=Highlight]Yinghuo[/c] ends.
While in [c=Highlight]Yinghuo[/c], if [c=Highlight]Fire of Life[/c] is not at 0 points, casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Soul Raid[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander[/c] consumes 25 points of [c=Highlight]Fire of Life[/c], and the DMG Multiplier of this [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Soul Raid[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander[/c] is increased based on Jingran's Max HP: The DMG Multiplier of this [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Soul Raid[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander[/c] is increased for every 1000 points of Jingran's Max HP over 25000. Up to 25000 points of Jingran's Max HP count towards this effect.

[c=Title]Nether to Light[/c]
- Jingran's DEF is fixed at 0.
- Jingran gains Incoming Healing Bonus based on Max HP: For every 1000 points of Max HP, Jingran receives 6.2% Incoming Healing Bonus, up to 310%.
- Jingran gains Fusion DMG Bonus based on Max HP: For every 1000 points of Max HP, Jingran receives 1.5% Fusion DMG Bonus, up to 75%.

[c=Title]Yang Changes, Yin Unites[/c]
Jingran gains additional ATK based on Max HP: For every 1000 points of Max HP, Jingran gains 36 additional ATK, up to 1800.

rows.label: Heavy Attack - Soul Raid DMG Increase per 1,000 Max HP
Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander DMG Increase per 1,000 Max HP

skills.name: Hark the Dust
skills.description:
Casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Question the Tombs[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin[/c], or [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang[/c] grants [c=Highlight]Earth Charm[/c].

[c=Title]Earth Charm[/c]
For 15s, if Jingran is the active Resonator in the team, gain an unstackable Shield equal to 1.6% of Max HP + 700 that lasts for 5s when dealing damage. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.
While Jingran is in the [c=Highlight]Yinghuo[/c] state, if he is the active Resonator in the team, he gains an unstackable Shield equal to 0.8% of Max HP + 350 that lasts for 5s when dealing damage. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.

skills.name: Trace the Vestige
skills.description:
Upon entering combat, if Jingran's [c=Highlight]Ghost Shroud[/c] is below 25 points, restore it to 25 points. This effect can be triggered once every 4s.

When nearby Resonators in the team other than Jingran gain a Shield, Jingran gains 2 points of [c=Highlight]Ghost Shroud[/c]. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

[c=Title]Fixation[/c]
- Upon entering combat, Jingran gains [c=Highlight]Fixation[/c]. This effect can be triggered once every 4s.
- Casting [c=Highlight]Outro Skill - Rising Fortune and Ebbing Evil[/c] grants [c=Highlight]Fixation[/c].
- When nearby Resonators in the team other than Jingran gain a Shield, Jingran gains 15 points of [c=Highlight]Ghost Shroud[/c] and removes [c=Highlight]Fixation[/c].

sequences.name: Yin and Yang in Harmony, the Ultimate Law of Being
sequences.description:
The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang[/c], and [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide[/c] are increased by 80%.
[c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang[/c], and [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide[/c] are now immune to interruption.

sequences.name: A Solitary Lantern, Across Lands Shade-Trodden
sequences.description:
The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Soul Raid[/c] and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander[/c] are increased by 46%. While in the [c=Highlight]Yinghuo[/c] state, the DMG Multiplier increase effect via [c=Highlight]Fire of Life[/c] on [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Soul Raid[/c] and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander[/c] is increased by 46%.

Upon entering combat, Jingran gains the following effects, triggered once every 4s:
- Gains 300 points of [c=Highlight]Qi[/c].
- Gains [c=Highlight]Netherworld's Boon[/c].

[c=Title]Netherworld's Boon[/c]
Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Soul Raid[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander[/c] restores 25% of Max Resonance Energy and grants [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Soul Raid[/c] and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander[/c] 180% DMG Amplification for 4s.

sequences.name: World's Course Shifts, Each to Their Rightful Paths
sequences.description:
When Jingran casts [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Soul Raid[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander[/c], gain 5 points of [c=Highlight]Ghost Shroud[/c].

When Jingran casts [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls[/c], [c=Highlight]Yang Changes, Yin Unites[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Yin-Yang Everflow[/c] for 15s.

[c=Title]Yin-Yang Everflow[/c]
Jingran gains additional ATK based on Max HP: For every 1000 points of Jingran's Max HP, gain 50 additional ATK, up to 2500.

sequences.name: Where Reality Meets Illusion, Where Living Meet Dead
sequences.description: When a Resonator in the team gains a Shield, all Resonators in the team gain 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for 30s.

sequences.name: Ends Return to Beginnings, Truth of Life Laid Bare
sequences.description: When Jingran takes a fatal blow, he will not fall and will instead gain a Shield equal to 50% of Max HP for 15s. This effect can be triggered once every 10 min. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.

sequences.name: As Favors and Feuds Fade, New Stories Await
sequences.description:
Targets take 40% more Heavy Attack DMG from Jingran.

The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Chimei Wangliang[/c] is increased by 80%.

Upon entering the [c=Highlight]Yinghuo[/c] state, Jingran gains the [c=Highlight]Parade of Thousand Souls[/c] effect for 15s. During this effect, if Jingran is the active Resonator in the team, upon dealing damage, Jingran summons [c=Highlight]Chimei Wangliang[/c] to attack the targets, dealing [c=Fire]Fusion DMG[/c], considered Heavy Attack DMG.

[c=Highlight]Chimei Wangliang[/c] can be summoned this way at an interval of 1s for up to 8 times. [c=Highlight]Parade of Thousand Souls[/c] ends and the available summon charges of [c=Highlight]Chimei Wangliang[/c] reset when either of the following conditions is met:
- Cast [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls[/c].
- [c=Highlight]Yinghuo[/c] ends or is removed.

skills.name: Gnawing Fangs
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Calcharo performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Consumes STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consumes STA to perform a Mid-Air Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

skills.name: Extermination Order
skills.description:
Calcharo performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
If Calcharo is switched off field, or if Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Extermination Order[/c] is not activated again in a while, this skill will enter Cooldown.
Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Extermination Order[/c] does not interrupt Calcharo's Basic Attack cycle.

skills.name: Phantom Etching
skills.description:
Calcharo attacks the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] and enters [c=Highlight]Deathblade Gear[/c] state. After [c=Highlight]Deathblade Gear[/c] state ends, Calcharo's next Intro Skill is replaced with Intro Skill [c=Highlight]"Necessary Means"[/c], which deals [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered as Intro Skill DMG.
 
[c=Title]Deathblade Gear[/c]
-[c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] is replaced with Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Hounds Roar[/c].
-[c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] deals increased DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.
-[c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] deals increased DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.
 
[c=Title]Basic Attack: Hounds Roar[/c]
Calcharo performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered as Basic Attack DMG.

skills.name: Bloodshed Awaken
skills.description: Casting Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Mercy[/c] gives Calcharo 10% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus for 15s.

skills.name: Tune Break: Broadblade
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Revenant Rush
skills.description: When Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]"Death Messenger"[/c] hits the target, the damage taken by Calcharo is reduced by 15% for 5s.

skills.name: Wanted Outlaw
skills.description: Attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

skills.name: Shadowy Raid
skills.description: Calcharo summons [c=Highlight]Phantom[/c] to support the active Resonator, clearing the targets in front with a slash. The [c=Highlight]Phantom's[/c] attack deals [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] equal to 195.98%+391.96% of Calcharo's ATK.

skills.name: Hunting Mission
skills.description:
[c=Title]Heavy Attack: "Mercy"[/c]
When Calcharo has 3 "Cruelty", his [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] is replaced with Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]"Mercy."[/c]
When casting Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]"Mercy"[/c], Calcharo consumes 3 "Cruelty" to deal [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered as Heavy Attack DMG, and recovers Resonance Energy and Concerto Energy.
 
[c=Title]"Cruelty"[/c]
Calcharo can hold up to 3 "Cruelty."
In Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Deathblade Gear[/c] state, "Cruelty" cannot be acquired.
When Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Extermination Order[/c] hits the target, gain 1 "Cruelty."
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack: "Death Messenger"[/c]
When Calcharo has 5 "Killing Intent", his [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] is replaced with Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]"Death Messenger."[/c]
When casting Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]"Death Messenger,"[/c] Calcharo consumes 5 "Killing Intent" to deal [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered as Resonance Liberation DMG, and recovers Resonance Energy and Concerto Energy.
 
[c=Title]"Killing Intent"[/c]
In Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Deathblade Gear[/c] state, Calcharo's Forte Gauge is replaced with "Killing Intent", stacking up to 5.
When Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Hounds Roar[/c] hits the target, Calcharo gains 1 "Killing Intent."

sequences.name: Covert Negotiation
sequences.description: When Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Extermination Order[/c] hits a target, it additionally recovers 10 Resonance Energy. This can be triggered once every 20s.

sequences.name: Zero-Sum Game
sequences.description: After Calcharo casts Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Wanted Criminal[/c] or Intro Skill [c=Highlight]"Necessary Means"[/c], his Resonance Skill DMG Bonus is increased by 30% for 15s.

sequences.name: Iron Fist Diplomacy
sequences.description: During the Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Deathblade Gear[/c] state, Calcharo's Electro DMG Bonus is increased by 25%.

sequences.name: Dark Alliance
sequences.description: After casting Outro Skill [c=Highlight]Shadowy Raid[/c], Electro DMG Bonus of all team members is increased by 20% for 30s.

sequences.name: Unconventional Compact
sequences.description: Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Wanted Criminal[/c] and Intro Skill [c=Highlight]"Necessary Means"[/c] deal 50% more DMG.

sequences.name: The Ultimatum
sequences.description: When casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]"Death Messenger"[/c], Calcharo will summon 2 [c=Highlight]Phantoms[/c] to perform Coordinated Attacks. Each [c=Highlight]Phantom[/c] deals [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] equal to 100.00% of Calcharo's ATK, which is considered Resonance Liberation DMG.

skills.name: Zapstring's Dance
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Yinlin controls the puppet "Zapstring" to perform up to 4 attacks, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Yinlin consumes STA to control "Zapstring", dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Yinlin consumes STA to control "Zapstring" to perform a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

skills.name: Magnetic Roar
skills.description:
[c=Title]Magnetic Roar[/c]
The puppet "Zapstring" deals [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] to the target, and puts Yinlin in Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Execution Mode[/c].
 
[c=Title]Execution Mode[/c]
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] and [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] will trigger 1 [c=Highlight]Electromagnetic Blast[/c] when hitting a target.
Each stage of [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] or [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] can only trigger 1 [c=Highlight]Electromagnetic Blast[/c], up to 4 times.
 
[c=Title]Electromagnetic Blast[/c]
Attack all targets marked with Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Sinner's Mark[/c], dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Lightning Execution[/c]
Use Resonance Skill after casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Magnetic Roar[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Lightning Execution[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
If Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Lightning Execution[/c] is not activated in a while or this Character is switched, this Skill will be put on Cooldown.

skills.name: Thundering Wrath
skills.description: Command "Zapstring" to call for thunder to fall upon a large range, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

skills.name: Raging Storm
skills.description: Command puppet "Zapstring" to attack, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] in a large range.

skills.name: Strategist
skills.description: The incoming Resonator has their Electro DMG Amplified by 20% and Resonance Liberation DMG Amplified by 25% for 14s or until they are switched out.

skills.name: Tune Break: Rectifier
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Chameleon Cipher
skills.description:
[c=Title]Chameleon Cipher[/c]
When Yinlin's Judgment Points are full, her [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Chameleon Cipher[/c], which consumes all Judgment Points to attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c]. When it hits a target marked with [c=Highlight]Sinner's Mark[/c], the [c=Highlight]Sinner's Mark[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Punishment Mark[/c], lasting for 18s. [c=Highlight]Chameleon Cipher[/c] deals Heavy Attack DMG.
 
[c=Title]Sinner's Mark[/c]
Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Zapstring's Dance[/c], Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Thundering Wrath[/c], and Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Roaring Storm[/c] apply [c=Highlight]Sinner's Mark[/c] to the target on hit.
[c=Highlight]Sinner's Mark[/c] is removed when Yinlin is switched out.
 
[c=Title]Punishment Mark[/c]
When a target marked with [c=Highlight]Punishment Mark[/c] takes damage, [c=Highlight]Judgement Strike[/c] will fall, triggering Coordinated Attacks to all targets marked with [c=Highlight]Punishment Mark[/c], dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c]. This can be triggered up to 1 time per second. [c=Highlight]Judgement Strike[/c] deals Resonance Skill DMG.
 
[c=Title]Judgment Points[/c]
Yinlin can hold up to 100 Judgement Points. Yinlin gains Judgement Points through the following ways:
Upon casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Raging Storm[/c]
When Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Zapstring's Dance[/c] hits a target
Upon casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Magnetic Roar[/c];
When Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Electromagnetic Blast[/c] hits a target;
Upon casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Lightning Execution[/c].

skills.name: Pain Immersion
skills.description: After using Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Magnetic Roar[/c], Yinlin's Crit. Rate is increased by 15% for 5s.

skills.name: Deadly Focus
skills.description: The damage of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Lightning Execution[/c] is increased by 10% when hitting targets marked with [c=Highlight]Sinner's Mark[/c], and Yinlin's ATK is increased by 10% for 4s when this is triggered.

sequences.name: Morality's Crossroads
sequences.description: Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Magnetic Roar[/c] and [c=Highlight]Lightning Execution[/c] deal 70% more DMG.

sequences.name: Ensnarled by Rapport
sequences.description: Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Electromagnetic Blast[/c] recovers an additional 5 Judgement Point(s) and 5 Resonance Energy on hit.

sequences.name: Unyielding Verdict
sequences.description: Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Judgment Strike[/c]'s DMG multiplier is increased by 55%.

sequences.name: Steadfast Conviction
sequences.description: When Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Judgment Strike[/c] hits a target, the ATK of all team members is increased by 20% for 12s.

sequences.name: Resounding Will
sequences.description: Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Thundering Wrath[/c] deals 100% extra DMG to targets with Forte Circuit's [c=Highlight]Sinner's Mark[/c] or [c=Highlight]Punishment Mark[/c].

sequences.name: Pursuit of Justice
sequences.description: In the first 30s after casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Thundering Wrath[/c], when Yinlin's [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] hits a target, [c=Highlight]Furious Thunder[/c] will be triggered, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] equal to 419.59% of Yinlin's ATK. Every [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] hit can trigger [c=Highlight]Furious Thunder[/c] 1 time, up to 4 times. This is considered Resonance Skill DMG.

skills.name: Leihuangquan
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Yuanwu performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Yuanwu consumes STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Yuanwu consumes STA to launch a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

skills.name: Leihuang Master
skills.description:
[c=Title]Thunder Wedge[/c]
Yuanwu summons [c=Highlight]Thunder Wedge[/c], dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], and forms a [c=Highlight]Thunder Field[/c] centered on the [c=Highlight]Thunder Wedge[/c]. [c=Highlight]Thunder Wedge[/c] lasts for 12s.
Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Rumbling Spark[/c] and Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Blazing Might[/c] will immediately detonate Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Thunder Wedge[/c] on the field, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered as Resonance Skill DMG.
 
[c=Title]Thunder Field[/c]
The active character gains the effects below when in the [c=Highlight]Thunder Field[/c]: a Coordinated Attack from Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Thunder Wedge[/c] is triggered when attacks hit a target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c]. This can be triggered once every 1.2s. The effect lasts for 1.5s.

skills.name: Blazing Might
skills.description: Awaken the power of thunder and provide Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Lightning Infused[/c] status to all characters on a nearby team for 10s, then perform a powerful blow that deals [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

skills.name: Thunderous Determination
skills.description: The DMG multiplier of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Thunder Uprising[/c] is increased by 40%, and its reduction efficiency of enemy Vibration Strength is enhanced.

skills.name: Tune Break: Gauntlets
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Reserved Confidence
skills.description: The ranges of the Resonance Skills [c=Highlight]Thunder Field[/c] and [c=Highlight]Thunder Uprising[/c] are greatly expanded. When switched off the field during combat, if "Readiness" is not full, Yuanwu will automatically leave 1 Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Thunder Wedge[/c] in place.

skills.name: Thunder Bombardment
skills.description: Attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

skills.name: Lightning Manipulation
skills.description: Yuanwu unleashes thunderbolts in an area centered around the skill target, greatly reducing the Vibration Strength of enemies upon impact.

skills.name: Unassuming Blade
skills.description:
[c=Title]Rumbling Spark[/c]
When "Readiness" is full, hold [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to consume all "Readiness" and cast [c=Highlight]Rumbling Spark[/c], dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] and entering the [c=Highlight]Lightning Infused[/c] state.

[c=Title]Thunder Uprising[/c]
When "Readiness" is full, Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Thunder Wedge[/c] will be replaced with [c=Highlight]Thunder Uprising[/c], dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Lightning Infused[/c]
The character in [c=Highlight]Lightning Infused[/c] state has a greatly increased resistance to interruption.
When Yuanwu is in this state:
-[c=Highlight]Basic Attacks[/c]: Hit targets in a larger range, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.
-[c=Highlight]Heavy Attacks[/c]: Have increased attack speed, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.
-[c=Highlight]Dodge Counters[/c]: Have increased attack speed, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.
-Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] within 3s after casting a [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] or a successful [c=Highlight]Counterattack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Thunderweaver[/c], dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered as Basic Attack DMG.
-Does not recover "Readiness".

[c=Title]Readiness[/c]
Yuanwu can hold up to 100 "Readiness".
When Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Thunder Wedge[/c] is on the field, Yuanwu gains 6 "Readiness" every second, even when he is not the active character;
When Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Thunder Wedge[/c] hits a target with a Coordinated Attack, Yuanwu gains 5 "Readiness".

sequences.name: Steaming Cup of Justice
sequences.description: When Yuanwu is in Forte Circuit's [c=Highlight]Lightning Infused[/c] state, his Basic Attack Speed is increased by 20%, and his Heavy Attack Speed is increased by 20%.

sequences.name: Fierce Heart, Serene Mind
sequences.description: Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Thunder Bombardment[/c] additionally recovers 15 Resonance Energy for Yuanwu.

sequences.name: Upholder of Integrity
sequences.description: When the Coordinated Attacks of Resonance Skill's [c=Highlight]Thunder Wedge[/c] hits a target, the damage is additionally increased by 20% of Yuanwu's DEF.

sequences.name: Retributive Knuckles
sequences.description: When casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Blazing Might[/c], the on-field character will gain a Shield equal to 200% of Yuanwu's DEF for 10s.

sequences.name: Neighborhood Protector
sequences.description: When Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Thunder Wedge[/c] is on the field, Yuanwu's Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus is increased by 50%.

sequences.name: Defender of All Realms
sequences.description: All team members nearby within the range of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Thunder Wedge[/c] will gain a 32% DEF increase, lasting 3s.

skills.name: Slash of Breaking Dawn
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive strikes, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Perform a charged attack at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Perform a Plunging Attack while in mid-air at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to counterattack, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].

skills.name: Trailing Lights of Eons
skills.description:
Dash forward and perform consecutive strikes that inflict [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Overflowing Radiance[/c]
After Jinhsi uses [c=Highlight]Basic Attack 4[/c] or, while not in [c=Highlight]Incarnation[/c], Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Loong's Halo[/c], an alternative Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Overflowing Radiance[/c] is available within 5s.
Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Overflowing Radiance[/c] inflicts [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] and sends Jinhsi into [c=Highlight]Incarnation[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air.

skills.name: Purge of Light
skills.description:
Unleash the power of invocation to deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air.

skills.name: Radiant Surge
skills.description: Jinhsi gains 20% Spectro DMG Bonus.

skills.name: Tune Break: Broadblade
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Converged Flash
skills.description: DMG Multiplier of Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Loong's Halo[/c] is increased by 50%.

skills.name: Loong's Halo
skills.description: Attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].

skills.name: Temporal Bender
skills.description: Summoning the power homologous with the Sentinel, Jinhsi may now gain Incandescence via [c=Highlight]Eras in Unity[/c] from damage of the same Attribute more effectively, at 1 time(s) every 1s for 20s.

skills.name: Luminal Synthesis
skills.description:
[c=Title]Incarnation[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Incarnation[/c]:
- Alternative Basic Attack [c=Highlight]"Incarnation - Basic Attack"[/c] becomes available. Perform up to 4 consecutive strikes, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] considered as Resonance Skill DMG. The basic attack cycle of this will not be reset. Can be cast in mid-air.
- Alternative Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]"Crescent Divinity"[/c] becomes available. Deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. Can be cast in mid-air.
- Alternative Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]"Incarnation - Heavy Attack"[/c] becomes available. Attack the target in mid-air at the cost of Stamina, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
- Alternative Dodge [c=Highlight]"Incarnation - Dodge"[/c] is available while in mid-air. Can be cast multiple times at the cost of Stamina.
- Alternative Dodge Counter [c=Highlight]"Incarnation - Dodge Counter"[/c] becomes available. Deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Illuminous Epiphany[/c]
After Stage 4 of [c=Highlight]Incarnation - Basic Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Incarnation[/c] terminates and Jinhsi gains [c=Highlight]Ordination Glow[/c]. 
Can be cast in mid-air.
While [c=Highlight]Ordination Glow[/c] lasts:
- Basic Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]"Incarnation - Heavy Attack"[/c]. Attack the target in mid-air at the cost of Stamina, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
- Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]"Illuminous Epiphany"[/c]. Send out [c=Highlight]Solar Flare[/c] that detonates as [c=Highlight]Stella Glamor[/c], dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] after a short delay. Consume up to 50 Incandescence, with each point of Incandescence granting bonus DMG Multiplier percentage to [c=Highlight]Stella Glamor[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air.
- After casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Illuminous Epiphany[/c], Jinhsi gains [c=Highlight]Unison[/c]. This can be triggered once every 25s.

[c=Title]Unison[/c]
While Jinhsi has [c=Highlight]Unison[/c], switching to other Resonators will remove Jinhsi's [c=Highlight]Unison[/c] to trigger Jinhsi's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. [c=Highlight]Unison[/c] will be consumed in priority in place of Concerto Energy when Concerto Energy is full.

[c=Title]Incandescence[/c]
Jinhsi can hold up to 50 Incandescence.
When Jinhsi is in the party, all nearby Resonators in the party gain [c=Highlight]Eras in Unity[/c].
[c=Highlight]Eras in Unity[/c] provides 2 independent effects:
Jinhsi gains 1 Incandescence anytime Resonators in the party inflict Attribute DMG. This effect may be triggered by damage of the same Attribute for up to 1 time(s) every 3s. Additionally, Jinhsi gains 2 Incandescence when Resonators in the party damage the enemy with Coordinated Attacks. This effect may be triggered by Coordinated Attacks of the same Attribute for up to 1 time(s) every 3s.

sequences.name: Abyssal Ascension
sequences.description: When casting Basic Attack [c=Highlight]"Incarnation - Basic Attack"[/c] or Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Crescent Divinity[/c], Jinhsi gains one stack of [c=Highlight]Herald of Revival[/c], stacking up to 4 times and lasting for 6s. When casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Illuminous Epiphany[/c], Jinhsi consumes all stacks of [c=Highlight]Herald of Revival[/c]. Each stack increases the damage of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Illuminous Epiphany[/c] by 20%.

sequences.name: Chronofrost Repose
sequences.description: Jinhsi restores 50 Incandescence while staying out of combat for more than 4s. This effect can only be triggered 1 time(s) every 4s.

sequences.name: Celestial Incarnate
sequences.description: Jinhsi gains one stack of [c=Highlight]Immortal's Descendancy[/c] after casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Loong's Halo[/c]. Each stack of [c=Highlight]Immortal's Descendancy[/c] increases Jinhsi's ATK by 25%, stacking up to 2 time(s) and lasting for 20s.

sequences.name: Benevolent Grace
sequences.description: When Jinhsi casts Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Purge of Light[/c] or Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Illuminous Epiphany[/c], all nearby Resonators on the team gain 20% Attribute DMG Bonus for 20s.

sequences.name: Frostfire Illumination
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Purge of Light[/c] is increased by 120%.

sequences.name: Thawing Triumph
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Illuminous Epiphany[/c] is increased by 45% and the additional DMG Multiplier gained by consuming Incandescence is increased by 45%.

skills.name: Probe
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Perform a charged attack at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Perform a Plunging Attack from mid-air at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

skills.name: Deduction
skills.description: Attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

skills.name: Cogitation Model
skills.description:
Attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c]. Enter [c=Highlight]Intuition[/c].
When in [c=Highlight]Intuition[/c]:
-Obtain 3 Hypercube(s). Each time Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Law of Reigns[/c] is cast, consume 1 Hypercube(s). [c=Highlight]Intuition[/c] ends once all Hypercubes are consumed.
-[c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] are replaced with Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Pivot - Impale[/c], which performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
-Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Deduction[/c] is replaced with Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Divergence[/c], which deals [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
-[c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] is replaced with Dodge Counter [c=Highlight]Unfathomed[/c], considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.

skills.name: Knowing
skills.description: Gain 5% Electro DMG Bonus after casting Resonance Skill for 8s, stackable for up to 4 times.

skills.name: Tune Break: Gauntlets
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Focus
skills.description: When in [c=Highlight]Intuition[/c] triggered by Resonance Liberation, Xiangli Yao's resistance to interruption is enhanced.

skills.name: Principle
skills.description: Attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

skills.name: Chain Rule
skills.description: Xiangli Yao will call down a laser beam upon the first target the incoming Resonator's [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] hits, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] equal to 237.63% of Xiangli Yao's ATK to an area. This effect lasts for 8s and can be triggered once every 2s, up to 3 times.

skills.name: Forever Seeking
skills.description:
[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Decipher[/c]
When Capacity reaches 100, Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Deduction[/c] is replaced by Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Decipher[/c].
Consume 100 Capacity to cast Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Decipher[/c], dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Law of Reigns[/c]
When Performance Capacity reaches 5 in [c=Highlight]Intuition[/c] state, Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Divergence[/c] is replaced by Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Law of Reigns[/c].
Consume 5 Performance Capacity to cast Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Law of Reigns[/c], dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Revamp[/c]
Shortly after casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Decipher[/c] or Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Divergence[/c], use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] to perform Mid-air Attack [c=Highlight]Revamp[/c] at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.

[c=Title]Capacity[/c]
Xiangli Yao can hold up to 100 Capacity.
Every Normal Attack [c=Highlight]Probe[/c] on hit grants Capacity.
Every Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Deduction[/c] on hit grants Capacity.

[c=Title]Performance Capacity[/c]
Xiangli Yao can hold up to 5 Performance Capacity.
When in [c=Highlight]Intuition[/c] triggered by Resonance Liberation:
Obtain 1 Performance Capacity when Stage 1 of Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Pivot - Impale[/c] hits a target.
Obtain 2 Performance Capacity when Stage 2 or 3 of Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Pivot - Impale[/c] hits a target.
Obtain 2 Performance Capacity for every Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Divergence[/c] on hit.
Obtain 3 Performance Capacity for every Mid-air Attack [c=Highlight]Revamp[/c] on hit.
Obtain 2 Performance Capacity for every Dodge Counter [c=Highlight]Unfathomed[/c] on hit.

sequences.name: Prodigy of Protégés
sequences.description: Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Law of Reigns[/c] additionally launches 6 Convolution Matrices at enemies, each dealing Resonance Liberation DMG equal to 8% of the skill's DMG Multiplier.

sequences.name: Traces of Predecessors
sequences.description: Casting Resonance Skill or Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Cogitation Model[/c] increases Crit. DMG by 30% for 8s.

sequences.name: Ruins of Ancient
sequences.description:
Casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Cogitation Model[/c] increases the DMG of the following Resonance Skill moves by 63% for 24s:
[c=Highlight]Decipher[/c], [c=Highlight]Deduction[/c], [c=Highlight]Divergence[/c], and [c=Highlight]Law of Reigns[/c].
This effect can be triggered up to 5 times.

sequences.name: Vessel of Rebirth
sequences.description: Casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Cogitation Model[/c] grants a 25% DMG Bonus to all team members' Resonance Liberation for 30s.

sequences.name: End of Stars
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of Outro Skill [c=Highlight]Chain Rule[/c] is increased by 222%. The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Cogitation Model[/c] is increased by 100%.

sequences.name: Solace of the Ordinary
sequences.description: The Hypercubes obtained from Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Cogitation Model[/c] are enhanced, increasing the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Law of Reigns[/c] by 76%.

skills.name: Hunter's Path
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Steelclash[/c]
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c]. [c=Highlight]Press Normal Attack[/c] shortly after performing Heavy Attack to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack from mid-air, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
[c=Highlight]Press Normal Attack[/c] after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Dodge Counter[/c]
[c=Highlight]Press Normal Attack[/c] after a successful Mid-air Dodge to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep[/c]
When Prowess is full, [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Steelclash[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep[/c], dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] and consuming all Prowess.
- While in action, [c=Highlight]release[/c] or [c=Highlight]press Normal Attack[/c] again within a certain period to perform [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash[/c].
- [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash[/c] is available if Augusta remains on the ground for a certain period after this skill is interrupted.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash[/c]
Augusta whirls and lashes out with her Broadblade, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut[/c]
[c=Highlight]Press Jump[/c] when Prowess is full to perform [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut[/c], dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] and consuming all Prowess.
If Prowess is full when casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade[/c], [c=Highlight]press Resonance Skill[/c] or [c=Highlight]Jump[/c] to perform [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut[/c], dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] and consuming all Prowess.
If Prowess is full when casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Steelclash[/c] or [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter – Heavy Attack: Steelclash[/c], [c=Highlight]release Normal Attack[/c] after a certain period or [c=Highlight]press Normal Attack[/c] or [c=Highlight]Jump[/c] again to perform [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut[/c], dealing, [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] and consuming all Prowess.

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash[/c]
When Prowess is full, [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash[/c], dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered as Heavy Attack DMG.

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Thunderoar: Backstep[/c]
When Ascendancy is full, [c=Highlight]press Normal Attack[/c] following a successful Dodge on the ground to cast [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Thunderoar: Backstep[/c] in place of [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] and [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash[/c], dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
- [c=Highlight]Release[/c] or [c=Highlight]press Normal Attack[/c] again within a certain period into the action to perform [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash[/c].
- [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash[/c] is available if Augusta remains on the ground for a certain period after this skill is interrupted.

[c=Title]Prowess[/c]
Augusta can hold up to 100 points of Prowess.
- Prowess is obtained when [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Steelclash[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Dodge Counter[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c], or [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash[/c] deals damage.
- Prowess is fully restored when casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare[/c].

skills.name: Warrior's Blade
skills.description: Augusta leaps and slams down her Broadblade, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

skills.name: Sunward Conquest
skills.description:
[c=Title]Resonance Liberation - Sword of Eternal Oath[/c]
[c=Highlight]Press and release Resonance Liberation[/c] to cast this skill. Augusta will sweep her Broadblade forward, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered as Heavy Attack DMG.

[c=Title]Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun[/c]
When Majesty reaches 2 stacks, [c=Highlight]hold Resonance Liberation[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun[/c]. Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun[/c] costs no Resonance Energy but 2 stacks of Majesty instead.
- When casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun[/c], Augusta generates the [c=Highlight]Ruler's Realm[/c] and enters the [c=Highlight]Sworn Allegiance[/c] state for 7s. Within this duration, time is temporarily stopped, and [c=Highlight]Resonator switching[/c] is disabled. Only [c=Highlight]Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne[/c], [c=Highlight]Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector[/c], and [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] can be performed in the [c=Highlight]Sworn Allegiance[/c] state. [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack[/c] is available while airborne.
- In the [c=Highlight]Sworn Allegiance[/c] state, [c=Highlight]press[/c] or [c=Highlight]hold Normal Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne[/c]. Augusta can walk on water without consuming STA in this state.
- Performing [c=Highlight]environmental, gameplay, or other interactions[/c] ends [c=Highlight]Sworn Allegiance[/c] without triggering [c=Highlight]Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector[/c].

[c=Title]Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne[/c]
Deal [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered as Heavy Attack DMG. After casting [c=Highlight]Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne[/c] 9 times, [c=Highlight]press Normal Attack or Resonance Liberation[/c] to perform [c=Highlight]Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector[/c].

[c=Title]Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector[/c]
Deal [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered as Heavy Attack DMG. Casting [c=Highlight]Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector[/c] ends the [c=Highlight]Sworn Allegiance[/c] state and consumes all stacks of Crown of Wills later. All other Resonators in the team will be made to leave the field.
- When [c=Highlight]Sworn Allegiance[/c] ends, [c=Highlight]Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector[/c] is automatically cast.
- During [c=Highlight]Sworn Allegiance[/c], [c=Highlight]hold Resonance Liberation[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector[/c] early.

[c=Title]Ruler's Realm[/c]
- [c=Highlight]Ruler's Realm[/c] lasts for 30s.
- When Resonators in the team cast [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c] within [c=Highlight]Ruler's Realm[/c], they gain a shield equal to 650 + 5% of Augusta's Max HP for 10s. This effect is unstackable. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.

[c=Title]Majesty[/c]
Augusta can hold up to 2 stacks of Majesty.
- 1 stack of Majesty is obtained when casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge[/c].
- 1 stack of Majesty is obtained when other Resonators in the team cast [c=Highlight]Outro Skill[/c] under the effect of Augusta's [c=Highlight]Outro Skill - Battlesong of the Unyielding[/c].

[c=Title]Switch Gears![/c]
Upon casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] or [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c], Rebecca can freely switch between the [c=Highlight]Huntress[/c] and [c=Highlight]Guts[/c] modes.
- The [c=Highlight]Huntress[/c] mode increases Rebecca's Crit. DMG by 30%.
- The [c=Highlight]Guts[/c] mode allows Rebecca to ignore 15% of the target's DEF.
By default, Rebecca starts in the [c=Highlight]Huntress[/c] mode.

[c=Title]Hack - Shifting[/c]
Rebecca inflicts [c=Highlight]Hack - Shifting[/c] upon dealing damage to the targets through the following skills. The same skill can trigger this effect once every 3s:
[c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time![/c], [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me![/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts[/c], and [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - BOOM! Fireworks![/c].

[c=Title]Hack Response - Meltdown[/c]
Deal [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] to all targets affected by [c=Highlight]Hack - Interfered[/c] within the range, considered Hack DMG.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress[/c]
At 120 points of [c=Highlight]Fervor[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Huntress[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress[/c]. [c=Highlight]Hold Normal Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress[/c], which consumes all [c=Highlight]Fervor[/c] to pull in nearby targets and deal [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered Basic Attack DMG.
During [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Huntress[/c], if [c=Highlight]Fervor[/c] is at 120 points and Rebecca is not in the action of [c=Highlight]Tactical Dodge - Huntress[/c], [c=Highlight]release Normal Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts[/c]
At 120 points of [c=Highlight]Fervor[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Guts[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts[/c]. [c=Highlight]Hold Normal Attack [/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts[/c], which consumes all [c=Highlight]Fervor[/c] to pull in nearby targets and deal [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered Basic Attack DMG.

[c=Title]Fervor[/c]
Rebecca can hold up to 120 points of [c=Highlight]Fervor[/c].
[c=Highlight]Normal Attacks[/c] restore [c=Highlight]Fervor[/c] upon damaging the target.
[c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] restores [c=Highlight]Fervor[/c] upon damaging the target.
When [c=Highlight]A Girl Gets What She Wants![/c] is gained by casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time![/c] or [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me![/c], Rebecca restores 50 points of Fervor.

[c=Title]Hot Hand[/c]
Rebecca can hold up to 120 points of [c=Highlight]Hot Hand[/c].
Regenerates over time at a rate of 10 points per second.
Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts[/c] restores 40 points.

[c=Title]A Girl Gets What She Wants![/c]
At 120 points of [c=Highlight]Hot Hand[/c], casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time![/c], [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me![/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill -  It's Big Boomin' Time![/c], or [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Come 'n' Get Me![/c] grants the following effects for 12s:
Rebecca simultaneously gains the Stat Bonuses of both the [c=Highlight]Huntress[/c] and [c=Highlight]Guts[/c] modes, regardless of which mode she's currently in.
[c=Highlight]Hot Hand[/c] cannot be restored during this period and is consumed by 10 points per second.

skills.name: Tag, You're It!
skills.description:
ATK is increased by 10% for 12s when [c=Highlight]A Girl Gets What She Wants![/c] is triggered, or when [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts[/c] is cast, stacking up to 2 times. 
When a Resonator in the team inflicts [c=Highlight]Hack - Shifting[/c], their Tune Break Boost is increased by 30 for 30s.

skills.name: Left an Opening!
skills.description:
[c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress[/c] and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts[/c] gain increased resistance to interruption.
When Rebecca casts [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn![/c], the ATK of all nearby Resonators in the team is increased by 20% for 30s.

sequences.name: Try Not to Get in the Way!
sequences.description:
The DMG Multipliers of the following skills are increased by 50%: 
- [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Huntress[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Huntress[/c], [c=Highlight]Tactical Dodge - Huntress[/c], and [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Huntress[/c]
- [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Guts[/c], [c=Highlight]Tactical Dodge - Guts[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Guts[/c].
When [c=Highlight]A Girl Gets What She Wants![/c] is triggered, Rebecca gains 3 additional stacks of Street Smarts for 12s. Upon performing [c=Highlight]Tactical Dodge - Huntress[/c] or [c=Highlight]Tactical Dodge - Guts[/c], if Rebecca has sufficient Street Smarts stacks, 1 stacks will be consumed to restore 20 STA.
Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]BOOM! Fireworks![/c] is immune to interruption.

sequences.name: Oh, Hey Choom!
sequences.description:
Casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time![/c], [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me![/c], or [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn![/c] grants 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for all Resonators in the team for 30s.
When Resonators in the team inflict [c=Highlight]Hack - Shifting[/c], they gain 15% All DMG Amplification for 30s.
[c=Highlight]Hot Hand[/c] regenerates twice as fast when Rebecca is out of combat.

sequences.name: Don't Sweat Your Six!
sequences.description:
Rebecca's [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn![/c], and [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - BOOM! Fireworks![/c] gain 60% DMG Multiplier increase.
Rebecca's [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn![/c] gains 30% more explosion range.
Casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time![/c] or [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me![/c] grants 120 points of [c=Highlight]Hot Hand[/c].

sequences.name: Got Ya Covered!
sequences.description: Rebecca gains an additional 60% Stat Bonus increase from the [c=Highlight]A Girl Gets What She Wants![/c] effect.

sequences.name: Dreamin' on the Edge
sequences.description: Rebecca gains 20% Basic Attack DMG Bonus for 8s when she inflicts [c=Highlight]Hack - Shifting[/c].

sequences.name: Maybe, Just Maybe...
sequences.description:
Rebecca's Basic Attack DMG Bonus from every source is increased by 40%.
During [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts[/c], Rebecca deals an additional instance of [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] equal to 900% of her ATK, considered Basic Attack DMG.
Rebecca recovers an additional 20 points of [c=Highlight]Hot Hand[/c] when she is casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts[/c].
When Rebecca takes a fatal blow, she does not fall to the damage and instead restores fixed 2077 HP for 5 times immediately. This effect is triggered once every 10 min.
When Rebecca stays out of combat for more than 4s, she restores 120 points of [c=Highlight]Fervor[/c]. This effect is triggered once every 4s.

skills.name: Deterrence
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Parry Stance[/c]
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to enter [c=Highlight]Parry Stance[/c] at the cost of STA. 
While active, Rover is immune to interruptions, takes 60% less DMG, and continuously consumes STA. Release [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to exit [c=Highlight]Parry Stance[/c] and perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Riposte Strike[/c], dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
If an attack hits Rover during a certain period of [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Riposte Strike[/c], neutralize this attack and temporarily Stagnate the target before performing [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble[/c], dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Riposte Strike[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Havoc[/c]
In [c=Highlight]Parry Stance[/c], use Dodge to consume STA to perform [c=Highlight]Dodge: Flicker[/c], which can trigger successful [c=Highlight]Dodges[/c] during the action of this skill shortly after it's cast.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack from mid-air, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Havoc[/c]
Perform up to 3 consecutive strikes, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting Stage 3 of this skill to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Repel[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] right after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Dodge Counter[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] right after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] in mid-air to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

skills.name: Thunderclap
skills.description: Launch the Cloudrift Bolt and grapple towards the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c]. Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Repel[/c], dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c].

skills.name: Ultimate Tactics
skills.description: Launch the [c=Highlight]Thunder Quietus[/c], dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

skills.name: Thunderous Fury
skills.description: Attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

skills.name: Rumbling Thunders
skills.description:
The incoming Resonator gains [c=Highlight]Electro Core[/c] for 20s or until the Resonator is switched out. After Resonators with [c=Highlight]Electro Core[/c] inflict Negative Statuses, their [c=Highlight]Electro Core[/c] is consumed, and they gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 14s. Switching to another Resonator ends the effect.
Casting Outro Skill ends the [c=Highlight]Apex Resonance[/c] state and clears all [c=Highlight]Thunder Rage[/c].

skills.name: Tune Break - Sword
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Myriad Omens' Mandate
skills.description:
[c=Title]Overshock[/c]
At max [c=Highlight]Electric Surge[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] is replaced with Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Overshock[/c], dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to perform [c=Highlight]Normal Attack Stage 4[/c].
This skill can be cast in mid-air.
If Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Overshock[/c] is cast by pressing the button, clear all [c=Highlight]Electric Surge[/c] to grant Resonators in the team 10% ATK Bonus for 20s.
If Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Overshock[/c] is cast by holding down the button, consume 60 points of Concerto Energy to deal damage, then clear all [c=Highlight]Electric Surge[/c] to enter [c=Highlight]Apex Resonance[/c].

[c=Title]Apex Resonance[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Apex Resonance[/c], Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Thrum of All Sounds[/c] is unlocked, which consumes 10% [c=Highlight]Thunder Rage[/c] per second:
While on the ground, press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to launch up to 7 consecutive attacks:
- The first 3 stages: [c=Highlight]Thrum of All Sounds: Spectro[/c], dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
- The next 3 stages: [c=Highlight]Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
- The last 1 stages: [c=Highlight]Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade[/c], dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
While on the ground, hold [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Thrum of All Sounds: Aero[/c], dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and leaping into the air.
While airborne, press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to perform up to 6 stages of Mid-air Attacks:
- The first 3 stages: [c=Highlight]Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc Mid-air Attack[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
- The next 2 stages: [c=Highlight]Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Mid-air Attack[/c], dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and healing all nearby Resonators in the team.
- The last 1 stages: [c=Highlight]Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack[/c], dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c]. Press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] shortly after landing to cast [c=Highlight]Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade[/c].
Hold [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] in mid-air to cast [c=Highlight]Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack[/c].
Each time [c=Highlight]Thrum of All Sounds[/c] hits the target, [c=Highlight]Thunder Bane[/c] is triggered, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] to the target within range, considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill DMG[/c].
While in [c=Highlight]Apex Resonance[/c], press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] shortly after casting a Basic Attack to chain into a specific [c=Highlight]Thrum of All Sounds[/c] skill based on the different Basic Attack Stages.

[c=Title]Electric Surge[/c]
Rover can hold up to 120 points of [c=Highlight]Electric Surge[/c].
[c=Highlight]Electric Surge[/c] is restored when [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury[/c], [c=Highlight]Normal Attack - Deterrence[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Thunderclap[/c], or [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Repel[/c] deals damage.

[c=Title]Thunder Rage[/c]
Rover can hold up to 100 points of [c=Highlight]Thunder Rage[/c].
Entering [c=Highlight]Apex Resonance[/c] restores [c=Highlight]Thunder Rage[/c] to the max limit.
[c=Highlight]Thunder Rage[/c] is restored when [c=Highlight]Thrum of All Sounds[/c] deals damage.

skills.description: Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Overshock[/c] inflicts 10 stacks of [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] on the target it damages.

skills.name: Regression
skills.description: When Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Overshock[/c] is cast by holding down the button, gain 20% Resonance Skill DMG Bonus for 20s. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect.

sequences.name: Celestial Ingenuity
sequences.description: While casting [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] and Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Thrum of All Sounds[/c], gain increased resistance to interruption for 0.5s.

sequences.name: Thousandfold Artifice
sequences.description: Inflict 5 stacks of [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] on the targets hit after Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Ultimate Tactics[/c] deals damage.

sequences.name: Alchemy of Wonders
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Overshock[/c] is increased by 20%.

sequences.name: Earthquaking Rumble
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Ultimate Tactics[/c] is increased by 20%.

sequences.name: Principle of Change
sequences.description: Crit. DMG is increased by 20% while in [c=Highlight]Apex Resonance[/c].

sequences.name: Mind's Depths in a Casket
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Thrum of All Sounds[/c] and [c=Highlight]Thunder Bane[/c] is increased by 20%.

skills.name: Manifold Bloom
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack - Answering Form[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Answering Form[/c], perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Answering Form[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Answering Form[/c], consume STA to deal [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
After casting this skill, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a short time to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Answering Form[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Answering Form[/c] and in mid-air, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
After casting this skill, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a short time to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Answering Form[/c] and in mid-air, hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease[/c], continuously consuming STA and dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] to the target.
Depleting all STA or switching to another Resonator ends the skill action early.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease[/c]
When the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] button is released during [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease[/c], Hsin casts [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease[/c], consuming STA to perform a Plunging Attack, transforming into the Moon Fox upon landing and dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
After casting [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a short time to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Answering Form[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Answering Form[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a short time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
After casting this skill, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a short time to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Illumining Form[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c] and not in the [c=Highlight]Mechanism Dominion[/c] state, command Xuanfang Mechanisms to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 1[/c] generates a [c=Highlight]Modular Heartlock[/c] at the target's position. Casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 2[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Illumining Form[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Illumining Form[/c], or [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Illumining Form[/c] causes the [c=Highlight]Modular Heartlock[/c] to collapse, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
Casting this skill consumes STA when Hsin is in mid-air.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Illumining Form[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c], consume STA to command Xuanfang Mechanisms, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
After casting this skill, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a short time to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Upward Cut - Illumining Form[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c] and on the ground, press [c=Highlight]Jump[/c] to cast this skill, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c] and Hsin is in mid-air, [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Illumining Form[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form[/c].
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Illumining Form[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a short time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
After casting this skill, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a short time to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c] and in the [c=Highlight]Mechanism Dominion[/c] state, command Xuanfang Mechanisms to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c] and in the [c=Highlight]Mechanism Dominion[/c] state, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a short time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
After casting this skill, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a short time to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned Stage 3[/c].

skills.name: Heartward by Moon
skills.description:
[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Answering Form[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Answering Form[/c], press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to deal [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
After casting this skill, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a short time to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air.

If Hsin moves while on the ground within a short time after casting this skill, she turns into the [c=Highlight]Moon Fox[/c]. 
- While in the [c=Highlight]Moon Fox[/c] form and out of combat, Hsin gains [c=Highlight]Dustless Tread[/c]. With [c=Highlight]Dustless Tread[/c], Hsin can enter the target's aggro range without triggering combat. [c=Highlight]Dustless Tread[/c] is removed when Hsin enters combat, is switched out, or ends the [c=Highlight]Moon Fox[/c] form by having environmental, gameplay, or feature interactions.
- While in the [c=Highlight]Moon Fox[/c] form and out of combat, Hsin restores 6% of Max HP every 3s.
- Taking damage, failing to perform a [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] with directional input while on the ground, or [c=Highlight]Dodging[/c] in mid-air will end the [c=Highlight]Moon Fox[/c] form. Switching to another Resonator or pressing [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] also ends the [c=Highlight]Moon Fox[/c] form. Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4[/c], which also ends the [c=Highlight]Moon Fox[/c] form.
- The Dash state continuously consumes STA when Hsin is in the [c=Highlight]Moon Fox[/c] form.
- [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] is disabled when Hsin is in the [c=Highlight]Moon Fox[/c] form.

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Illumining Form[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c] and Hsin is on the ground, press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to have Hsin command a Colossal Xuanfang Mechanism, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

skills.name: Nexus Alight
skills.description:
[c=Title]Formshift[/c]
Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector[/c] unlocks [c=Highlight]Formshift[/c].
Cast [c=Highlight]Formshift[/c] to unfurl the Manifold Sanctum. Hsin switches to [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c], unlocking a new set of combat abilities, and enters the [c=Highlight]Heart Manifest[/c] state.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
While in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c], engaging in [c=Highlight]quest dialogue[/c], performing an [c=Highlight]environmental interaction with an animation[/c], or using a [c=Highlight]Utility[/c] switches Hsin back to [c=Highlight]Answering Form[/c] to perform the corresponding action.
While in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c], Hsin can walk on the surface of water, and will continuously consume STA in deep water areas. In Walking Mode, Hsin in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c] can step off a cliff into the air and walk slowly in mid-air, continuously consuming STA in this state. Hsin cannot restore STA while in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c] and in mid-air.

[c=Title]Pillars Across Heaven[/c]
After casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons[/c], when in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c] with full Resonance Energy, [c=Highlight]Pillars Across Heaven[/c] becomes available.
Cast [c=Highlight]Pillars Across Heaven[/c] to bring the Manifold Sanctum crashing down, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] to the target, considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill DMG[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Hsin returns to [c=Highlight]Answering Form[/c] and exits the [c=Highlight]Heart Manifest[/c] state.

[c=Title]Edict[/c]
Casting [c=Highlight]Formshift[/c] grants Hsin 21 stacks of [c=Highlight]Edict[/c] for 45s. The effect cannot exceed 21 stacks and all stacks are removed when the duration ends.
After a Resonator on the field deals DMG, Hsin automatically consumes [c=Highlight]Edict[/c] in the following 3s to trigger the following effect up to once per second. Retriggering the effect resets the duration:
- When [c=Highlight]Edict[/c] is consumed, summon a [c=Highlight]Soaring Pillar[/c] from the Manifold Sanctum as a Coordinated Attack to strike the target once, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c]. 
- [c=Highlight]Edict[/c] can be automatically consumed up to 1 stack per second.
- Damage dealt by [c=Highlight]Soaring Pillar[/c] does not trigger this effect.
- When Hsin is knocked out, all [c=Highlight]Edict[/c] stacks are removed.

[c=Title]Heart Manifest[/c]
Increases Hsin's resistance to interruption for 45s.
Entering the [c=Highlight]Heart Manifest[/c] state resets Hsin's [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c].
While in the [c=Highlight]Heart Manifest[/c] state and in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c], if [c=Highlight]Pillars Across Heaven[/c] is locked, press [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] to have Hsin cast [c=Highlight]Invoked Form: Answering[/c]. While in [c=Highlight]Answering Form[/c], press [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] to have Hsin cast [c=Highlight]Invoked Form: Illumining[/c].
Besides, if Hsin is still in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c] after exiting [c=Highlight]Heart Manifest[/c], and [c=Highlight]Pillars Across Heaven[/c] is locked, press [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] to have Hsin cast [c=Highlight]Invoked Form: Answering[/c].

[c=Title]Invoked Form: Answering[/c]
Hsin temporarily reverts to [c=Highlight]Answering Form[/c]. When this skill is cast, if Hsin is on the ground, She casts [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2[/c]; if She is in mid-air, She casts [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Answering Form[/c].

[c=Title]Invoked Form: Illumining[/c]
Hsin turns back into [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c]. When this skill is cast, if Hsin is on the ground, She casts [c=Highlight]Upward Cut - Illumining Form[/c]; if She is in mid-air, She casts [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form[/c].

skills.name: Glance on a Whim
skills.description:
[c=Title]Intro Skill - Answering Form[/c]
This skill becomes available while in [c=Highlight]Answering Form[/c]. Attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
After casting this skill, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a short time to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3[/c] (when in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Unison[/c]) or [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4[/c] (when in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Electro Flare[/c]).

[c=Title]Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison[/c]
This skill becomes available while in [c=Highlight]Answering Form[/c]. Attack the target, dealing greater [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill DMG[/c].
After casting this skill, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a short time to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Intro Skill - Illumining Form[/c]
This skill becomes available while in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c]. Attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison[/c]
This skill becomes available while in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c]. Attack the target, dealing greater [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill DMG[/c].
