skills.name: Herself a Thousand Lanterns
skills.description:
Attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] equal to 100% of Hsin's ATK.
Hsin gains [c=Highlight]Nightglow[/c] upon entering combat or casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven[/c]. When Hsin casts [c=Highlight]Outro Skill[/c], [c=Highlight]Nightglow[/c] is consumed to trigger various effects depending on the [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode[/c] She is in:
- While in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Unison[/c], Resonators in the team other than Hsin gain [c=Highlight]Shared Light[/c] when they gain [c=Highlight]Unison[/c]. After Hsin casts [c=Highlight]Outro Skill[/c], Resonators with [c=Highlight]Shared Light[/c] gain 20% All DMG Amplification for 30s.
- While in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Electro Flare[/c], Resonators in the team other than Hsin gain 20% Electro DMG Amplification for 20s.
The above effects end early when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.

skills.name: Tune Break: Rectifier
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Forms Turn, Heart Abides
skills.description:
[c=Title]Forms Born of Heart[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Answering Form[/c], Hsin can gain and consume [c=Highlight]Answering Heart[/c].
While in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c], Hsin can gain and consume [c=Highlight]Illumining Heart[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Answering Form[/c], when Hsin's [c=Highlight]Answering Heart[/c] reaches 100 points, [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Answering Form[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer[/c].
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to cast the skill at the cost of STA and 100 points of [c=Highlight]Answering Heart[/c]. Hsin is immune to interruption during the action, and deals [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] to the target, considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill DMG[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer[/c] grants Hsin [c=Highlight]Resolution of Wishes[/c]. This [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer[/c] consumes [c=Highlight]Resolution of Wishes[/c] to become [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector[/c], dealing greater DMG. [c=Highlight]Resolution of Wishes[/c] can only be gained once every 24s.
While casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector[/c], if Hsin is not in the [c=Highlight]Heart Manifest[/c] state, unlock [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Formshift[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c], when Hsin's [c=Highlight]Illumining Heart[/c] reaches 0 during the [c=Highlight]Mechanism Dominion[/c] state, [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Illumining Form[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons[/c].
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to cast the skill at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] to the target, considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill DMG[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons[/c] grants Hsin [c=Highlight]Law of Heaven[/c]. This [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons[/c] consumes [c=Highlight]Law of Heaven[/c] to become [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons[/c], dealing greater DMG. [c=Highlight]Law of Heaven[/c] can only be gained once every 24s.
Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons[/c] ends the [c=Highlight]Mechanism Dominion[/c] state and unlocks [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c], when Hsin's [c=Highlight]Illumining Heart[/c] reaches 300 points and She is on the ground, [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned[/c].
When Hsin is on the ground, press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to deal [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] to surrounding targets.
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned[/c] sends Hsin into the [c=Highlight]Mechanism Dominion[/c] state.

[c=Title]Mechanism Dominion[/c]
The [c=Highlight]Mechanism Dominion[/c] state lasts 13s.
While this state is active, [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Illumining Form[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned[/c], and [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Illumining Form[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned[/c].
When [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned[/c] or [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned[/c] hits a target, [c=Highlight]Illumining Heart[/c] is consumed if Hsin is the active Resonator.
Exiting [c=Highlight]Mechanism Dominion[/c] clears [c=Highlight]Illumining Heart[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Mode - Unison[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Unison[/c], Hsin gains the following effects:
- Hsin can trigger [c=Highlight]Unison Response[/c], but not in Co-op Mode.
- After casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Answering Form[/c] or [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison[/c], the next [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Formshift[/c] grants Hsin [c=Highlight]Unison[/c] for 5s.
- When Hsin triggers [c=Highlight]Unison Response[/c], She gains [c=Highlight]Source Intent[/c], and this cast of [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Manifold Unison[/c], dealing greater DMG.
When Hsin casts an [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c] without triggering [c=Highlight]Unison Response[/c] while holding [c=Highlight]Source Intent[/c], She consumes [c=Highlight]Source Intent[/c] instead, and the [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Manifold Unison[/c], dealing greater DMG.
- The aforementioned effects are removed when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
- Casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Illumining Form[/c] or [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison[/c] sends Hsin directly into the [c=Highlight]Mechanism Dominion[/c] state.

[c=Title]Resonance Mode - Electro Flare[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Electro Flare[/c], Hsin gains the following effects:
- When Hsin enters combat, targets within a certain range do not lose [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] stacks when it's triggered.
- After Resonators in the team inflict [c=Highlight]Electro Rage[/c] on a target, every 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Electro Rage[/c] inflicted grants Hsin 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Heart of Thunder[/c], stacking up to 100 times, and consumes all [c=Highlight]Electro Rage[/c] stacks from that target. [c=Highlight]Heart of Thunder[/c] is removed when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
- At the last stage of [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon[/c], Hsin actively triggers 1 instance of [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] DMG on the targets. Its DMG Multiplier is equal to 35% x (the number of [c=Highlight]Heart of Thunder[/c] stacks on Hsin) x (the [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] DMG Multiplier corresponding to the target's current [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] stacks).
While casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon[/c], switching to another Resonator or ending the skill early removes the above effects.
Some time after casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon[/c], Hsin consumes all remaining stacks of [c=Highlight]Heart of Thunder[/c].
When Hsin has at least 50 stacks of [c=Highlight]Heart of Thunder[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Illumining Form[/c] stagnates nearby targets during the action.
- After casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Formshift[/c], inflict 5 stacks of [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] on nearby targets within a certain range. It also makes [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned[/c] or [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned[/c] inflict [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] on hit targets, up to 5 times. Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Formshift[/c] again resets this count. Switching Resonance Mode removes it.
[c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned[/c] and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons[/c] inflict 5 stacks of [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] on the target hit. [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Illumining Form[/c], [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Answering Form[/c], and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector[/c] inflict 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] on the target hit.

[c=Title]Unison[/c]
While Hsin is in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Unison[/c] with [c=Highlight]Unison[/c], switching to another Resonator will remove Hsin's [c=Highlight]Unison[/c] to trigger Hsin's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. If Hsin has full Concerto Energy and [c=Highlight]Unison[/c] at the same time, only [c=Highlight]Unison[/c] is consumed to trigger the effect.

[c=Title]Unison Response[/c]
While Hsin is in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Unison[/c] and the active Resonator in the team has [c=Highlight]Unison[/c], Hsin triggers [c=Highlight]Unison Response[/c] after She is switched in and casts [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c], granting 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Unison Boon[/c] to all Resonators in the team for 30s.
Hsin can only grant up to 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Unison Boon[/c] in this way.

[c=Title]Unison Boon[/c]
Only the Resonators who can trigger Unison Response can gain this effect. Each stack of [c=Highlight]Unison Boon[/c] increases the total DMG dealt by Resonators who can trigger [c=Highlight]Unison Response[/c] in the team by 3%, stacking up to 2 times.

[c=Title]Answering Heart[/c]
Can hold up to 100 points of [c=Highlight]Answering Heart[/c].
While in [c=Highlight]Answering Form[/c], when [c=Highlight]Normal Attack - Answering Form[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Answering Form[/c], [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Answering Form[/c], or [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison[/c] hits a target, Hsin gains [c=Highlight]Answering Heart[/c] if She is the active Resonator.
Casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Answering Form[/c] or [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison[/c] grants 60 points of [c=Highlight]Answering Heart[/c].

[c=Title]Illumining Heart[/c]
Can hold up to 300 points of [c=Highlight]Illumining Heart[/c].
While in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c] and not in the [c=Highlight]Mechanism Dominion[/c] state, when [c=Highlight]Normal Attack - Illumining Form[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Illumining Form[/c], or [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Illumining Form[/c] hits a target, Hsin gains [c=Highlight]Illumining Heart[/c] if She is the active Resonator.
- While in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Unison[/c], casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Illumining Form[/c] or [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison[/c] directly sends Hsin into the [c=Highlight]Mechanism Dominion[/c] state and grants 300 points of [c=Highlight]Illumining Heart[/c].
- While in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Electro Flare[/c], after casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Formshift[/c], when the [c=Highlight]Modular Heartlock[/c] generated by [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 1[/c] is collapsed by [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 2[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Illumining Form[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Illumining Form[/c], or [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Illumining Form[/c], additionally gain 150 points of [c=Highlight]Illumining Heart[/c] if Hsin is the active Resonator in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c] but not in the [c=Highlight]Mechanism Dominion[/c] state. This effect can only be triggered once before the next cast of [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Formshift[/c] resets it, and is disabled when switched to the other Resonance Mode.

skills.name: Tides of Succession
skills.description:
While in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Unison[/c], when Hsin casts [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison[/c] or [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison[/c], Her ATK is increased by 50% for 8s. Switching to another Resonator or Resonance Mode ends this effect.

While in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Electro Flare[/c], after Resonators in the team inflict [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c], Hsin gains 25% Electro DMG Bonus, stacking up to 2 times. Each Resonator can trigger this effect only once. In addition, if Rover: Electro is in the same team, when Rover: Electro casts [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury[/c], both Hsin and Rover: Electro gain 20% Electro DMG Bonus for 30s.
This effect resets when a Resonator is added to the team or when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.

skills.name: Gleaning Simple Joys
skills.description:
While in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Unison[/c], the maximum stacks of the [c=Highlight]Unison Boon[/c] effect on Resonators in the team are increased by 1. When a Resonator in the team triggers [c=Highlight]Unison Response[/c], all Resonators in the team gain 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Unison Boon[/c] for 30s. This effect does not stack.

While in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Electro Flare[/c] and Hsin is not in the [c=Highlight]Heart Manifest[/c] state, after Resonators in the team other than Hsin inflict [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] on a target, every 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] inflicted grants Hsin1 stack of [c=Highlight]Thunderglow[/c], stacking up to 10 times.
While Hsin is in the [c=Highlight]Heart Manifest[/c] state, when targets within a certain range have 0 stacks of [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c], inflict 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] on the targets. If [c=Highlight]Thunderglow[/c] on Hsin reaches the stack limit, Hsin also inflicts [c=Highlight]Fleeting Thunder[/c] on the targets:
- When Hsin inflicts [c=Highlight]Fleeting Thunder[/c] on the target, She also inflicts [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] on the target to the stack limit, up to 16 stacks of [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c].
- When [c=Highlight]Fleeting Thunder[/c] is active, if the maximum stacks of [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] on the target is increased, Hsin will inflict [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] on the target to the stack limit again, up to 16 stacks of [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c].
- [c=Highlight]Fleeting Thunder[/c] will be removed when the target leaves the designated range around Hsin.
Exiting the [c=Highlight]Heart Manifest[/c] state or switching Resonance Mode removes the aforementioned effects.

sequences.name: A Boat to Cross the Rising Tide
sequences.description:
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Formshift[/c] grants Hsin 2 stacks of [c=Highlight]Radiance Ward[/c], stacking up to 2 times. Switching to [c=Highlight]Answering Form[/c] clears all stacks. When Hsin takes DMG from an enemy target's attack, 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Radiance Ward[/c] can be consumed to make Her immune to interruption and reduce DMG taken by 60% for 1s. This effect can be triggered once every 1s.

While in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Unison[/c]:
The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison[/c] and [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison[/c] are increased by 15%, and each stack of [c=Highlight]Unison Boon[/c] additionally increases the DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison[/c] and [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison[/c] by 10%, up to a total of 4 stacks.

While in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Electro Flare[/c]:
When Hsin enters combat, if [c=Highlight]Heart of Thunder[/c] is below 50 stacks, it is increased to 50 stacks, triggered once every 12s.
The DMG Multiplier of the [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] DMG triggered by [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon[/c] is increased to 42% x (the number of [c=Highlight]Heart of Thunder[/c] stacks on Hsin) x (the [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] DMG Multiplier corresponding to the target's current [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] stacks).

sequences.name: To Wake Is to Wonder What I Am
sequences.description:
The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer[/c] and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector[/c] are increased by 60%.
The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons[/c] and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons[/c] are increased by 60%.

When Hsin enters combat, reset the Cooldowns for Hsin to gain [c=Highlight]Resolution of Wishes[/c] and [c=Highlight]Law of Heaven[/c], and restore 100 additional points of [c=Highlight]Answering Heart[/c]. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.

sequences.name: A Dream of Return Among the Hills
sequences.description:
The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven[/c] is increased by 70%.

While in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Unison[/c]:
The Crit. DMG of [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven[/c] is increased by 20%, and each stack of [c=Highlight]Unison Boon[/c] additionally increases its Crit. DMG by 15%, up to a total of 4 stacks.

While in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Electro Flare[/c]:
When the last stage of [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven[/c] hits a target inflicted with [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c], it triggers 1 instance of [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] DMG, with its DMG Multiplier equal to 1500% times the [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] DMG Multiplier corresponding to the current [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] stacks on the target.

sequences.name: A River of Lanterns, a River of Wishes
sequences.description:
All Resonators in the team gain 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for 30s when a Resonator in the team triggers any of the following actions:
- Inflict [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] or [c=Highlight]Electro Rage[/c] on a target.
- Gain [c=Highlight]Unison[/c] while not having the effect.
- Trigger [c=Highlight]Unison Response[/c].

sequences.name: Forms Turn as the Heart Wills
sequences.description:
While in [c=Highlight]Illumining Form[/c], DMG taken by Hsin is reduced by 20%.
When Hsin takes a fatal blow, She will not be knocked out, but instead restores 100% of Max HP and becomes immune to DMG and interruption for 1s. This effect can be triggered once every 10 minutes.

sequences.name: The Moon Owes Its Light to the Living
sequences.description:
Targets take 40% more Resonance Skill DMG from Hsin.

Resonance Skill DMG dealt by Hsin ignores 20% of the target's DEF.

While in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Unison[/c]:
The maximum stacks of the [c=Highlight]Unison Boon[/c] effect on Resonators in the team are additionally increased by 1. When a Resonator in the team triggers [c=Highlight]Unison Response[/c], all Resonators in the team additionally gain 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Unison Boon[/c] for 30s. This effect does not stack.

While in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Electro Flare[/c]:
While in combat, [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c] DMG taken by targets within a certain range around Hsin can be Critical, with Crit. Rate fixed at 80% and Crit. DMG fixed at 230%.

skills.name: Furled Canopy
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy[/c]
While in the [c=Highlight]Deep Mind[/c] state, [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy[/c], performing up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 1 and Stage 2[/c] in succession.
Shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 2[/c], hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder Stage 1 and Stage 2[/c] in succession, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
Shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 3[/c], hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 4[/c].
Shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder Stage 1[/c], press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder[/c]
Deal [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
- While in the [c=Highlight]Deep Mind[/c] state, [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Unfurled Canopy[/c].
- Shortly after casting the skill, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Unfurled Canopy[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
- Shortly after casting the skill, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 3[/c].
- Shortly after casting the skill, hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder Stage 1[/c], dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].

skills.name: Furled Canopy: Rift Cleaver
skills.description:
Attack targets within range, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
- Within a certain period after opening the umbrella and dashing forward, when attacked by an enemy target, Suoming becomes immune to this damage and stagnates nearby targets. She then becomes immune to interruption and receives 100% less DMG for a certain period, and casts [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Crimson Gleam[/c].
- Entering the [c=Highlight]Deep Mind[/c] state resets the Cooldown of [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c].
- While in the [c=Highlight]Awakened Mind[/c] state, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].
- While in the [c=Highlight]Deep Mind[/c] state, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to chain into [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Crimson Gleam[/c]
Attack targets within range, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
- While in the [c=Highlight]Awakened Mind[/c] state, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c].
- While in the [c=Highlight]Deep Mind[/c] state, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to chain into [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 4[/c].

skills.name: Umbral Canopy: Miasma Lock
skills.description:
While in the [c=Highlight]Deep Mind[/c] state, [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] becomes available. Casting Resonance Liberation deals [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c] to targets within range.
- Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] grants Suoming [c=Highlight]Unison[/c] for 5s.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

[c=Title]Blight Rain, Miasmic Thunder[/c]
While casting [c=Highlight]Outro Skill[/c], if Suoming has [c=Highlight]Unison[/c], when a Resonator on the field deals damage, a [c=Highlight]Thunder Crest[/c] is summoned as a Coordinated Attack on the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].
- Within 3s after this damage is dealt, a [c=Highlight]Thunder Crest[/c] can be summoned each second. This effect is triggered once per second. The damage dealt by [c=Highlight]Thunder Crest[/c] does not trigger this effect.
- Only 1 [c=Highlight]Thunder Crest[/c] can be summoned per second, up to 6 in total.
- This effect lasts 8s, or until the number of summoned [c=Highlight]Thunder Crest[/c] reaches the limit.

skills.name: Furled Canopy: Flash Rift
skills.description:
Attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c].
- While in the [c=Highlight]Awakened Mind[/c] state, casting this skill sends Suoming into the [c=Highlight]Deep Mind[/c] state and clears all [c=Highlight]Delusion[/c].
- While in the [c=Highlight]Deep Mind[/c] state, [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Thunder Rending[/c].
- While in the [c=Highlight]Awakened Mind[/c] state, triggering Unison Response replaces [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c] with [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion (Unison)[/c].
- While in the [c=Highlight]Deep Mind[/c] state, triggering Unison Response replaces [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c] with [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison)[/c].

[c=Title]Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Thunder Rending[/c]
Deal [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c].
- Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to chain into [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Intro Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion (Unison)[/c]
Attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c].
- Casting this skill sends Suoming into the [c=Highlight]Deep Mind[/c] state and clears all [c=Highlight]Delusion[/c].

[c=Title]Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison)[/c]
Attack the target, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c].
- While in the [c=Highlight]Deep Mind[/c] state, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison)[/c] to chain into [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder Stage 2[/c].

skills.description: The incoming Resonator gains 20% Electro DMG Amplification for 8s or until the Resonator is switched out. While having [c=Highlight]Unison Boon[/c], they also gain 25% Resonance Skill DMG Amplification.

skills.name: Bound Obsession, Forged Mind
skills.description:
[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion[/c]
While in the [c=Highlight]Awakened Mind[/c] state, when [c=Highlight]Delusion[/c] reaches 800 points, [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion[/c], dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c].
- Casting this skill sends Suoming into [c=Highlight]Deep Mind[/c] and clears all [c=Highlight]Delusion[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Unforsaken Mind[/c]
While in the [c=Highlight]Deep Mind[/c] state, when [c=Highlight]Delusion[/c] reaches 800 points, [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Unforsaken Mind[/c], pulling in nearby targets and dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Umbral Canopy: Engraved Heart[/c]
Within a certain period after casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Unforsaken Mind[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] and [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] are replaced with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Umbral Canopy: Engraved Heart[/c]. Press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] or [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to cast this skill. Attack targets within range, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c].
- Casting this skill sends Suoming into [c=Highlight]Calamity Mind[/c] and clears all [c=Highlight]Delusion[/c]; she enters [c=Highlight]Awakened Mind[/c] once the skill ends.
- When casting this skill, hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] or [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to continuously attack the target for a certain period.
- While casting this skill, Suoming is immune to DMG and interruption for a certain period.
- During the skill action, she cannot move, dash, jump, dodge, or cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c], [c=Highlight]Plunging Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack[/c], or [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c], and Resonator switching is also restricted.

[c=Title]Unison[/c]
When Suoming has [c=Highlight]Unison[/c], switching to another Resonator will remove her [c=Highlight]Unison[/c] to trigger Suoming's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. When Suoming's Concerto Energy is full and she has [c=Highlight]Unison[/c], only the [c=Highlight]Unison[/c] effect is consumed.

[c=Title]Unison Response[/c]
Suoming can trigger [c=Highlight]Unison Response[/c].
When the active Resonator in the team has [c=Highlight]Unison[/c], Suoming triggers Unison Response after she is switched in and casts Intro Skill, granting all Resonators in the team 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Unison Boon[/c] for 30s.
Suoming can grant up to 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Unison Boon[/c]. Gaining it again only resets the duration.
[c=Highlight]Unison Response[/c] cannot be triggered in Co-op.

[c=Title]Unison Boon[/c]
Only the Resonators who can trigger Unison Response can gain this effect. Each stack of [c=Highlight]Unison Boon[/c] increases the total DMG dealt by Resonators in the team who can trigger [c=Highlight]Unison Response[/c] by 3%, up to 2 stacks.

[c=Title]Delusion[/c]
Can hold up to 800 points of Delusion.
- Hitting a target with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Unfurled Canopy[/c], or [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Crimson Gleam[/c] grants [c=Highlight]Delusion[/c] if Suoming is the active Resonator.
- Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] grants 200 points of [c=Highlight]Delusion[/c].
- Casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Thunder Rending[/c] or [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison)[/c] grants 200 points of [c=Highlight]Delusion[/c].

skills.name: Rain-Soaked Covenant
skills.description:
Casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Furled Canopy: Flash Rift[/c], [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Thunder Rending[/c], [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion (Unison)[/c], or [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison)[/c] grants 50% Electro DMG Bonus for 15s. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect early.
- When Suoming casts [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion (Unison)[/c] or [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison)[/c], she additionally gains 10 points of Concerto Energy, triggered only once every 25s.

skills.name: Sunken Seal, Forged Lock
skills.description:
When Suoming has [c=Highlight]Unison[/c] and casts Outro Skill, she gains the [c=Highlight]Aligned Seals[/c] effect for 30s.
Within 8s after Suoming casts [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] or [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Umbral Canopy: Engraved Heart[/c], if she gains or has [c=Highlight]Aligned Seals[/c], her [c=Highlight]Outro Skill[/c] grants the incoming Resonator 30% Electro DMG Bonus, plus an additional 20% for each stack of [c=Highlight]Unison Boon[/c] they have, up to 40%. This effect lasts for 8s or until the Resonator is switched out.

When Suoming has [c=Highlight]Unison[/c], casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Furled Canopy: Rift Cleaver[/c] removes [c=Highlight]Unison[/c] and the [c=Highlight]Unison Boon[/c] on her, consumes 20 points of Concerto Energy, and clears all [c=Highlight]Delusion[/c], granting the [c=Highlight]Seal Master[/c] effect: the DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy[/c] and [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder[/c] are increased by 100%, each stage of both skills restores 5 additional points of Concerto Energy on hit, and Suoming's Crit. DMG is increased by 100%. This effect lasts for 12s or until the Resonator is switched out.
- Gaining [c=Highlight]Unison[/c] ends this effect early.
- Gaining the [c=Highlight]Aligned Seals[/c] effect ends this effect early.
- The [c=Highlight]Seal Master[/c] effect cannot be gained while the [c=Highlight]Aligned Seals[/c] effect is active.
- While the [c=Highlight]Seal Master[/c] effect is active, press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 4[/c] to chain into [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 2[/c].

sequences.name: Into the Blight Rain
sequences.description:
[c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Unforsaken Mind[/c] is immune to interruption.
The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Furled Canopy: Flash Rift[/c], [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Thunder Rending[/c], [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion (Unison)[/c], and [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison)[/c] are increased by 60%.

sequences.name: Breaking Thunder, Slaying Evil

Crit. DMG is increased by 40%.
Casting [c=Highlight]Outro Skill[/c] increases the incoming Resonator's Crit. DMG by 10%, plus an additional 6% for each stack of [c=Highlight]Unison Boon[/c] they have, up to 24%. This effect lasts for 30s or until the Resonator is switched out.

sequences.description:

- If Suoming has already granted [c=Highlight]Unison Boon[/c] and it is still in effect, gaining it again only resets its duration.

Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c] grants Suoming 30% Basic Attack DMG Amplification for 25s.

skills.name: Feather as Blade
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Yangyang performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Yangyang consumes STA to lunge forward, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack: Zephyr Song[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] or [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] to perform Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Zephyr Song[/c], dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Yangyang consumes STA to perform a Plunging Attack from mid-air, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to thrust forward, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

skills.name: Zephyr Domain
skills.description: Yangyang wields her sword to create a whirling vortex of winds that pulls nearby enemies to the center, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

skills.name: Echoing Feathers
skills.description:
[c=Title]Heavy Attack: Stormy Strike[/c]
When Yangyang has 3 Melodies, she can cast [c=Highlight]Stormy Strike[/c] after [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] or [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c], dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack: Feather Release[/c]
When Yangyang has 3 Melodies, cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] in mid-air to consume all Melodies and perform consecutive strikes, diving from mid-air, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c]. As Yangyang lands, she sheathes her sword with an attack, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c], considered as Basic Attack DMG.
 
[c=Title]Melody[/c]
Yangyang can hold up to 3 Melodies
Yangyang obtains 1 Melody with every [c=Highlight]Basic Attack 4[/c] on hit.
Yangyang obtains 1 Melody for every Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Zephyr Song[/c] on hit.
Yangyang obtains 1 Melody for every Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Zephyr Domain[/c] on hit.
Yangyang obtains 1 Melody upon casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Cerulean Song[/c].

skills.name: Half Truths
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Aalto fires up to 5 consecutive shots, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c]. Basic Attack 4 will spread the Mist forward, which lasts for 1.5s.
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Aalto enters the aiming state for a more powerful shot.
The aimed shot fired after charging finishes deals [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Aalto consumes STA to perform consecutive shots at the target in mid-air, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

skills.name: Shift Trick
skills.description:
[c=Title]Mist Avatar[/c]
Casts Mist and 1 "Mist Avatar(s)" to taunt the surrounding targets. The avatars inherit a portion of Aalto's HP and generate 6 Mist Bullets around them, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mist Bullets[/c]
Deals [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c], considered as Resonance Skill DMG.

skills.name: Flower in the Mist
skills.description: Generate a Gate of Quandary in front, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c]. When bullets pass through the Gate of Quandary, they deal increased DMG. Gate of Quandary lasts for 10s.

skills.name: Feint Shot
skills.description: Aalto shows up out of thin air to perform rapid continuous shooting, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

skills.name: Dissolving Mist
skills.description: The incoming Resonator has their Aero DMG Amplified by 23% for 14s or until they are switched out.

skills.name: Tune Break: Pistols
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Misty Cover
skills.description:
When Aalto passes through "Mist" or "Gate of Quandary", he enters the [c=Highlight]Mistcloak Dash[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mistcloak Dash[/c]
-Movement speed increased;
-During this period, "Mist Drops" are continuously consumed, and for each 1 "Mist Drop" consumed, 1 Mist Bullet(s) is generated.
 
[c=Title]Mist Drops[/c]
Aalto can hold up to 6 "Mist Drops".
When [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] or [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack[/c] passes through "Mist" and hits the target, 1 "Mist Drop" is recovered.

skills.name: Perfect Performance
skills.description: Aalto's [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] will always critically hit, triggered once every 30s.

skills.name: Mid-game Break
skills.description: Aalto will continuously recover STA when he is in the Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Mistcloak Dash[/c] state.

sequences.name: Mistweaver's Debut
sequences.description: "Mist Avatar" inherits 100% more HP from Aalto. When Aalto attacks targets taunted by the "Mist Avatar(s)", his ATK is increased by 15%.

sequences.name: Hazey Transition

sequences.name: Blake Bloom for Finale

sequences.name: Applause of the Lost
sequences.description: In the Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Mistcloak Dash[/c] state, Aalto's Aero DMG Bonus is increased by 25% for 6s.

sequences.name: Broker's Secrets
sequences.description: Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Flower in the Mist[/c] now additionally increases Crit. Rate by 8%. When Aalto's Heavy Attack passes through the Gate of Quandary, the damage dealt is additionally increased by 50%.

skills.name: Lone Lance
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Consume Stamina to thrust forward, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack: Windborne Strike[/c]
Hold [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] during [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Windborne Strike[/c] after [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] ends, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack: Abyssal Slash[/c]
Release [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] during [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Abyssal Slash[/c] after [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] ends, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-Air Attack[/c]
Consume Stamina to perform a Plunging Attack while in mid-air, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
After performing the [c=Highlight]Plunging Attack[/c], use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] to perform a follow-up attack, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-Air Attack: Banner of Triumph[/c]
After casting Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Windborne Strike[/c] or Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Windqueller[/c] in mid-air, Jiyan can perform a mid-air attack, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

skills.name: Windqueller
skills.description:
Dash forward a certain distance, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
 
Can be cast in the air.

skills.name: Emerald Storm - Prelude
skills.description:
After releasing Emerald Storm - Prelude, Jiyan enters [c=Highlight]Qingloong Mode[/c].
 
[c=Title]Qingloong Mode[/c]
Jiyan has increased resistance to interruption.
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] and [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] are replaced with Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Lance of Qingloong[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack: Lance of Qingloong[/c]
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c], considered as Heavy Attack DMG.

skills.name: Tactical Strike
skills.description: Jiyan pierces the target in mid-air, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

skills.name: Discipline
skills.description: When the incoming Resonator's Heavy Attack hits a target, Jiyan will summon a lance to launch a coordinated attack, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] equal to 313.40% of Jiyan's ATK. This attack lasts for 8s and can be triggered once every 1s, up to 2 times.

skills.name: Tune Break: Broadblade
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Qingloong at War
skills.description:
When casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Windqueller[/c], if Jiyan has 30 or more "Resolve", he consumes 30 "Resolve" to increase the DMG of this Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Windqueller[/c] by 20%.
When Jiyan is in [c=Highlight]Qingloong Mode[/c], DMG of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Windqueller[/c] is increased by 20% and no longer consumes "Resolve".
 
[c=Title]Resonance Liberation: Emerald Storm - Finale[/c]
When casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Emerald Storm - Prelude[/c], if Jiyan has 30 "Resolve" or more, he will consume 30 "Resolve" to cast Emerald Storm - Finale, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c], considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
Emerald Storm: Finale can be cast in mid-air at low altitude.
 
[c=Title]Resolve[/c]
Jiyan can hold up to 60 Resolve.
Jiyan gains "Resolve" when his Normal Attack [c=Highlight]Lone Lance[/c] hits the target.
Jiyan gains "Resolve" when the Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Tactical Strike[/c] hits the target.
"Resolve" will gradually decrease if Jiyan does not hit a target within 15s.

skills.name: Heavenly Balance
skills.description: After casting the Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Tactical Strike[/c], Jiyan's ATK is increased by 10% for 15s.

skills.name: Tempest Taming
skills.description: When Jiyan's attacks hit a target, Jiyan's Crit. DMG is increased by 12% for 8s.

sequences.name: Benevolence
sequences.description:
Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Windqueller[/c] can be used 1 more time.

When casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Windqueller[/c], the Resolve cost is decreased by 15.

sequences.name: Versatility
sequences.description: After casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Tactical Strike[/c], Jiyan gains 30 Resolve and his ATK is increased by 28% for 15s. This can be triggered once every 15s.

sequences.name: Spectation
sequences.description: When casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Windqueller[/c], Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Emerald Storm: Prelude[/c], Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Emerald Storm: Finale[/c] or Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Tactical Strike[/c], Jiyan's Crit. Rate is increased by 16% and Crit. DMG is increased by 32% for 8s.

sequences.name: Prudence
sequences.description: When casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Emerald Storm: Prelude[/c] or Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Emerald Storm: Finale[/c], the Heavy Attack DMG Bonus of all team members is increased by 25% for 30s.

sequences.name: Resolution
sequences.description:
Outro Skill [c=Highlight]Discipline[/c] gains an additional DMG Multiplier of 120%. 
When Jiyan's attacks hit a target, his ATK is increased by 3% for 8s, stacking up to 15 times; this effect is immediately maxed after he casts Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Tactical Strike[/c].

sequences.name: Fortitude
sequences.description:
Every time [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c], Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Tactical Strike[/c] or Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Windqueller[/c] is used, Jiyan gains 1 stack(s) of "Momentum", stacking up to 2 times.
Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Emerald Storm: Finale[/c] will consume all "Momentum", and each stack consumed increases the DMG multiplier of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Emerald Storm: Finale[/c] by 120%.

skills.name: Fengyiquan
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Jianxin performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Jianxin consumes STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Jianxin consumes STA to plunge and unleash a powerful kick, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

skills.name: Calming Air
skills.description:
Hold [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to enter [c=Highlight]Parry Stance[/c].
 
[c=Title]Chi Counter[/c]
When Jianxin is attacked in the [c=Highlight]Parry Stance[/c], she does not take damage and immediately performs [c=Highlight]Chi Counter[/c], dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Chi Parry[/c]
Release the [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] button during [c=Highlight]Parry Stance[/c] to interrupt [c=Highlight]Parry Stance[/c] and perform [c=Highlight]Chi Parry[/c], dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

skills.name: Purification Force Field
skills.description: Create a strong wind field, continuously pulling targets within the wind field to the center and dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c]. When the wind field disappears, it will trigger an explosion to deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] to all targets within the range again.

skills.name: Formless Release
skills.description: Damage of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Purification Force Field[/c] is increased by 20%.

skills.name: Tune Break: Gauntlets
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Reflection
skills.description: The Shield obtained from Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Primordial Chi Spiral[/c] is increased by 20%.

skills.name: Essence of Tao
skills.description: Pull in targets within the range, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

skills.name: Transcendence
skills.description: The incoming Resonator has their Resonance Liberation DMG Amplified by 38% for 14s or until they are switched out.

skills.name: Primordial Chi Spiral
skills.description:
[c=Title]Heavy Attack: Primordial Chi Spiral[/c]
When "Chi" reaches max stacks, hold [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Primordial Chi Spiral[/c] and start [c=Highlight]Zhoutian Progress[/c].
 
[c=Title]Zhoutian Progress[/c]
Jianxin's resistance to interruption is increased, and her the damage taken is reduced by 50%:
Jianxin continuously consumes "Chi" and casts [c=Highlight]Chi Strike[/c] to attack targets nearby, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
As [c=Highlight]Zhoutian Progress[/c] accumulates, Jianxin reaches different Zhoutian and gains effects accordingly.
-Before Minor Zhoutian: Gain Zhoutian Progress 1 shield. When [c=Highlight]Zhoutian Progress[/c] is interrupted, cast [c=Highlight]Pushing Punch[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
-Minor Zhoutian: Gain Zhoutian Progress 2 shield and cast [c=Highlight]Shock[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].  When [c=Highlight]Zhoutian Progress[/c] is interrupted, cast [c=Highlight]Yielding Pull[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
-Major Zhoutian - Inner: Gain Zhoutian Progress 3 shield and cast [c=Highlight]Shock[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c]. When [c=Highlight]Zhoutian Progress[/c] is interrupted, cast [c=Highlight]Yielding Pull[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
-Major Zhoutian - Outer: Gain Zhoutian Progress 3 shield and cast [c=Highlight]Shock[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
-When [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] button is released, interrupt [c=Highlight]Zhoutian Progress[/c] and lose all "Chi";
-When all "Chi" is consumed, end [c=Highlight]Zhoutian Progress[/c].
 
When [c=Highlight]Zhoutian Progress[/c] ends, regain a shield according to the Zhoutian Progress reached;
As the shield provided by [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack: Primordial Chi Spiral[/c] persists, the active character is healed once every 6s.
 
[c=Title]Chi[/c]
Jianxin can hold up to 120 Chi.
Chi is obtained when Normal Attack [c=Highlight]Fengyiquan[/c] hits the target.
Chi is obtained when the Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Calming Air[/c] is cast.
Chi is obtained when the Resonance Skills [c=Highlight]Chi Counter[/c] or [c=Highlight]Chi Parry[/c] hits the target.
Chi is obtained when the Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Essence of Tao[/c] hits the target.

sequences.name: Verdant Branchlet
sequences.description: After casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Essence of Tao[/c], Jianxin gains 100% extra Chi from [c=Highlight]Basic Attacks[/c] for 10s.

sequences.name: Tao Seeker's Journey
sequences.description: Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Calming Air[/c] can be used 1 more time.

sequences.name: Principles of Wuwei
sequences.description: After staying in the [c=Highlight]Parry Stance[/c] of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Calming Air[/c] for 2.5s, Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Chi Counter[/c] becomes immediately available.

sequences.name: Multitide Reflection
sequences.description: When performing Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack: Primordial Chi Spiral[/c], Jianxin's Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Purification Force Field[/c] DMG is increased by 80% for 14s.

sequences.name: Mirroring Introspection
sequences.description: The range of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Purification Force Field[/c] is increased by 33%.

sequences.name: Truth from Within
sequences.description: During Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack: Primordial Qi Spiral[/c], if Jianxin performs [c=Highlight]Pushing Punch[/c], enhanced Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Special Chi Counter[/c] can be used 1 time(s) in 5s.  [c=Highlight]Special Chi Counter[/c]: Deals [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] equal to 556.67% of Jianxin's ATK, considered as Heavy Attack DMG. Obtain a Zhoutian Progress 4 Shield (Benefits from Inherent Skill [c=Highlight]Reflection[/c]'s bonus effect.)

skills.name: Wind Cutter
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
- Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] right after casting the skill to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c] directly.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Razor Wind[/c]
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] after casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c], or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] to cast Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Razor Wind[/c]. Consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
- Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after landing to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 4[/c].
- At max Windstrings, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after landing to cast Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Unbound Flow[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] right after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

skills.name: Illusion Breaker
skills.description:
[c=Title]Awakening Gale[/c]
Jump up into the mid-air and slash the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Skyfall Severance[/c]
While in mid-air, press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c], which removes all stacks of Spectro Frazzle, Havoc Bane, Fusion Burst, Glacio Chafe, and Electro Flare from the target hit and inflicts 1 stack of Aero Erosion for each stack removed.

skills.name: Omega Storm
skills.description:
Unleash the power of the Eye of Tempest, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and healing all nearby Resonators in the team.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

skills.name: Relentless Squall
skills.description: Deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

skills.name: Storm's Echo
skills.description:
Grant [c=Highlight]Aeolian Realm[/c] to all nearby Resonators in the team for 30s. [c=Highlight]Aeolian Realm[/c] effect:
- Upon hitting a target, increase the maximum stack of Aero Erosion the target can receive by 3 for 10s. This effect is not stackable.

skills.name: Tune Break: Sword
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Cycle of Wind
skills.description:
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Cloudburst Dance[/c]
Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] (considered Resonance Skill DMG) and healing all nearby Resonators in the team. Cast through the following 3 ways:
- Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] right after casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Awakening Gale[/c].
- Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] right after casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c].
- Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] right after casting Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Razor Wind[/c].
When casting Mid-air Attack [c=Highlight]Cloudburst Dance[/c], hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to perform [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Unbound Flow[/c]
At max Windstrings, Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Awakening Gale[/c] becomes Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Unbound Flow[/c]: Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks. Each attack consumes 60 Windstrings, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c], considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Switching to another Resonator after Stage 1 automatically triggers Stage 2 of this skill. 

[c=Title]Windstring[/c]
Rover can hold up to 120 Windstrings.
Each stage of Mid-air Attack [c=Highlight]Cloudburst Dance[/c] restores 25 Windstrings on hit.
Casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c] restores 20 Windstrings.
Hitting a target with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3 or 4[/c] or [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] restores 10 Windstrings.

rows.label: Unbound Flow Concerto Regen per Stage

skills.name: Sand in the Storm
skills.description: Casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Relentless Squall[/c] increases ATK by 20% for 10s.

skills.name: Boundless Winds
skills.description: Increase Healing from Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Omega Storm[/c] by 20%.

sequences.name: Storm Subsides in the Void
sequences.description: Casting Mid-air Attack [c=Highlight]Cloudburst Dance[/c] enhances Rover's resistance to interruption for 3s.

sequences.name: Glimmers Fade into the Dark
sequences.description: Casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Unbound Flow[/c] continuously restores HP for the Resonator on the field by 20% of Rover's ATK every 3s for 30s. When the Resonator on the field has an HP lower than 35%, immediately restore 10% of their lost HP. This restoration effect can be triggered once every 10s and will not be affected by any Healing Bonus.

sequences.name: Illusions Collapse in a Grip
sequences.description: Aero DMG Bonus is increased by 15%.

sequences.name: Boundaries Shatter in an Instant
sequences.description: Casting Mid-air Attack [c=Highlight]Cloudburst Dance[/c] increases Resonance Skill DMG Bonus by 15% for 5s.

sequences.name: Life and Death Intertwine
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Omega Storm[/c] is increased by 20%.

sequences.name: All Crumble in the Wind
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Unbound Flow[/c] is increased by 30%.

skills.name: Quadruple Time Steps
skills.description:
[c=Title] Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c]. Basic Attack Stage 4 inflicts 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Aero Erosion[/c] upon the target hit.
- When the first three stages of Ciaccona's Basic Attack are interrupted by dodging, press Basic Attack in time to resume the attack cycle and cast the corresponding Basic Attack stage.
- After Basic Attack Stage 4, Ciaccona starts a [c=Highlight]Solo Concert[/c]. If Ciaccona's Basic Attack Stage 4 or [c=Highlight]Solo Concert[/c] ends early (proactively or being interrupted), an [c=Highlight]Ensemble Sylph[/c] is generated.

[c=Title]Solo Concert[/c]
When Ciaccona or Ensemble Sylph performs Solo Concert, they give 24% Aero DMG Bonus to all nearby Resonators in the team. This effect is not stackable.

[c=Title]Ensemble Sylph[/c]
Up to 2 Ensemble Sylphs may exist simultaneously.
If Ciaccona's [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 4[/c] is interrupted, the Ensemble Sylphs generated will finish the attack for Ciaccona and enter [c=Highlight]Solo Concert[/c].
If Ciaccona's [c=Highlight]Solo Concert[/c] is interrupted, the [c=Highlight]Ensemble Sylphs[/c] generated will continue the [c=Highlight]Solo Concert[/c] for Ciaccona.
Aside from the two situations mentioned above, Ensemble Sylphs generated by [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] will finish Ciaccona's current attack without entering [c=Highlight]Solo Concert[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Consume STA to jump into mid-air and attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Aimed Attack[/c]
Press Aim to enter Aiming Mode to fire charged shots, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c], considered Heavy Attack DMG.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
Press Normal Attack after Mid-air Attack Stage 2 to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.

[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Follow up successful [c=Highlight]Dodges[/c] with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

skills.name: Harmonic Allegro
skills.description:
Move a certain distance, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and inflicting 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Aero Erosion[/c] on the target upon hit.
Press Normal Attack in time to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
- When Ciaccona interrupts Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Mid-air Attack, or [c=Highlight]Solo Concert[/c] with Resonance Skill, an [c=Highlight]Ensemble Sylph[/c] is generated.
- Ciaccona's Resonance Skill can be cast in mid-air.

skills.name: Singer's Triple Cadenza
skills.description:
Ciaccona and [c=Highlight]Ensemble Sylphs[/c] perform an [c=Highlight]Improvised Symphonic Poem[/c] together, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] once to the nearby targets and entering [c=Highlight]Recital[/c].

[c=Title]Recital[/c]
When in Recital, sound waves will periodically radiate around Ciaccona. When the sound wave overlaps with the circle indicator, press the green or yellow buttons to generate [c=Highlight]Symphonic Poem: Tonic[/c] of the corresponding color and recover a certain amount of Concerto Energy.
During Recital:
- Switching to another Resonator doesn't end Recital, but automatically generates a [c=Highlight]Symphonic Poem: Tonic[/c] matching the color of the last generated Tonic before switching. A green [c=Highlight]Symphonic Poem: Tonic[/c] is generated by default if no interaction input is given before switching to another Resonator.
- Ciaccona is immune to interruptions and takes 50% less DMG.
- Exit Recital by pressing Resonance Liberation again or switching Ciaccona back onto the field.
- [c=Highlight]Ensemble Sylphs[/c] can now directly grant Aero DMG Bonus provided by [c=Highlight]Solo Concert[/c].

[c=Title]Symphonic Poem: Tonic[/c]
Green Tonic: Deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] to nearby targets and inflict a stack of [c=Highlight]Aero Erosion[/c] on targets hit.
Yellow Tonic: Deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] to nearby targets and inflict a stack of [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle[/c] on targets hit.

skills.name: Roaming with the Wind
skills.description:
Attack the target to deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and inflict a stack of [c=Highlight]Aero Erosion[/c].
Follow up with Basic Attack in time to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

skills.name: Windcalling Tune
skills.description: [c=Highlight]Aero Erosion[/c] DMG dealt to targets near the active Resonator is Amplified by 100% for 30s.

skills.name: Tune Break: Pistols
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Symphony of Wind and Verse
skills.description:
[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat[/c]
When there are 3 segments of Musical Essence, Heavy Attack is replaced with [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat[/c].
Consume all Musical Essence to shoot [c=Highlight]Downbeat Notes[/c] forward to deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c], pulling in the nearby targets and inflicting 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Aero Erosion[/c] on the target hit.
[c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat[/c] can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

[c=Title]Musical Essence[/c]
Ciaccona can hold up to 3 segments of Musical Essence.
Casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 4[/c] or [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c] recovers 1 segment of Musical Essence.

skills.name: Interlude Tune
skills.description: Casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Singer's Triple Cadenza[/c] grants Ciaccona a Shield equal to 100% of her Max HP for 4s. Switching out Ciaccona removes the Shield.

skills.name: Winds of Rinascita
skills.description: Increase [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat[/c]'s DMG by 30%.

sequences.name: Where Wind Sings
sequences.description: Casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Harmonic Allegro[/c] grants Ciaccona immunity to interruption for 3s. Casting Basic Attack increases Ciaccona's ATK by 35% for 10s.

sequences.name: Song of the Four Seasons
sequences.description: During Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Singer's Triple Cadenza[/c], Resonators in the team gain 40% Aero DMG Bonus.

sequences.name: Starlit Improv
sequences.description: Casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 4[/c] additionally grants 1 segments of Musical Essence. Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Harmonic Allegro[/c] gains 1 more charge.

sequences.name: Toccata and Fugue
sequences.description:
Ciaccona ignores 45% of the targets' DEF when dealing damage with Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Quadruple Downbeat[/c];
Ciaccona ignores 45% of the targets' DEF when dealing Resonance Liberation DMG.

sequences.name: Eternal Idyll to Lasting Summer
sequences.description:
Gain 40% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus;
DMG taken by Resonators within and around the range of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Singer's Triple Cadenza[/c] is reduced by 30%.

sequences.name: Unending Cadence
sequences.description: When in [c=Highlight]Solo Concert[/c], Ciaccona or [c=Highlight]Ensemble Sylph[/c] deals [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] equal to 220% of Ciaccona's ATK to nearby targets, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.

skills.name: Sword to Carve My Forms
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack - Cartethyia[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
Following [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Cartethyia[/c] Stage 4, inflict 1 stack of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] on targets hit and summon [c=Highlight]Sword of Divinity's Shadow[/c].
Up to 1 [c=Highlight]Sword of Divinity's Shadow[/c] may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Cartethyia[/c] 
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and summoning [c=Highlight]Sword of Discord's Shadow[/c]. Can be performed in mid-air.
Up to 1 [c=Highlight]Sword of Discord's Shadow[/c] may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.
This instance of DMG is considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia[/c]
Release [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] button while airborne to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c], also considered [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] DMG.
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after the [c=Highlight]Plunging Attack[/c] to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia[/c] recalls all [c=Highlight]Sword Shadows[/c]. Based on the types and number of [c=Highlight] Sword Shadows[/c] recalled, perform different forms of Plunging Attack and obtain the corresponding [c=Highlight]Heart of Virtue[/c], [c=Highlight]Mandate of Divinity[/c], and [c=Highlight]Power of Discord[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Cartethyia[/c]
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

skills.name: Sword to Bear Their Names
skills.description:
[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Cartethyia[/c]
Attack the target, launch nearby enemies, and then plunge them to the ground, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and inflicting 2 stacks of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] on the targets hit. This instance of DMG is considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c]. Can be performed in mid-air.
Following [c=Highlight]Cartethyia - Resonance Skill[/c], summon [c=Highlight]Sword of Virtue's Shadow[/c].
Up to 1 [c=Highlight]Sword of Virtue's Shadow[/c] may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.

skills.name: A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers
skills.description:
[c=Title]Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers[/c]
By reducing HP to 50% of the Max HP, [c=Highlight]Cartethyia[/c] transforms into [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c], unlocking new moves and entering the [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c] state for 12s.
Can be performed in mid-air.
Entering [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c] clears all [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c].
As [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2[/c], and [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides[/c] instantly trigger 1 instance of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] DMG and reduce the [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] stack on the target hit by 1.
- Ending the state will not clear Resonance Energy.
- No HP cost when HP is below 50%.

[c=Highlight]Fleurdelys's[/c] attacks restore [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] on hit. When [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] reaches 120 points, press Resonance Liberation to cast [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall[/c].

When [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] is below 120 points, press Resonance Liberation to transform back into [c=Highlight]Cartethyia[/c]. When in [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c], casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers[/c] as Cartethyia consumes no Resonance Energy.

When [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c] has [c=Highlight]Heart of Virtue[/c] in [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c]:
- [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4[/c] will generate a force field to Stagnate the targets within the range.
- [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys's[/c] resistance to interruption increases. 
[c=Highlight]Heart of Virtue[/c] is removed when [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c] ends.

When [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c] has [c=Highlight]Mandate of Divinity[/c] in [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c]: 
[c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] DMG is Amplified by 50% and the damage interval is decreased by 50% for enemies within a certain distance from [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c].
[c=Highlight]Mandate of Divinity[/c] is removed when [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c] ends.
 
When [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c] has [c=Highlight]Power of Discord[/c] in [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c]:
When casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2[/c] and [c=Highlight]Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys[/c] or after [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides[/c] deals damage, raise the [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] stacks on all nearby targets to the highest count among the targets.
[c=Highlight]Power of Discord[/c] is removed when [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c] ends.
 
[c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c] will transform back to [c=Highlight]Cartethyia[/c] during [c=Highlight]quest dialogues[/c], [c=Highlight]environmental interaction animations[/c], or using [c=Highlight]Utilities[/c].
[c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c] can walk on water. Doing so on deep waters continuously consumes STA. When in walking state, [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c] can step out of a high place and walk in mid-air by continuously consuming STA.
 
[c=Title]Avatar - Cartethyia[/c]
As [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c], when [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] is below 120 points, press Resonance Liberation to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2[/c] and temporarily transform back to [c=Highlight]Cartethyia[/c], which pauses the timer on [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air. Casting the skill in mid-air performs [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia[/c].
 
[c=Title]Avatar - Fleurdelys[/c]
When in [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c], casting Resonance Liberation as [c=Highlight]Cartethyia[/c] performs [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2[/c] without consuming Resonance Energy and transforms her back to [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c], which resumes the timer on [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air. Casting this skill in mid-air performs [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 1[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall[/c]
When [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c] has 120 points of [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall[/c] removes all [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c], ends [c=Highlight]Manifest[/c], restores 50% of Max HP, and then deals [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] to all targets in an area along a straight line in front. Upon hitting the target, remove all stacks of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] on the target. Each stack removed Amplifies the DMG taken by the targets by 20%, up to 5 stacks.
Can be cast in mid-air.

skills.name: Tempest
skills.description:
[c=Highlight]Cartethyia[/c] unlocks new moves when she transforms into [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c]:

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Fleurdelys[/c] 
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Cartethyia[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Fleurdelys[/c].
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and restoring [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] on hit.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys[/c] 
[c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys[/c].
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks in the air at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and restoring [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] on hit.
While airborne, hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3[/c].
Follow up with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] shortly afterward to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3[/c].
While airborne, casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call[/c] and [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides[/c] resets the cycle of [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys[/c]
[c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Cartethyia[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys[/c].
Thrust forward to deliver a focused strike, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and restoring [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] on hit. This instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG.

[c=Title]Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys[/c]
While casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] again to cast Enhanced [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys[/c]: fall back and blast the area in a straight line in front, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and restoring [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] on hit. This instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG.
Follow up with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Upward Cut - Fleurdelys[/c].

[c=Title]Upward Cut - Fleurdelys[/c]
While [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c] is on the ground, [c=Highlight]Jump[/c] to cast this skill, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and restoring [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] on hit.

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Fleurdelys[/c] 
[c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Cartethyia[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Fleurdelys[/c].
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and restoring [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] on hit.
Follow up with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] shortly afterward to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4 [/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call[/c] 
[c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Cartethyia[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call[/c].
Summon a force field near the target's location to continuously pull in nearby targets, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and restoring [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] on hit.
Can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides[/c]
Following [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call[/c], press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] again to call down a giant Sword Shadow to crush an area around the target, creating a force field to pull in nearby targets, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] to ground targets, and restoring [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] on hit.
Follow up with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] shortly afterward to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3[/c].
The Resonance Skill enters cooldown if [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides[/c] is not cast within a certain period or when switching to another Resonator. 
Can be cast in mid-air.
