skills.description: The healing received by all Resonators other than [c=Highlight]Cartethyia/Fleurdelys[/c] in the team is increased by 20% and their resistance to interruption is enhanced. If Rover: Aero is in the team, Rover: Aero additionally restores 25 [c=Highlight]Windstrings[/c] upon casting [c=Highlight]Omega Storm[/c].

skills.name: Wind's Indelible Imprint
skills.description: Targets with 1 to 3 stacks of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] take 30% more DMG from [c=Highlight]Cartethyia[/c] and [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c]. Targets with more than 3 stacks of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] additionally take 10% more DMG from [c=Highlight]Cartethyia[/c] and [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c] for each stack of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] they have, up to 3 stacks.

sequences.name: Crown Destined by Fate
sequences.description:
Gain [c=Highlight]Zeal[/c] that lasts for 10s when [c=Highlight]Cartethyia's[/c] or [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys's[/c] attacks directly damage and defeat targets inflicted with [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c].
In the [c=Highlight]Zeal[/c] state, upon defeating enemies, the next move that directly damages targets raises the [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] stacks on the targets to the highest count among the targets defeated. This will not exceed the current max [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] stack limit. [c=Highlight]Zeal[/c] is removed afterward and enters a 1s cooldown.
When [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys's[/c] [c=Highlight]Conviction[/c] hits 30/60/90/120, [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys's[/c] Crit. DMG is increased by 25% for 15s, up to 4 stacks. The duration of this effect does not reset upon gaining new stacks. After casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall[/c], the increased Crit. DMG is removed.

sequences.name: Blade Broken by Tempest
sequences.description:
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers[/c] increases the max stack limit of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] on targets within a certain range by 3 stacks. The next attack that directly damages the target inflicts 3 stacks of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] on all targets within a certain range and immediately triggers the [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] DMG on the targets hit once without consuming the [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] stacks.
The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Cartethyia's[/c] Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Dodge Counter, and Intro Skill are increased by 50% and the DMG Multiplier of her Mid-air Attack is increased by 200%.
After casting [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia[/c], every 1 type of Sword Shadow recalled reduces the cooldown of [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Cartethyia[/c] by 1s.

sequences.name: Prisoner Hanged in the Tower
sequences.description:
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2[/c], [c=Highlight]Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys[/c], and [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides[/c] now inflict 2 stacks of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] on the targets hit.
The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall[/c] is increased by 100%.

sequences.name: Sacrifice Made for Salvation
sequences.description: After Resonators in the team inflict [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c], [c=Highlight]Fusion Burst[/c], [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle[/c], [c=Highlight]Electro Flare[/c], [c=Highlight]Glacio Chafe[/c], or[c=Highlight]Aero Erosion[/c], all Resonators in the team gain 20% DMG Bonus for all Attributes for 20s.

sequences.name: Hope Reshaped in Storms
sequences.description:
When [c=Highlight]Cartethyia[/c] or [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c] takes a fatal blow, they will not be downed by this instance of damage, but instead gain a Shield equal to 20% of [c=Highlight]Cartethyia's[/c] Max HP for 10s. This effect can be triggered once every 10 min.
The HP cost for casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers[/c] is reduced to 25% of Max HP.

sequences.name: Freedom Found in Storm's Wake
sequences.description:
After casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall[/c], raise the [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] stacks on the target hit to max. Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall[/c] no longer removes the [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] stacks on the target.
Within 30s after casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Sword to Mark Tide's Trace[/c], [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Sword to Call for Freedom[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers[/c], and [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall[/c], when any Resonator in the team inflicts [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] on the targets with max stacks of [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c], immediately trigger the [c=Wind]Aero Erosion[/c] DMG once.
The targets take 40% more DMG from [c=Highlight]Fleurdelys[/c].

skills.name: Moon Steps
skills.description:
[c=Title]Moonring - Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks with the [c=Highlight]Moonring[/c], dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Moonring - Dodge Counter[/c]
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target with [c=Highlight]Moonring[/c], dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c]. Press Normal Attack again shortly after performing this skill to cast Moonring - Basic Attack Stage 3.

[c=Title]Moonbow - Basic Attack[/c]
Enter [c=Highlight]Lunar Cycle - New Moon[/c] by casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring[/c]. When in this state, Iuno will attack with [c=Highlight]Moonbow[/c].
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks with the [c=Highlight]Moonbow[/c], dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c], considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Moonbow - Dodge Counter[/c]
When in [c=Highlight]Lunar Cycle - New Moon[/c], press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target with [c=Highlight]Moonbow[/c], dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c], considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.
When in [c=Highlight]Lunar Cycle - New Moon[/c], press Normal Attack again shortly after performing this skill to cast Moonbow - Basic Attack Stage 3.
Can be cast in mid-air.

skills.name: Foresight Fugue
skills.description:
[c=Title]Pulse of Origins[/c]
Dash forward, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Closing Refrain[/c]
When not in [c=Highlight]Lunar Cycle[/c], casting [c=Highlight]Moonring - Basic Attack Stage 3[/c], [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c], or [c=Highlight]Pulse of Origins[/c] replaces Iuno's Resonance Skill with [c=Highlight]Closing Refrain[/c] for 5s.
Casting Closing Refrain unleashes a flurry of strikes, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c], and activates [c=Highlight]Lunar Cycle[/c].

[c=Title]Unfinished Refrain[/c]
When in [c=Highlight]Lunar Cycle - Half Moon[/c], Iuno's Resonance Skill is replaced with [c=Highlight]Unfinished Refrain[/c].
Casting Unfinished Refrain unleashes a flurry of strikes, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
Unfinished Refrain shares the same Cooldown as Closing Refrain.

[c=Title]Arc Beyond the Edge[/c]
When Iuno is in [c=Highlight]Lunar Cycle - New Moon[/c], her Resonance Skill is replaced with [c=Highlight]Arc Beyond the Edge[/c], which has 2 initial charges.
Casting Arc Beyond the Edge causes Iuno to shift position and deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c], considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.
- Directional input can be used to extend the travel distance. If Iuno is hit or launched into mid-air, casting [c=Highlight]Arc Beyond the Edge[/c] immediately makes her recover from the attack.
Can be cast in mid-air.

skills.description:
Deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] and activate the [c=Highlight]Lunar Cycle[/c] state.

skills.name: Illuminated Manifestation
skills.description: Deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

skills.name: From Gloom to Gleam
skills.description:
Attack the target to deal 100% [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c]. The incoming Resonator gains 50% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification for 14s. This effect ends early if they are switched off the field.
Casting [c=Highlight]Outro Skill[/c] won't interrupt [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Absolute Fullness[/c], and the Outro Skill effect still applies.

skills.name: Tune Break: Gauntlets
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Ebb and Flow
skills.description:
[c=Title]Lunar Cycle[/c]
Iuno can activate Lunar Cycle by casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Closing Refrain[/c] or [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation[/c].
Lunar Cycle has two states: [c=Highlight]Half Moon[/c] and [c=Highlight]New Moon[/c]. By default, Iuno enters the [c=Highlight]Half Moon[/c] state when activating Lunar Cycle and can switch between the two states by casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Flux[/c].
When in Lunar Cycle:
- Iuno's Jump is replaced with [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Flux[/c]. STA won't recover when Iuno is in mid-air. 
- Iuno's movement becomes [c=Highlight]Meandering[/c], which consumes STA continuously in mid-air to move in a unique manner.
- Performing environmental interactions, using Utilities, or holding Jump will end [c=Highlight]Lunar Cycle[/c].

[c=Title]Lunar Cycle - Half Moon[/c]
Iuno attacks using the Moonring, restoring [c=Highlight]Sentience[/c] on hit.
She can use [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonbow[/c] to deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG) and switch to [c=Highlight]Lunar Cycle - New Moon[/c].
[c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonbow[/c] can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Lunar Cycle - New Moon[/c]
Iuno attacks using the Moonbow. While in this state, casting [c=Highlight]Moonbow - Basic Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Arc Beyond the Edge[/c], or [c=Highlight]Moonbow - Dodge Counter[/c] consumes [c=Highlight]Sentience[/c] to increase the skill's DMG Multiplier, restore additional Concerto Energy, and heal nearby Resonators in the team.
Iuno can use [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring[/c] to deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG) and switch to [c=Highlight]Lunar Cycle - Half Moon[/c].
[c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring[/c] can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Absolute Fullness[/c]
When Iuno's Concerto Energy is full, her Heavy Attack is replaced with [c=Highlight]Absolute Fullness[/c].
Casting Absolute Fullness ends [c=Highlight]Lunar Cycle[/c], provides healing for nearby Resonators in the team, deals [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] to nearby targets (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG), and conjures a [c=Highlight]Full Moon[/c] domain at her location. This effect can be triggered once every 25s.
Can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Full Moon Domain[/c]
Resonators inside the domain periodically restore  HP and STA.
Gaining a Shield inside the domain grants 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Blessing of the Wan Light[/c]. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

[c=Title]Blessing of the Wan Light[/c]
The receiving Resonator gains 4% all DMG Amplification for 10s, stacking up to 10 times. Gaining new stacks resets the duration. This effect ends early if the receiving Resonator is switched off the field.

[c=Title]Sentience[/c]
Iuno can hold up to 100 points of [c=Highlight]Sentience[/c].
Casting Intro Skill restores 40 points of [c=Highlight]Sentience[/c].
Casting Resonance Liberation restores 60 points of [c=Highlight]Sentience[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Closing Refrain[/c] or [c=Highlight]Unfinished Refrain[/c] restores 25 points of [c=Highlight]Sentience[/c].
When Iuno is in [c=Highlight]Lunar Cycle[/c], Moonring - Basic Attack, Moonring - Dodge Counter, and Mid-air Attack restore [c=Highlight]Sentience[/c] on hit.

skills.description: Every time Iuno casts Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Dodge Counter, Resonance Skill, Resonance Liberation, or Intro Skill, she gains 1 Shield equal to 32% of her ATK for 15s. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.

skills.name: Derivation
skills.description: When Iuno casts Intro Skill or Resonance Liberation, she immediately gains 5 stacks of [c=Highlight]Blessing of the Wan Light[/c].

sequences.name: Wax or Wane, All Gild the Bough
sequences.description:
When Iuno is in [c=Highlight]Lunar Cycle[/c], her ATK is increased by 40%.
When Iuno is inside the [c=Highlight]Full Moon Domain[/c], she additionally restores 1 point of Resonance Energy per second.
[c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Arc Beyond the Edge[/c] and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Absolute Fullness[/c] become immune to interruption.

sequences.name: Day or Night, Let This Be Eternal
sequences.description: Resonators in the team with 10 stacks of [c=Highlight]Blessing of the Wan Light[/c] gain an additional 40% all DMG Amplification.

sequences.name: I Drink Deep of Their Forgetting
sequences.description:
When Iuno is in [c=Highlight]Lunar Cycle[/c], DMG dealt by [c=Highlight]Moonbow - Basic Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Arc Beyond the Edge[/c], and [c=Highlight]Moonbow - Dodge Counter[/c] is Amplified by 65%.
Within a certain period after performing [c=Highlight]Moonbow - Basic Attack[/c] or [c=Highlight] Moonbow - Dodge Counter[/c], casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Arc Beyond the Edge[/c] does not reset the cycle of [c=Highlight]Moonbow - Basic Attack[/c].

sequences.name: Rainy Season Dwell in My Eyes
sequences.description: Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Absolute Fullness[/c] grants a Shield equal to 160% of Iuno's ATK to all Resonators in the team for 30s, which cannot be passed on to the incoming Resonator.

sequences.name: A Thousand Futile Glimpses
sequences.description: Iuno gains 20% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus.

sequences.name: I Am the Constant in the Chaos
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Absolute Fullness[/c] is increased by 1600%. Upon casting this skill, Iuno re-enters [c=Highlight]Lunar Cycle - New Moon[/c], gains 100 points of [c=Highlight]Sentience[/c], and resets all the cooldown of [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Arc Beyond the Edge[/c].

skills.name: Inkwash
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c]. Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain period of time after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash[/c] Stage 4.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] right after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c], considered as [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c].
Moments after a [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c], Qiuyuan becomes immune to the next instance of DMG he takes and casts [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] upon being attacked, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].

skills.name: Through the Groves
skills.description:
Press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to dash forward for a distance, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c], considered as Echo Skill DMG. If [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] is cast upon being attacked by an enemy target, Qiuyuan becomes immune to this instance of DMG and stagnates nearby enemies, while gaining immunity to interruption during this [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c].
Switching to other Resonators removes the Stagnation effect from enemies.

[c=Title]Undaunted Wayfarer[/c]
Hold [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to dash forward for a distance at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] to the target, considered as Echo Skill DMG.
If there are no targets nearby, Qiuyuan will leap up and dash through the air by continuously consuming STA until it runs out. Release [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to immediately end the dash and land. If there are targets nearby when Qiuyuan lands, deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] to nearby targets, considered as Echo Skill DMG. This skill can be cast in mid-air.

skills.name: Sundering Strike
skills.description:
Deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] to targets within range, considered as Echo Skill DMG.
For every 1% of Qiuyuan's Crit. Rate over 50%, this skill increases the Crit. DMG of all nearby active Resonators in the team by 2% for 30s, up to 30%.

skills.name: Attack the Must-Defend
skills.description:
Attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c], considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
Within a certain period of time after casting this skill, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to perform Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash[/c] Stage 3.

skills.name: Strike Before Ready
skills.description:
Attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] equal to 100% of Qiuyuan's ATK, considered as Echo Skill DMG.
Grant 50% Echo Skill DMG Amplification to the incoming Resonator, lasting for 14s or until the Resonator is switched out.

skills.name: Tune Break: Sword
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Verdant Edge
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack - Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash[/c]
When Qiuyuan reaches 200 points of Swordster's Soliloquy, his [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] is replaced with Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash[/c], which chains together up to 4 consecutive strikes, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c], considered as Heavy Attack DMG.

[c=Title]Bamboo's Shade[/c]
When Qiuyuan reaches 400 points of Swordster's Soliloquy, he gains the [c=Highlight]Bamboo's Shade[/c] effect, granting all nearby active Resonators in the team 30% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for 30s.

[c=Title]Inksplash of Mind[/c]
When Swordster's Soliloquy is full, Qiuyuan enters the [c=Highlight]Inksplash of Mind[/c] state for 8s, during which [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] is replaced with Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save[/c].
In this state, hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to consume Swordster's Soliloquy to perform Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach[/c], [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save[/c], and [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice[/c] in order, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c], considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
- Performing [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach[/c], [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save[/c], or [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice[/c] is considered as performing [c=Highlight]Echo Skill[/c].
- Inksplash of Mind ends when Swordster's Soliloquy is used up.

[c=Title]Swordster's Soliloquy[/c]
Qiuyuan can hold up to 600 points of Swordster's Soliloquy.
- 100 points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] Stage 3.
- 100 points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing each stage of Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash[/c].
- 100 points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c].
- 400 points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c].
- Swordster's Soliloquy cannot be obtained in the Inksplash of Mind state.
- Swordster's Soliloquy is cleared when the Inksplash of Mind state ends.

skills.name: Quietude Within
skills.description:
Qiuyuan obtains [c=Highlight]Quietude Within[/c] for 10s upon entering the Inksplash of Mind state. This effect can be triggered once every 22s.
Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach[/c], [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save[/c], and [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice[/c] deal 50% more DMG. [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice[/c] additionally restores 30 points of Concerto Energy on hit.
- This effect ends early when Qiuyuan is switched off the field.

skills.name: Drink Away Woes Age-Old
skills.description:
When casting Echo Skill, Qiuyuan's bamboo flask absorbs the overflowing energy and brews it into [c=Highlight]Flowing Panacea[/c].
The next time Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained, the [c=Highlight]Flowing Panacea[/c] is consumed to gain 10% ATK increase for 20s.

sequences.name: Sword Sheathed, Mind Unclouded
sequences.description:
[c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach[/c], [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save[/c], and [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice[/c] can no longer be interrupted.
Qiuyuan gains 20% Crit. Rate increase.

sequences.name: O Blade, I, Who Teach No More
sequences.description: Bamboo's Shade now grants an additional 30% Echo Skill DMG Amplification to all nearby Resonators in the team.

sequences.name: O Blade, I, Who Save No More
sequences.description:
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Sundering Strike[/c] is increased by 500%.
If Concerto Energy is full when not in the Inksplash of Mind state, Qiuyuan's [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] is replaced with Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Straw Cape in Drizzly Rain[/c], available once every 20s.
Upon casting [c=Highlight]Straw Cape in Drizzly Rain[/c], the [c=Highlight]Quietude Within[/c] effect immediately ends and 60 Concerto Energy is consumed to deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] equal to 500% of Qiuyuan's ATK, considered Echo Skill DMG, and restore 400 points of Swordster's Soliloquy. The next [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash[/c] Stage 3. 
Upon casting [c=Highlight]Straw Cape in Drizzly Rain[/c], Qiuyuan cannot gain the [c=Highlight]Quietude Within[/c] effect the next time he enters Inksplash of Mind. [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach[/c], [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save[/c], and [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice[/c] gain 600% DMG Multiplier increase and additionally restore 30 points of Concerto Energy on hit.
When not in Co-op mode, upon casting [c=Highlight]Straw Cape in Drizzly Rain[/c], the next [c=Highlight]Outro Skill[/c] is replaced with Outro Skill [c=Highlight]Sheath Fallen, New Shoots Revealed[/c], which deals [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] equal to 500% of Qiuyuan's ATK, considered Echo Skill DMG.

sequences.name: O Blade, I, Who Sacrifice No More
sequences.description: ATK is increased by 20%.

sequences.name: O Blade, I, Who Await to be Wielded
sequences.description: Qiuyuan now ignores 15% of the target's DEF when dealing damage.

sequences.name: Thus I Heard, Thus I Saw, Thus I Spoke
sequences.description:
Casting Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice[/c] stagnates nearby targets for 5s or until the targets are damaged or until Qiuyuan is switched off the field. This effect is not available in the Co-op Mode.
When Qiuyuan is the active Resonator in the team, upon exiting Inksplash of Mind, he deals [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] equal to 600% of his ATK to all targets within range, considered Echo Skill DMG.
Casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Straw Cape in Drizzly Rain[/c] increases Qiuyuan's Crit. DMG by 100% for 6s. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect early.

skills.name: One, Two, Three
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
Enter the [c=Highlight]Decipher[/c] state for 5s after casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 4[/c]. This effect ends early if Sigrika is switched off the field.
When Sigrika has at least 50 points of [c=Highlight]Full Stop[/c], her Basic Attack cycle starts from Stage 2.

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Elucidated[/c]
While in the [c=Highlight]Decipher[/c] state, press Normal Attack on the ground to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Elucidated[/c], dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Leave the [c=Highlight]Decipher[/c] state upon casting this skill.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
[c=Highlight]Press Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
[c=Highlight]Press Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting Plunging Attack to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
[c=Highlight]Press Normal Attack[/c] shortly after a successful Dodge on the ground to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
[c=Highlight]Press Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 4[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Decipher[/c]
While in the [c=Highlight]Decipher[/c] state, [c=Highlight]press Normal Attack[/c] shortly after a successful Dodge on the ground to cast [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Decipher[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Leave the [c=Highlight]Decipher[/c] state upon casting this skill.

[c=Title]Mid-air Dodge Counter[/c]
[c=Highlight]Press Normal Attack[/c] shortly after a successful Dodge in mid-air to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
[c=Highlight]Press Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Mid-air Dodge Counter[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].

skills.name: Royan Close Quarters Combat
skills.description:
[c=Title]BOOMY BOOM![/c]
Attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
[c=Highlight]Press Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]BOOMY BOOM![/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]BIG BOOMY BOOM![/c]
While in the [c=Highlight]Decipher[/c] state, [c=Highlight]press Resonance Skill[/c] on the ground to cast [c=Highlight]BIG BOOMY BOOM![/c], dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Leave the [c=Highlight]Decipher[/c] state upon casting this skill.

[c=Title]Soliskin to the Aid[/c]
While in the [c=Highlight]Decipher[/c] state, with at least 50 points of [c=Highlight]Full Stop[/c], [c=Highlight]press Resonance Skill[/c] on the ground to cast [c=Highlight]Soliskin to the Aid[/c], dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Leave the [c=Highlight]Decipher[/c] state upon casting this skill.

skills.name: Where Trust Leads Me!
skills.description:
Deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] (considered Echo Skill DMG). Gain [c=Highlight]Divergent[/c] for 20s.

[c=Title]Divergent[/c]
The next time Sigrika obtains a [c=Highlight]Rune[/c], she additionally obtains a [c=Highlight]Rune[/c] of the opposite type and removes [c=Highlight]Divergent[/c].
When Sigrika holds [c=Highlight]Divergent[/c] and [c=Highlight]Convergent[/c] at the same time, [c=Highlight]Convergent[/c] takes priority.
When Sigrika holds 100 points of [c=Highlight]Full Stop[/c], [c=Highlight]Divergent[/c] doesn't take effect.

skills.name: Solsworn Etymology
skills.description:
Deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
[c=Highlight]Press Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].

skills.name: In This Very Moment
skills.description:
Attack the target, deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] equal to 795% of Sigrika's ATK. Gain 2 stacks of [c=Highlight]Encapsulated[/c] for 30s.

[c=Title]Encapsulated[/c]
When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skills, Stagnate the target and consume 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Encapsulated[/c]. [c=Highlight]Encapsulated[/c] stacks up to 2 times.
All stacks of [c=Highlight]Encapsulated[/c] are removed when Sigrika is removed from the lineup.

skills.name: Tune Break: Gauntlets
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Within Infinity's Embrace
skills.description:
[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes[/c]
[c=Highlight]Hold Normal Attack[/c] to consume two [c=Highlight]Runes[/c] and cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes[/c], dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c]. Based on the types of the [c=Highlight]Runes[/c] consumed, Sigrika gains the following effects:
- When consuming [c=Highlight]Rune: Trust[/c] and [c=Highlight]Rune: Answer[/c], this skill gains the effect of [c=Highlight]Runic Outburst[/c].
- When consuming two [c=Highlight]Runes: Trust[/c], this skill gains the effect of [c=Highlight]Runic Chain Whip[/c].
- When consuming two [c=Highlight]Runes: Answer[/c], this skill gains the effect of [c=Highlight]Runic Soliskin[/c].
When consuming [c=Highlight]Runes[/c], if Sigrika holds at least 30 points of [c=Highlight]Soliskin Vitality[/c], consume 30 points to increase the DMG Multipliers of the current [c=Highlight]Runic Outburst[/c], [c=Highlight]Runic Chain Whip[/c], and [c=Highlight]Runic Soliskin[/c] by 50%. Obtain a stack of [c=Highlight]Innate Gift?[/c].
When consuming [c=Highlight]Runes[/c], if [c=Highlight]Soliskin Vitality[/c] is lower than 30 points, consume all [c=Highlight]Soliskin Vitality[/c]. Every 10 points of [c=Highlight]Soliskin Vitality[/c] consumed grants the current [c=Highlight]Runic Outburst[/c], [c=Highlight]Runic Chain Whip[/c], and [c=Highlight]Runic Soliskin[/c] 15% DMG Amplification.
[c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes[/c] deals Echo Skill DMG.

[c=Title]Runic Outburst[/c]
Deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] (considered Echo Skill DMG).

[c=Title]Runic Chain Whip[/c]
Stagnate nearby targets and deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] (considered Echo Skill DMG).

[c=Title]Runic Soliskin[/c]
Pull in nearby targets and deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] (considered Echo Skill DMG).

[c=Title]Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name[/c]
When [c=Highlight]Full Stop[/c] reaches 100 points, if [c=Highlight]Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name[/c] is not on Cooldown, press Resonance Skill to cast [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - BOOMY BOOM![/c] or [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid[/c]. [c=Highlight]Hold Resonance Skill[/c] to consume all [c=Highlight]Full Stop[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name[/c], dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] (considered Echo Skill DMG).

[c=Title]Innate Gift?[/c]
Sigrika can hold up to 2 stacks of [c=Highlight]Innate Gift?[/c]. Each stack grants [c=Highlight]Runic Outburst[/c], [c=Highlight]Runic Chain Whip[/c], [c=Highlight]Runic Soliskin[/c] and [c=Highlight]Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name[/c] 30% DMG Amplification.
This effect ends after Sigrika casts [c=Highlight]Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name[/c] or is switched off the field.

[c=Title]Rune[/c]
Sigrika holds up to [c=Highlight]4 Runes[/c]. Without [c=Highlight]Full Stop[/c], Sigrika can only hold up to [c=Highlight]2 Runes[/c]. When Sigrika gains a new [c=Highlight]Rune[/c] at max capacity, the existing [c=Highlight]Runes[/c] shift one slot to the left, removing the leftmost [c=Highlight]Rune[/c]. With at least 50 points of [c=Highlight]Full Stop[/c], Sigrika can hold 2 additional Runes.
Hitting a target directly with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Elucidated[/c] or [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Decipher[/c] in the duration of the moves grants one [c=Highlight]Rune: Trust[/c].
Hitting a target directly with [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM![/c] or [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid[/c] in the duration of the moves grants one [c=Highlight]Rune: Answer[/c].

[c=Title]Full Stop[/c]
After casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes[/c], gain 50 points of [c=Highlight]Full Stop[/c], up to 100 points.

[c=Title]Soliskin Vitality[/c]
When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Sigrika gains 10 points of [c=Highlight]Soliskin Vitality[/c], up to 60 points. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once. Casting [c=Highlight]Outro Skill - In This Very Moment[/c] resets the record of Echo triggering this effect.

skills.name: True Names Invoked
skills.description:
Casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Solsworn Etymology[/c] grants [c=Highlight]Convergent[/c] for 20s.

[c=Title]Convergent[/c]
The next time Sigrika obtains a [c=Highlight]Rune[/c], she additionally obtains a [c=Highlight]Rune[/c] of the same type and removes [c=Highlight]Convergent[/c].
When Sigrika holds [c=Highlight]Divergent[/c] and [c=Highlight]Convergent[/c] at the same time, [c=Highlight]Convergent[/c] takes priority.
When Sigrika holds 100 points of [c=Highlight]Full Stop[/c], [c=Highlight]Convergent[/c] doesn't take effect.

skills.name: True Names Aligned
skills.description:
When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Sigrika gains a stack of [c=Highlight]Blessing of Runes[/c], up to 6 stacks. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once. 
This effect resets upon a lineup change.

[c=Title]Blessing of Runes[/c]
Each stack of [c=Highlight]Blessing of Runes[/c] grants the active Resonator in the team 3% Aero DMG Bonus and 3% Echo Skill DMG Bonus.
When [c=Highlight]Blessing of Runes[/c] reaches 6 stacks, Sigrika additionally gains 30% Aero DMG Bonus and Echo Skill DMG Bonus.

For every 1% of Sigrika's Energy Regen over 125%, Sigrika gains 2% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for up to 50%.

sequences.name: The Gleam Meant for Radiance
sequences.description:
The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Elucidated[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Decipher[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM![/c], and [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid[/c] are increased by 70%.
Sigrika becomes immune to interruptions while casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Elucidated[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM![/c], and [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid[/c].
[c=Highlight]Encapsulated[/c] now stacks up to 3 times. After casting Outro Skill [c=Highlight]In This Very Moment[/c], Sigrika obtains 1 additional stacks.

sequences.name: The Bitterness Steeped in Hope
sequences.description:
The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name[/c] is increased by 120%. 
When not in combat for over 4s, Sigrika gains [c=Highlight]Divergent[/c]. This effect is active for up to 1 times every 4s.

sequences.name: I Flee, Yet I Seek
sequences.description:
[c=Highlight]Innate Gift?[/c] now stacks up to 4 times and is no longer removed after Sigrika casts [c=Highlight]Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name[/c] or is switched off the field.
When not in combat, all [c=Highlight]Innate Gift?[/c] stacks are removed every 30s.

sequences.name: I Lose, Yet I Gain
sequences.description: When a Resonator in the team casts Echo Skill, all Resonators in the team gain an 20% ATK increase for 20s.

sequences.name: Until Submerged by the Dark
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Where Trust Leads Me![/c] is increased by 30%.

sequences.name: True Names Resurfaced, Rising in Light
sequences.description:
Targets take 30% more DMG from Sigrika.
[c=Highlight]Innate Gift?[/c] gains following effects:
- Each stack additionally grants [c=Highlight]Runic Outburst[/c], [c=Highlight]Runic Chain Whip[/c], [c=Highlight]Runic Soliskin[/c], and [c=Highlight]Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name[/c] 15% DMG Amplification, up to 60%.
- Each stack causes [c=Highlight]Runic Outburst[/c], [c=Highlight]Runic Chain Whip[/c], [c=Highlight]Runic Soliskin[/c], and [c=Highlight]Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name[/c] to ignore 7.5% of the target's DEF when dealing damage, up to 30%.

skills.name: Strings to Steel
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack - Stringblade[/c]
Press repeatedly or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 1[/c] and [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4[/c] are in [c=Highlight]Sheathed Stance[/c].
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 2[/c] and [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3[/c] are in [c=Highlight]Drawn Stance[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Stringblade[/c]
When [c=Highlight]Qin Heart[/c] and [c=Highlight]Sword Cadence[/c] are full, [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stringblade[/c] becomes available.
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to consume STA and cast this skill, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
Casting this skill consumes all [c=Highlight]Qin Heart[/c] and [c=Highlight]Sword Cadence[/c] and sends Qingxiao into the [c=Highlight]Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] state.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Stringblade[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] consecutively or hold it down to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
This skill is in [c=Highlight]Drawn Stance[/c].
After landing from [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3[/c], press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3[/c].
While in mid-air, [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Plunging Attack[/c]
While in the [c=Highlight]Sword Flight[/c] state, [c=Highlight]Jump[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Plunging Attack[/c].
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
While out of the [c=Highlight]Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] state, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Stringblade[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
This skill is in [c=Highlight]Drawn Stance[/c].
Press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4[/c].

[c=Title]Sword Glide[/c]
While in mid-air, [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Sword Glide[/c].

skills.name: Severing Note
skills.description:
[c=Title]Severing Note: Judgement[/c]
Deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c]. During this skill, gain 45 points of [c=Highlight]Qin Heart[/c].
While not in the [c=Highlight]Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] state, press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4[/c].

[c=Title]Severing Note: Ascendant[/c]
While casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 2[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3[/c], or [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Stringblade[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Severing Note: Ascendant[/c].
Deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
This skill is in [c=Highlight]Drawn Stance[/c].

skills.name: Billows Beneath Heaven
skills.description:
Deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

skills.name: Tonality Shift
skills.description:
Deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c]. Casting the skill restores 30 points of [c=Highlight]Sword Cadence[/c] and grants [c=Highlight]Resonant Chime[/c].

[c=Title]Resonant Chime[/c]
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Severing Note: Judgement[/c] grants 30 points of [c=Highlight]Qin Heart[/c] and removes [c=Highlight]Resonant Chime[/c].

skills.name: Lingering Song
skills.description: Deal [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c] equal to 800% of Qingxiao's ATK.

skills.name: Draw and Sunder
skills.description:
Qingxiao inflicts [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Shifting[/c] on the target after dealing damage with skills. Each skill can only trigger this once for the same target.
Qingxiao can respond to [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c].
Responding to [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c]: For each stack of [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] on the target, every point of Qingxiao's Tune Break Boost increases the total DMG Qingxiao deals to that target by 0.12%. While Qingxiao is in the team, the max stack limit of [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] on a target is increased by 1.
Additionally, when the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, Qingxiao can cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on it. While on the ground and not in the [c=Highlight]Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] state, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time after casting [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3[/c].

skills.name: Formless Heart Sword
skills.description:
[c=Title]Ephemeral Transcendence[/c]
While Qingxiao is in the [c=Highlight]Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] state, [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] and [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] become available.

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c]
Press repeatedly or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
Before [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] becomes available, this skill's DMG Multiplier is increased by 100%.
Can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c]
Press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
Before [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] becomes available, this skill's DMG Multiplier is increased by 100%.
Can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c]
When [c=Highlight]Heart Sword Intent[/c] is full, [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] becomes available. Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to cast the skill, dealing [c=Wind]Aero DMG[/c].
Casting this skill consumes all [c=Highlight]Heart Sword Intent[/c] and ends the [c=Highlight]Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] state.

[c=Title]Mindlock[/c]
[c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] stacks up to 15 times.
Each time a Resonator in the team inflicts [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] on a target, inflict 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] on the target.
For each stack of [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] on the target, DMG taken from Qingxiao's following skills is Amplified by 2%, with an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 stacks.
- [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stringblade[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven[/c].

[c=Title]Heaven's Clarity[/c]
Upon entering combat or casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Billows Beneath Heaven[/c], gain [c=Highlight]Heaven's Clarity[/c].
When [c=Highlight]Sheathed Stance[/c]/[c=Highlight]Drawn Stance[/c] skills deal damage, the rates at which [c=Highlight]Qin Heart[/c]/[c=Highlight]Sword Cadence[/c] are obtained increase by 100%.
When casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stringblade[/c], inflict 3 stacks of [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] on nearby targets, and enhance the next [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c]: its DMG Multiplier is increased by 100% and it builds additional Off-Tune Level on the target. Switching to another Resonator ends the [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] enhancement.
Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] removes [c=Highlight]Heaven's Clarity[/c].

[c=Title]Swordlight Ward[/c]
Casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Tonality Shift[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stringblade[/c] grants 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Swordlight Ward[/c].
[c=Highlight]Swordlight Ward[/c] stacks up to 1 times. When taking DMG from an enemy's attack, 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Swordlight Ward[/c] can be consumed to grant immunity to interruption and reduce DMG taken by 60% for 1s. This effect can be triggered once per second.

[c=Title]Sword Flight[/c]
While in the [c=Highlight]Sword Flight[/c] state, Qingxiao moves with a special animation.
Moving in [c=Highlight]Sword Flight[/c] continuously consumes [c=Highlight]Flight Qi[/c].
- Casting the following skills sends Qingxiao into the [c=Highlight]Sword Flight[/c] state:
[c=Highlight]Sword Glide[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stringblade[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 1[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 2[/c], [c=Highlight]Severing Note: Ascendant[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c], and [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Tonality Shift[/c].
- Exit the [c=Highlight]Sword Flight[/c] state by:
1. Casting [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3[/c] or [c=Highlight]Plunging Attack[/c].
2. Triggering certain environmental interactions or Utilities.
3. Returning to the ground.
4. Switching to another Resonator.
5. Depleting all [c=Highlight]Flight Qi[/c].

[c=Title]Sword Step[/c]
While in the [c=Highlight]Sword Flight[/c] state, hold [c=Highlight]Jump[/c] to leap up and dash forward a short distance.
[c=Highlight]Sword Step[/c] can only be cast once during [c=Highlight]Sword Flight[/c].

[c=Title]Qin Heart[/c]
Can hold up to 100 points.
Dealing damage with [c=Highlight]Sheathed Stance[/c] skills grants [c=Highlight]Qin Heart[/c].
[c=Highlight]Qin Heart[/c] cannot be gained while in the [c=Highlight]Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] state.

[c=Title]Sword Cadence[/c]
Can hold up to 100 points.
Dealing damage with [c=Highlight]Drawn Stance[/c] skills grants [c=Highlight]Sword Cadence[/c].
[c=Highlight]Sword Cadence[/c] cannot be gained while in the [c=Highlight]Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] state.

[c=Title]Heart Sword Intent[/c]
Can hold up to 100 points.
Dealing damage with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] or [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c] grants [c=Highlight]Heart Sword Intent[/c].

skills.name: Sea of Thought, World of Dust
skills.description:
Upon entering combat, gain 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c].

After damage dealt directly by Resonators in the team defeats a target inflicted with the [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] effect:
If Qingxiao does not have the [c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c] effect, gain [c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c] with stacks equal to the target's [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] stacks.
If Qingxiao already has [c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c] and the target's [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] stacks are no fewer than Qingxiao's [c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c] stacks, Qingxiao's [c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c] stacks will be matched to the target's [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] stacks.

[c=Title]Gathered Mind[/c]
After Resonators in the team deal damage to a target, inflict [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] equal to Qingxiao's [c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c] stacks. This effect can only trigger 1 times on the same target.
When Resonators in the team cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c], if the target has [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Shifting[/c], additionally inflict 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] on the target. This effect can only trigger 1 times on the same target.
When Qingxiao is knocked out, she can no longer gain [c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c], and any existing [c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c] effect becomes inactive.
[c=Highlight]Gathered Mind[/c] stacks up to 15 times and lasts for 30s.

skills.name: To Know, To Banish
skills.description:
Qingxiao's following skills deal 2% more DMG per stack of [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] on the target, with an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 stacks.
- [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stringblade[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven[/c].

Each time after a Resonator in the team inflicts [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] on an Overlord Class or Calamity Class target, additionally inflict 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Mindlock[/c] on the target.

sequences.name: Like Clouds That Meet and Drift Apart
sequences.description:

The max stack limit of [c=Highlight]Swordlight Ward[/c] is increased to 2. Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Stringblade[/c] additionally grants 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Swordlight Ward[/c].
