[c=Title]Laser[/c]
Casting Outro Skill consumes all Sparks obtained in the current mode.
Laser can be cast when the amount of consumed Sparks is greater than or equal to 25, dealing [c=Thunder]Electro DMG[/c].  The DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG. 
Every 25 Sparks consumed generates 1 extra Laser beam, up to 4 Laser beams.

[c=Title]Yellow Light Spark[/c]
Lumi can hold up to 100 Yellow Light Sparks.
Lumi obtains Yellow Light Spark under the following conditions: 
When [c=Highlight]Yellow Light: Basic Attack[/c] hits the target;
When [c=Highlight]Glitter[/c] hits the target;
When [c=Highlight]Glare[/c] hits the target;
When Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Energized Rebound[/c] hits the target;
When casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Special Delivery[/c].

[c=Title]Red Light Spark[/c]
Lumi can hold up to 100 Red Light Sparks.
Lumi obtains Red Light Spark under the following conditions:
When Normal Attack [c=Highlight]Navigation Support[/c] hits the target in [c=Highlight]Red Light Mode[/c] or [c=Highlight]Red Spotlight Mode[/c].

skills.name: Pathfinding
skills.description: Gain 10% Electro DMG Bonus when in Red Light Mode.

skills.name: Expediting
skills.description: Casting [c=Highlight]Energized Pounce[/c] or [c=Highlight]Energized Rebound[/c] increases ATK by 10% for 5s.

sequences.name: Parcel To Be Delivered
sequences.description: After casting [c=Highlight]Energized Rebound[/c], additionally recovers 60 STA within 3s.

sequences.name: Lollo Logistics, Ready to Help
sequences.description: [c=Highlight]Energized Pounce[/c] and [c=Highlight]Energized Rebound[/c] ignore 20% of the target's DEF.

sequences.name: Priority Parcel In Transit
sequences.description: The DMG of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Squeakie Express[/c] is increased by 30%.

sequences.name: Captain Lumi, At Your Service
sequences.description: Gain 30% Basic Attack DMG Bonus.

sequences.name: Parcel Collected On Time
sequences.description: When Spark is fully recovered, [c=Highlight]Laser[/c] DMG Multiplier is increased by 100%.

sequences.name: Give Me A Five-star Rating
sequences.description: Casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Squeakie Express[/c] increases all team members' ATK by 20% for 20s.

skills.name: Origin Calculus
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. Each hit generates 1 [c=Highlight]Collapsed Core[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Hold the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack Button[/c] to enter [c=Highlight]Unbound Form[/c], which consumes STA continuously. While in this form, Shorekeeper will:
- Generate a segment of [c=Highlight]Deductive Data[/c] every second;
- Automatically collect nearby plant collectibles.
Using up all STA or actions such as casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] will end the [c=Highlight]Unbound Form[/c] and deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] to the target. Each accumulated segment of [c=Highlight]Deductive Data[/c] will convert into a segment of Empirical Data and generate a [c=Highlight]Collapsed Core[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack. Each hit generates 1 [c=Highlight]Collapsed Core[/c]. Quickly Press the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack Button[/c] after the Plunging Attack to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Press the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack Button[/c] after a successful Dodge to attack a target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].

skills.name: Chaos Theory
skills.description:
Restore HP for all nearby party members and summon 5 [c=Highlight]Dim Star Butterflies[/c], which automatically track and attack a target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. Follow up with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] in time to start the Basic Attack cycle from [c=Highlight]Stage 2[/c].
Can be performed in mid-air.

skills.name: End Loop
skills.description:
[c=Title]Outer Stellarealm[/c]
Generate the [c=Highlight]Outer Stellarealm[/c] to restore HP for all party members within its effective range continuously. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.
 
[c=Title]Inner Stellarealm[/c]
When a party member uses [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c] within the [c=Highlight]Outer Stellarealm[/c], it evolves into the [c=Highlight]Inner Stellarealm[/c]. Within the effective range of the [c=Highlight]Inner Stellarealm[/c], for every 0.2% of Shorekeeper's Energy Regen, all party members gain a 0.01% increase of Crit. Rate, up to 12.5%. 
[c=Highlight]Inner Stellarealm[/c] has all the effects of the [c=Highlight]Outer Stellarealm[/c].
 
[c=Title]Supernal Stellarealm[/c]
When a party member uses [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c] within the [c=Highlight]Inner Stellarealm[/c], it evolves into the [c=Highlight]Supernal Stellarealm[/c]. Within the effective range of the [c=Highlight]Supernal Stellarealm[/c], for every 0.1% of Shorekeeper's Energy Regen, all party members gain a 0.01% increase of Crit. DMG, up to 25%. 
[c=Highlight]Supernal Stellarealm[/c] has all the effects of the [c=Highlight]Inner Stellarealm[/c].

skills.name: Life Entwined
skills.description: When a Resonator other than Shorekeeper takes a fatal blow, they will not be knocked out and will instead be healed for 50% of Shorekeeper's HP while Shorekeeper loses the same amount of HP. Shorekeeper's HP will not go below 1 from this effect. This effect can be triggered once every 10 minutes.

skills.name: Tune Break: Rectifier
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Self Gravitation
skills.description: When the on-field Resonator is within range of a [c=Highlight]Stellarealm[/c], Shorekeeper's Energy Regen is increased by 10%, and Rover's Energy Regen is also increased by 10% if Rover is on the team.

skills.name: Proof of Existence
skills.description:
[c=Title]Enlightenment[/c]
Shorekeeper appears to restore HP for all nearby party members and summon 5 [c=Highlight]Dim Star Butterflies[/c], which automatically track and attack a target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. This is considered Resonance Skill DMG.
 
[c=Title]Discernment[/c]
When a [c=Highlight]Supernal Stellarealm[/c] is generated, Shorekeeper's first Intro Skill triggered in its duration will be replaced with Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Discernment[/c].  Casting Discernment ends the current Stellarealm, restores HP for all nearby party members, and deals [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] to the targets. This attack is guaranteed to be a Critical Hit dealing Resonance Liberation DMG. The Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Discernment[/c] can only be triggered once each time a [c=Highlight]Supernal Stellarealm[/c] is generated.

skills.name: Binary Butterfly
skills.description:
Shorekeeper summons 1 [c=Highlight]Flare Star Butterfly[/c] and 1 [c=Highlight]Dim Star Butterfly[/c] to circle the Resonator on the field for up to 30s, granting the following effects:  
- If the Resonator on the field is hit or launched, tapping the [c=Highlight]Dodge Button[/c] allows the Resonator to immediately recover from the interruption, triggering a successful Dodge. The Resonator launched in the air can land on the ground standing if they are close to the ground. This effect can be triggered up to 5 time(s).
- All nearby party members' DMG is Amplified by 15%.

skills.name: Astral Chord
skills.description:
[c=Title]Flare Star Butterfly[/c]
Hitting a target with a Normal Attack generates a [c=Highlight]Collapsed Core[/c], which transforms into a [c=Highlight]Flare Star Butterfly[/c] after 6s. [c=Highlight]Flare Star Butterflies[/c] automatically track and attack a target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. If there are already 5 [c=Highlight]Collapsed Cores[/c], Shorekeeper's next [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] hit will instantly convert a [c=Highlight]Collapsed Core[/c] into a [c=Highlight]Flare Star Butterfly[/c].
 
[c=Title]Illation[/c]
When Shorekeeper has 5 segments of Empirical Data, casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] will consume all segments to pull in nearby targets, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. Meanwhile, all generated [c=Highlight]Collapsed Cores[/c] will instantly transform into [c=Highlight]Flare Star Butterflies[/c].
 
[c=Title]Transmutation[/c]
When Shorekeeper has 5 segments of Empirical Data, casting [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack[/c] will consume all segments to deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. Meanwhile, all generated [c=Highlight]Collapsed Cores[/c] will instantly transform into [c=Highlight]Flare Star Butterflies[/c]. Quickly press the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack Button[/c] afterward to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].
 
[c=Title]Empirical Data[/c]
Shorekeeper can hold up to 5 segments of Empirical Data.
- Obtain 1 segment of Empirical Data when [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 1, 2, or 4[/c] hits a target.
- Obtain 2 segments of Empirical Data when [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c] hits a target.
- Obtain 1 segment of Empirical Data when [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack[/c] hits a target.
- Obtain 1 segment of Empirical Data when [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] hits a target.

sequences.name: Unspoken Conjecture
sequences.description:
The [c=Highlight]Stellarealms[/c] generated by Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]End Loop[/c] gain the following enhancements:
- The effective range of the healing and buffs is extended by 150%
- The duration is extended by 10s.
- Casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Discernment[/c] no longer ends the existing [c=Highlight]Stellarealm[/c].

sequences.name: Night's Gift and Refusal
sequences.description: The [c=Highlight]Outer Stellarealm[/c] now increases the ATK of all nearby party members by 40%.

sequences.name: Infinity Awaits Me
sequences.description: Casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]End Loop[/c] grants Shorekeeper 20 Concerto Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 25s.

sequences.name: Overflowing Quietude
sequences.description: Gain 70% additional Healing Bonus when casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Chaos Theory[/c].

sequences.name: Echoes in Silence
sequences.description: Extend the ranges of the pulling effect of [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c] by 50% and [c=Highlight]Illation[/c] by 30%.

sequences.name: To the New World
sequences.description: Increase the DMG Multiplier of Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Discernment[/c] by 42%. Casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Discernment[/c] increases Shorekeeper's Crit. DMG by 500%.

skills.name: O Come Divine Light
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks of Holy Light, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to ride the staff and dive down from mid-air to attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Heavy Attack[/c]
Consume STA to ride on the staff for a distance.
- Can be re-cast after a Mid-Air Dodge or using Grapple.
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
After a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c], quickly use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
- When Phoebe is inside the Ring of Mirrors, Dodge Counter becomes [c=Highlight]Chamuel's Star: Dodge Counter[/c].

skills.name: To Where Light Shines
skills.description:
Summon a Ring of Mirrors at the target location, making the target hit stagnate for 2s and dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. The stagnation effect can be applied to 12 targets max for each Ring of Mirrors. Using [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] again shortly after the summoning teleports Phoebe to the Ring of Mirrors' location, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
Unable to teleport if Phoebe is too far from the Ring of Mirrors.
 
[c=Title]Ring of Mirrors[/c]
- Ring of Mirrors lasts for 30s. When Phoebe summons a new Ring of Mirrors, the existing Ring of Mirrors disappears.
- When Phoebe is outside of the Ring of Mirrors, a [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] or [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] that hits the Ring of Mirrors will refract Holy Light, which deals [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] to targets inside the [c=Highlight]Ring of Mirrors[/c] and pulls the targets hit to the center of the ring. The DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG. Can be triggered once every 0.5s.
- When Phoebe is inside the Ring of Mirrors, [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] becomes Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Chamuel's Star[/c], which performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c], considered Basic Attack DMG.

rows.label: Ring of Mirrors: Refracted Holy Light DMG

skills.name: Dawn of Enlightenment
skills.description:
Phoebe concentrates the light in her hands into the Mirror of Enlightenment and smashes it, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
- [c=Highlight]Absolution[/c] Enhancement: Increase DMG Multiplier by 255%.
- [c=Highlight]Confession[/c] Enhancement: Apply 8 stacks of [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle[/c] to targets hit.

skills.name: Golden Grace
skills.description: Knock back nearby targets and deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].

skills.name: Attentive Heart
skills.description:
Deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] equal to 528.41% of Phoebe's ATK to nearby targets.
- [c=Highlight]Absolution[/c] Enhancement: Increase DMG Multiplier by 255%.
- [c=Highlight]Confession[/c] Enhancement: Grant [c=Highlight]Silent Prayer[/c] to the Resonator on the field, reducing the Spectro RES of nearby targets by 10% and granting 100% [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle[/c] DMG Amplification. When [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle[/c] inflicts DMG, extend [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle's[/c] damage interval by 50%. This effect lasts 30s or until Phoebe switches to [c=Highlight]Absolution[/c] status.

skills.name: Tune Break: Rectifier
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Radiant Invocation
skills.description:
When Phoebe's Prayer is full, consume all Prayer to cast one of the following skills:
- Hold [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] to cast Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Absolution Litany[/c], dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] and applying 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle[/c] to the targets hit. Phoebe enters [c=Highlight]Absolution[/c] status, which allows her to deal more damage.
- Hold [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to cast Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Utter Confession[/c], dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] and applying 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle[/c] to the targets hit. Phoebe enters [c=Highlight]Confession[/c] status, which allows her to better exploit Spectro Frazzle.
- [c=Highlight]Absolution[/c] and [c=Highlight]Confession[/c] cannot coexist. Entering into one will end the other.
- When Divine Voice is not exhausted, Phoebe is unable to cast Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Absolution Litany[/c] and Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Utter Confession[/c].
- When Divine Voice is exhausted, Phoebe will not exit the [c=Highlight]Absolution[/c] or [c=Highlight]Confession[/c] status.
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack: Starflash[/c]
When Phoebe has Divine Voice, casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c] or [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] replaces the next [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] with [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack: Starflash[/c], which deals [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] at the cost of 30 Divine Voice.
- [c=Highlight]Absolution[/c] Enhancement: Reduce the cost of Divine Voice by 15. When the targets hit have [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle[/c], the skill gains 256% DMG Amplification.
- [c=Highlight]Confession[/c] Enhancement: Apply 5 stacks of [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle[/c] to the targets hit.
 
[c=Title]Prayer [/c]
Phoebe can hold up to 120 Prayer.
Phoebe automatically gains 5 Prayer every second.
 
[c=Title]Divine Voice[/c]
Phoebe can hold up to 60 Divine Voice.
Casting Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Absolution Litany[/c] or Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Utter Confession[/c] restores 60 Divine Voice.

skills.name: Presence
skills.description: Mid-air Heavy Attack can be cast 1 more times.

skills.name: Revelation
skills.description: When in the [c=Highlight]Absolution[/c] status and [c=Highlight]Confession[/c] status, Spectro DMG Bonus is increased by 12%.

sequences.name: Warm Light and Bedside Wishes
sequences.description:
When in [c=Highlight]Absolution[/c], Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Dawn of Enlightenment[/c] now increases DMG Multiplier by 480% instead of 255%. 
When in [c=Highlight]Confession[/c], Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Dawn of Enlightenment [/c] increases DMG Multiplier by 90% and applies [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle[/c] to the targets with the maximum stack the targets can receive.

sequences.name: A Boat Adrift in Tears
sequences.description:
When in [c=Highlight]Absolution[/c], DMG dealt by Outro Skills to targets with [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle[/c] is Amplified by 120%.
When in [c=Highlight]Confession[/c], [c=Highlight]Silent Prayer[/c] grants 120% more DMG Amplification for [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle[/c].

sequences.name: Daisy Wreaths and Dreams
sequences.description:
When in [c=Highlight]Absolution[/c], the DMG Multiplier of Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Starflash[/c] is increased by 91%.
When in [c=Highlight]Confession[/c], the DMG Multiplier of Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Starflash[/c] is increased by 249%.

sequences.name: Ringing Bells on Wings Aloft
sequences.description: When [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c], Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Chamuel's Star[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c], or [c=Highlight]Chamuel's Star: Dodge Counter[/c] hits, the target's Spectro RES is reduced by 10% for 30s.

sequences.name: Prayer to the Distant Light
sequences.description: Casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Golden Grace[/c] increases Phoebe's Spectro DMG Bonus by 12% for 15s.

sequences.name: Whispering Chirps in Silence
sequences.description:
Targets entering the Ring of Mirrors are stagnated for an additional 2s. The stagnation effect affects all targets entering the Ring of Mirrors and can be applied to 12 targets max for each Ring of Mirrors. Each target will only be affected by this effect once.
When in [c=Highlight]Absolution[/c] or [c=Highlight]Confession[/c], summoning a Ring of Mirrors with [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] increases Phoebe's ATK by 10% for 20s, and triggers an extra Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Starflash[/c] at the Ring of Mirrors' location. This Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Starflash[/c] does not consume Divine Voice and is not considered as casting a [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c].

skills.name: Routine Negotiation
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks to deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
After performing [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] at the right time to perform Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Breakthrough[/c], which can be followed by [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 4[/c] by pressing Normal Attack again.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform a plunging attack, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. Then press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] at the right time to cast Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Breakthrough[/c].

skills.name: Restless Watch
skills.description:
[c=Title]Standard Defense Protocol[/c]
Attack the target to deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] and enter a block stance. This state ends early if Zani is switched off the field. Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c], recovering 10 points of Redundant Energy and Stagnating the target on hit.
When attacked by an enemy while in block stance, reduce this instance of damage by 100% and Stagnate nearby targets, then cast [c=Highlight]Pinpoint Strike[/c], dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] and further reducing their Vibration Strength by  5%. DMG taken by Zani is reduced by 30% within the next 2s.

[c=Title]Crisis Response Protocol[/c]
When Zani is not in [c=Highlight]Inferno Mode[/c] and has full Redundant Energy, her [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] is replaced with Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Crisis Response Protocol[/c].
Hold [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to enter [c=Highlight]Ready Stance[/c]. While in [c=Highlight]Ready Stance[/c], Zani is immune to interruption. This state ends early if Zani is switched off the field. After releasing [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] button or when the stance duration ends, consume all Redundant Energy to cast [c=Highlight]Targeted Action[/c], dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c], which is also considered [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle DMG[/c].
When attacked by an enemy in while in [c=Highlight]Ready Stance[/c], reduce this instance of damage by 100% and consume all Redundant Energy to cast [c=Highlight]Forcible Riposte[/c], dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] (also considered [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle DMG[/c]), Stagnating the target, and further reducing their Vibration Strength by 5%. DMG taken by Zani is reduced by 30% within the next 2s.
Casting [c=Highlight]Targeted Action[/c] or [c=Highlight]Forcible Riposte[/c] sends Zani into [c=Highlight]Sunburst[/c] mode and inflicts a stack of Heliacal Ember upon the target on hit. The last stage of the attack recovers Blaze.

[c=Title]Sunburst[/c]
The [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle[/c] DMG dealt by Zani to the target is Amplified by 20%.

skills.name: Between Dawn and Dusk
skills.description:
[c=Title]Rekindle[/c]
Deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] and enter [c=Highlight]Inferno Mode[/c], increasing Max Blaze from 100 to 150 and granting 50 Blazes. When in [c=Highlight]Inferno Mode[/c], the DMG Multiplier of Basic Attack is increased.

[c=Title]The Last Stand[/c]
When in [c=Highlight]Inferno Mode[/c], Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]The Last Stand[/c] becomes available when Blaze is lower than 30 or after 8s in [c=Highlight]Inferno Mode[/c].
Casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]The Last Stand[/c] deals [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] and ends the [c=Highlight]Inferno Mode[/c].

skills.name: Immediate Execution
skills.description: Attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].

skills.name: Beacon For the Future
skills.description: Attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] equal to 150% of Zani's ATK and removing all stacks of Heliacal Ember inflicted upon the target. Each stack increases the DMG dealt by 10%. This DMG is considered [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle[/c] DMG. The Spectro DMG dealt by other Resonators in the team to the target marked by [c=Highlight]Heliacal Ember[/c] is Amplified by 20% for 20s.

skills.name: Tune Break: Gauntlets
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: There Will Be A Light
skills.description:
[c=Title]Heliacal Ember[/c]
When Zani is in the team and a nearby Resonator inflicts [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle[/c] upon a target, immediately trigger the DMG of all Spectro Frazzle stacks and convert Spectro Frazzle into an equal number of Heliacal Embers. Every time the conversion happens, Zani obtains Blaze based on the stacks of Heliacal Ember inflicted. Heliacal Ember is capped at 60 stacks, with each stack lasting for 6s. Heliacal Ember stacks are counted toward the Spectro Frazzle stacks for the Eternal Radiance Sonata Effect.

[c=Title]Scorching Light[/c]
When Zani is in [c=Highlight]Inferno Mode[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Daybreak[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Dawning[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Nightfall[/c], and [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Lightsmash[/c] become available, which deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] that is considered both Heavy Attack DMG and [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle[/c] DMG.
When Blaze is no less than 30, Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Standard Defense Protocol[/c] is replaced with Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Scorching Light[/c].
Hold [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to enter [c=Highlight]Ready Stance[/c], during which Zani is immune to interruption. This state ends early when Zani is switched off the field. While in [c=Highlight]Ready Stance[/c], release [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] button within a certain time to consume Blaze and perform [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Daybreak[/c].
When attacked in a certain time after entering [c=Highlight]Ready Stance[/c], reduce this instance of damage by 100% and Stagnate nearby targets, then perform [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Lightsmash[/c], consuming Blazes and further reducing their Vibration Strength by 10%. Zani's DMG taken within the next 2s is reduced by 30%.
After casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Lightsmash[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Nightfall[/c], consuming up to 40 Blazes on hit, with each Blaze increasing the DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Nightfall[/c]. If [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Nightfall Stage 1[/c] is interrupted, press [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] again to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Nightfall Stage 2[/c].
Upon releasing the button after a certain time or when [c=Highlight]Ready Stance[/c] ends, immediately perform [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Nightfall[/c].
When Blaze is no less than 30, [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Daybreak[/c]. After entering [c=Highlight]Inferno Mode[/c], casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] immediately replaces the current [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] with Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Scorching Light[/c]. Hold [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] to enter [c=Highlight]Ready Stance[/c].
After performing [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Daybreak[/c], press [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] immediately to perform [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Dawning[/c] at the cost of Blaze.
After performing [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Dawning[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Nightfall[/c].
If [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] is not replaced with [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Nightfall[/c] after a successful Dodge and Zani has no less than 30 Blazes, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time to perform [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Lightsmash[/c] at the cost of Blazes.

[c=Title]Redundant Energy[/c]
Zani can hold up to 100 Redundant Energy.
Obtain Redundant Energy when Normal Attacks hit a target.
Obtain Redundant Energy when casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Immediate Execution[/c].
Obtain Redundant Energy when casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Standard Defense Protocol[/c].
Obtain Redundant Energy when casting  [c=Highlight]Pinpoint Strike[/c].
Cannot obtain Redundant Energy while in [c=Highlight]Inferno Mode[/c].

[c=Title]Blaze[/c]
Blaze is capped at 100 when not in [c=Highlight]Inferno Mode[/c].
Blaze is capped at 150 in [c=Highlight]Inferno Mode[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Targeted Action[/c] or [c=Highlight]Forcible Riposte[/c] grants 10 Blazes.
Every stack of Heliacal Ember converted from [c=Highlight]Spectro Frazzle[/c] grants 5 Blazes.
Casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Rekindle[/c] grants 50 Blazes.

skills.name: Quick Response
skills.description: Casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Immediate Execution[/c] gives 12% Spectro DMG Bonus for 14s.

skills.name: Fear No Pain
skills.description: When in [c=Highlight]Ready Stance[/c], all DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

sequences.name: When the Alarm Clock Rings
sequences.description:
Casting [c=Highlight]Targeted Action[/c] or [c=Highlight]Forcible Riposte[/c] gives a 50% Spectro DMG Bonus for 14s.
Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Nightfall[/c] can't be interrupted.

sequences.name: Stale Bread With Energy Drink
sequences.description:
Crit. Rate is increased by 20%.
The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Targeted Action[/c] and [c=Highlight]Forcible Riposte[/c] is increased by 80%.

sequences.name: Each Day A New Commute
sequences.description: When in [c=Highlight]Inferno Mode[/c], every 1 Blazes consumed increases the last stage DMG Multiplier of the subsequent Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]The Last Stand[/c] by 8%, maxed at 1200%.

sequences.name: More Efficiency, Less Drama
sequences.description: When Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Immediate Execution[/c] is cast, the ATK of all Resonators in the team is increased by 20% for 30s.

sequences.name: Delivered In Full On Time
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Rekindle[/c] is increased by 120%.

sequences.name: First Things First? Clock Out!
sequences.description:
The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Daybreak[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash- Dawning[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Nightfall[/c], and [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Lightsmash[/c] are increased by 40%. Every Blaze consumed increases the DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Heavy Slash - Nightfall[/c] by 40% on hit.
Gain following effects when in [c=Highlight]Inferno Mode[/c]: 
- When Blaze is lower than 70, restore 70 Blazes immediately. This effect is triggered once in [c=Highlight]Inferno Mode[/c].
- Within 8s after entering [c=Highlight]Inferno Mode[/c], Zani will remain standing with at least 1 HP if hit by a fatal blow.

skills.name: Reign of Silence
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Rending Lunge[/c]. 

[c=Title]Rending Lunge[/c]
Deal [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill on the ground to cast [c=Highlight]Death Snip[/c].
Use [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill in mid-air to cast [c=Highlight]Hanging Finality[/c].

[c=Title]Death Snip[/c]
Open the scissors, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. After a while, the scissors snip, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] and restoring HP for all nearby Resonators in the team.
Use [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] during this skill to deal additional [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. Use [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] again to immediately snip the target.
The skill DMG is considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Death Snip[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Thread Withdrawn[/c].

[c=Title]Thread Withdrawn[/c]
Deal [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. 
Can trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after being cast.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Leap into the air and consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
This skill cannot be cast while in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c].
Perform the following actions within a certain time after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Hanging Finality[/c]:
- Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c];
- Cast [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Glide[/c] and press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] before landing.
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] before landing after casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Severed Facet[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. 
While not in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time after casting Mid-air Attack to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Severed Facet[/c]
Deal [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. 
Use [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time after casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Severed Facet[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Hanging Finality[/c].
If interrupted, [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Severed Facet[/c] can be cast again by holding [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] before landing. This effect can be triggered once only before landing.

[c=Title]Hanging Finality[/c]
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. 
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill on the ground to cast [c=Highlight]Death Snip[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] right after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Rending Lunge[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction[/c]
Hold [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] on the ground to cast [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction[/c] to attack and Stagnate the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
- While not in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], after casting this skill, Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] on the ground or use [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] in mid-air to cast [c=Highlight]Rending Lunge[/c]. This effect is removed when Chisa enters [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c].
- While in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3[/c].

skills.name: Fractured Composition
skills.description:
[c=Title]Eye of Unraveling[/c]
Stagnate and deal [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
- While not in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], after casting this skill, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] on the ground or use [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] in mid-air to cast [c=Highlight]Rending Lunge[/c]. This effect is removed when Chisa enters [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c].
- While in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c] and on the ground, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Serrated Loop[/c]
While on the ground and [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c] is full, [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Serrated Loop[/c].
Stagnate targets, and deal [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] and pull in nearby targets.
Casting this skill sends Chisa into [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c] and replaces [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] with [c=Highlight]Eye of Unraveling[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2[/c].
Hold [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] while casting this skill to continuously attack and pull in nearby targets. Release the [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] button in the duration or keep holding it for a certain period of time to cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 1[/c].

skills.name: Moment of Nihility
skills.description:
Deal [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] and recover HP for all nearby Resonators in the team. 
Casting this skill sends Chisa into [c=Highlight]Woven Myriad - Convergence[/c] for 15s.
While not in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

[c=Title]Woven Myriad - Convergence[/c]
The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c], [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c], and [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c] are increased by 120%.
The bonus DMG Multiplier for [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c] granted by [c=Highlight]Sawring- Blitz[/c] and [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] when [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c] is consumed additionally increases by 120%.
Casting [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c] ends [c=Highlight]Woven Myriad - Convergence[/c].

skills.name: Reverberance - Return
skills.description:
Attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
While not in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].
While in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], use [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2[/c].

skills.name: Unraveling - Law Zero
skills.description:
Grant [c=Highlight]Resonant Thread of Closure[/c] to all nearby Resonators in the team for 20s.
While in [c=Highlight]Resonant Thread of Closure[/c]:
- When an attack hits, increase the max stacks of [c=Highlight]Negative Status[/c] and [c=Highlight]Electro Rage[/c] the target can receive by 3 for 15s. Unstackable.
- Inflicting [c=Highlight]Negative Status[/c] or dealing [c=Highlight]Negative Status DMG[/c] grants [c=Highlight]Thread of Bane[/c] for 15s.

skills.name: Tune Break: Broadblade
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Sight of Unraveling - Oblivion
skills.description:
[c=Title]Unseen Snare[/c]
Chisa inflicts [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c] on the target for 30s in the following 4 ways:
- Hitting a target with [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c].
- Hitting a target within a certain period of time after casting [c=Highlight]Serrated Loop[/c].
- Hitting a target with [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction[/c].
- [c=Highlight]Locking[/c] on to a target.
When targets marked by [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c] take direct damage from Resonators, Chisa inflicts 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c] on them. This effect can be triggered up to once every 2s.

[c=Title]Thread of Bane[/c]
When dealing damage to targets affected by [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c], ignore 18% of their DEF.

[c=Title]Chainsaw Mode[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], Chisa unlocks [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c], [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c], [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c].
[c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c] and [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] consume [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c] on hit.

[c=Title]Sawring - Blitz[/c]
[c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c] chains up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].  
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to start the combo from [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 1[/c]. Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to start from [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2[/c].
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] while casting [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2[/c] to continuously attack the target. [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2[/c] is automatically followed by [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3[/c].
While casting [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2[/c], release the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] button or [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] without directional input to automatically cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. Shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance[/c], successful Dodges can be triggered.
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3[/c].
While casting [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3[/c], hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to continuously attack the target. [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3[/c] is automatically followed by [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c].
Release [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] during [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3[/c] to automatically cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
[c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c] DMG is considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] following a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] following [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3[/c].
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] while casting [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] to sustain the attack. When [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] ends, cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3[/c] automatically.
Release the [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] button or [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] without directional input while casting [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance[/c] automatically.
[c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] deals [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Sawring - Eradication[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], Chisa casts [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c] in the following 2 ways:
- Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] after casting [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone[/c].
- Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] after consuming all [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c] with [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c] or [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c].
Attacking targets with [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c] deals [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] and grants Shields to all nearby Resonators in the team for 30s.
The skill DMG is considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation DMG[/c].
Every 1 point of [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c] consumed by [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c] and [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] increases the DMG Multiplier of the next [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c]. Up to 100 points will be counted toward this effect.
Casting this skill consumes all [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c] and ends [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c].

[c=Title]Chainsaw Fever[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Jetstream[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Fever[/c].
[c=Highlight]Chainsaw Fever[/c] is at 100% by default.
When Chisa goes on for a period without dealing any damage, [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Fever[/c] will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa enters the [c=Highlight]Burnout State[/c] and exits [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c].
While in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c], Chisa resets [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Fever[/c] when dealing damage or when casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Moment of Nihility[/c], Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Reverberance - Return[/c] and [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone[/c].
While in the [c=Highlight]Burnout State[/c], [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c] will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa exits the [c=Highlight]Burnout State[/c].
When in [c=Highlight]Burnout State[/c], Chisa exits the state upon dealing damage, or casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Moment of Nihility[/c] and Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Reverberance - Return[/c].

[c=Title]Lifethread - Glide[/c]
When Chisa is not in [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c] and has more than 10 points of [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Jetstream[/c], she can consume 50 points of [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Jetstream[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Glide[/c] in the following 5 ways:
- Press [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] in mid-air before landing after casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c].
- While in mid-air, press [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] before landing after casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Eye of Unraveling[/c] or [c=Highlight]Rending Lunge[/c].
- [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] forward shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Thread Withdrawn[/c].
- Press [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] before landing when launched into mid-air.
- Press [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] before landing after casting [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Glide[/c].
Casting this skill can pull in nearby enemies marked by [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c].
During the skill, hold [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to glide a short distance on the weapon.
Can trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after casting this skill.

[c=Title]Ring of Chainsaw[/c]
Chisa can hold up to 100 points of [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c].
Hitting a target with [c=Highlight]Normal Attack [/c] and Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Eye of Unraveling[/c] grants [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c].
Casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Moment of Nihility[/c] grants 40 points of [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c].
Casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Reverberance - Return[/c] grants 20 points of [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c].

[c=Title]Lifethread - Jetstream[/c]
Chisa can hold up to 100 points of [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Jetstream[/c]. 
Chisa continuously obtains [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Jetstream[/c] over time.
Chisa obtains 100 points of [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Jetstream[/c] upon defeating a target. 
Exiting [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode[/c] resets [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Jetstream[/c] to the max limit.
Chisa cannot obtain [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Jetstream[/c] passively for a short period of time after casting  [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Glide[/c].

rows.label: Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter Hold DMG
Bonus DMG Multiplier per Ring of Chainsaw

skills.name: Inescapable Fate
skills.description: When a Resonator in the team defeats a target marked by [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c], the Cooldown of Chisa's Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Eye of Unraveling[/c] is reset, triggered up to once every 3s.

skills.name: All Ends Here
skills.description:
Casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Reverberance - Return[/c] or Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Moment of Nihility[/c] grants 20% Havoc DMG Bonus and 20% Healing Bonus for 12s.
When Resonators in the team with [c=Highlight]Thread of Bane[/c] defeat a target marked by [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c], Chisa gains Sight of Unraveling, lasting 3s.
While in Sight of Unraveling, Chisa inflicts [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c] that lasts for 30s on the targets damaged by Resonators in the team with [c=Highlight]Thread of Bane[/c].

sequences.name: Wandering Through the Desolate Corridors
sequences.description:
Chisa is immune to interruption during [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c],  [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c], and [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c]

Inflicting [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c] grants the following additional effects:
- Chisa's ATK is increased by 30% for 15s.
- Deal fixed 61803 points of [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. The target's HP can be reduced to 61.80% at most and each target can take this damage only once. This instance of damage is considered Basic Attack DMG that does not bear any effect from damage bonuses.

sequences.name: Into the Web of Endless Bonds
sequences.description:
Ignore 10% of the target's Havoc RES when dealing damage.
Nearby Resonators in the team with [c=Highlight]Thread of Bane[/c] gain 50% All-Attribute DMG Bonus.

sequences.name: Across the Confusion of the Long Night
sequences.description:
The DMG Multipliers of [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c], [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] and [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c] are increased by 120%. This effect is mutually stackable with that of [c=Highlight]Woven Myriad - Convergence[/c].
The bonus DMG Multiplier for [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c] granted by [c=Highlight]Sawring- Blitz[/c] and [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] when [c=Highlight]Ring of Chainsaw[/c] is consumed is increased by 120%. This effect is mutually stackable with that of [c=Highlight]Woven Myriad - Convergence[/c].
The Vibration Strength Reduction Rate of [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c], [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c] and [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c] is increased by 50%.

sequences.name: Severing the Endless Cycle of Tragic Fate
sequences.description:
The effect of [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c] becomes:
When targets marked by [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c] take direct damage from Resonators, Chisa inflicts 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c] on them. This effect is triggered up to once every 1s.

sequences.name: Thousands of Lights to Guide the Way Home
sequences.description:
Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Moment of Nihility[/c] gains 100% DMG Bonus.
[c=Highlight]Lifethread - Glide[/c] costs 50% less [c=Highlight]Lifethread - Jetstream[/c].

sequences.name: Thus, Hope is Rekindled with the Rising Dawn
sequences.description:
When Chisa takes a fatal blow during [c=Highlight]Sawring - Blitz[/c], [c=Highlight]Sawring - Eradication[/c], and [c=Highlight]Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter[/c], she will remain standing with at least 1 HP.

[c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c] becomes [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare - Finality[/c], which has the following effects:
- [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare - Finality[/c] has all the effects of [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare[/c].
- Targets affected by [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare - Finality[/c] takes 30% Amplified DMG from Negative Statuses.
- Targets affected by [c=Highlight]Unseen Snare - Finality[/c] takes 40% increased DMG from Chisa.

skills.name: Chroma Drift
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Press or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Spark Collision[/c]
With full [c=Highlight]Overflow[/c] in the [c=Highlight]Optical Sampling Stage[/c], hold Normal Attack to enter a charging state.
During this state, 15 points of [c=Highlight]Overflow[/c] will be converted to 12.5% of [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c] every 0.2s. Lynae is immune to interruption and takes 50% less DMG.
Upon releasing Normal Attack or when [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c] is full, Lynae casts Spark Collision of varying strengths based on the ratio of [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c], dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]:
- Spark Collision Lv. 1: [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c] <50%
- Spark Collision Lv. 2: 50% ≤ [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c] < 100%
- Spark Collision Lv. 3: [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c]=100%

[c=Title]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack[/c].
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
With 120 points of [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c], [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 1 & 4[/c] track enemies in a greater distance.

[c=Title]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Ground Heavy Attack[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c], hold Normal Attack on the ground to cast this skill. Consume STA to continuously attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c], considered Basic Attack DMG. Release to cast [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Graffiti Blast[/c], dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c], considered Basic Attack DMG.

[c=Title]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c], hold Normal Attack in mid-air to cast this skill. Consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c], considered Basic Attack DMG.
Cannot gain new charges while in the air. The available charges reset when Lynae is the active Resonator and is on the ground.

[c=Title]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Attack[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Attack[/c].
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter[/c].
Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
While in [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c], press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].

skills.name: Lynae-Style Palettes
skills.description:
[c=Title]Lynae-Style Palettes[/c]
Press Resonance Skill to deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. 
While in [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c], hold Resonance Skill to attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] and exiting the [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c]. 
Press Normal Attack within a certain time after this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].
Lynae-Style Palettes and Additive Color [c=Highlight]share a cooldown[/c].

[c=Title]Additive Color[/c]
During [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c], press Resonance Skill on the ground to attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
Within a certain time during the skill, press Normal Attack to cast [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].
Lynae-Style Palettes and Additive Color [c=Highlight]share a cooldown[/c].

skills.name: Prismatic Overblast
skills.description:
Deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. Casting this skill increases the DMG dealt by all nearby Resonators in the team by 24% for 30s.

[c=Title]Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow![/c]
Press Normal Attack within a certain time after casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Prismatic Overblast[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow![/c], dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
While in [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c], press Normal Attack within a certain time during the skill to cast [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].

rows.label: Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow! DMG

skills.name: Time to Show Some Colors!
skills.description:
Deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c], inflicting [c=Highlight]Photochromic Flux[/c] on targets hit.
While in [c=Highlight]Optical Sampling Stage[/c], casting this skill recovers 100 points of [c=Highlight]Overflow[/c].

rows.label: Time to Show Some Colors! DMG

skills.name: Let's Hit the Road!
skills.description:
Attack the target and deal 100% [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. The next incoming Resonator gain 15% All DMG Amplification and 25% Resonance Liberation DMG Amplification for 14s or until they are switched out.
Lynae leaves the [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c] state upon casting Outro Skill.

skills.name: Spectral Analysis
skills.description:
Lynae can inflict [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture - Shifting[/c] or [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Shifting[/c] on targets.
Lynae can respond to [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture - Interfered[/c] and [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c].
- Responding to [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture - Interfered[/c]: When any Resonator in the team deals [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] DMG and inflicts the [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture - Interfered[/c] state, Lynae casts [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture Response - Spectral Analysis[/c]. Each target can be damaged by this skill up to once every 8s.
- Responding to [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c]: For each stack of [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] on the target, each point of Lynae's Tune Break Boost increases her total DMG against that target by 0.12%. When Lynae is in the team, the target's max stack limit of [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] is increased by 1.
When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, Lynae can cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Chromaticity Modeling
skills.description:
[c=Title]Optical Sampling Stage[/c]
Lynae is in [c=Highlight]Optical Sampling Stage[/c] by default. While in this state, [c=Highlight]Overflow[/c] recovers during certain skills.

[c=Title]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c]
Casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Spark Collision[/c] sends Lynae into [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c]. In this state, Lynae continuously recovers [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c] while moving on the ground or during certain periods of certain skills. Lynae will not Walk during this state, and her Running and Sprinting will be replaced by the faster [c=Highlight]Free Skating[/c] and [c=Highlight]Speed Skating[/c].

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c], with at least 1/3 of the max [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c], Jump is replaced by [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap[/c].
Consume 1/3 of the max [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c] to deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. Inflict [c=Highlight]Photochromic Flux[/c] on targets hit. Successful Dodges can be triggered within a certain time during this skill. While airborne, [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap[/c] chains up to 3 stages. Switching to another Resonator resets the combo.
While in combat, each stage of [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap[/c] cast recovers 1 point of [c=Highlight]True Color[/c].
Within a certain time after [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Stage 1[/c] press Normal Attack on the ground to cast [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Stage 2[/c] also pulls in nearby targets.

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash[/c]
During [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c], when Lynae is in mid-air with 3 points of [c=Highlight]True Color[/c], and [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Visual Impact[/c] is on cooldown, press Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] and inflict [c=Highlight]Photochromic Flux[/c] on targets hit.
This skill consumes 3 points of [c=Highlight]True Color[/c].
Press Normal Attack within a certain time during this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Visual Impact[/c]
During [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c], when Lynae is in mid-air with 3 points of [c=Highlight]True Color[/c], and this skill is not on cooldown, press Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] and inflict [c=Highlight]Photochromic Flux[/c] on targets hit.
This skill consumes 3 points of [c=Highlight]True Color[/c] and grants all nearby Resonators in the team 40 points of Tune Break Boost for 30s.
Press Normal Attack within a certain time during this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2[/c]. 

[c=Title]Resonance Mode[/c]
Inflict [c=Highlight]Photochromic Flux[/c] when hitting a target with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Visual Impact[/c] and [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Time to Show Some Colors![/c].
Lynae can switch between [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture[/c] and [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Strain[/c]:
- When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture[/c], [c=Highlight]Photochromic Flux[/c] inflicts [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture - Shifting[/c] on targets for 25s.
- When in [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode - Tune Strain[/c], [c=Highlight]Photochromic Flux[/c] inflicts [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Shifting[/c] on targets for 25s.

[c=Title]Tune Rupture Response - Spectral Analysis[/c]
Deal an instance of [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c], considered Tune Rupture DMG, to targets within range affected by [c=Highlight]Tune Rupture - Interfered[/c].

[c=Title]Overflow[/c]
Lynae can hold up to 120 points of Overflow.
While in [c=Highlight]Optical Sampling Stage[/c], [c=Highlight]Overflow[/c] recovers during Basic Attack, Lynae-Style Palettes, Mid-air Attack, and Dodge Counter, or when Intro Skill is cast.
When [c=Highlight]Overflow[/c] is full, [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Spark Collision[/c] becomes available.
Casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Spark Collision[/c] removes all [c=Highlight]Overflow[/c].

[c=Title]Lumiflow[/c]
Lynae can hold up to 120 points of Lumiflow.
During [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c]:
- Restore 20% of [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c] per second when Lynae is moving on the ground/climbing, or performs a successful Dodge on the ground, or within a certain time during [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Ground Heavy Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter[/c], [c=Highlight]Additive Color[/c], ground Dodge, Intro Skill, or [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow![/c].
- [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c] starts to deplete by 20% per second while Lynae is staying still on the ground/climbing/swimming or off the field, or after a certain time following the use of the skills listed above.
- [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c] does not change while Lynae is not in any of the states described above.
Exiting [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c] removes all [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c].
With 120 points of [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c], Lynae's roller skating speed further increases. [c=Highlight]Speed Skating[/c] consumes STA over time.

[c=Title]True Color[/c]
Lynae can hold up to 3 points of True Color.
During combat, each time [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap[/c] is cast, gain 1 point of [c=Highlight]True Color[/c]. With 3 points of [c=Highlight]True Color[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash[/c] and [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Visual Impact[/c] become available.
Exiting [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c] removes all [c=Highlight]True Color[/c].
