Roller Skating STA Cost Per Sec at Max Overflow

skills.name: Colors Never Fade!
skills.description:
After casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Visual Impact[/c], Lynae leaves [c=Highlight]Spray Paint[/c] on the ground and continuously inflicts [c=Highlight]Photochromic Flux[/c] on targets within the [c=Highlight]Spray Paint[/c] for 5s, triggered once every 2s. When [c=Highlight]Spray Paint[/c] is on the ground, switching to another [c=Highlight]Resonance Mode[/c] doesn't affect the [c=Highlight]Photochromic Flux[/c] effects inflicted by the [c=Highlight]Spray Paint[/c].

With Lynae in the team, the expedition motorbike's Energy Tank expands by 600 points. Lynae enters [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c] automatically while on the expedition motorbike and restores 20% of [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c] per second.

skills.name: "Adaptive Optics: Everyday Applications"
skills.description:
Casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Time to Show Some Colors![/c] increases Lynae's [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] Bonus by 25% for 9s. 

During [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c], if Lynae isn't in combat, dodging without directional input grants her [c=Highlight]Optic Camo[/c] for 15s, which will be removed when Lynae casts any skill other than dodging or is switched off the field. Performing environmental, gameplay or functional interactions, or entering combat, removes the [c=Highlight]Optic Camo[/c]. With [c=Highlight]Optic Camo[/c], Lynae may enter the enemy's aggro range without triggering combat.

sequences.name: Days to be Painted Like a Canvas
sequences.description:
The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap[/c] is increased by 120%.
The duration of [c=Highlight]Spray Paint[/c] is increased by 100%. Targets within the range of [c=Highlight]Spray Paint[/c] are [c=Highlight]pulled in[/c] towards the center every 6s.
Lynae is now immune to interruptions during [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap[/c] and [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Visual Impact[/c].
During [c=Highlight]Optical Sampling Stage[/c], after staying in a non-combat state for 2s, restore 120 points of [c=Highlight]Overflow[/c] every 2s.

sequences.name: Into Lights' Vanishing Point
sequences.description:
Gain 25% All DMG Amplification.
Outro Skill gains the following effect:
Casting Outro Skill now additionally grants the incoming Resonator 25% All DMG Amplification for 14s or until the Resonator is switched out.

sequences.name: For One Brilliant Moment
sequences.description:
The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Visual Impact[/c] and [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash[/c] is increased by 90%.
While Lynae is in combat, when [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c] is at least 120 points, gain 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Premixed Hue[/c] every 1s, up to 25 stacks. Each stack of [c=Highlight]Premixed Hue[/c] increases the Spectro DMG Bonus of [c=Highlight]Additive Color[/c] by 55%. No [c=Highlight]Premixed Hue[/c] is gained while casting [c=Highlight]Additive Color[/c]. When [c=Highlight]Additive Color[/c] ends, remove all stacks of [c=Highlight]Premixed Hue[/c]. Lynae loses a stack of [c=Highlight]Premixed Hue[/c] every 0.5s when [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c] is below 120 points.
While Lynae is out of combat, with at least 120 points of [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c], gain 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Premixed Hue[/c] every 0.5s; when [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c] is below 120 points, lose 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Premixed Hue[/c] every 1s.

sequences.name: Shadows of a Wind Racer
sequences.description: ATK is increased by 20%.

sequences.name: Visions of a Future Unbound
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Prismatic Overblast[/c] is increased by 70%.

sequences.name: Painted in My True Color
sequences.description:
Each time [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Graffiti Blast[/c] or [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack[/c] is cast, Lynae gains 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Color of Soul[/c], up to 3 stacks. Each stack of [c=Highlight]Color of Soul[/c] increases the DMG the target takes from [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash[/c] and [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Visual Impact[/c] by 30%. After casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash[/c] or [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Visual Impact[/c], all stacks of [c=Highlight]Color of Soul[/c] are removed.
Casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap[/c] resets the charges of [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack[/c].
Lynae is immune to interruptions, and DMG taken is reduced by 30% during [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack[/c].
Lynae now stays in [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c] after casting [c=Highlight]Outro Skill - Let's Hit the Road![/c].
The [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c] upper limit is increased from 120 to 360. At the max limit, Lynae's roller skating speed further increases.
If Intro Skill is cast during [c=Highlight]Kaleidoscopic Parade[/c], restore 120 points of [c=Highlight]Lumiflow[/c].

skills.name: Such is Light
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
Hurl out a whirling blade on Stage 3, which disappears when Luuk Herssen casts other skills that can deal damage or leaves the field.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Consume STA to jump into the air, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks in mid-air, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. Stage 4 is a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.
[c=Highlight]Press Normal Attack[/c] or [c=Highlight]Jump[/c] to perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] Stage 2 and 3 in mid-air.
Luuk Herssen attacks with [c=Highlight]Scythe: Dissection[/c] when the input is [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c].
Luuk Herssen attacks with [c=Highlight]Scythe: Resection[/c] when the input is [c=Highlight]Jump[/c]. He also inflicts [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Shifting[/c] on the target hit for 25s and reduces DMG taken by 15% for 1s.
As the active Resonator, while in mid-air, this skill's cycle will not be reset.
While in mid-air, [c=Highlight]hold Normal Attack[/c] to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.

[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
[c=Highlight]Press Normal Attack[/c] right after a successful Dodge on the ground to deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. [c=Highlight]Press Normal Attack[/c] right after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c].
[c=Highlight]Press Normal Attack[/c] right after a successful Dodge in mid-air to flash toward the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].

rows.label: Mid-air Attack Stage 2 Scythe: Dissection DMG
Mid-air Attack Stage 3 Scythe: Dissection DMG
Mid-air Attack Stage 2 Scythe: Resction DMG
Mid-air Attack Stage 3 Scythe: Resction DMG

skills.name: Reunion of All the Fallen
skills.description:
[c=Title]Golden Reflux[/c]
Flash toward the target and deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. Inflict [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Shifting[/c] on the target hit for 25s.
[c=Highlight]Golden Reflux[/c] has 2 charges.
Can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Aureole of Execution[/c]
Casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 4[/c] or [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack Stage 3[/c] replaces [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] with [c=Highlight]Aureole of Execution[/c], which deals Basic Attack DMG and inflicts [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Shifting[/c] on the target hit for 25s.
[c=Highlight]Aureole of Execution[/c] has 3 forms, including [c=Highlight]Aureole of Execution: Ring[/c], [c=Highlight]Aureole of Execution: Breach[/c], and [c=Highlight]Aureole of Execution: Glare[/c].
Casting any form of [c=Highlight]Aureole of Execution[/c] grants 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Endnotes on the Endgame[/c] and switches [c=Highlight]Aureole of Execution[/c] to the next form in sequence.
Switching to another Resonator resets the cycle of [c=Highlight]Aureole of Execution[/c] and [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] is reset to [c=Highlight]Golden Reflux[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air.

[c=Title]Aureole of Execution: Ring[/c]
Deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c], and reset the [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack[/c] cycle to Stage 1.
The next [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] triggers [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Golden Impale[/c].
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Golden Impale[/c] is no longer available if [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] is cast in mid-air or Luuk Herssen is switched out in the duration.

[c=Title]Aureole of Execution: Breach[/c]
Spin and dash forward, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] to enemies along the path and resetting the [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack[/c] cycle to Stage 1. Then, hurl out an [c=Highlight]Ichor Blade[/c].
The next [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] triggers [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Golden Impale[/c].
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Golden Impale[/c] is no longer available if [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] is cast in air or Luuk Herssen is switched out in the duration.

[c=Title]Aureole of Execution: Glare[/c]
Hurl out Solid-State Ichor, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] and forming an [c=Highlight]Ichor Deposit[/c] on the ground.

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Golden Impale[/c]
Flash toward the target and deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c], considered Basic Attack DMG.

[c=Title]Ichor Deposit[/c]
[c=Highlight]Ichor Deposit[/c] detonates automatically after 5s, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c], considered Basic Attack DMG.

[c=Title]Endnotes on the Endgame[/c]
Increase the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Rewritten in Winter's Margins[/c] by 25%, stacking up to 3 times. Casting [c=Highlight]Rewritten in Winter's Margins[/c] or switching to another Resonator removes all stacks.

skills.name: Rewritten in Winter's Margins
skills.description:
Deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c], considered Basic Attack DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air.

skills.name: Before Injection of Dawn
skills.description:
Deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. Hurl out an [c=Highlight]Ichor Blade[/c] and inflict [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Shifting[/c] on the target.
[c=Highlight]Press Normal Attack[/c] after this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack Stage 2 - Scythe: Dissection[/c] or [c=Highlight]Jump[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack Stage 2 - Scythe: Resection[/c].

skills.name: Bow to the Last Light
skills.description: Deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] equal to 500% of Luuk Herssen's ATK.

skills.name: Silent Debate of Light
skills.description:
Luuk Herssen can inflict [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Shifting[/c] on targets.
Luuk Herssen can respond to [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c].
When responding to [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c]: For each stack of [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] on the target, each point of Luuk Herssen's Tune Break Boost increases his total DMG against the target by 0.12%. While Luuk Herssen is in the team, the max stack limit of [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] on a target is increased by 1.
When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, Luuk Herssen can cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Spark from the Frost
skills.description:
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker[/c]
When the Solid-State Ichor of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Aureole of Execution: Glare[/c] is hurled out, [c=Highlight]press Normal Attack[/c] in mid-air to cast [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker[/c].
Slam down from the air to detonate the [c=Highlight]Ichor Deposit[/c], dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] (considered Basic Attack DMG) and recovering all STA.
[c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker[/c] is no longer available when Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Rewritten in Winter's Margins[/c] is cast or Luuk Herssen is switched off the field.

[c=Title]Aureate Judge[/c]
With full Ichor Flow, enter the [c=Highlight]Aureate Judge[/c] state. In this state, Luuk Herssen gains the following effects:
- Ichor Flow does not restore. The DMG Multipliers of all forms of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Aureole of Execution[/c] increase by 110%.
- Casting [c=Highlight]Aureole of Execution: Glare[/c] increases the DMG Multiplier of the next [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker[/c] and [c=Highlight]Ichor Deposit[/c] DMG by 110%.
- 100 points of Ichor Flow is consumed each time Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Aureole of Execution[/c] is cast.
- [c=Highlight]Aureate Judge[/c] ends when Ichor Flow depletes.

[c=Title]Golden Rule[/c]
When Luuk Herssen is in the team, all other Resonators in the team gain Golden Rule. When Resonators with Golden Rule cast Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator is Luuk Herssen, remove all Golden Rules on Resonators in the team and grant Luuk Herssen 200 points of Ichor Flow and 12 points of Concerto Energy. Resonators in the team gain Golden Rule again after 24s. This effect does not apply in Co-op Mode.

[c=Title]Dawnlit Keep[/c]
Luuk Herssen gains 1 stacks of Dawnlit Keep when he stays out of combat for over 4s or casts Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Before Injection of Dawn[/c].
Dawnlit Keep is capped at 1 stack. When taking damage from enemies, consume 1 stacks of Dawnlit Keep to reduce the DMG taken by 60% and gain immunity to interruptions for 1s. This effect can be triggered once per second.

[c=Title]Radiant Reave[/c]
When Luuk Herssen performs Dodge in mid-air, he briefly stays airborne and hurls out an [c=Highlight]Ichor Blade[/c].
Luuk Herssen consumes STA continuously while airborne.
If Luuk Herssen is launched into mid-air, [c=Highlight]press Dodge[/c] before landing to trigger this effect, up to 3 times. When he is on the ground or switched out for more than 3s, the trigger count is reset.

[c=Title]Ichor Blade[/c]
Deal fixed [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c], considered Basic Attack DMG that is not affected by any DMG Bonus.
Only one [c=Highlight]Ichor Blade[/c] can exist at a time. It cannot trigger [c=Highlight]Counterattack[/c].
[c=Highlight]Ichor Blade[/c] cannot be launched without a nearby target.
[c=Highlight]Ichor Blade[/c] disappears when Luuk Herssen casts other skills that deal damage or leaves the field.

[c=Title]Ichor Flow[/c]
Luuk Herssen holds up to 300 points of Ichor Flow.
Normal Attacks, Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Golden Reflux[/c], Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Aureole of Execution[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Golden Impale[/c], and [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker[/c] restore Ichor Flow on hit.
Casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Before Injection of Dawn[/c] restores 100 points of Ichor Flow.

skills.name: Pulses Under the Snow
skills.description:
When Resonators in the team directly damage and defeat targets, if the targets are affected by [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c]:
- If Luuk Herssen has no Perpetuating Daytime, gain stacks of Perpetuating Daytime equal to the stacks of [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c].
- If Luuk Herssen already has Perpetuating Daytime, and the target's stacks of [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] exceed the current stacks of Perpetuating Daytime, increase Perpetuating Daytime's stacks to match the target's [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] stacks.

[c=Title]Perpetuating Daytime[/c]
- When Resonators in the team casts [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c], if the target is affected by [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Shifting[/c],  Luuk Herssen loses all stacks of Perpetuating Daytime, then apply equal stacks of [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] on the target, up to the target's current [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] stack cap. Cooldown: 1s.
Luuk Herssen loses all stacks of Perpetuating Daytime and will not be able to obtain any new stacks when knocked out.
- Perpetuating Daytime stacks up to 2 times.

skills.name: Uncaused Diagnosis
skills.description:
When Luuk Herssen's skills directly damage targets affected by [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c], every 10 points of [c=Highlight]Tune Break Boost[/c] he has Amplifies this instance of damage by 5%, up to 30%.
After any nearby Resonator in the team inflicts [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Shifting[/c] on the enemies or deals [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] DMG, Luuk Herssen's ATK increases by 25% for 20s.

sequences.name: Gold Kindled in Ash
sequences.description:
Luuk Herssen gains 150% [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack[/c] DMG Bonus.
The max stack limit of Dawnlit Keep is increased by 1.
When in the [c=Highlight]Aureate Judge[/c] state, casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Aureole of Execution[/c] grants 1 stacks of Dawnlit Keep.

sequences.name: Avalanche Roaring in Eyes
sequences.description:
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Rewritten in Winter's Margins[/c] is increased by 60%. This DMG Multiplier increase effect is stackable with that of Endnotes on the Endgame.
Inherent Skill [c=Highlight]Uncaused Diagnosis[/c] is enhanced:
When Luuk Herssen deals damage to targets inflicted with [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c], every 10 points of Tune Break Boost he has now Amplify this instance of damage by 10%. This effect now increases the DMG Amplification up to 60% instead of 30%.

sequences.name: Spine Tempered by Golden Rain
sequences.description:
The DMG Multipliers of all forms of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Aureole of Execution[/c] are increased by 136% in the [c=Highlight]Aureate Judge[/c] state. Casting [c=Highlight]Aureole of Execution: Glare[/c] increases the DMG Multipliers of the next [c=Highlight]Mid-Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker[/c] and [c=Highlight]Ichor Deposit[/c] by 136%.
Inherent Skill [c=Highlight]Pulses Under the Snow[/c] is enhanced:
Perpetuating Daytime now stacks up to 4 times.

sequences.name: Pulse Thrumming Under Rime
sequences.description: After a Resonator in the team deals [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] DMG, all Resonators in the team deal 20% more DMG for 20s. This effect is unstackable.

sequences.name: Through the Stillness of Snowstorm
sequences.description:
Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Before Injection of Dawn[/c] and Outro Skill [c=Highlight]Bow to the Last Light[/c] gain 80% DMG Bonus.
Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Golden Reflux[/c] has its DMG Multiplier increased by 50% and Cooldown reduced by 2s, and gains 1 more charge.

sequences.name: Dawn Unfurling over Frostlands
sequences.description:
When nearby Resonators in the team deal [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] DMG, all forms of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Aureole of Execution[/c], [c=Highlight]Ichor Deposit[/c], and [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker[/c] deal 30% more DMG to the target for 25s.
Each stack of Endnotes on the Endgame additionally grants Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Rewritten in Winter's Margins[/c] 40% DMG Bonus, up to 120%.
When Luuk Herssen deals damage to targets inflicted with [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c], the stack count of [c=Highlight]Tune Strain - Interfered[/c] on the target is increased by 2. This effect ignores the max stack limit.

skills.name: Locked Thread
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] right after [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 1[/c] to continuously attack the targets, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. Hold this skill for a certain amount of time to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack Stage 1[/c].
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c] lands to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Consume STA to lash out against the enemies with Monowire, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] after [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack Stage 1[/c] lands to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack Stage 2[/c], dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack Stage 1[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 4[/c].
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after this skill lands to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Thread Shredding[/c]
When in [c=Highlight]Algorithm Compaction[/c], Lucy's [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Thread Shredding[/c].
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c], considered Heavy Attack DMG.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Single Threading[/c]
When in [c=Highlight]Algorithm Compaction[/c], Lucy's [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Single Threading[/c].
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill while airborne to cast [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill while on the ground to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Dual Threading[/c]
When in [c=Highlight]Algorithm Compaction[/c] and [c=Highlight]Root Access[/c] reaches 100 points, [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Single Threading[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Dual Threading[/c].
Consume STA and all [c=Highlight]Root Access[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
Press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill while airborne to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Multi-threading[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill while on the ground to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Multi-threading[/c]
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] and inflicting [c=Highlight]Hack - Shifting[/c] on the target. [c=Highlight]SQL[/c] can be consumed for a 270% increase in this attack's DMG Multiplier.
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction[/c]
When in [c=Highlight]Algorithm Compaction[/c], Mid-air Attack is replaced with [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction[/c].
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction[/c]
When in [c=Highlight]Algorithm Compaction[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 3[/c].

skills.name: Protocol Breach
skills.description:
[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Payload[/c]
Cast [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Payload[/c] to charge forward, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] and inflicting [c=Highlight]Hack - Shifting[/c]. Upon hitting the target, a follow-up attack is automatically triggered, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] and activating [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference[/c]. If no target is hit during the charge, reduce the skill CD by 70%. If the charge is interrupted or not successfully cast, the skill CD is not reduced.
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after the follow-up attack to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].
Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after follow-up attack lands to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference[/c]
Cast [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference[/c] to cut through the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] and briefly Stagnating the target, before granting [c=Highlight]Digital Handshake[/c]. 
[c=Highlight]Digital Handshake[/c]: When Lucy is not in [c=Highlight]Algorithm Compaction[/c] and is the active Resonator in the team, she gains [c=Highlight]TCP[/c] every second. This effect is removed when [c=Highlight]TCP[/c] reaches 100 points or when [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Netrunner[/c] or [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive[/c] is cast.
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Deadlock[/c]
When [c=Highlight]TCP[/c] reaches 100 points or Lucy is in [c=Highlight]Algorithm Compaction[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Payload[/c] and [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference[/c] are replaced with [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Deadlock[/c].
Cast [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Deadlock[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] and inflicting [c=Highlight]Hack - Shifting[/c], considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2[/c].
Reset the CD of [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Deadlock[/c] after casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Netrunner[/c] or [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive[/c].

rows.label: Resonance Skill - Payload Follow-Up Attack DMG
Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference Concerto Regen

skills.name: Netrunner
skills.description:
[c=Title]Resonance Liberation - Netrunner[/c]
Lucy deep dives into cyberspace and pulls up the Protocol Interface for 10s. While the Protocol Interface is active, choose up to 7 different [c=Highlight]Spoofing Program[/c] effects, each requiring different RAM costs. Lucy starts with 24 points of RAM.
While in the Protocol Interface, Lucy marks targets within a certain range in her view. Marked targets will be applied with all [c=Highlight]Spoofing Program[/c] effects selected afterwards. Adjust Lucy's view to mark more targets. When no target is in view, no [c=Highlight]Spoofing Program[/c] can be applied.
While in the Protocol Interface, when either the duration expires or when [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] is held down, [c=Highlight]Override[/c] is triggered, which deals [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] to all marked targets before closing the Protocol Interface, considered Heavy Attack DMG. When RAM runs out or is insufficient to activate any [c=Highlight]Spoofing Programs[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to trigger [c=Highlight]Override[/c] on all marked targets. 
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

[c=Highlight]Spoofing Program: Ping[/c]
Requires 2 RAM. Extends field of view. Lucy marks and deals [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] to all nearby targets within the effective range without having to adjust the view, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
[c=Highlight]Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction[/c]
Requires 4 RAM. Marked targets take 5% more DMG for 30s.
[c=Highlight]Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol[/c]
Requires 4 RAM. Marked targets' DEF is reduced by 5% for 30s.
[c=Highlight]Spoofing Program: Synapse Burnout[/c]
Requires 5 RAM. Deals [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] to all marked targets within a certain range, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
[c=Highlight]Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement[/c]
Requires 6 RAM. Deals Hack DMG to all marked targets and reduces their ATK by 5% for 30s.
[c=Highlight]Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch[/c]
Requires 5 RAM. Causes all marked targets' attacks to have a chance to be reduced by 100% within 30s.
[c=Highlight]Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis[/c]
Requires 6 RAM. Convert all marked targets to neutral units and reduce their Vibration Strength. Only effective against Common Class enemies.

[c=Title]Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive[/c]
When in [c=Highlight]Algorithm Compaction[/c], after [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Multi-threading[/c] is cast, [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Netrunner[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive[/c]. Lucy gains all effects of [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Netrunner[/c], and the DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Override[/c] is greatly increased.
After casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive[/c], or when Lucy exits the [c=Highlight]Algorithm Compaction[/c] state, [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Netrunner[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

rows.label: Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive: Override DMG

skills.name: Outdated Hallucination
skills.description:
Attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] and granting Resonators in the team [c=Highlight]Involuntary Sharing[/c], allowing them to see targets behind obstacles for 25s. Additionally, [c=Highlight]Involuntary Sharing[/c] is enhanced on Rebecca, allowing her to lock onto targets behind obstacles. If Rebecca's turret is on the field, its Overload effect is activated, increasing its DMG dealt for 4s.
If Lucy is not in [c=Highlight]Algorithm Compaction[/c] after casting this skill, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].
If Lucy is in [c=Highlight]Algorithm Compaction[/c] after casting this skill, press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a certain time to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2[/c].
After casting this skill, the next [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference[/c] additionally grants 20 points of [c=Highlight]TCP[/c].

skills.name: Countermeasure Program
skills.description:
The incoming Resonator gains 25% Basic Attack DMG Amplification for 14s or until they are switched out.
Grants all Resonators in the team [c=Highlight]Countermeasure Program[/c] for 25s.
While the effect is active, when an active Resonator in the team other than Lucy inflicts [c=Highlight]Hack - Shifting[/c], that Resonator gains 20% All DMG Amplification.
While the effect is active, when a Resonator in the team other than Lucy is attacked, Lucy grants them 30% DMG Reduction for 3s and Stagnates their attacker for 1s. This effect can only trigger up to 1 time while [c=Highlight]Countermeasure Program[/c] is active. Obtaining [c=Highlight]Countermeasure Program[/c] again resets the effective charge. 
When the All DMG Amplification is effective, switching to another Resonator ends the [c=Highlight]Countermeasure Program[/c] early.

skills.name: Data Crash
skills.description:
When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, Lucy can cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.
Responding to [c=Highlight]Hack - Interfered[/c]: when Resonators in the team trigger [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target and cause them to be affected by [c=Highlight]Hack - Interfered[/c], Lucy applies [c=Highlight]Hack Response - Data Crash[/c] on the target. Each target can be inflicted with this effect up to 1 times every 8s.

skills.name: Depths of Blackwall
skills.description:
[c=Title]Cloud Portal[/c]
When not in [c=Highlight]Algorithm Compaction[/c], Lucy gains [c=Highlight]TCP[/c] upon hitting a target. At 100 points of [c=Highlight]TCP[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Payload[/c] and [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference[/c] are replaced with [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Deadlock[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Netrunner[/c] or [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive[/c] clears all [c=Highlight]TCP[/c].

[c=Title]Algorithm Compaction[/c]
After casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Deadlock[/c], Lucy enters [c=Highlight]Algorithm Compaction[/c] and gains 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]SQL[/c]. Her [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Thread Shredding[/c], and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Single Threading[/c]. Lucy's [c=Light]Spectro DMG Bonus[/c] is increased by 65% for 8s.
While in [c=Highlight]Algorithm Compaction[/c], casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Deadlock[/c] again will not grant [c=Highlight]SQL[/c] and Spectro DMG Bonus repetitively.
When in [c=Highlight]Algorithm Compaction[/c], Lucy gains [c=Highlight]Root Access[/c] upon hitting a target with attacks including [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Thread Shredding[/c] and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Single Threading[/c]. Reaching 100 points of [c=Highlight]Root Access[/c] replaces [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Single Threading[/c] with [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Dual Threading[/c]. Press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Dual Threading[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Multi-threading[/c].
When casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Multi-threading[/c], if Lucy has [c=Highlight]SQL[/c], increase this attack's DMG Multiplier by 270% and remove [c=Highlight]SQL[/c].
When casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Multi-threading[/c], if Lucy does not have [c=Highlight]SQL[/c], she loses 20% of current HP. If Lucy's HP is below 1%, no HP is consumed.
After casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Multi-threading[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Netrunner[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive[/c].
Lucy exits the the [c=Highlight]Algorithm Compaction[/c] state after casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Netrunner[/c] or [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive[/c], or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Multi-threading[/c] is not followed up by one of these skills: [c=Highlight]Normal Attack - Locked Thread[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Protocol Breach[/c], [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination[/c], and [c=Highlight]Tune Break - Data Crash[/c].

[c=Title]Hack Response - Data Crash[/c]
Lucy deals [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] to a target inflicted with [c=Highlight]Hack - Interfered[/c] and applies the same target with [c=Highlight]Data Crash[/c], considered Hack DMG.
[c=Highlight]Data Crash[/c]: After the target deals damage, Stagnate the target for 0.5s. Data Crash is removed after this effect is triggered.

[c=Title]TCP[/c]
Lucy holds up to 100 points of [c=Highlight]TCP[/c].
Lucy gains [c=Highlight]TCP[/c] when she deals damage through [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c].
Lucy gains [c=Highlight]TCP[/c] when she deals damage through [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Payload[/c] and [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference[/c].
After casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination[/c], casting the next [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference[/c] additionally grants 20 points of [c=Highlight]TCP[/c].

[c=Title]Root Access[/c]
Lucy holds up to 100 points of [c=Highlight]Root Access[/c].
Lucy gains [c=Highlight]Root Access[/c] when she deals damage through [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Thread Shredding[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Single Threading[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction[/c], and [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction[/c].

skills.name: Ghost Cyberware
skills.description:
When Lucy is the active Resonator in the team, if she takes no damage for 8s, she gains 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Optical Illusion[/c]. Max 1 stacks by default.
[c=Highlight]Optical Illusion[/c]: When attacked, reduce this instance of DMG by 100%. If Lucy is hit or launched from the attack, she immediately recovers and triggers a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] if she's on the ground. After this effect is triggered, remove 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Optical Illusion[/c]. This effect can be triggered up to 1 times every 0.5s.

skills.name: Function Cracking
skills.description:
When [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Payload[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference[/c], or [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Deadlock[/c] damages an [c=Highlight]Overlord Class[/c] or [c=Highlight]Calamity Class[/c] enemy, Lucy applies [c=Highlight]Botnet Mark[/c] on them for 2 min. While [c=Highlight]Botnet Mark[/c] is active, when a Resonator in the team defeats that target with direct damage, Lucy gains the [c=Highlight]Network Backdoor[/c] effect. If Rebecca is in the team, she gains the same effect.

[c=Title]Network Backdoor[/c]
Grants 10% All DMG Amplification and 10% additional Hack DMG Multiplier. This effect lasts for 2 min and stacks up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, additionally increases All DMG Amplification by 5% and Hack DMG Multiplier by 5%. When Lucy is downed, she can no longer gain [c=Highlight]Network Backdoor[/c], and any existing [c=Highlight]Network Backdoor[/c] effects become invalid.

sequences.name: The Moon, a Ticket, and a Dream
sequences.description:
Lucy is now immune to interruptions during [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Payload[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Pulse Inteference[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Dual Threading[/c], and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Multi-Threading[/c]
Casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination[/c] increases ATK by 20% for 14s.
When a Resonator in the team defeats a target affected by [c=Highlight]Spoofing Program[/c] with direct damage, Lucy records the effect triggered and activates the corresponding [c=Highlight]Quick Action[/c] on that Resonator for 6s. The record expires when Lucy is knocked out.
[c=Highlight]Quick Action[/c]: When activated, inflict the recorded [c=Highlight]Spoofing Program[/c] effects on targets within a certain distance from the active Resonator in the team, effective once only on each target.
The following [c=Highlight]Spoofing Program[/c] effects can be recorded: [c=Highlight]Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction[/c], [c=Highlight]Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol[/c], [c=Highlight]Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement[/c], [c=Highlight]Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch[/c], and [c=Highlight]Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis[/c]. When applying [c=Highlight]Spoofing Program[/c] effects via [c=Highlight]Quick Action[/c], only the continuous status effects are applied.

sequences.name: The Blackwall, the Past, the Escape
sequences.description:
While casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Netrunner[/c] and [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive[/c], Lucy's starting [c=Highlight]RAM[/c] is increased to 32.
After casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference[/c], deal 1 additional instances of [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] equal to 450% of Lucy's ATK, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When this instance of damage hits the target, apply all of the following [c=Highlight]Spoofing Program[/c] effects: [c=Highlight]Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction[/c], 
[c=Highlight]Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol[/c], [c=Highlight]Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement[/c], [c=Highlight]Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch[/c], and [c=Highlight]Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis[/c]. Only the continuous status effects are applied.
[c=Highlight]Forte Circuit - Depths of Blackwall[/c] is enhanced: When casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Multi-threading[/c], if Lucy has [c=Highlight]SQL[/c], the DMG Multiplier increase is raised from 270% to 560%.

sequences.name: Cyberpunk
sequences.description:
The DMG Multiplier of Override from [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Netrunner[/c] and [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive[/c] is increased by 50%, and its Crit. DMG is increased by 100%.
The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement[/c] is increased by 65%.
The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Hack Response - Data Crash[/c] is increased by 65%.

sequences.name: No Living Legends in Night City
sequences.description: When Resonators in the team inflict [c=Highlight]Hack - Shifting[/c], Resonators in the team gain 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for 20s.

sequences.name: A Broken Path to Hell
sequences.description:
The stack limit of [c=Highlight]Optical Illusion[/c] obtainable via [c=Highlight]Inherent Skill - Ghost Cyberware[/c] is increased to 2.
[c=Highlight]Inherent Skill - Ghost Cyberware[/c] is now enhanced: When Lucy's HP falls below 50%, she immediately gains 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Optical Illusion[/c] upon being hit. This effect has a Cooldown of 180s. When [c=Highlight]Optical Illusion[/c] is triggered, Lucy gains a Shield equal to 150% of ATK for 10s.

sequences.name: I Really Want to Stay At Your House
sequences.description:
Targets with [c=Highlight]Hack - Shifting[/c] or in the [c=Highlight]Hack - Interfered[/c] state take 40% increased Heavy Attack DMG from Lucy.
Targets with [c=Highlight]Hack - Shifting[/c] or in the [c=Highlight]Hack - Interfered[/c] state take 60% increased Hack DMG from Lucy.
The Stagnation triggered by [c=Highlight]Hack Response - Data Crash[/c] now lasts for 1.5s.

skills.name: Mend and Cleanse
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Press repeatedly or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.

skills.name: Dream Blend
skills.description:
[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Nightmare Blend[/c]
Lily starts with [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale[/c] by default. When [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale[/c] is active, press Resonance Skill to deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] to nearby targets, then switch to [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm[/c].
This skill shares a Cooldown with [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Reverie Blend[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Reverie Blend[/c]
When [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm[/c] is active, press Resonance Skill to deal [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] to nearby targets, then switch to [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale[/c].
This skill shares a Cooldown with [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Nightmare Blend[/c].

rows.label: Resonance Skill - Reverie Blend/Nightmare Blend Cooldown
Resonance Skill - Reverie Blend/Nightmare Blend Concerto Regen

skills.name: Into the Dream Cradle
skills.description:
Casting this skill sends Lily into [c=Highlight]Slumberland[/c] and grants her [c=Highlight]Cradle Lullaby[/c].
Casting this skill also grants Lily a Shield equal to 100% of her Max HP for 4s. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

[c=Title]Slumberland[/c]
Lasts for 50s. When Lily is in [c=Highlight]Slumberland[/c], she heals the nearby active Resonator every 3s. During [c=Highlight]Slumberland[/c], use directional input to command [c=Highlight]Dreambind[/c] to attack, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] to nearby targets. [c=Highlight]Dreambind[/c] pulls in targets within a certain range every 5s while attacking, and stops attacking 10s after movement stops. Press Resonance Liberation again during [c=Highlight]Slumberland[/c] to end it early.
When Lily is in [c=Highlight]Slumberland[/c] and a Resonator in the team other than Lily casts [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c], targets within a certain range are pulled in. This effect can be triggered once every 10s. Lily is immune to interruption during [c=Highlight]Slumberland[/c] and takes 50% less DMG.
Switching to another Resonator during [c=Highlight]Slumberland[/c] keeps Lily on the field but stops the attacks of [c=Highlight]Dreambind[/c]. Lily leaves the field when [c=Highlight]Slumberland[/c] ends, or earlier if she gets too far from the active Resonator. Casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom[/c] also ends [c=Highlight]Slumberland[/c] immediately.

[c=Title]Cradle Lullaby[/c]
Lasts for 25s. While this effect is active, each [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c] cast by a Resonator in the team other than Lily grants 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Dream Aroma[/c]. [c=Highlight]Cradle Lullaby[/c] is removed when Lily is the incoming Resonator.

[c=Title]Dream Aroma[/c]
Stacks up to 4 times. Each stack increases the ATK of all Resonators in the team by 0.1% for every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 190%, up to 7%. This effect is removed when Lily is the incoming Resonator or when [c=Highlight]Cradle Lullaby[/c] ends.

skills.name: Blooming Dream
skills.description:
[c=Title]First Bloom[/c]
Attack the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c]. Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

[c=Title]Eternal Bloom[/c]
After casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Into the Dream Cradle[/c], Lily's next Intro Skill [c=Highlight]First Bloom[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Eternal Bloom[/c]. When cast, it attacks the target, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
For every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, this skill gains 0.5% Crit. Rate, up to 80%, and 1% Crit. DMG, up to 160%.
Casting this skill grants [c=Highlight]Deep Dream Fragrance[/c] for 8s. Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm[/c] consumes [c=Highlight]Deep Dream Fragrance[/c] to additionally grant 100 points of [c=Highlight]Dreambell Chime[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

skills.name: Blooming Fragrance
skills.description: Resonators in the team gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 30s.

skills.name: Tune Break: Pistols
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Dreamland of Flowers
skills.description:
[c=Title]Dream Perfume[/c]
Can hold up to 300 points.
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack[/c], and [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] restore [c=Highlight]Dream Perfume[/c] when dealing damage.
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Reverie Blend[/c] or [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Nightmare Blend[/c] restores 130 points of [c=Highlight]Dream Perfume[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom[/c] restores 130 points of [c=Highlight]Dream Perfume[/c].

[c=Title]Dreambell Chime[/c]
Can hold up to 300 points.
Can be gained continuously during [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale[/c] and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm[/c]. Any unconsumed [c=Highlight]Dreambell Chime[/c] will be converted into an equal amount of [c=Highlight]Dream Perfume[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale[/c]
When [c=Highlight]Dream Perfume[/c] is full, hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale[/c], consuming all [c=Highlight]Dream Perfume[/c] to grant 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Dream Shelter[/c]. During the skill, Lily pulls in nearby targets and continuously deals [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] to them. She also heals all Resonators in the team every second for 2s.
Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale[/c] grants Lily [c=Highlight]Wish of Praying Dream[/c].
Switching to another Resonator during [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale[/c] ends the skill immediately.
Lily continuously gains [c=Highlight]Dreambell Chime[/c] and Concerto Energy (up to 30 points) during the skill.
When [c=Highlight]Dreambell Chime[/c] reaches 300 points, press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to end the skill immediately and cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale[/c]. [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale[/c] is automatically cast at the end of [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale[/c]. Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale[/c] consumes all [c=Highlight]Dreambell Chime[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale[/c]
Attack targets within range, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
For every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, this skill gains 0.5% Crit. Rate, up to 80%, and 1% Crit. DMG, up to 160%.
Lily gains [c=Highlight]Sillage[/c] for 6s while casting this skill. Casting Outro Skill consumes [c=Highlight]Sillage[/c] and grants [c=Highlight]Silvered Dream[/c] to Resonators in the team. This effect can be triggered once every 20s.
Lily cannot be switched out while casting this skill.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm[/c]
When [c=Highlight]Dream Perfume[/c] is full, hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm[/c], consuming all [c=Highlight]Dream Perfume[/c] to grant 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Dream Shelter[/c]. During the skill, Lily pulls in nearby targets and continuously deals [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] to them. She also heals all Resonators in the team every second for 2s.
Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm[/c] grants Lily [c=Highlight]Wish of Praying Dream[/c].
Switching to another Resonator during [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm[/c] ends the skill immediately.
Lily continuously gains [c=Highlight]Dreambell Chime[/c] and Concerto Energy (up to 30 points) during the skill.
When [c=Highlight]Dreambell Chime[/c] reaches 300 points, press or hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to end the skill immediately and cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End[/c]. [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End[/c] is automatically cast at the end of [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm[/c]. Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End[/c] consumes all [c=Highlight]Dreambell Chime[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End[/c]
Attack targets within range, dealing [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c].
For every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, this skill gains 0.5% Crit. Rate, up to 80%, and 1% Crit. DMG, up to 160%.
Lily gains [c=Highlight]Sillage[/c] for 6s while casting this skill. Casting Outro Skill consumes [c=Highlight]Sillage[/c] and grants [c=Highlight]Silvered Dream[/c] to Resonators in the team. This effect can be triggered once every 20s.
Lily cannot be switched out while casting this skill.

[c=Title]Silvered Dream[/c]
Lasts for 30s.
When the Resonator with this effect is the active Resonator and can trigger Unison Response, each stack of [c=Highlight]Unison Boon[/c] on the team increases their ATK by 0.1% for every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 190%, up to 7%, counting up to 4 stacks of [c=Highlight]Unison Boon[/c].
The active Resonator's Echo Skill DMG gains more Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG. For every 0.7% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 190%, the Crit. Rate of Echo Skill DMG is increased by 0.1%, up to 10%, and the Crit. DMG of Echo Skill DMG is increased by 0.2%, up to 20%.
All Resonators in the team gain increased resistance to interruption.

[c=Title]Dream Shelter[/c]
Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm[/c] grants 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Dream Shelter[/c], stacking up to 1 time. [c=Highlight]Dream Shelter[/c] is removed when [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End[/c] ends, or when [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm[/c] is interrupted. Receiving damage from an enemy target consumes 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Dream Shelter[/c] to grant Lily immunity to interruption and reduce the DMG taken by 60% for 1s. This effect can be triggered once per second.

[c=Title]Wish of Praying Dream[/c]
Can be gained once every 25s.
When Lily has [c=Highlight]Wish of Praying Dream[/c], the current [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm[/c] consumes [c=Highlight]Wish of Praying Dream[/c] to increase the skill's healing by 400%.

rows.label: Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale/Phantasm's End Concerto Regen

skills.name: Woven Scent
skills.description:
Casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom[/c] additionally restores 10 points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every 20s.
Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End[/c] additionally restores 15 points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every 20s.

skills.name: Flowers for You
skills.description:
While a nearby active Resonator has 50% or more HP, Lily grants them 10% DMG Reduction.
When a Resonator in the team takes a fatal blow, they will not fall and will instead gain a Shield equal to 10% of Lily's Max HP for 10s. This effect can be triggered once every 5 min.
Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End[/c] grants Lily [c=Highlight]Floral Blessing[/c].

[c=Title]Floral Blessing[/c]
Lasts for 60s. When the HP of a surviving Resonator in the team is below 50% of their Max HP, restore 50% of their Max HP and remove [c=Highlight]Floral Blessing[/c]. This effect can be triggered once every 120s.

sequences.name: Look, White Flowers from the Ruins of Dreams
sequences.description:
Lily is immune to interruption while casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale[/c], or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End[/c].
While [c=Highlight]Cradle Lullaby[/c] is active, each [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c] cast by a Resonator in the team other than Lily now grants 2 stacks of [c=Highlight]Dream Aroma[/c].

sequences.name: Listen, a Requiem from the Dream Cradle
sequences.description: While [c=Highlight]Cradle Lullaby[/c] is active, when a Resonator in the team other than Lily casts an [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c], each stack of [c=Highlight]Dream Aroma[/c] additionally increases Crit. Rate by 2% and Crit. DMG by 6%.

sequences.name: May Your Soul Wander No More
sequences.description:
Lily additionally gains 170 points of [c=Highlight]Dream Perfume[/c] upon entering combat, triggered once every 12s. After Lily casts [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom[/c], she additionally gains 170 points of [c=Highlight]Dream Perfume[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Into the Dream Cradle[/c] additionally restores 10 points of Concerto Energy.
Dealing DMG with [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End[/c] additionally restores 10 points of Resonance Energy.
During [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale[/c] or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm[/c], Lily gains [c=Highlight]Dreambell Chime[/c] faster.

sequences.name: May Your Past Sink into Silence
sequences.description: [c=Highlight]Slumberland[/c]'s healing is increased by 30%.

sequences.name: May You Find Peace in Endless Light
sequences.description: While Lily is in [c=Highlight]Slumberland[/c], the pull-in effect range is increased by 50% when a Resonator in the team other than Lily casts [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c].

sequences.name: May My Reverie Never End
sequences.description:
The [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] dealt by [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale[/c] and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End[/c] is increased by 100%.
The [c=Light]Spectro DMG[/c] dealt by [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom[/c] is increased by 700%.

skills.name: Concealed Edge
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Consume Stamina to deal [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
Hold Basic Attack to enter [c=Highlight]Rocksteady Defense[/c].
 
[c=Title]Rocksteady Defense[/c]
- Taoqi's damage taken is reduced by 35%;
- When Taoqi is attacked during [c=Highlight]Rocksteady Defense[/c], she will cast [c=Highlight]Strategic Parry[/c];
- [c=Highlight]Strategic Parry[/c] is automatically cast after [c=Highlight]Rocksteady Defense[/c] lasts for 3s;
If Taoqi is attacked when casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Fortified Defense[/c], [c=Highlight]Strategic Parry[/c] is automatically cast.
 
[c=Title]Strategic Parry[/c]
Attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-Air Attack[/c]
Consume Stamina to perform a Plunging Attack while in mid-air, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].

skills.name: Fortified Defense
skills.description:
Taoqi deals [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] to surrounding targets, generating 3 Rocksteady Shield and healing herself.
If attacked when casting [c=Highlight]Fortified Defense[/c], [c=Highlight]Strategic Parry[/c] will be automatically cast.
 
[c=Title]Rocksteady Shield[/c]
When the active character on the team is attacked, 1 [c=Highlight]Rocksteady Shield[/c] is consumed to reduce the damage taken.

skills.name: Unmovable
skills.description: Attack the target based on Taoqi's DEF, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].

skills.name: Defense Formation
skills.description: Attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].

skills.name: Iron Will
skills.description: The incoming Resonator has their Resonance Skill DMG Amplified by 38% for 14s or until they are switched out.

skills.name: Tune Break: Broadblade
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Power Shift
skills.description:
[c=Title]Timed Counters[/c]
When carrying "Resolving Caliber", use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Strategic Parry[/c] or Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Defense Formation[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Timed Counters[/c], performing up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], considered as Basic Attack DMG.
[c=Highlight]Timed Counters[/c] consume 1 "Resolving Caliber" upon hitting an enemy to grant a shield.
After casting the Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Defense Formation[/c], use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] to directly cast [c=Highlight]Timed Counters[/c].

[c=Title]Resolving Caliber[/c]
Taoqi can hold up to 3 Resolving Caliber.
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack 4[/c] will consume all of Taoqi's "Rocksteady Shields" to grant that many "Resolving Caliber".
While [c=Highlight]Rocksteady Shield[/c] exists, when the active character is attacked, 1 "Rocksteady Shield" will be consumed to recover "Resolving Caliber".
After [c=Highlight]Rocksteady Shield[/c] ends, all remaining "Rocksteady Shield" will be consumed to grant that many "Resolving Caliber".

skills.name: Steadfast Protection
skills.description: While Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Rocksteady Shield[/c] lasts, the Character's DEF is increased by 15%.

skills.name: Unyielding
skills.description: After Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Strategic Parry[/c] is successfully triggered, 25 STA is recovered.

sequences.name: Essense of Tranquility
sequences.description: Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Power Shift[/c]'s Shield is increased by 40%.

sequences.name: Silent Strength
sequences.description: The Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Unmovable[/c] is increased by 20% and 20%, respectively.

sequences.name: Keen-eyed Observer
sequences.description: The duration of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Rocksteady Shield[/c] is extended to 30s.

sequences.name: Heavylifting Duty
sequences.description: When Taoqi successfully triggers Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Strategic Parry[/c], she restores 25% HP and increases her DEF by 50% for 5s. This can be triggered once every 15s.

sequences.name: Benevolent Guardian
sequences.description: The damage of Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Power Shift[/c] is increased by 50%. When Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Power Shift[/c] hits a target, restore 20 Resonance Energy.

sequences.name: Defender of Peace
sequences.description: The damage of Taoqi's Basic Attack and Heavy Attack is increased by 40% while the Shield granted by Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Rocksteady Shield[/c] holds.

skills.name: Execution
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Danjin performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Danjin consumes STA to launch consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to launch an attack, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter: Ruby Shades[/c]
After a successful Dodge Counter, Danjin can use Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Crimson Fragment[/c] to perform Resonance Skill: [c=Highlight]Crimson Erosion[/c].

skills.name: Crimson Fragment
skills.description:
When casting [c=Highlight]Crimson Fragment[/c], each attack consumes 3% of Danjin's max HP. When Danjin's HP is less than 1%, this no longer consumes HP.
 
[c=Title]Carmine Gleam[/c]
Danjin attacks the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Crimson Erosion[/c]
After [c=Highlight]Basic Attack 2[/c], [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] or Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Vindication[/c], use [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to perform up to 2 consecutive strikes, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
When [c=Highlight]Crimson Erosion 2[/c] hits a target, apply [c=Highlight]Incinerating Will[/c] to it.
 
[c=Title]Incinerating Will[/c]
Danjin's damage dealt to targets marked with [c=Highlight]Incinerating Will[/c] is increased by 20%.
 
[c=Title]Sanguine Pulse[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] after [c=Highlight]Basic Attack 3[/c] to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].

skills.name: Crimson Bloom
skills.description: Danjin's anger intensifies as she frantically swings her dual blades, performing multiple rapid consecutive attacks, and 1 Scarlet Burst attack(s), dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].

skills.name: Vindication
skills.description: With unwavering determination, Danjin unleashes a strike, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].

skills.name: Duality
skills.description: The incoming Resonator has their Havoc DMG Amplified by 23% for 14s or until they are switched out.

skills.name: Tune Break: Sword
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Serene Vigil
skills.description:
[c=Title]Heavy Attack: Chaoscleave[/c]
After accumulating 60 "Ruby Blossom", long press [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] to consume all "Ruby Blossom" to cast [c=Highlight]Chaoscleave[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], considered as Heavy Attack DMG, and healing Danjin.
If current "Ruby Blossom" reaches over 120, 120 "Ruby Blossom" is consumed instead to increase the DMG multiplier of [c=Highlight]Chaoscleave[/c] and [c=Highlight]Scatterbloom[/c] performed this time.
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack: Scatterbloom[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Chaoscleave[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Scatterbloom[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
 
[c=Title]Ruby Blossom[/c]
Danjin can hold up to 120 Ruby Blossom.
Danjin obtains "Ruby Blossom" when using Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Crimson Fragment[/c].

skills.name: Crimson Light
skills.description: Damage of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Crimson Erosion[/c] triggered by [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter: Ruby Shades[/c] is increased by 20%. The HP cost and stacks of Ruby Blossom recovered are doubled.

skills.name: Overflow
skills.description: After casting the Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Sanguine Pulse[/c], Danjin's Heavy Attack DMG is increased by 30% for 5s.

sequences.name: Crimson Heart of Justice
sequences.description: When Danjin attacks a target with Resonance Skill's [c=Highlight]Incinerating Will[/c], her ATK is increased by 5% for 6s, stacking up to 6 times. Danjin loses 1 stacks of this effect each time she takes damage.

sequences.name: Dusted Mirror
sequences.description: When Danjin attacks a target with Resonance Skill's [c=Highlight]Incinerating Will[/c], her damage dealt is increased by 20%.

sequences.name: Fleeting Blossom
sequences.description: Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus is increased by 30%.

sequences.name: Solitary Carnation
sequences.description:
When Danjin has more than 60 "Ruby Blossom", her Crit. Rate is increased by 15%.
This effect lasts until the end of [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack: Scatterbloom[/c] even after all "Ruby Blossom" is consumed when casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack: Chaoscleave[/c].

sequences.name: Reigning Blade
sequences.description: Danjin's Havoc DMG Bonus is increased by 15%, and further increased by another 15% when her HP is lower than 60%.

sequences.name: Bloodied Jade
sequences.description: Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Chaoscleave[/c] increases the ATK of all team members by 20% for 20s.

skills.name: Burgeoning
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
After performing [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c] or Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Pruning[/c], hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack Button[/c] to continuously strike the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 4[/c] is automatically followed by [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 5[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Pruning[/c]
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] right after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].

skills.name: Valse of Bloom and Blight
skills.description:
[c=Title]Crimson Blossom[/c]
Attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] (considered Basic Attack DMG), then enter [c=Highlight]Blossom Mode[/c].
This attack can be performed in mid-air.
 
[c=Title]Blossom Mode[/c]
- Unable to move while suspended on vines.
- [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] and Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Pruning[/c] are replaced by Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Vining Waltz[/c]: chain together 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], considered Basic Attack DMG.
- When performing [c=Highlight]Vining Waltz Stage 3[/c], hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack Button[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Blazing Waltz[/c] that deals [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] before automatically performing [c=Highlight]Vining Waltz Stage 4[/c].
- [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] is replaced by Dodge Counter [c=Highlight]Atonement[/c]. Tap [c=Highlight]Normal Attack Button[/c] right after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], considered Basic Attack DMG.
- Resonance Skill is replaced by Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Floral Ravage[/c]. Casting [c=Highlight]Floral Ravage[/c] deals [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], considered Basic Attack DMG.
- Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Floral Ravage[/c] can be cast in mid-air.
- [c=Highlight]Blossom Mode[/c] ends after casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Floral Ravage[/c].
- [c=Highlight]Blossom Mode[/c] ends after using the [c=Highlight]Levitator[/c].
- Jump is replaced with Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Vining Ronde[/c]. Use Jump to attack the target at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] (considered Basic Attack DMG). This ends the [c=Highlight]Blossom Mode[/c].
- Using Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Vining Waltz[/c] and Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Blazing Waltz[/c] in mid-air consumes STA.
- Casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Floral Ravage[/c] doesn't restore STA.
- Consume STA continuously to stay suspended on the vines.

rows.label: STA Cost Per Second When Suspended

skills.name: Fervor Efflorescent
skills.description:
Attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
This attack can be performed in mid-air.

skills.name: Seedbed
skills.description: Gain 15% Havoc DMG Bonus. DMG dealt by Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Pruning[/c] is now considered Basic Attack DMG.

skills.name: Tune Break: Sword
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Epiphyte
skills.description: Gain 15% Basic DMG Bonus. Gain increased resistance to interruption when casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c], Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Vining Waltz[/c], and Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Blazing Waltz[/c].

skills.name: Everblooming
skills.description: Attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].

skills.name: Twining
skills.description:
Attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] equal to 329.24% of Camellya's ATK.
After activating Forte Circuit's [c=Highlight]Ephemeral[/c], the next Outro Skill [c=Highlight]Twining[/c] deals additional [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] equal to 459.02% of Camellya's ATK.

skills.name: Vegetative Universe
skills.description:
Hitting a target with [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c], Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Vining Waltz[/c], Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Blazing Waltz[/c], Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Vining Ronde[/c], Dodge Counter [c=Highlight]Atonement [/c], Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Crimson Blossom[/c], and Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Floral Ravage[/c] consumes Crimson Pistils. The Energy Regen Multiplier of this attack is increased by 150%.
Consuming 10 Crimson Pistils recovers 4 Concerto Energy and obtains 1 Crimson Bud(s). Each bud lasts for 15s, stacking up to 10 times.
 
[c=Title]Forte Circuit: Ephemeral[/c]
When Concerto Energy is fully recovered, and [c=Highlight]Ephemeral[/c] is not on Cooldown, Resonance Skill is replaced with [c=Highlight]Ephemeral[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Ephemeral[/c] consumes 70 Concerto Energy and deals [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] to the targets. This damage is considered Basic Attack DMG.
Camellya enters [c=Highlight]Budding Mode[/c] after casting [c=Highlight]Ephemeral[/c].
This can be cast in mid-air.
 
[c=Title]Budding Mode[/c]
- [c=Highlight]Sweet Dream[/c]: Increase the DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c], Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Vining Waltz[/c], Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Blazing Waltz[/c], Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Vining Ronde[/c], Dodge Counter [c=Highlight]Atonement[/c], Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Crimson Blossom[/c], and Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Floral Ravage[/c] by 50%.
- Casting [c=Highlight]Ephemeral[/c] consumes all Crimson Buds. Each Crimson Bud consumed additionally increases the DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Sweet Dream[/c] by 5%, up to 50%. 
- When in [c=Highlight]Budding Mode[/c], Camellya cannot gain Crimson Buds.
- When in [c=Highlight]Budding Mode[/c], the Energy Regen Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c], Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Vining Waltz[/c], Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Blazing Waltz[/c], Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Vining Ronde[/c], Dodge Counter [c=Highlight]Atonement[/c], Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Crimson Blossom[/c], and Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Floral Ravage[/c] is reduced to 0%.
- [c=Highlight]Budding Mode[/c] ends when Camellya is switched off the field.
- [c=Highlight]Budding Mode[/c] ends when all Crimson Pistils are consumed.
 
[c=Title]Crimson Pistil[/c]
Camellya can hold up to 100 Crimson Pistils.
- Casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Everblooming[/c] recovers 100 Crimson Pistils.
- Activating Forte Circuit's [c=Highlight]Ephemeral[/c] recovers 100 Crimson Pistils.

sequences.name: Somewhere No One Travelled
sequences.description:
Casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Everblooming[/c] increases Camellya's Crit. DMG by 28% for 18s. This effect can be triggered once every 25s.
Immune to interruptions while casting [c=Highlight]Ephemeral[/c].

sequences.name: Calling Upon the Silent Rose
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Ephemeral[/c] is increased by 120%.

sequences.name: A Bud Adorned by Thorns
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Fervor Efflorescent[/c] is increased by 50%. When in [c=Highlight]Budding Mode[/c], Camellya's ATK is increased by 58%.

sequences.name: Roots Set Deep In Eternity
sequences.description: Casting [c=Highlight]Everblooming[/c] gives all team members 25% Basic Attack DMG Bonus for 30s.

sequences.name: Infinity Held in Your Palm
sequences.description: The DMG Multipliers of Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Everblooming[/c] is increased by 303% and Outro Skill [c=Highlight]Twining[/c] is increased by 68%.

sequences.name: Bloom For You Thousand Times Over
sequences.description:
The DMG Multiplier of Forte Circuit's [c=Highlight]Sweet Dream[/c] is additionally increased by 150%. 
Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Perennial[/c]: Within 15s after casting [c=Highlight]Ephemeral[/c], if Concerto Energy is full and [c=Highlight]Perennial[/c] is not on cooldown, Resonance Skill is replaced with [c=Highlight]Perennial[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Perennial[/c] consumes 50 Concerto Energy and recovers 50 Crimson Pistils, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] equal to 100% of [c=Highlight]Ephemeral[/c] DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG. This skill can be cast once every 25s.
Camellya enters [c=Highlight]Budding Mode[/c] after casting [c=Highlight]Perennial[/c] and removes all Crimson Buds. The bonus DMG Multiplier granted by Forte Circuit's [c=Highlight]Sweet Dream[/c] is increased to 250%.
Immune to interruptions when casting [c=Highlight]Perennial[/c].

skills.name: Tuneslayer
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Rover-Havoc performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Rover-Havoc consumes STA to attack, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after casting Heavy Attack to cast Basic Attack 4.
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Rover-Havoc consumes STA to cast a Mid-Air Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].

skills.name: Wingblade
skills.description: Transform sound into feathers, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].

skills.name: Deadening Abyss
skills.description: Rover gathers resonating sounds to attack targets, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].

skills.name: Instant of Annihilation
skills.description: Attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].

skills.name: Soundweaver
skills.description: Rover summons a Havoc Field, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] of 143.3% of Rover's ATK to all targets within the range every 2s for 6s.

skills.name: Tune Break: Sword
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Umbra Eclipse
skills.description:
[c=Title]Devastation[/c]
When "Umbra" is full, hold [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Devastation[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
 
[c=Title]Dark Surge[/c]
After casting [c=Highlight]Devastation[/c], Rover enters the [c=Highlight]Dark Surge[/c] state. In this state:
-[c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Enhanced Basic Attack[/c], which performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
-[c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Enhanced Heavy Attack[/c];
-Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after casting [c=Highlight]Enhanced Heavy Attack[/c] to cast Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Thwackblade[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
-Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] after casting Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Thwackblade[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Enhanced Basic Attack 3[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c];
-Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Wingblade[/c] is replaced with Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Lifetaker[/c], transforming sounds into blades to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Umbra[/c]
Rover can hold up to 100 points of Umbra.
Normal Attack [c=Highlight]Tuneslayer[/c] recovers Umbra on hit.
Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Wingblade[/c] recovers Umbra when cast.
Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Lifetaker[/c] recovers Umbra when cast.
Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Instant of Annihilation[/c] recovers Umbra when cast.

skills.name: Metamorph
skills.description: In the [c=Highlight]Dark Surge[/c] state, gain 20% Havoc DMG Bonus.

skills.name: Bleak Crescendo
skills.description: While in the [c=Highlight]Dark Surge[/c] state, [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] recovers 1 extra Resonance Energy when it hits a target. This effect can be triggered 1 time per second.

sequences.name: Cryptic Insight
sequences.description: Resonance Skill DMG Bonus is increased by 30%.

sequences.name: Waning Crescent
sequences.description: Reset Resonance Skill's Cooldown when Rover enters the [c=Highlight]Dark Surge[/c] state by casting Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Devastation[/c].

sequences.name: Surging Resonance
sequences.description: In the [c=Highlight]Dark Surge[/c] state, [c=Highlight]Basic Attack 5[/c] restores HP equal to 10% of total HP lost on hit.

sequences.name: Annihilated Silence
sequences.description: Heavy Attack [c=Highlight]Devastation[/c] and Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Deadening Abyss[/c] reduces enemy's Havoc RES by 10% for 20s on hit.

sequences.name: Aeon Symphony
sequences.description: In the [c=Highlight]Dark Surge[/c] state, [c=Highlight]Basic Attack 5[/c] deals an additional [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] equal to 50% of [c=Highlight]Basic Attack 5[/c] DMG.

sequences.name: Ebbing Undercurrent
sequences.description: In the [c=Highlight]Dark Surge[/c] state, Rover's Crit. Rate is increased by 25%.

skills.name: Pero, Easy
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Consume STA to attack, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. Hitting a target with at least 100 Imagination sends Roccia into mid-air and activates the [c=Highlight]Beyond Imagination[/c] state. The longer you hold the [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] button, the more Imagination Roccia gains. In this state, Roccia can continue to charge the attack even when her STA depletes. Heavy Attack will be automatically cast when you release the [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] button while charging or when Imagination reaches the max limit.
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] right after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
