skills.name: Acrobatic Trick
skills.description: Roccia projects her creativity into reality, pulling in nearby targets and dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. She then launches into mid-air and activates the [c=Highlight]Beyond Imagination[/c] state.

skills.name: Commedia Improvviso!
skills.description: Roccia's improvised comedy begins! Deal [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] to the target, considered Heavy Attack DMG. For every 0.1% of Roccia's Crit. Rate over 50%, this skill increases the ATK of all Resonators in the team by 1 points for 30s, up to 200 points.

skills.name: Pero, Help
skills.description: Attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. Use [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] right after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 4[/c].

skills.name: Applause, Please!
skills.description: The incoming Resonator has their Havoc DMG Amplified by 20% and Basic Attack DMG Amplified by 25% for 14s or until the Resonator is switched out.

skills.name: Tune Break: Gauntlets
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: A Prop Master Prepares
skills.description:
[c=Title]Beyond Imagination[/c]
- When Roccia is in [c=Highlight]Beyond Imagination[/c] with at least 100 Imagination, press the [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] button to consume 100 Imagination to cast Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Real Fantasy[/c].
- Roccia exits this state when she is not airborne or when switched off the field.
 
[c=Title]Basic Attack - Real Fantasy[/c]
- Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], considered Heavy Attack DMG. When Roccia lands after Stage 1 and Stage 2 attacks with over 100 Imagination, she will launch into mid-air and activate [c=Highlight]Beyond Imagination[/c].
 
[c=Title]Imagination[/c]
Roccia can hold up to 300 Imagination.
- Dealing DMG with Normal Attacks restores Imagination.
- Hold [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] to charge the next attack while restoring Imagination.
- Casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Acrobatic Trick[/c] restores 100 Imagination.
- Casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Pero, Help[/c] restores 100 Imagination.

skills.name: Immersive Performance
skills.description: Casting Resonance Skill or Heavy Attack increases Roccia's ATK by 20% for 12s.

skills.name: Super Attractive Magic Box
skills.description:
After casting Outro Skill, the Utility of the incoming Resonator is replaced with Magic Box.
 
[c=Title]Magic Box[/c]
- Upon use, pull nearby targets toward the Magic Box, dealing 100 points of [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. This skill is considered Echo Skill that deals Utility DMG.
- The Magic Box lasts for 14s or until the Resonator is switched out.

sequences.name: When Shadows Engulf the Hull
sequences.description:
Casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Acrobatic Trick[/c] grants 100 additional Imagination and 10 Concerto Energy.
Immune to interruptions when casting Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Real Fantasy[/c]

sequences.name: When the Luceanite Gleams
sequences.description: Casting Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Real Fantasy[/c] grants all Resonators in the team 10% Havoc DMG Bonus for 30s, stacking up to 3 times. Upon reaching the max stacks, it grants all Resonators in the team 10% additional Havoc DMG Bonus for 30s.

sequences.name: When the Heart Sees and Hands Feel
sequences.description: Casting Intro Skill [c=Highlight]Pero, Help[/c] increases Roccia's Crit. Rate by 10% and Crit. DMG by 30% for 15s.

sequences.name: When Wonders Gather in the Box
sequences.description: Casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Acrobatic Trick[/c] increases Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Real Fantasy[/c]'s DMG Multiplier by 60% for 12s.

sequences.name: When Dreams Are Reborn on Stage
sequences.description: Increase Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Commedia Improvviso![/c]'s DMG Multiplier by 20% and [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c]'s DMG Multiplier by 80%.

sequences.name: When the Golden Wings Fly
sequences.description:
Casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Commedia Improvviso![/c] grants the following effects for 12s:
- Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Real Fantasy[/c] ignores enemies' DEF by 60%.
- When Roccia lands after performing Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Real Fantasy[/c] Stage 3, she is launched into mid-air, activating [c=Highlight]Beyond Imagination[/c]. In this state, [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] becomes Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Reality Recreation[/c], dealing DMG equal to 100% of Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Real Fantasy[/c] Stage 3 DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG. Roccia is immune to interruptions while casting Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Reality Recreation[/c].
- When Roccia lands after performing Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Reality Recreation[/c], she is launched into mid-air, activating [c=Highlight]Beyond Imagination[/c]. Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Reality Recreation[/c] is only available in the [c=Highlight]Beyond Imagination[/c] state.

skills.name: Illusion Collapse
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Delusive Dive[/c]
When Cantarella has Trance, [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] becomes [c=Highlight]Delusive Dive[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] to the target, and then Cantarella enters [c=Highlight]Mirage[/c]. While in [c=Highlight]Mirage[/c], casting [c=Highlight]Delusive Dive[/c] does not activate [c=Highlight]Mirage[/c] again.
Can be cast in water.
 
[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] right after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].

skills.name: Dance with Shadows
skills.description:
[c=Title]Graceful Step[/c]
Attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
 
[c=Title]Flickering Reverie[/c]
When in [c=Highlight]Mirage[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] becomes [c=Highlight]Flickering Reverie[/c], which is considered an [c=Highlight]Echo Skill[/c] when being cast. Attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], and send them into [c=Highlight]Hazy Dream[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air.
 
[c=Title]Hazy Dream[/c]
Reduce the target's movement speed for 6.5s. When the target takes damage, [c=Highlight]Jolt[/c] is triggered once, removing [c=Highlight]Hazy Dream[/c] to deal [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], considered Basic Attack DMG.
Attacks by other Resonators in the team will not [c=Highlight]Jolt[/c] a target influenced by [c=Highlight]Hazy Dream[/c] and will remove the [c=Highlight]Hazy Dream[/c]. 
Coordinated Attacks and damage from Utilities will not [c=Highlight]Jolt[/c] a target.

skills.name: Beneath the Sea
skills.description:
[c=Title]Flowing Suffocation[/c]
Attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] (considered Basic Attack DMG). Grant [c=Highlight]Diffusion[/c] to all Resonators in the team. Casting this skill is also considered as casting [c=Highlight]Echo Skill[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
 
[c=Title]Diffusion[/c]
When the Resonator on the field deals damage to a target, summon [c=Highlight]Dreamweavers[/c] to perform Coordinated Attack, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] (considered as Basic Attack DMG).
- Within 3s after the Resonator deals damage, summon 1 [c=Highlight]Dreamweavers[/c] per second. This effect can be triggered once per second. Damage dealt by [c=Highlight]Dreamweavers[/c] cannot trigger this effect.
- Up to 1 [c=Highlight]Dreamweavers[/c] can be summoned each second, max 21 [c=Highlight]Dreamweavers[/c] in total.
- This effect lasts for 30s or until reaching the maximum number of [c=Highlight]Dreamweavers[/c].

skills.name: Cruise
skills.description:
[c=Title]Ripple[/c]
Attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to start the Basic Attack combo from [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c].
 
[c=Title]Tidal Surge[/c]
When in [c=Highlight]Mirage[/c], [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c] becomes [c=Highlight]Tidal Surge[/c], which triggers 3 coordinated attacks on hit, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. Casting [c=Highlight]Tidal Surge[/c] resets the combo of Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Phantom Sting[/c].

skills.name: Gentle Tentacles
skills.description: Amplify the incoming Resonator's Havoc DMG by 20% and Resonance Skill DMG by 25% for 14s. Switching Resonators ends this effect.

skills.name: Tune Break: Rectifier
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Between Illusion and Reality
skills.description:
[c=Title]Mirage[/c]
- [c=Highlight]Basic Attack[/c] becomes Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Phantom Sting[/c]. Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. Can be cast in mid-air. When cast mid-air, Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Phantom Sting[/c] consumes STA, and the combo does not reset when Cantarella is airborne.
- Hitting the target with Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Phantom Sting[/c] consumes 1 point of Trance to obtain 1 point of Shiver and heal all nearby Resonators in the team.
- The third stage of Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Phantom Sting[/c] triggers 3 Coordinated Attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
- [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack[/c] becomes [c=Highlight]Abysmal Vortex[/c]. Press [c=Highlight]Jump[/c] to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
- [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter[/c] becomes Dodge Counter [c=Highlight]Shadowy Sweep[/c]. Attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] right after casting the skill to cast Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Phantom Sting Stage 2[/c].
- When Mid-air Attack [c=Highlight]Abysmal Vortex[/c] or Dodge Counter [c=Highlight]Shadowy Sweep[/c] hits a target, consume 1 point of Trance to obtain 1 point of Shiver and heal all nearby Resonators in the team.
- Mirage lasts for 8s.
- [c=Highlight]Mirage[/c] ends when Trance is depleted.
 
[c=Title]Forte Circuit - Perception Drain[/c]
If Cantarella has 3 points of Shiver when in [c=Highlight]Mirage[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] becomes [c=Highlight]Perception Drain[/c].
Consume all Shiver to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], considered Basic Attack DMG. Send the target into [c=Highlight]Hazy Dream[/c] and heal all Resonators in the team.
Casting this skill is also considered as casting [c=Highlight]Echo Skill[/c].
Can be cast in mid-air.
 
[c=Title]Abyssal Rebirth[/c]
After casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c], Cantarella enters [c=Highlight]Abyssal Rebirth[/c], which lasts for 25s and can be activated once every 25s. In the duration, for up to 6 times, when Resonators in the team cast [c=Highlight]Echo Skill[/c], Cantarella recovers 6 points of Concerto Energy. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once.
When in water, Cantarella's swimming speed increases and STA cost decreases.
 
[c=Title]Trance[/c]
- Cantarella can hold up to 5 points of Trance.
- Casting [c=Highlight]Intro Skill[/c] recovers 1 point of Trance.
- Hitting a target with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c] recovers 1 point of Trance.
- Casting Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Graceful Step[/c] recovers 1 point of Trance.
- Casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Flowing Suffocation[/c] recovers 3 points of Trance.
- When in the water, recover 1 point of Trance every 5s.
 
[c=Title]Shiver[/c]
- Cantarella can hold up to 3 points of Shiver.
- Hitting the target with Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Phantom Sting[/c] recovers 1 point of Shiver.
- When Mid-air Attack [c=Highlight]Abysmal Vortex[/c] or Dodge Counter [c=Highlight]Shadowy Sweep[/c] hits a target, restore 1 point of Shiver.

skills.name: "Cure"
skills.description: Increase Healing Bonus by 20%.

skills.name: "Poison"
skills.description: Casting [c=Highlight]Echo Skill[/c] gives 6% Havoc DMG Bonus for 10s, stacking up to 2 times.

sequences.name: Embrace the Endless Waves
sequences.description: Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] recovers 1 points of Trance. The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Graceful Step[/c], Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Flickering Reverie[/c], and Forte Circuit [c=Highlight]Perception Drain[/c] is increased by 50%. Immune to interruptions while casting [c=Highlight]Perception Drain[/c].

sequences.name: Surrender to the Illusive Reverie
sequences.description: Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Flowing Suffocation[/c] now sends the target into [c=Highlight]Hazy Dream[/c]. The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Jolt[/c] triggered by Cantarella is increased by 245%.

sequences.name: Gaze into the Abyss
sequences.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Flowing Suffocation[/c] is increased by 370%. After casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Flowing Suffocation[/c], enter into [c=Highlight]Mirage[/c]. If already in [c=Highlight]Mirage[/c], casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Flowing Suffocation[/c] does not activate the Mirage state again.

sequences.name: Behold Your Own Soul
sequences.description: When in [c=Highlight]Mirage[/c], Healing Bonus is increased by 25%.

sequences.name: Rest in Your Reflection
sequences.description: The maximum number of [c=Highlight]Dreamweavers[/c] Cantarella can summon through Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Diffusion[/c] is increased by 5.

sequences.name: Fall, Fall... and Fall Deeper into the Dream
sequences.description:
Increase the DMG Multiplier of Basic Attack [c=Highlight]Phantom Sting[/c] by 80%. Casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Flowing Suffocation[/c] makes Cantarella's DMG ignore 30% of the target's DEF for 10s.
For the first 1.2s of [c=Highlight]Hazy Dream[/c], when the target takes an instance of DMG that does not inflict [c=Highlight]Hazy Dream[/c], [c=Highlight]Jolt[/c] will not be triggered on the target.

skills.name: Movement of Life and Death
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack[/c]
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
When performing [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c], enter [c=Highlight]Reincarnate[/c] state.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack[/c]
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Scarlet Coda[/c]
Phrolova enters the [c=Highlight]Compose[/c] state every 25s.
When the following 3 conditions are met, [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Scarlet Coda[/c].
- Has 6 [c=Highlight]Volatile Notes[/c].
- In the [c=Highlight]Compose[/c] state.
- Not in the [c=Highlight]Resolving Chord[/c] state.

[c=Highlight]Scarlet Coda[/c]: Consume STA to deal [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], Stagnating and pulling in nearby targets. This instance of damage is considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill DMG[/c].
Each stack of [c=Highlight]Aftersound[/c] additionally increases the DMG Multiplier of this instance of damage.
Casting this skill is considered as casting [c=Highlight]Echo Skill[/c].
Casting this skill sends [c=Highlight]Compose[/c] state into cooldown and activates the [c=Highlight]Resolving Chord[/c] state.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack[/c]
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] after a successful [c=Highlight]Dodge[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c].

skills.name: Whispers in a Fleeting Dream
skills.description:
Attack the target and deal [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
Casting this skill sends Phrolova into [c=Highlight]Reincarnate[/c].

skills.name: Waltz of Forsaken Depths
skills.description:
[c=Title]Waltz of Forsaken Depths[/c]
Phrolova's max Resonance Energy is 0. [c=Highlight]Waltz of Forsaken Depths[/c] does not consume Resonance Energy.
When in the [c=Highlight]Resolving Chord[/c] state, [c=Highlight]Waltz of Forsaken Depths[/c] becomes available.
Casting this skill ends the [c=Highlight]Resolving Chord[/c] state, and Phrolova enters the [c=Highlight]Maestro[/c] state for 24s.

[c=Title]Maestro[/c]
Gain 120% ATK increase.
Phrolova floats in the air and commands Hecate to fight. Hecate will share Phrolova's stats and statuses, and damage dealt by Hecate will be considered coming from Phrolova. Hecate's attacks will not remove the target's Hazy Dream state.
During this period, Phrolova plays the [c=Highlight]Volatile Notes[/c] in turn. Each [c=Highlight]Volatile Note[/c] holds for 4s.
If Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, she can give the following cues to Hecate. Any damage taken by Hecate in this state affects Phrolova as well.
- [c=Highlight]Cue - Basic Attack[/c]: Press Normal Attack to command Hecate to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Hecate[/c]. When Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, for every 2 times Hecate casts [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Hecate[/c], the next [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Hecate[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Enhanced Attack - Hecate[/c].
- [c=Highlight]Cue - Dodge[/c]: Press Dodge to command Hecate to dodge an attack. Hecate takes no damage from a hit successfully Dodged.
- [c=Highlight]Cue - Reset[/c]: Press Jump to reset Hecate's position.
- [c=Highlight]Cue - Curtain Call[/c]: Press Resonance Liberation to command Hecate to cast [c=Highlight]Curtain Call[/c] and end the [c=Highlight]Maestro[/c] state.
When Phrolova is not the active Resonator, Hecate takes no damage and automatically casts [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Hecate[/c] to attack the target. When Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Hecate casts [c=Highlight]Enhanced Attack - Hecate[/c] to attack the target. This effect can be triggered up to 10 times in total during Phrolova's [c=Highlight]Maestro[/c] state. Echoes of the same name can trigger this effect 1 times.
Switching back to Phrolova ends [c=Highlight]Maestro[/c] state.
Ending [c=Highlight]Maestro[/c] state removes all [c=Highlight]Volatile Notes[/c].

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Hecate[/c]
Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] (considered [c=Highlight]Echo Skill DMG[/c]).

[c=Title]Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings[/c]
When Phrolova plays [c=Highlight]Volatile Note - Strings[/c], Hecate casts [c=Highlight]Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings[/c] when casting [c=Highlight]Enhanced Attack - Hecate[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] and Stagnating the targets (considered [c=Highlight]Echo Skill DMG[/c]).

[c=Title]Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds[/c]
When Phrolova plays [c=Highlight]Volatile Note - Winds[/c], Hecate casts [c=Highlight]Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds[/c] when casting [c=Highlight]Enhanced Attack - Hecate[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], pulling the targets in (considered [c=Highlight]Echo Skill DMG[/c]).

[c=Title]Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza[/c]
When Phrolova plays [c=Highlight]Volatile Note - Cadenza[/c], Hecate casts [c=Highlight]Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza[/c] when casting [c=Highlight]Enhanced Attack - Hecate[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], Stagnating and pulling the targets in (considered [c=Highlight]Echo Skill DMG[/c]).

[c=Title]Curtain Call[/c]
[c=Highlight]Curtain Call[/c] can be cast via the following 5 ways, Stagnating the targets and dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
- When Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, end the [c=Highlight]Maestro[/c] state.
- When Phrolova is in the [c=Highlight]Maestro[/c] state, switch to Phrolova without casting Intro Skill.
- When Phrolova is not the active Resonator and the [c=Highlight]Maestro[/c] state ends, switch to Phrolova without casting Intro Skill.
- When Phrolova is in the [c=Highlight]Maestro[/c] state, press Resonance Liberation.
- When Phrolova is in the [c=Highlight]Resolving Chord[/c] state, hold Resonance Liberation.
When in [c=Highlight]Resolving Chord[/c] state, casting [c=Highlight]Curtain Call[/c] removes all [c=Highlight]Volatile Notes[/c] and ends the [c=Highlight]Resolving Chord[/c] state.

skills.name: Suite of Quietus
skills.description:
[c=Title]Suite of Quietus[/c]
Attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c].

[c=Title]Suite of Immortality[/c]
When in the [c=Highlight]Maestro[/c] state, the next [c=Highlight]Suite of Quietus[/c] is replaced with [c=Highlight]Suite of Immortality[/c]. This replacement is cancelled if [c=Highlight]Curtain Call[/c] is cast while in this state. [c=Highlight]Suite of Immortality[/c] deals [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] (considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill DMG[/c]) and Stagnates the target.
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] shortly after casting this skill to cast [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c].

skills.name: Unfinished Piece
skills.description:
The incoming Resonator gains 20% Havoc DMG Amplification and 25% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification for 14s or until they are switched out.
If Phrolova is in [c=Highlight]Maestro[/c] state when she casts this skill, Hecate additionally casts [c=Highlight]Enhanced Attack - Hecate[/c] 2 times when Phrolova is switched off the field while in the same [c=Highlight]Maestro[/c] state duration.

skills.name: Tune Break: Rectifier
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: Rhapsody of a New World
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack - Movement of Fate and Finality[/c]
When in [c=Highlight]Reincarnate[/c], press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] on the ground to cast [c=Highlight]Movement of Fate and Finality[/c], which Stagnates the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] (considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill DMG[/c]) and ending [c=Highlight]Reincarnate[/c] afterward.

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Murmurs in a Haunting Dream[/c]
When in [c=Highlight]Reincarnate[/c], press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] on the ground to cast [c=Highlight]Murmurs in a Haunting Dream[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] (considered [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill DMG[/c]) and ending [c=Highlight]Reincarnate[/c] afterward.

[c=Title]Aftersound[/c]
Phrolova can hold up to 24 stacks of Aftersound.
When Phrolova is not the active Resonator, casting [c=Highlight]Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings[/c], [c=Highlight]Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds[/c], and [c=Highlight]Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza[/c] grants 1 stacks of Aftersound.
When Phrolova is out of combat, all stacks of Aftersound are removed every 30s.

[c=Title]Volatile Note[/c]
Phrolova can hold up to 6 [c=Highlight]Volatile Notes[/c]. When [c=Highlight]Volatile Notes[/c] reach the max number, gaining new [c=Highlight]Volatile Notes[/c] moves all [c=Highlight]Volatile Notes[/c] one slot to the left, and the leftmost [c=Highlight]Volatile Note - Strings[/c] or [c=Highlight]Volatile Note - Winds[/c] will be removed.
Hitting a target with [c=Highlight]Basic Attack Stage 3[/c] or [c=Highlight]Movement of Fate and Finality[/c] grants 1 [c=Highlight]Volatile Note - Strings[/c].
Hitting a target with Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Whispers in a Fleeting Dream[/c] or Resonance Skill [c=Highlight]Murmurs in a Haunting Dream[/c] grants 1 [c=Highlight]Volatile Note - Winds[/c].
When [c=Highlight]Inherent Skill - Accidental[/c] is activated, casting Suite of Quietus, Suite of Immortality, or Echo Skill grants 1 [c=Highlight]Volatile Note - Cadenza[/c].
Phrolova cannot obtain [c=Highlight]Volatile Notes[/c] during [c=Highlight]Resolving Chord[/c].

skills.name: Accidental
skills.description:
Casting [c=Highlight]Echo Skill[/c] grants increased resistance to interruption and reduces damage taken by 30% for 15s.
After casting [c=Highlight]Suite of Quietus[/c], [c=Highlight]Suite of Immortality[/c], and [c=Highlight]Echo Skill[/c], the next [c=Highlight]Volatile Note[/c] becomes [c=Highlight]Volatile Note - Cadenza[/c].

skills.name: Octet
skills.description:
Obtain 10 stacks of [c=Highlight]Aftersound[/c] upon entering battle. This effect cannot be triggered again within 4s after exiting the combat state. For every 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Aftersound[/c], Crit. DMG is increased by 2.5%.
When [c=Highlight]Aftersound[/c] reaches the max, each new stack of [c=Highlight]Aftersound[/c] increases Phrolova's Crit. DMG by 1%, up to 100%. The increased Crit. DMG is removed when [c=Highlight]Aftersound[/c] stacks are cleared.

sequences.name: A Key to Netherworld's Secrets
sequences.description:
The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Movement of Fate and Finality[/c] is increased by 80%.
The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Murmurs in a Haunting Dream[/c] is increased by 80%.
If Phrolova has less than 2 [c=Highlight]Volatile Notes[/c] when she is not in the [c=Highlight]Maestro[/c] state and stays out of combat for 4s, she gains [c=Highlight]Volatile Note - Cadenza[/c] until she has at least 2 [c=Highlight]Volatile Notes[/c].

sequences.name: A Rope Tied to a Life Beyond
sequences.description:
The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Scarlet Coda[/c] is increased by 75%. [c=Highlight]Aftersound[/c] now additionally increases the DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Scarlet Coda[/c] by 75%.
Casting [c=Highlight]Scarlet Coda[/c] grants 14 stacks of [c=Highlight]Aftersound[/c].

sequences.name: A Dagger to Cut Clean Obsessions
sequences.description:
Echo Skill DMG is Amplified by 80%.
Casting [c=Highlight]Scarlet Coda[/c] will convert all [c=Highlight]Volatile Notes[/c] to [c=Highlight]Volatile Notes - Cadenza[/c] in turn. Targets hit by [c=Highlight]Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza[/c] will have their ATK reduced by 20% for 15s.

sequences.name: A Torch Illuminating the Path
sequences.description: Casting [c=Highlight]Echo Skill[/c] grants 20% Attribute DMG Bonus for all Resonators in the team for 30s.

sequences.name: A Forked Road in Fate's Heartland
sequences.description:
Upon entering the [c=Highlight]Maestro[/c] state, generate a field to Stagnate the nearby targets, which lasts for 4s. Leaving the [c=Highlight]Maestro[/c] state or switching to other Resonators removes the Stagnation effect early.
Damage taken during the [c=Highlight]Maestro[/c] state is reduced by 30%.

sequences.name: A Night to Depart From Eternal Rest
sequences.description:
The DMG Multiplier of [c=Highlight]Enhanced Attack - Hecate[/c] is increased by 24%. 

During [c=Highlight]Movement of Fate and Finality[/c] and [c=Highlight]Murmurs in a Haunting Dream[/c], command Hecate to cast 1 [c=Highlight]Apparition of Beyond - Hecate[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] equal to 216.42% of Phrolova's ATK (considered [c=Highlight]Echo Skill DMG[/c]) and granting 8 stacks of [c=Highlight]Aftersound[/c] on hit.

If Phrolova is not the active Resonator during the [c=Highlight]Maestro[/c] state, targets take 40% more DMG from Hecate and Phrolova. If Phrolova is the active Resonator during the [c=Highlight]Maestro[/c] state, gain 60% Havoc DMG Bonus.

skills.name: Succor and Smite
skills.description:
[c=Title]Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] repeatedly or hold it down to consume [c=Highlight]Melody[/c] and perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. While [c=Highlight]Melody[/c] is not depleted, the Energy Regen is increased by 20% when [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance[/c] deals damage.
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 4[/c] applies 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c] to the targets hit.

[c=Title]Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] repeatedly or hold it down to consume [c=Highlight]Melody[/c] and perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. While [c=Highlight]Melody[/c] is not depleted, the Energy Regen is increased by 20% when [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance[/c] deals damage.
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 4[/c] applies 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c] to the targets hit.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Azure Sword Stance[/c]
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, consuming [c=Highlight]Melody[/c] and dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
Pressing [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a short time after casting this skill triggers [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Feather Sword Stance[/c]
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, consuming [c=Highlight]Melody[/c] and dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
Pressing [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a short time after casting this skill triggers [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Azure Sword Stance[/c]
Pressing [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a short time after a successful Dodge consumes [c=Highlight]Melody[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
Pressing [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a short time after casting this skill triggers [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 3[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Azure Sword Stance[/c] counts as casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 2[/c].

[c=Title]Dodge Counter - Feather Sword Stance[/c]
Pressing [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a short time after a successful Dodge consumes [c=Highlight]Melody[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].
Pressing [c=Highlight]Normal Attack[/c] within a short time after casting this skill triggers [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 3[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Feather Sword Stance[/c] counts as casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 2[/c].

skills.name: Feather's Edge
skills.description:
[c=Title]Sword Stance Switch[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Azure Sword Stance[/c], press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to switch to [c=Highlight]Feather Sword Stance[/c] and perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 1[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].

While in [c=Highlight]Feather Sword Stance[/c], press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to switch to [c=Highlight]Azure Sword Stance[/c] and perform [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 1[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c].

[c=Title]Sword Stance Switch: Azure[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] within a short time after casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance[/c] to switch to [c=Highlight]Azure Sword Stance[/c] and cast [c=Highlight]Sword Stance Switch: Azure[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack DMG[/c].
A successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 [c=Highlight]Melody[/c].
After casting this skill, the Basic Attack cycle will not reset for a short time.

[c=Title]Sword Stance Switch: Feather[/c]
Press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] within a short time after casting [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance[/c] to switch to [c=Highlight]Feather Sword Stance[/c] and cast [c=Highlight]Sword Stance Switch: Feather[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack DMG[/c].
A successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 [c=Highlight]Melody[/c].
After casting this skill, the Basic Attack cycle will not reset for a short time.

skills.name: Hush of a Thousand Voices
skills.description:
[c=Title]Hush of a Thousand Voices[/c]
Consume all [c=Highlight]Melody[/c] to deal [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] and restore 1 point of [c=Highlight]Azure Plume[/c]. This DMG is considered [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack DMG[/c].

Upon casting this skill, obtain [c=Highlight]Voice upon Voice[/c]. When casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure[/c] or [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather[/c], summon [c=Highlight]Shadow of Xuanling[/c] to attack the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack DMG[/c].
[c=Highlight]Voice upon Voice[/c] cannot stack. Once [c=Highlight]Shadow of Xuanling[/c] is summoned, the [c=Highlight]Voice upon Voice[/c] state is removed.

skills.description:
Deal [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] and restore 1 points of [c=Highlight]Azure Plume[/c].
When [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Skybound Feather[/c] deals damage, it applies 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c] on the target.

skills.name: As the Wind Wills
skills.description:
Attacks the target, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] equal to 300% of Yangyang: Xuanling's ATK.
All Resonators in the team other than Yangyang: Xuanling gains [c=Highlight]Tonal Switch[/c] for 20s. After a Resonator with [c=Highlight]Tonal Switch[/c] inflicts [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c], that Resonator's Havoc DMG is Amplified by 20%.
This effect is reset upon casting this skill again.

skills.name: Tune Break - Sword
skills.description: When the target's [c=Highlight]Off-Tune Level[/c] is full, the Resonator may cast [c=Highlight]Tune Break[/c] on the target.

skills.name: The Way of Ten Thousand Voices
skills.description:
[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure[/c]
Yangyang: Xuanling is in [c=Highlight]Azure Sword Stance[/c] by default. When [c=Highlight]Melody[/c] is depleted while in [c=Highlight]Feather Sword Stance[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Feather's Edge[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to switch to  [c=Highlight]Azure Sword Stance[/c] and cast [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] and restoring 100 points of [c=Highlight]Melody[/c] and 1 points of [c=Highlight]Azure Plume[/c]. This instance of DMG is considered [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack DMG[/c].
When [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure[/c] hits the target, consume 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c] on the target.
The [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance[/c] cycle is not reset within a short time after casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure[/c]. If casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure[/c] resets the cycle, summon a [c=Highlight]Wraith of Sound[/c] to finish the current attack and deal a fixed instance of [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c], which is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects and does not inflict [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c].
Successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 points of [c=Highlight]Melody[/c].

[c=Title]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather[/c]
When [c=Highlight]Melody[/c] is depleted while in [c=Highlight]Azure Sword Stance[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Feather's Edge[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather[/c].
Press [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill[/c] to switch to [c=Highlight]Feather Sword Stance[/c] and cast [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c] and restoring 100 points of [c=Highlight]Melody[/c] and 1 points of [c=Highlight]Azure Plume[/c]. This instance of DMG is considered [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack DMG[/c].
When [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather[/c] hits, consume 1 stacks of [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c] on the target.
The [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance[/c] cycle is not reset within a short time after casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather[/c]. If casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather[/c] resets the cycle, summon a [c=Highlight]Wraith of Sound[/c] to finish the current attack and deal a fixed instance of [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Basic Attack DMG[/c], which is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects and does not inflict [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c].
Successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 points of [c=Highlight]Melody[/c].

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance[/c]
When [c=Highlight]Azure Plume[/c] is restored to its maximum while in [c=Highlight]Azure Sword Stance[/c], hold Normal Attack to consume STA and all [c=Highlight]Azure Plume[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance[/c], generating a massive cyclone that strikes the area in front, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack DMG[/c].
When casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance[/c], gain [c=Highlight]Bated Breath[/c]: If Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the field, the Crit. DMG of this [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance[/c] increases by 160%. When [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance[/c] ends, [c=Highlight]Bated Breath[/c] is removed. [c=Highlight]Bated Breath[/c] can be gained up to once every 25s.
[c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance[/c] applies 2 stacks of [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c] to the targets hit.

[c=Title]Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance[/c]
When [c=Highlight]Azure Plume[/c] is restored to its maximum while in [c=Highlight]Feather Sword Stance[/c], if Yangyang: Xuanling is on the ground and not in a [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom[/c] cycle, hold Normal Attack to consume STA and cast [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c]. After it hits a target, [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall[/c] is automatically cast.
When casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance[/c], gain [c=Highlight]Streaming Storm[/c], which lasts 15s. While Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the team, the Crit. DMG of this [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance[/c] or the next [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom[/c], or [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom[/c] is increased by 160%. [c=Highlight]Streaming Storm[/c] is removed when [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom[/c] Stage 3 or [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom[/c] Stage 3 ends. [c=Highlight]Streaming Storm[/c] can be gained up to once every 25s.
[c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance[/c] applies 2 stacks stacks of [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c] to the targets hit.

[c=Title]Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall[/c]
When [c=Highlight]Azure Plume[/c] is restored to its maximum while in [c=Highlight]Feather Sword Stance[/c] and airborne,  [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Feather Sword Stance[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall[/c].
Press or hold Normal Attack to consume STA and all [c=Highlight]Azure Plume[/c] to cast [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall[/c], dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack DMG[/c]. Casting [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall[/c] enters [c=Highlight]Hark the Wind[/c] for 12s.

[c=Title]Hark the Wind[/c]
While in [c=Highlight]Feather Sword Stance[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance[/c] is replaced by [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom[/c], which performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing [c=Dark]Havoc DMG[/c], considered [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack DMG[/c].
[c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom[/c] Stage 2 and Stage 3 can be cast in mid-air close to the ground. Casting Stage 3 ends [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom[/c]. This attack cycle cannot be reset.
During [c=Highlight]Hark the Wind[/c], a Dodge Counter counts towards the [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom[/c] cycle.

[c=Title]Feathered Oath[/c]
When nearby Resonators in the team inflict [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c] on a target, Yangyang: Xuanling gains 1 stack of [c=Highlight]Feathered Oath[/c] for 4s. [c=Highlight]Feathered Oath[/c] can be gained once every 1s, stacking up to 6 times. While Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the team, each stack increases the Crit. DMG of [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance[/c], [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom[/c], and [c=Highlight]Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom[/c] by 25%, up to 150%.

[c=Title]Refrain[/c]
Before Yangyang: Xuanling's [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 4[/c], [c=Highlight]Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 4[/c], [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance[/c], or [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance[/c] hits a target, record and propagate the highest stack count of [c=Highlight]Havoc Bane[/c] on targets within a certain range to all targets within range.

[c=Title]Melody[/c]
[c=Highlight]Melody[/c] has a maximum of 100 points.
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure[/c] or [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather[/c] restores 100 points of [c=Highlight]Melody[/c].
Casting Resonance Liberation [c=Highlight]Hush of a Thousand Voices[/c] consumes all [c=Highlight]Melody[/c].
[c=Highlight]Normal Attacks[/c] consumes [c=Highlight]Melody[/c] upon dealing damage.
Successful Dodge can be triggered during the action of [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Azure[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Feather[/c], [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure[/c], or [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather[/c] within a certain time of casting these skills, which consumes 50 points of [c=Highlight]Melody[/c].

[c=Title]Azure Plume[/c]
[c=Highlight]Azure Plume[/c] has a maximum of 2 points.
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure[/c],  [c=Highlight]Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather[/c], or [c=Highlight]Intro Skill - Skybound Feather[/c] restores 1 points of [c=Highlight]Azure Plume[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Resonance Liberation - Hush of a Thousand Voices[/c] restores 1 points of [c=Highlight]Azure Plume[/c].
Casting [c=Highlight]Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance[/c] or [c=Highlight]Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall[/c] consumes all [c=Highlight]Azure Plume[/c].

Upon using Outro Skill, increases the ATK of the next Resonator by 22.5% for 15s.

Resonance Skill DMG + 12%
Casting Resonance Skill grants 22.5% Glacio DMG Bonus for 15s and casting Resonance Liberation increases Resonance Skill DMG by 18%, lasting for 5s. This effect stacks up to 2 times.
Spectro DMG + 10%
Inflicting Spectro Frazzle on enemies increases Crit. Rate by 20% for 15s. Attacking enemies inflicted with 10 stacks of Spectro Frazzle grants 15% Spectro DMG Bonus for 15s.
Havoc DMG + 10%
When Outro Skill is triggered, deal additional 480% Havoc DMG to surrounding enemies, considered Outro Skill DMG, and grant the incoming Resonator 15% Havoc DMG Bonus for 15s.
Energy Regen + 10%
Increase the Resonator's Coordinated Attack DMG by 80%. Upon a critical hit of Coordinated Attack, increase the active Resonator's ATK by 20% for 4s.
Energy Regen + 10%
Increase the Resonator's ATK by 15%. Reaching 250% Energy Regen increases all Attribute DMG by 30% for the Resonator.
Aero DMG + 10%
Inflicting Aero Erosion upon enemies increases Aero DMG for all Resonators in the team by 15%, and for the Resonator triggering this effect by an additional 15%, lasting for 20s.
Aero DMG + 10%
Hitting a target with Aero Erosion increases Crit. Rate by 10% and grants 30% Aero DMG Bonus, lasting for 10s.
Fusion DMG + 10%
Casting Resonance Liberation grants all Resonators in the team 15% Fusion DMG Bonus and the caster 20% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus, lasting for 35s.
Holding 0 Resonance Energy increases Crit. Rate by 20% and grants 35% Echo Skill DMG Bonus.
Upon gaining a Shield, increase the Resonator's ATK by 6% and Crit. DMG by 4% for 4s. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s and stacks up to 5 times.

Casting Echo Skill grants 30% Heavy Attack DMG Bonus to the caster for 4s.
Additionally, all Resonators in the team gain 4% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for 30s, stacking up to 4 times. Echoes of the same name can only trigger this effect once. The record of Echo triggering this effect is cleared along with this effect. At 4 stacks, casting Echo Skill again resets the duration of this effect.

Dealing Echo Skill DMG increases Heavy Attack Crit. Rate by 20% for 6s. Dealing Heavy Attack DMG increases Echo Skill Crit. Rate by 20% for 6s. While both effects are active, gain 16% Fusion DMG Bonus.
Inflicting Havoc Bane increases the Resonator's ATK by 20% and grants 30% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus for 5s.
Spectro DMG + 10%

Casting Outro Skill increases the ATK of the incoming Resonator who casts Intro Skill by 15%. Each point of Tune Break Boost the incoming Resonator has additionally increases their ATK by 0.3%, up to 15%. This effect lasts for 15s, or until the Resonator is switched out.
Healing Bonus + 10%.
When healing a Resonator in the team, every 1% of Off-Tune Buildup Rate grants a 0.2% ATK increase to all Resonators in the team for 4s, up to 25%. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.
Spectro DMG + 10%
Dealing Basic Attack DMG increases Spectro DMG by 10% for 5s, stacking up to 3 times. With 3 stacks, casting Resonance Liberation grants 40% Basic Attack DMG Bonus.
Fusion DMG + 10%
Inflicting Fusion Burst or Tune Rupture - Shifting increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate by 20% and grants 20% Fusion DMG Bonus for 8s.
Fusion DMG + 10%

When the Resonator inflicts Fusion Burst on the enemies, they gain the following effects: Gain 10% Fusion DMG Bonus for 15 s. While this effect is active, casting an Outro Skill grants the incoming Resonator 25% Fusion DMG Bonus for 15s.
Aero DMG + 10%
Dealing Echo Skill DMG to enemies increases the Resonator's Echo Skill Crit. Rate by 20%, and grants 15% Aero DMG Bonus for 5s.
Glacio DMG + 10%

Inflicting Glacio Chafe on enemies increases Glacio DMG dealt by 10% for 15s. The Resonator gains the Snowfall effect for 15s, which can be triggered once every 25s. While Snowfall is active:
- Dealing Resonance Liberation DMG removes Snowfall and increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate by 25% for 6s. While the effect is active, dealing Resonance Liberation DMG extends its duration by 4s, triggered once every 0.5s, up to 6 times.
- Casting Outro Skill removes Snowfall and grants 25% Glacio DMG Bonus to the incoming Resonator for 15s.
When Snowfall is removed, only one of the effects above can be triggered.
ATK + 10%
Inflicting Tune Rupture - Shifting or Tune Strain - Shifting on enemies increases the Tune Break Boost of Resonators in the team by 20 for 30s. Effects of the same name do not stack.
Inflicting Hack - Shifting on the target grants 35% Basic Attack DMG Bonus and Heavy Attack DMG Bonus for 15s.
Energy Regen + 10%

Upon inflicting Havoc Bane, gain Xuanling's Feather, which grants a 20% increase in Crit. Rate and 35% increase in Heavy Attack DMG Bonus to the Resonator, lasting 15s.
Upon inflicting Glacio Chafe, gain Chongming's Feather, which grants a 0.1% increase in ATK to Resonators in the team for every 1% of the Resonator's Energy Regen, up to 25%, lasting 10s.
Aero DMG + 10%
Inflicting Tune Strain - Shifting increases Crit. DMG by 20% and Aero DMG Bonus 30% for 15s.
Upon gaining a Shield, gain 5% increase in Crit. Rate for 5s, max 4 stacks. This effect can be triggered every 0.5s. At max stacks, gain 15% Fusion DMG Bonus.
Electro DMG + 10%
Inflicting Electro Flare on the target, obtaining Unison, or triggering Unison Response increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate by 15% and grants them 22.5% Electro DMG for 30s.
Electro DMG + 10%

When the Resonator inflicts Electro Flare on enemies, they gain the following effects: Gain 10% Electro DMG Bonus for 15s. While this effect is active, casting Outro Skill grants the incoming Resonator 25% Electro DMG Bonus for 15s.
Healing + 10%

Healing a Resonator in the team increases the ATK of all Resonators in the team by 10% for 30s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked. While the effect is active, if the Resonator gains Unison or triggers Unison Response, their ATK is further increased by 15%.
